HUMAN RESOURCES GENERALIST

Department: Corporate Affairs – Human Resources

Reports To: Director, Human Resources

Employment Type: Full-Time

FLSA Classification: Non-Exempt

Location: Remote / Hybrid (TBD)

About ASI

Advanced Strategic Insight, Inc. (ASI) delivers mission-critical tactical and technical solutions to address our customers' most challenging and complex problem sets.

At ASI, we pride ourselves on anticipating future operational needs and delivering innovative solutions that enhance warfighter capabilities and decision advantage. Our success depends on attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional professionals who share our commitment to excellence, integrity, and mission success.

Position Summary

ASI is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Human Resources Generalist to support the company's growing workforce and HR operations.

Reporting directly to the Director of Human Resources, this position will serve as a key operational resource responsible for coordinating talent acquisition activities, administering employee benefits programs, and supporting compliance with federal, state, and local employment regulations, and perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Director of Human Resources to support departmental operations, organizational priorities, and evolving business needs.

The ideal candidate is a resourceful HR professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates sound judgment when handling confidential information, and can independently manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.

This position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively with leadership, employees, candidates, and external service providers.

Key Responsibilities

1. Talent Acquisition & Recruiting

  • Coordinate the full recruiting lifecycle, including job postings, candidate sourcing, applicant screening, interview scheduling, and candidate communications.
  • Partner with the HR Director, Division Vice Presidents, Team Leads, and hiring managers to understand staffing requirements and recruitment priorities.

2. Employee Benefits Administration

  • Support the day-to-day administration of ASI's employee benefits programs, including retirement and other employer-sponsored benefits.

3.Human Resources Compliance

  • Support compliance with applicable federal, state, and local employment laws, regulations, and reporting requirements. Escalate potential compliance concerns, missing documentation, and regulatory risks to the HR Director.
  • Maintain accurate and complete employee personnel files, employment documentation, and required HR records.

4. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Support

  • Coordinate onboarding activities, including new-hire documentation, BambooHR task assignments, communications, and tracking completion of outstanding tasks with new hires, supervisors, and department leadership.
  • Assist with employee offboarding, including separation documentation, exit checklists, equipment return coordination, and benefits-related notifications; monitor and respond to employee inquiries on HR-related topics.
  • Develop and maintain HR procedures, checklists, templates, and resources while identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, automate processes, and improve HR efficiency.

Required Qualifications

  • Associate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in human resources, recruiting coordination, benefits administration, or a related administrative HR function.
  • Working knowledge of HR processes, employee benefits administration, and general employment compliance requirements.
  • Experience using a Human Resources Information System (HRIS) or Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail, accuracy, and confidentiality.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a distributed team.
  • Strong customer service skills and a professional approach to employee and candidate interactions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • SHRM-CP, PHR, aPHR, or other relevant HR certification.
  • Experience with BambooHR, including HRIS, ATS, onboarding, benefits, and reporting functions.
  • Experience supporting a federal government contractor or defense industry organization.
  • Familiarity with recruiting candidates for technical, engineering, military, and government contracting positions.
  • Experience supporting employees across multiple states.
  • Familiarity with 401(k) administration and employee benefits eligibility requirements.
  • Knowledge of federal contractor compliance requirements, including OFCCP-related obligations where applicable.
  • Experience with HR reporting, process improvement, and administrative workflow automation.

Additional Information

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. ASI reserves the right to modify job responsibilities based on organizational and operational needs.

jobs.title: QA Engineer - Backend & Frontend
jobs.excerpt: At Qu you’ll find a fun, dynamic, and diverse culture that celebrates team and individual success.
jobs.description:
At Qu you’ll find a fun, dynamic, and diverse culture that celebrates team and individual success. Our people are down to earth, trail blazin’ folks who value innovation.

While mostly virtual, we collaborate closely to produce leading-edge software solutions much needed in the restaurant industry.

Our technology team is a rapidly growing group of talented and experienced engineers building the leading enterprise software company focused on restaurant technology. We use modern technologies, automation, and AI-assisted engineering practices to build products that power restaurant operations at scale.

We are looking for a hands-on QA Engineer who is strong in both manual and automated testing, across backend APIs and frontend UIs. You'll test end-to-end flows that cross several Qu products, such as an order that starts in POS or web ordering and ends on the kitchen display. You'll make sure every case is tested at the right level, from API checks to end-to-end and manual tests.

You'll work inside QuDLC, Qu's AI-first delivery lifecycle. AI agents refine each story, propose its test cases, and write the tests before the code; people decide at review gates, on evidence. As the team's quality engineer, you own two of those gates: you approve the test cases before development starts, and you sign off the story when the test results are in.

What You'll Do Here

  • Review the test cases AI agents propose from each story's acceptance criteria: tighten vague steps, add missing negative and edge cases, and approve them in AIO Tests.
  • Review each story's test plan before development starts: the right test level for every case (unit, API, end-to-end or manual), and which existing tests to reuse, update or retire.
  • Review, debug and fix the backend API and frontend UI tests that agents write in TypeScript and Playwright. Keep the shared fixtures, page objects and API clients healthy, and the smoke suite focused on critical paths.
  • Run exploratory testing and the cases that stay manual, then sign off each story using the pipeline's results: smoke tests, the story's own tests and the AIO Tests run.
  • Test end-to-end flows across services, such as POS, web ordering, the in-store server and the kitchen display, including scheduled and multi-channel orders.
  • Investigate failing, flaky and blocked tests: read the pipeline's diagnosis, separate environment, test data and product issues, and fix the test plan or cases when they are the cause.
  • Give feedback that improves how the AI agents write test cases and tests.
  • Answer testing questions during story refinement, and partner with developers and product managers on release validation.

Experience We're Looking For

  • 4+ years in QA or Quality Engineering, with hands-on experience in both manual testing and test automation.
  • Strong test design and exploratory testing: turning acceptance criteria into clear test cases, finding edge and negative cases, and writing defect reports with precise repro steps.
  • Knowledge of test levels (unit, integration, API, end-to-end) and when to use each.
  • Hands-on UI and API automation with Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, including the Page Object Model, REST APIs and JSON payloads.
  • Programming skills in TypeScript or JavaScript, or in another language such as Java or Python with readiness to work in TypeScript; strong enough to review and fix test code you didn't write.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (ideally Azure DevOps), Git and pull request reviews, and with debugging flaky tests and environment issues.
  • Hands-on experience reviewing AI-generated test cases, tests or code, and deciding on evidence whether to trust them.
  • Clear written and spoken English, and experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.

Bonus Experience

  • Experience with agentic development tools such as Kiro, or with AI-first delivery workflows where agents generate tests and code.
  • Experience with test-first development (TDD), where tests fail before the code exists and pass after.
  • Experience with restaurant technology, POS, kitchen display systems or online ordering.
  • Experience testing systems where on-premise components sync with cloud services.
  • Experience with test management and traceability tools such as AIO Tests or TestRail.
  • PowerShell or other scripting to set up Windows test environments.
  • Experience with code-quality tooling: ESLint, Prettier and pre-commit hooks.

Technology Environment

  • TypeScript / Node.js
  • Playwright (UI and API tests)
  • REST API testing
  • Azure DevOps (Repos and Pipelines)
  • Git
  • Jira
  • AIO Tests (test case management)
  • ESLint, Prettier and pre-commit hooks
  • PowerShell (Windows test setup)
  • QuDLC (Qu's AI-first delivery lifecycle): Kiro agents in Azure Pipelines, human review gates, and an AI pull request reviewer

The Type of Team Player We Need

  • Proactive mindset with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
  • Passion for quality, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong analytical thinker and creative problem-solver.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.
  • Curious about AI-assisted software development, and careful to verify what AI produces.
  • Team-oriented professional who enjoys partnering across Engineering, Product, and QA disciplines.

jobs.description:
Redwood Finance Automation Engineer, Italy

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Italy. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will build what the solution design sets out. You will configure the close and reconciliation processes, build the integrations with the ERP and the systems around it, and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

Close processes built and configured end to end: task lists, dependencies, approvals and the automated steps between them. Automated account reconciliation, including matching rules and exception handling. Journal entry automation, from data preparation and validation through to posting in the ERP. Integration with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and other source systems, through standard connectors, file and API interfaces. Intercompany, accrual and reclassification steps automated alongside the close. Workflow logic in REL or JavaScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on delivery on Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance), where you built close, reconciliation or journal processes yourself on at least one live implementation. 5 or more years in finance systems or automation engineering. Working knowledge of SAP FI/CO postings and master data, or the Oracle equivalent, and where ERP integrations tend to break. Workflow scripting in REL or JavaScript, and hands-on ERP integration. A finance-side understanding of the record-to-report cycle and month-end controls.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood RunMyJobs workload automation. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A current Redwood certification. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and what you built yourself.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

Octus

Octus is a leading global provider of credit intelligence, data, and analytics. Octus hires growth-minded innovators and trailblazers across the globe to drive our business and culture. Role

We're hiring a hands-on Senior Cybersecurity Engineer to own the security technology that protects Octus employees, endpoints, and enterprise systems. You'll keep our security stack healthy and well tuned, and you'll harden the security settings in the business systems people use every day.

Our security team is small, so this role is broad. Your main focus is IT and enterprise security. You'll also work on cloud security, application security, incident response, vendor risk, and audits. Anyone who joins gets real exposure across the whole program.

You'll also help us secure AI tools. Octus uses AI heavily, and we want someone who can make tools like Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT safe to use at scale.

Responsibilities

Primary focus: IT and enterprise security

  • Own the care and feeding of our security tools. Tune policies, manage upgrades, fix integrations, and retire what we no longer need.
  • Manage endpoint security across Mac and Windows with Microsoft Defender, Intune, and Jamf Pro.
  • Manage Netskope policies for web, SaaS, and data loss prevention.
  • Harden identity in Okta and Microsoft Entra ID. This covers SSO, MFA, conditional access, privileged access, and admin access reviews.
  • Set and enforce security configuration in enterprise systems like Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and other SaaS apps.
  • Manage email security with Abnormal Security and Google Workspace controls.
  • Support secrets and credential management in 1Password.
  • Harden AI tools like Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT. Configure admin settings, connector and MCP controls, audit logging, and data protections.

Also in scope: the broader program

  • Build and tune detections in Google SecOps with our managed SOC partner.
  • Respond to incidents and lead post-incident reviews. Join the team on-call rotation. Calls are rare.
  • Track and drive remediation of cloud and code findings from Wiz and Snyk.
  • Partner with Engineering on AWS security and secure development practices.
  • Automate security work with Python, APIs, and workflow tools.
  • Collect evidence for SOC 2 and support client security reviews.
  • Assess security risk in new vendors and tools.
  • Mentor teammates and share what you learn across Technology.

Requirements

  • 6+ years in cybersecurity or security-focused IT engineering.
  • Hands-on experience running EDR and MDM tools across Mac and Windows fleets.
  • Strong working knowledge of identity platforms like Okta or Entra ID, including SSO, MFA, and conditional access.
  • Experience hardening SaaS platforms such as Google Workspace or Microsoft 365.
  • Experience with SSE or secure web gateway tools, and with DLP.
  • Experience tuning a SIEM and responding to security incidents.
  • Working knowledge of SOC 2, NIST CSF, and GDPR, and how technical controls support them.
  • Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell. Comfort working with REST APIs.
  • Clear writing and speaking with both technical and non-technical people.
  • Comfort working across many areas at once on a small team.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with our stack, including Okta, Microsoft Defender, Intune, Jamf Pro, Netskope, Google SecOps, or Wiz.
  • Experience hardening enterprise AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT, including MCP servers and connectors.
  • Experience building security automation or workflows that cut manual work.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, Security+, or a cloud security cert.

Our portfolio includes social entertainment platforms designed to connect people online across different cultures and regions of the world.

We bring together a team of like-minded people and IT professionals who specialize in creating and developing globally impactful social discovery products. Our international team of digital nomads works remotely from all over the world.

We’re proud to be a two-time “Great Place to Work” winner (USA & Japan, 2024–2025) and a Top-5 Company for Work-From-Anywhere Jobs (FlexJobs, 2025).

We are looking for a Deputy Chief Data Officer for the Research Center of the Core Business Unit — the #2 role in a data function that directly drives company P&L.

We see the Deputy CDO as a full-fledged successor to the CDO: a leader who can take over the function when needed. Together, the CDO and the Deputy CDO make sure we do the right things and that these things reach measurable results fast and predictably. The Deputy CDO owns execution across the function, leads part of the strategic initiatives personally and works directly with C-level executives. This is not a chief of staff or program manager role: we need a leader who goes deep into the substance of analytics, ML, data engineering, marketing analytics, UX research and experimentation, and turns strategy into business results.

We expect from you:

jobs.excerpt: THE ROLE: Vice President Sales & Partnerships Insights LOCATION: RemoteDEPARTMENT: Legends Global InsightsREPORTS TO: Insights Leadership ABOUT LEGENDS GLOBALLegends Global is the premier partner to the world’s greatest live events, venues, and brands.
jobs.description:
THE ROLE: Vice President Sales & Partnerships Insights

LOCATION: Remote

DEPARTMENT: Legends Global Insights

REPORTS TO: Insights Leadership

ABOUT LEGENDS GLOBAL

Legends Global is the premier partner to the world’s greatest live events, venues, and brands. We deliver a fully integrated suite of premium services through a white-label model that keeps our partners front and center — from feasibility and project development to sales, partnerships, hospitality, merchandise, venue management, and world-class content and booking.

With a global network of more than 450 venues, hosting 20,000 events and welcoming 165 million guests annually, Legends Global brings unmatched scale, expertise, and connectivity to help our partners grow. The Legends Global Way guides how we operate: Align, Scale, Connect, Team, Win — shared success, repeatable systems, connected solutions, unstoppable teams, and wins that are earned every day.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Vice President of Sales & Partnerships Insights will lead the insights and analytics function supporting Legends Global Sales and Global Partnerships, the teams responsible for sponsorship, premium, and ticket sales revenue across our client portfolio. This is a senior, highly visible role. You will be the analytics counterpart to our sales and partnership executives, to the venue leaders they serve, and to the clients whose revenue outcomes we are accountable for.

The role mirrors the model our Operational Insights leader has built on the Hospitality, Merchandise, and Venues side of the business. Where that function embedded analytics inside operations, you will do the same for the commercial side, standing up a consistent, scalable insights practice across a set of sales organizations that today operate with uneven data maturity. You will build the team, set the standards, and personally carry the most consequential executive conversations.

This leader will partner closely with our Central Insights function, which owns CRM, data science, AI, guest research, and other enterprise data capabilities, to ensure Consulting Insights draws on shared infrastructure and models rather than building in isolation. You will also work alongside our feasibility and consulting practice, which owns partnership valuation and market study work. The strength of this role is in the connective tissue: translating enterprise capability into commercial outcomes at the venue and client level.


WHAT YOU’LL DO (KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & OUTCOMES)

Executive Partnership & Influence

  • Serve as the primary insights partner to Global Sales and Global Partnerships executive leadership, translating commercial questions into analytical work and analytical work into decisions leaders will act on.
  • Build and own trusted relationships with venue leaders and property-level sales leadership, ensuring insights are adopted on the ground and not simply delivered from the center.
  • Represent the insights function in client-facing settings including pitches, renewals, annual business reviews, and property leadership meetings, with the credibility to be in the room when revenue decisions are made.
  • Set the agenda on what the business should be measuring rather than fulfilling requests as they arrive.

Partnership Sales Analytics

  • Own the reporting and measurement layer for partnership sales performance: pipeline, pacing, close rates, category coverage, and revenue against plan across the portfolio.
  • Build sponsor fulfillment and delivery analytics that show what a partner actually received, giving our sellers evidence to bring into renewal conversations.
  • Develop renewal risk, whitespace, and prospecting analytics that shape where partnership teams spend their time.
  • Standardize how partnership performance is defined and reported across properties so results are comparable, credible, and repeatable.
  • Partner with our feasibility and consulting practice on valuation and market study work, supplying the operating data and performance evidence their analysis depends on rather than duplicating it.

Ticketing & Premium Sales Analytics

  • Lead analytics supporting season, group, premium, and single-event ticket sales, including pricing strategy, demand and pacing forecasts, and inventory and yield management.
  • Partner with Central Insights to deploy lead scoring, propensity, churn, and retention models into the hands of sales teams through CRM, and drive adoption once they are there.
  • Build pipeline, productivity, and rep performance reporting that sales leaders use to manage their business week to week.
  • Support premium and new-build sales efforts with pricing, positioning, and take-rate analysis.

Team, Standards & Delivery

  • Recruit, develop, and lead a team of directors, managers, and embedded analysts supporting sales and partnership organizations across the portfolio.
  • Establish the operating model for the function: intake, prioritization, delivery standards, and the reporting layer every property can rely on.
  • Partner with Central Insights and enterprise data teams on data architecture, CRM data quality, model deployment, and AI-enabled tooling, ensuring the commercial side of the business has a clear and well-represented voice in enterprise roadmaps.
  • Bring thought leadership on emerging analytics, AI, and commercial measurement practices, and drive their adoption across the sales organization.

WHAT YOU BRING (QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE)

This is an analytics leadership role, not a sales role. We are looking for a leader whose depth is in analytics and insights, who has applied that depth to commercial problems and can hold their own with revenue executives.

  • 8+ years in analytics, insights, business intelligence, or quantitative consulting, including meaningful time interacting with senior organizational leadership
  • Demonstrated experience leading and scaling an analytics team, including managing director- or manager-level talent
  • Experience in sports, entertainment, live events, or venues is strongly preferred
  • Track record of building analytics that support revenue functions such as sponsorship, ticketing, premium, or media, and evidence that the work was adopted and changed decisions
  • Bachelor's and/or master's degree in business analytics, statistics, economics, or a related field
  • Experience building an analytics function where one did not previously exist, or standardizing analytics across a decentralized portfolio, is a strong differentiator

Core Skills

  • Executive Communication - The ability to take a complex analysis and land it in three minutes with a leader who has no interest in the methodology
  • Fluency in commercial analytics: pricing, forecasting, pipeline and funnel measurement, segmentation, and performance measurement
  • Hands-on analytical capability. SQL, Excel, Python, R, and Tableau experience is useful, though we care less about any specific tool than about the judgment to know what question to ask and whether an answer holds up
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted analytics tooling such as Claude Code, and a point of view on how it changes what a small analytics team can deliver
  • Strong understanding of CRM platforms (Salesforce) as both a data source and an adoption channel for analytics
  • Consultative stakeholder management. Able to develop, own, and expand relationships across internal leadership, venues, and clients

KEY LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES

  • A builder's instinct. Comfort standing up a function, setting standards, and creating structure where none exists.
  • Commercial judgment over analytical purity, and the willingness to give a leader a directionally right answer today rather than a perfect one next month.
  • Credibility with sellers. This role does not work if the sales organization does not want you in the room.
  • A collaborative posture toward Central Insights, Operational Insights, our feasibility and consulting practice, and peer insights leaders. Leverage the enterprise, do not rebuild it.
  • Curiosity about how data drives revenue, partner value, and fan engagement in live sports and entertainment.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Sales and partnership executives bring you into decisions early, on pricing, deal structure, and resourcing, rather than asking for a report after the fact.
  • A consistent measurement and reporting standard exists across properties, so partnership and ticketing performance can be compared and benchmarked portfolio-wide.
  • Sponsor renewals are supported by clear evidence of what was delivered and how it performed, and valuation work produced by our consulting practice is grounded in Legends operating data rather than external assumptions.
  • Models and tools built with Central Insights are adopted by sales teams in their daily workflow, with measurable impact on pipeline conversion and retention.
  • The function is staffed, developing talent, and no longer dependent on any single person, including you, to deliver.

COMPENSATION

Competitive salary, commensurate with experience, and a generous benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, paid vacation, and 401k plan.

The salary range for this position is $225,000 - $245,000 (+ performance bonus)

At Legends Global, our people power every success. You’ll work alongside exceptional talent, learn from world-leading experts, and contribute to projects that set the standard across sports, entertainment, hospitality, and live experiences. If you’re driven to operate at the highest level, build with purpose, and help partners win on the biggest stages, you’ll thrive here.


Legends Global is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer, and encourages Women, Minorities, Individuals with Disabilities, and protected Veterans to apply. VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Innovate with Tether

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We have launched Keet Mobile on iOS and Android, bringing our full P2P technology stack to everyone. Keet Mobile is not your average app: it’s heavy lifting is performed by a custom JS runtime specially designed for peer-to-peer usage (in fact, it reuses 100% of Keet Desktop’s code!). The UI logic, on the other hand, is 100% React Native, giving us flexibility and the ability to iterate quickly.

We believe this pattern opens the door to huge possibilities in the future, and we need your help getting there!

Responsibilities

In this role, you will develop and maintain Keet Mobile, our peer-to-peer chat and calling app for iOS and Android. Keet Mobile is built with React Native and Expo, and its P2P core runs on the device itself in a Bare worklet. You'll own features end to end, from UI/UX implementation to using the P2P core apis.

You will:

- Build and polish features across chat, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing and identity backup
- Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android
- Profile and optimise performance on real devices, including startup time, long chats, media handling, battery and network use
- Write unit and end-to-end tests, and help keep releases stable through CI and crash reporting
- Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for quality

Requirements

  • Significant experience with React Native, Redux for state management and Redux-Saga

  • Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.

  • Experienced with WebSockets, RESTful based APIs.

  • Knowledge in native languages (Swift/Kotlin) and familiarity with native build tools (Xcode/Android Studio) is advantageous.

  • Experience working with a remote team

  • Interested in modernizing and optimizing different mobile or web applications.

  • Bonus points if you have any built something amazing on any p2p frameworks .

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och förändra vården?

Då vill vi prata med dig!

Om den digitala tjänsten

Hej! Jag heter Maria Lundqvist och är verksamhetschef på Kry Digital. Jag tror på en enkel sak: vården blir bättre när vi vågar göra den annorlunda. I vår digitala tjänst jobbar vi nära varandra med hjälp av våra digitala verktyg. Det är lika självklart att be om hjälp som att komma med en ny idé. Vi är ett psykologteam på 50 medarbetare som delar samma övertygelse – att hög tillgänglighet, ny teknik och ett genuint fokus på kvalitet och patientnöjdhet inte är motsatser. Det bevisar vi varje dag.

Varför Kry?
Vi har förändrat hur vård bedrivs i Sverige i över tio år. Gjort den digital, tillgänglig och mer jämlik. Men vi är inte klara och det är poängen.På Kry tror vi att det modigaste du kan göra i vårdbranschen är att vara snäll. Och att de som kan vården ska styra den. Hos oss får du mandat att göra det - ta det, be inte om det.

Vad du faktiskt gör

I arbetet som digital psykolog på Kry ingår behandling, triagering och handläggning. Du tar emot patienter på primärvårdsnivå via videomöten samt finns som stöd via chatt till IKBT patienter. Du har stöd i form av riktlinjer, behandlingsmaterial, kollegor online samt handledning. Du genomför digitala konsultationer via vår plattform och du gör det på ett sätt som får patienter att känna sig sedda. Du samarbetar nära vårdcentralerna och övriga vårdflöden. Vi tror inte att digital och fysisk vård är varandras motpoler. De är varandras förutsättningar. Dina erfarenheter är med och formar hur vi arbetar, idag och framåt. Det kallar vi Kry-modellen.Läs mer om den här.

Vad vi förväntar oss av dig

  • Du är legitimerad psykolog med KBT-inriktning.

  • Du besitter erfarenhet från arbete inom primärvård, psykiatri eller företagshälsovård.

  • Du tar ansvar och får saker gjorda.

  • Du trivs i förändring och ser det som kul.

  • Du levererar vård med hög kvalitet och sätter patienten först.

  • Du är flytande i både svenska och engelska.

Praktiskt

Start: Vintern 2026

Ersättning:Ackordsbaserad lön/ arvode

Omfattning: flexibel % ej fast
Arbetstid:Alla dagar i veckan mellan kl 07-22

Är du redo?
Skicka din ansökan senast 31/12 2026. Vid eventuella frågor, vänligen ämnesraden "Rekrytering psykolog".

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Ta hand om dig ❤

jobs.excerpt: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution.
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether Wallet is our self-custodial wallet, built to bring USDT and XAUT directly to the people who rely on Tether every day, especially in markets where access to stable money and savings is hardest. For that to work, getting into these assets has to be simple, fast and affordable. Our goal is to give every Tether Wallet user the best option to exchange any local currency or token into USDT and XAUT, wherever they are.

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

  • Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.

  • Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.

  • Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.

  • Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.

  • Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.

  • Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.

  • Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • 5+ years of product management experience in the financial industry (banking, payment service provider, FinTech)

  • 3+ years of product management experience in DeFi or crypto industry

  • Good understanding of crypto wallets and DeFi features, including token swaps, DEX aggregators and on-chain transaction flows.

  • Good understanding of global payment systems and credit card schemes (e.g. Visa, Mastercard), including authorization, 3-D Secure and chargebacks, as well as local payment methods such as bank transfers, instant payment rails and mobile money.

  • Hands-on experience with fiat on-ramp, off-ramp or swap providers, or with integrating third-party payment providers and gateways into a consumer product.

  • Proven experience evaluating, selecting and onboarding external partners, and managing their performance after launch.

  • Working knowledge of KYC/AML requirements and how they affect user onboarding and conversion.

  • Technical enough to read partner API documentation, assess integration options and work closely with engineering teams.

  • Data-driven: experience defining funnel KPIs and using data to improve conversion and make partner decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, expansion teams and engineers across time zones in a remote environment.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Zayo Group is seeking a talented and motivated Software Engineer II to join our Network Automation Software Engineering team. Our team develops and maintains the software platforms, microservices, and automation solutions that enable the provisioning, configuration, and management of Zayo's large-scale telecommunications network infrastructure.


In this role, you will design, develop, test, and maintain software solutions that automate complex network operations and improve the efficiency and reliability of network service delivery. You will work primarily in Python, developing microservices that communicate through gRPC APIs defined using Protocol Buffers (Protobuf), and leverage Cisco Network Services Orchestrator (NSO) to automate network device configuration and service provisioning.


The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in software development, experience building and maintaining production applications, and is able to solve complex technical challenges. You will work across a broad range of teams to provide perspective on technical design and take ownership of software development tasks and features.


Key Responsibilities

Software Development & Architecture

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain Python-based applications and microservices supporting network automation and orchestration.
  • Develop and integrate gRPC-based services using Protocol Buffers to define APIs and service contracts.
  • Implement new features, enhancements, and integrations across software platforms.
  • Build reusable software components, libraries, and APIs that integrate with internal systems and network infrastructure.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-documented, and thoroughly tested code following SDLC best practices.
  • Troubleshoot software defects, investigate application issues, and implement reliable solutions.
  • Participate in technical design discussions and contribute ideas for improving application architecture, performance, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with technical and non-technical teams to develop solutions.

Network Automation & Orchestration

  • Develop and maintain automation solutions using Cisco NSO, including service packages, service models, and integrations with network devices.
  • Build software that interfaces with Cisco NSO APIs to support network configuration, provisioning, and service lifecycle operations.
  • Work with network engineering and operations teams to understand network requirements and translate them into automated workflows.
  • Develop and enhance automation that reduces manual configuration, minimizes errors, and accelerates service delivery.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues involving network automation workflows, system integrations, and device interactions.
  • Develop an understanding of Zayo’s network infrastructure, provisioning processes, and operational requirements.

DevOps & Infrastructure

  • Develop and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines supporting automated testing, application builds, and deployment.
  • Build, package, and deploy containerized applications using Docker, with services hosted through Docker Swarm.
  • Assist with monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintaining the reliability of production microservices.
  • Implement automated tests and participate in code reviews to ensure software quality.
  • Support continuous improvement of development workflows, deployment processes, and application reliability.
  • Work within established operational practices to identify and resolve production issues.

Collaboration & Professional Growth

  • Participate in an Agile development environment, including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, code reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, network engineers, product stakeholders, and operations teams to deliver automation solutions.
  • Take ownership of assigned features and development tasks, delivering quality solutions with appropriate testing and documentation.
  • Participate in peer code reviews and contribute constructive feedback.
  • Work with senior engineers to improve technical skills, learn new technologies, and develop a deeper understanding of the team’s systems and architecture.
  • Contribute to engineering best practices, technical documentation, and ongoing improvements to software quality and maintainability.
  • Communicate technical progress, challenges, and potential solutions clearly to team members and stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of professional software development experience, including experience developing, testing, and maintaining production applications.
  • Proficiency in Python, including object-oriented programming, common Python libraries, and software development best practices.
  • Experience developing or integrating APIs and backend services.
  • Familiarity with microservices architecture and distributed application concepts.
  • Understanding of software design principles, data structures, and common programming patterns.
  • Experience using Git-based source control and collaborative development workflows.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD processes, automated testing, and modern software delivery practices.
  • Experience working with Docker or similar containerization technologies.
  • Experience debugging applications, investigating software issues, and implementing fixes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively within a collaborative engineering team.
  • Ability to independently complete well-defined development tasks and contribute to moderately complex technical projects.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing gRPC services using Protocol Buffers (Protobuf).
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco Network Services Orchestrator (NSO), including Python APIs, service packages, or YANG models.
  • Experience with GitLab CI/CD and Docker Swarm.
  • Familiarity with network automation technologies and protocols such as NETCONF, RESTCONF, SSH, and YANG.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, MPLS, and BGP.
  • Experience with network provisioning, configuration management, or service activation systems.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems concepts such as service-to-service communication, asynchronous processing, retries, and error handling.
  • Experience with Linux systems and command-line tools.
  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, metrics, and application troubleshooting.
  • Experience with relational or non-relational databases.
  • Experience writing automated tests using frameworks such as pytest.
  • Experience working in an Agile software development environment.
  • Previous experience in telecommunications, network infrastructure, or related industries.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently deliver reliable, well-tested software features and enhancements that support network automation.
  • Develop a strong working knowledge of our Python microservices, gRPC APIs, and Cisco NSO integrations.
  • Take ownership of assigned development work from implementation through testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Effectively troubleshoot application issues and contribute to improving system reliability.
  • Collaborate with other engineers and network operations teams to solve technical challenges.
  • Demonstrate growing independence in technical problem-solving and implementation decisions.
  • Contribute to code quality, documentation, and continuous improvement across the engineering team.

Why Join Our Team?

At Zayo, network automation is essential to supporting the scale, reliability, and operational efficiency of our telecommunications infrastructure.

Our engineering team works at the intersection of modern software development and large-scale network infrastructure, building solutions that have a direct impact on how network services are provisioned, configured, and managed.


As a Software Engineer II, you will have the opportunity to work with Python-based microservices, gRPC, Cisco NSO, and containerized applications while collaborating with experienced engineers on meaningful technical challenges.

You'll gain hands-on experience with complex distributed systems, deepen your understanding of network automation, and have opportunities to expand your technical capabilities and responsibilities as you grow.

If you enjoy building software, solving practical engineering problems, and developing automation that makes a measurable difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Company Overview

At Continuous Composites Inc., we are Delivering the Future of Manufacturing. Our unique CF3D® technology for composite 3D printing opens new frontiers in Aerospace and Defense. We thrive on innovation, rapid iteration, and empowering every team member to take initiative and drive breakthrough solutions. Our mission is to transform industrial manufacturing through pioneering research, creative problem-solving, and relentless execution.

Position Overview

We are looking for a proven Aerospace and Defense business developer who knows where the government’s money is, how to shape it, and how to get CCI on contract fast. This role is measured on dollars of orders closed. The ideal person will thrive on bringing in business. Our sales are not transactional: dollar values are high, sales cycles are long and complex, and most wins require shaping requirements and funding before a solicitation exists.

Our CF3D® technology 3D prints continuous-fiber composites, both polymer matrix (PMC) and ceramic matrix (CMC), producing complex, lightweight, high-performance parts for hypersonics, missiles, propulsion, reentry, unmanned systems, and other demanding defense applications. You will work alongside our Sr. Director of Defense Strategy & Business Development and partner closely with Engineering, Applications, and Finance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Find and Create Funding: Identify and shape the budget lines, program office funds, and congressional adds that can pay for CCI’s technology, and position CCI in requirements before solicitations are released.
  • Get CCI on Contract Fast: Choose and execute the fastest path for each opportunity: SBIR/STTR (including Phase III sole-source), OTAs and consortia, CSOs, BAAs, STRATFI/TACFI, ManTech, direct awards, and congressionally directed funding.
  • Sell Directly and Through the Primes: Build relationships with program offices, labs, end users, and congressional staff, and get CCI written into prime contractors’ bids and programs through teaming and subcontract agreements.
  • Move Technology into Programs: Carry CCI from development and prototype awards to follow-on production and programs of record (PoR).
  • Lead Capture and Proposals: Own white papers, proposals, and pricing strategy with Engineering and Finance, including technical data rights and IP considerations.
  • Own the Pipeline: Build and forecast a qualified pipeline, track defense priorities and funding trends, and close orders.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, materials science, aerospace, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of experience in government business development, defense contracting, federal capture management, government-funded technology development, or a related field.
  • A Record of Closing: Personally closed government or defense orders in the last three to five years. You can name the awards, customers, dollar values, contract vehicles, and your role in winning them.
  • Long-Cycle Selling: Carried high-value pursuits from first contact through award.
  • Deep Contracting Knowledge: Hands-on fluency with FAR/DFARS, SBIR/STTR, OTAs, and other fast-path vehicles.
  • Funding Knowledge: Understanding of how program budgets are built, and how appropriations reach programs.
  • Government Network: Working relationships across several of: Air Force, Space Force, Army, Navy, Missile Defense Agency, DIU, DARPA, and the primes.
  • Technical Aptitude: Able to learn advanced materials and manufacturing well enough to explain CCI’s value and translate customer needs to Engineering. Deep product expertise is not required.
  • Strong Writing: Experience leading or substantially writing proposals and white papers.
  • Ability to Travel: ~50% Travel Required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Moving SBIR Phase I or II awards into Phase III, follow-on procurement, or production.
  • Prior DoD acquisition experience as a contracting officer, program manager, or legislative or budget liaison.
  • Experience securing congressional adds or working with appropriations staff.
  • Transitioning a new material or manufacturing process into a program of record, especially additive manufacturing or composites.
  • Understanding of the qualification and manufacturing-readiness challenges new materials face.
  • Background in hypersonics, missiles, high-temperature materials, or reentry systems.
  • Experience at a growth-stage defense or advanced manufacturing company.

This Role Is Not

  • Contracts administration. You choose and shape the path to contract; you don’t primarily process paperwork.
  • Relationships for their own sake. Access matters because it leads to orders.
  • Product or engineering leadership. The technical roadmap stays with Engineering.

Why Join Us:

At Continuous Composites, you will be part of a team that is redefining how advanced composites are manufactured. We move fast, communicate clearly, and innovate constantly. If you thrive in a dynamic, hands-on environment and are passionate about cutting-edge technology, we want to hear from you.

Continuous Composites, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified candidate must be eligible to work in the U.S. Candidates need to be lawfully able to work on ITAR or controlled information which requires that the applicant be a U.S. Person as defined by 22 CFR 120.62.

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

The Opportunity

If you are interested in joining Abbott's high caliber ICE Specialist, EP program, we want to network with you!

In this role, you will assist with the implantation and support of cardiac mapping procedures. Assists in the day-to-day management of various clinically-related issues. Working under direct supervision, provides educational and technical support in response to field inquiries from physicians, health care professionals, patients, and field sales staff. Identifies and routinely uses the most effective, cost efficient and best business practices to execute processes; continually evaluates their effectiveness and appropriateness. Exercises judgment in planning, organizing and performing work; monitors performance and reports status to manager. We value people with great ideas who partner with others both internally and externally to take action and accomplish goals.

What You’ll Work On

  • Provides technical assistance and support for procedures in which Electrophysiology (EP) products are used, including during pre- and post-procedures.
  • Provides regional EP support on an as-needed basis.
  • Develops and executes trouble-shooting for highly complex medical devices.
  • Assists in the support of complex cardiac mapping procedures
  • Remains technically competent relative to best practices and the products offered in the marketplace.
  • Develops, leads and/or facilitates trainings and other programs on Abbott products to healthcare professionals.
  • Ensures that all pertinent patient information is completed and forwarded to patient tracking when required.
  • Responsible for the management of any assigned physical inventory.
  • Performs work that involves a high degree of independence.
  • Identifies and implements the most efficient, cost-effective and best business practices to execute processes; continually evaluates their effectiveness and appropriateness.
  • Identifies reports and advises of customer needs, product performance and potential sales opportunities to sales representatives / directors and/or management to influence sales growth and service of accounts.
  • Participates in the creation and implementation of long- and short-term sales and business strategies.

Maintains positive and cooperative communications and collaboration with all levels of employees, customers, contractors, and vendors.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and/or facilitate educational programs to healthcare professionals.
  • Familiarity with cath lab, EP lab, and operating room procedures and protocol.
  • Must apply engineering skills and abilities to analyze complex devices and cardiac mapping during critical situations.
  • Must be able to work effectively with engineers, clinical specialists, vendors, health care professionals, and customers to achieve assigned goals; must be capable of coordinating multiple assignments simultaneously and effectively.
  • Ability to work in a highly matrixed and geographically diverse business environment.
  • Ability to work within a team and as an individual contributor in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Ability to leverage and/or engage others to accomplish projects.
  • Strong verbal and written communications with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels in the organization.
  • Multitasks, prioritizes and meets deadlines in timely manner.
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills, as well as attention to detail.
  • Ability to travel based on business need.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in relevant program
  • Biomedical engineering degree
  • Demonstrated knowledge of cardiac medical procedures

Every role at Orsini moves a patient closer to life-changing therapy. We partner with biopharma innovators, healthcare providers, and payers to make access simple, compassionate, and reliable - so no patient is left behind. Make your next role matter.

ABOUT ORSINI

Providing compassionate care since 1987, Orsini is a leader in rare disease and gene therapy pharmacy solutions, built to simplify how patients connect to advanced medicines. Through our comprehensive commercialization solutions including a nationwide specialty pharmacy, patient services hub, home infusion and nursing network, and third-party logistics provider, we work with biopharma, providers, and payors to ensure No Patient is Left Behind™

OUR MISSION

Orsini is on a mission to be the essential partner for biopharma innovators, healthcare providers, and payers to support patients and their families in accessing revolutionary treatments for rare diseases. Through our integrated portfolio of services, we seek to pioneer comprehensive solutions that simplify how patients connect to advanced therapies while providing holistic, compassionate care so that No Patient is Left Behind™.

CORE VALUES

At the heart of our company culture, the Orsini LIVE IT Core Values serve as guiding principles that shape how we interact with each other and those we serve. These values are the driving force behind our commitment to excellence, collaboration, and genuine care in every aspect of our work.

COMPENSATION & LOCATION

The salary for this role is $55,000.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Specialty Pharmacy Program Analyst position works in collaboration with the Program Manager to provide support for assigned manufacturer program(s) and therapies. The analyst will be a key contact interacting with the manufacturer, HUB and case management teams, prescribers, prescriber office staff and patients.

The role will require a high sense of urgency and the ability to answer questions quickly or respond/resolve issues that may arise. This support includes providing concise and accurate patient status information, participate and facilitate manufacturer status update meetings, ensure manufacturer contract obligations met, and provide prompt follow-up on inquiries from assigned manufacturer(s). The analyst will support internal therapy team by assisting in processing orders and/or handling escalated cases as time allows around manufacturer activities. The analyst will be actively engaged in manufacturer program manager and therapy team to ensure program requirements are met and program is operating as designed.

Why choose this role?

  • Real legal experience from day one. You'll work on commercial contracts and third-party reviews, gradually taking on more complex matters and negotiations.
  • Breadth that builds your Inhouse legal career. Exposure to commercial contracts, company secretarial, data privacy and, over time, intellectual property, supporting multiple service areas and teams.

  • Team administration: Support calendars, meetings, legal files and other day-to-day administrative requirements.

The above Job Description reflects the requirements of this position at time of issue. As duties and responsibilities change and develop, this will be reviewed and may be subject to amendments.

About You (Skills and Experience):

  • A degree in Law, Legal Studies or a related field.
  • Previous industry experience as an In-house Paralegal or in a similar legal support role, ideally in-house within technology or healthcare.
  • Experience across commercial contracts, data protection/privacy and corporate secretarial matters.
  • Compliance and intellectual property experience would be an advantage.
  • A solid understanding of contract law, corporate governance and legal research methodologies.

Skills get you in the door - Will (Attitude & Approach ) gets your hired

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced business with constantly changing priorities.
  • Able to juggle deadlines, prioritise effectively and adapt quickly.
  • Explain complex legal matters clearly to colleagues across the business.
  • Detail-focused, thorough and committed to accuracy.
  • Take ownership, use sound judgement and follow through.
  • Work independently, ask questions and know when to escalate.
  • Confident using legal research tools, document systems and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
  • Keen to use AI contract management systems and enterprise AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude).
  • Handle sensitive legal and commercial information with discretion and confidentiality.

Desirable

You don't need experience in every area below, but we'd welcome:

  • Experience in pathology, laboratories, oncology, academic medical centres or clinical services.
  • Familiarity with healthcare or pathology services in the UK or Republic of Ireland.
  • Knowledge of clinical guidelines and regulations.
  • Working knowledge of GDPR, UK GDPR and data protection practices.

Your development and career progression:

  • We want this role to be a strong foundation for your long-term legal career.
  • You'll work closely with our Legal team on varied, commercially meaningful matters, gaining practical experience across contracts, governance, privacy and other areas as your skills develop.
  • We actively support professional development and welcome conversations about further qualifications, including routes to qualifying as a solicitor in the UK or Ireland.

  • We're growing, and we'd love someone who wants to grow with us.

What else can Deciphex offer you?

💼 Competitive salary with performance-based annual increments recognising commercial impact.

🏥 Healthcare coverage supporting long-term wellbeing.

🌴 Annual leave that gives you time to properly switch off and recharge.

🫀 Purpose-driven work supporting faster, more accurate patient diagnoses.

📈 Regular, meaningful performance feedback, clear accountability and opportunities to develop.

🤝 A collaborative, inclusive and multicultural team built on trust, respect and shared standards.

More About Us

Founded in Dublin in 2017, Deciphex is helping address one of healthcare's biggest challenges: the growing demand for pathology expertise.

Our AI-powered software supports faster, more accurate diagnoses and helps pharmaceutical companies accelerate essential drug development.

Today, we're a team of over 230 people, with offices in Dublin, Exeter, Oxford, Toronto and Chicago, and we're continuing to grow internationally. Our people bring together expertise in software development, clinical pathology, AI engineering, operations and many other disciplines. We're ambitious about what we're building and equally committed to how we work together.

We value people who approach challenges with curiosity, take responsibility and enjoy finding practical solutions.

The SEC Reporting Consultant serves as an accounting expert and applies accounting acumen to customers on a project basis, providing customer project management, XBRL data modeling, mapping, tagging, and review of customer XBRL projects in compliance with quality and customer satisfaction standards. jobs.excerpt: Job Title: Account Manager Compensation Range: $80,000-90,000 Base + Commission (OTE $140,000-150,000) Location: This role can be remote anywhere in the US.
jobs.description:
Job Title: Account Manager  

Compensation Range: $80,000-90,000 Base + Commission (OTE $140,000-150,000)  

Location: This role can be remote anywhere in the US.  

Become one of the changemakers. At Quid, you won’t just be joining a team but contributing to a culture of innovation, where every challenge becomes an opportunity to learn and grow. When you join our team, you’re not just stepping into a job—you’re embracing a future where we lead the game with the unmatched advantage of foresight.  

Position Overview

As an Account Manager at Quid, you will own the success, retention, and growth of a portfolio of customers. You will manage the full post-sale customer lifecycle—from onboarding and adoption through renewal, contract execution, and expansion—while serving as the customer’s primary relationship owner and internal advocate.

This role blends strategic account management, customer success, and program management. You will help customers achieve measurable value from Quid, monitor product adoption and account health, coordinate complex customer initiatives, and manage renewals from early planning through signature. The ideal candidate is a proactive, strategic, and execution-oriented Account Manager with the technical aptitude to understand customer workflows, identify barriers to adoption, and coordinate the right resources to solve them.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Success and Adoption

  • Develop a deep understanding of each customer’s priorities, use cases, desired outcomes, and measures of success.

  • Create and manage customer success and adoption plans with clear goals, milestones, owners, risks, and next steps.

  • Monitor product usage, engagement, support trends, and stakeholder participation to identify risks and opportunities early.

  • Recommend training, configuration, workflows, or additional capabilities that improve adoption and customer value.

  • Conduct strategic business reviews that connect Quid usage and outcomes to the customer’s broader priorities.

Relationship and Program Management

  • Build strong relationships across users, champions, program owners, technical stakeholders, procurement teams, and executive sponsors.

  • Serve as the central point of coordination for customer initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and internal teams.

  • Establish clear objectives, responsibilities, timelines, dependencies, and follow-up actions.

  • Maintain momentum between meetings and hold internal and external stakeholders accountable for commitments.

  • Act as the voice of the customer and share actionable feedback with Product, Engineering, Support, Education, and leadership.

Technical and Product Fluency

  • Develop a strong working knowledge of Quid’s platform, product configuration, data sources, workflows, integrations, usage reporting, and AI capabilities.

  • Help determine whether customer challenges stem from product limitations, configuration, adoption, enablement, or business processes.

  • Translate technical concepts into clear, practical guidance for business stakeholders.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, and customer technical teams to resolve challenges and improve the customer experience.

Renewals and Contract Execution

  • Own renewal strategy and execution for an assigned book of business, including retention, upsell, and cross-sell goals.

  • Begin renewal planning early by confirming stakeholders, timelines, budgets, decision criteria, procurement requirements, and potential risks.

  • Manage renewals through pricing, proposal development, contract preparation, procurement, legal, security and AI reviews, negotiation, signature, and internal handoff.

  • Maintain accurate renewal and expansion forecasts, clearly documenting risk, expected outcomes, last steps, next steps, and required support.

Growth and Account Planning

  • Identify expansion opportunities based on customer outcomes, emerging business needs, additional use cases, and opportunities across departments or business units.

  • Develop account plans covering customer goals, stakeholders, adoption, risks, renewal strategy, and growth opportunities.

  • Multi-thread customer relationships to reduce reliance on a single contact and strengthen the overall partnership.

  • Lead commercial conversations and negotiations in partnership with the appropriate internal stakeholders.

  • Maintain accurate customer, opportunity, contract, and activity information in Quid’s systems of record.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Gross and net revenue retention

  • Renewal and expansion performance

  • Timely and successful contract execution

  • Product adoption and customer engagement

  • Customer health and risk mitigation

  • Achievement of documented customer outcomes

  • Forecast accuracy and account-plan execution

  • Strength and breadth of customer relationships

Requirements

  • Five to seven years of experience in account management, customer success, client services, or another customer-facing commercial role, preferably within a SaaS or technology company.

  • Demonstrated history of exceptional performance, with consistent renewal, retention, and growth results that have placed you among the top 5–10% of performers in your current and previous roles.

  • Proven success retaining and growing a book of business while helping customers achieve measurable outcomes.

  • Experience owning renewals and managing commercial and contractual processes through negotiation and signature.

  • Strong program-management skills, including the ability to coordinate stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and drive initiatives through completion.

  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand product configuration, usage data, workflows, and integrations.

  • Ability to interpret customer-health and adoption signals and translate them into clear actions.

  • Strong commercial, negotiation, forecasting, communication, and presentation skills.

  • Ability to build credibility with users, technical stakeholders, procurement teams, and senior executives.

  • Exceptional organization, accountability, and follow-through.

  • Bachelor’s degree

Total Rewards

  • 20 days of paid time off

  • 12 company holidays

  • Company-provided equipment

  • 401(k) with company match

  • FSA and HSA options

  • Paid parental leave and reintegration program

  • Employee wellness resources

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Four-week sabbatical after five years

Still Not Sure? 

We understand many candidates tend to only apply for jobs if they meet every single requirement listed. However, if you’re genuinely enthusiastic about this position and confident in your ability to excel, we strongly urge you to submit your application! You might just be the perfect fit for this role—or another exciting opportunity within Quid.  

Remote Work! 

We’ve been passionate about remote work since day one! Our team is comfortable collaborating across different time zones. While we’re excited about future growth and expansion, certain legal restrictions require that we can only accept candidates eligible to work in the United States.  

About Quid   

Quid helps business leaders turn complexity into clarity, and clarity into outcomes. 
We leverage our proprietary AI to listen to the market at scale, leveraging billions of conversations, articles, and signals, and translates that noise into clarity. Then we go further: we show you our customers how to act on it. 
Whether it’s protecting brand health, driving in-season sales, fueling product innovation, or shaping company strategy, Quid raises the bar for what business leaders should demand.   
We’re not a dashboard company. We’re an outcome engineering organization, relentless in our focus on helping organizations make smarter and bolder decisions that drive positive outcomes for their business. 
Quid has been featured in Forbes, Fortune, The Stanford AI Index, and more, highlighting our leadership in the consumer and market intelligence space, and illustrating  how Quid helps organizations achieve their business outcomes to stay ahead of their competition.
