The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadKeystead, an AI-native insurance brokerage venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Keysteadis an insurance brokerage built for the small businesses traditional brokers can't afford to serve. AI agents run the full workflow, from intake and multi-carrier quoting to binding and certificates of insurance, with licensed agents stepping in where judgment matters. Keystead starts with the businesses that need proof of coverage again and again, such as contractors, event vendors, and product brands selling into retail. For these owners, a certificate that takes days to arrive can cost them the job. Keystead issues it in minutes, explains coverage in plain language, and re-shops the market at every renewal.

Market Context

Roughly 35M small businesses in the US are underserved by a broker model built for larger accounts. Across the US and Canada, small business insurance represents a $6.2B commission pool. About $4.5B of that comes from businesses that already carry commercial insurance. Digital buying is proven, with the leading digital insurer serving more than 750K small businesses. The multi-carrier, servicing-first model remains open.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across insurtech and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning

  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with small business owners in certificate-heavy verticals, convert them to bound policies, and build the go-to-market motion

  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

  • Direct exposure to commercial P&C insurance distribution, such as agency, brokerage, MGA, or insurtech experience, ideally with carrier relationships or a producer license

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

jobs.description:
GenLogs is a transportation-technology company building the next generation of truck intelligence. Through a nationwide network of sensors and proprietary data, We deliver real-time, high-fidelity insights into freight movement for commercial supply-chain customers and public-sector agencies. Our mission is to strengthen America’s logistics backbone, combat freight fraud and cargo theft, and provide near-instantaneous visibility into commercial motor vehicle activity across major freight corridors. By operating at the intersection of edge sensing, computer vision, AI-driven analytics, and large-scale field deployment, GenLogs is transforming how transportation data is captured, secured, and commercialized.

ABOUT THE GTM TEAM

The Go-to-Market team at GenLogs is responsible for bringing our nationwide commercial-vehicle intelligence platform to the agencies and enterprises that depend on trustworthy, real-time freight visibility. We work directly with state and federal law-enforcement partners, departments of transportation, ports, shippers, carriers, and brokers to define problems, scope operational deployments, and scale high-impact programs. As the commercial face of GenLogs, we translate the capabilities of our sensor network and freight intelligence data platform into clear value propositions that strengthen public safety, reduce fraud and theft, and improve supply-chain reliability. The team operates with urgency, precision, and deep market understanding, collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to ensure our solutions solve the most important problems in the freight ecosystem.

ABOUT THE JOB

As we expand our Go-to-Market team, the Business Development Representative will play a foundational role in building a predictable revenue engine and shaping GenLogs’ presence in the market.

The Business Development Representative (BDR) drives top-of-funnel pipeline across LSPs, Shippers, and accounts within GenLogs’ commercial auto insurance vertical. This includes working with retailers, wholesalers, carriers, and MGAs.

This role requires strong communication skills, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to operate within both mid-market and enterprise outbound motions. Based on experience, candidates may focus on strategic enterprise accounts or mid-market accounts.

You will work closely with Account Executives, Product, and Customer Success to understand buyer pain points, refine and develop messaging, and contribute to the broader go-to-market strategy.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Outbound Prospecting

  • Research and identify high-quality prospects across logistics and commercial auto insurance verticals.
  • Execute consistent multichannel outreach including calls, email, and LinkedIn.
  • Tailor outreach to specific workflows across logistics and insurance stakeholders, including underwriting, claims, operations, compliance, and distribution channels.
  • Maintain daily activities and expectations to generate a healthy volume of qualified meetings.

Qualification & Discovery

  • Conduct initial discovery conversations to understand prospect challenges.
  • Align prospect pain points with GenLogs’ capabilities, particularly within the commercial auto insurance ecosystem.
  • Qualify prospects to sales qualified leads based on defined criteria including fit, need, urgency, and role alignment.
  • Schedule meetings for Account Executives with clear, detailed handoff notes.

Collaboration & Internal Alignment

  • Work closely with Account Executives to prioritize accounts and refine outreach strategy.
  • Provide ongoing feedback to Product based on prospect objections, market signals, and emerging trends within the commercial auto insurance industry.
  • Support GTM initiatives tied to industry events through pre-event booking and post-event follow-up.

Systems, Reporting & Process Excellence

  • Maintain accurate data, notes, and qualification details in Salesforce.
  • Utilize sales engagement tools to improve productivity and streamline outbound workflows.
  • Participate in weekly meetings to review performance, account progress, and outbound results.
  • Contribute to the evolution of outbound playbooks, ICP profiles, and messaging frameworks.

Why Join?

  • Opportunity to help build the outbound function from the ground up.
  • Direct access to GTM leadership and high visibility across the organization.
  • Impactful role within a fast-growing logistics technology company.
  • Ability to influence messaging, strategy, and market penetration early in the GTM journey.

Required Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of experience selling transportation insurance or selling technology/data solutions to insurance organizations within the transportation and logistics space.
  • Experience in SaaS, Logistics, or Insurance (especially commercial auto) is a strong plus.
  • Commercial auto insurance industry knowledge preferred, with experience across multiple verticals (e.g., retailers, wholesalers, carriers, MGAs).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with attention to detail.
  • Comfort with cold outreach and consistent outbound prospecting activity.
  • Coachable, driven, and reliable in daily execution and follow-through.
  • Experience using Salesforce and sales engagement tools.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, early-stage startup environment.

US SALARY RANGE

GenLogs establishes compensation based on role, level, experience, and location. Salary bands are benchmarked against high-growth technology companies and adjusted for market conditions.

Щомісяця мільйони людей у 66 країнах світу використовують Jooble для пошуку роботи та найму талантів. За цим стоїть команда з понад 300 професіоналів, які поєднують глибоку експертизу в аналітиці, технологіях та роботі з даними, щоб зробити цей процес простішим і ефективнішим.

  • Сильну внутрішню експертизу в performance marketing з мільйонами користувачів щомісяця

У цій ролі ти будеш:

  • Тісно співпрацювати з performance marketing спеціалістами, user acquisition, design та аналітикою для досягнення вагомих бізнес-результатів.

Необхідні навички та досвід:

  • Досвід від 1 року у створенні контенту (digital, SMM) для mobile app або web продукту в кількох гео;

  • Розуміння вимог рекламних платформ (Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Ads);

  • Досвід у ads копірайтингу;

  • Досвід експериментів з AI-тулами (Sora, NanoBanana, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, N8n тощо);

  • Амбіція впливати на глобальний продукт і бренд у 66 країнах;

  • Англійська на рівні B2+;

  • Комфортна робота в крос-функціональних командах та вміння тримати в голові кілька контекстів одночасно.

Якщо ти готовий/а впливати на життя мільйонів людей у всьому світі — надсилай резюме, і ми зв’яжемося з тобою найближчим часом.

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As part of the Technology Distribution team of Tether Data, we are seeking an Engagement Manager to lead the implementation of AI-driven initiatives powered by QVAC, Tether’s SDK for local AI and delegated inference. The role focuses on orchestrating complex, multi-stakeholder deployments of decentralized AI solutions across enterprise, government, and institutional environments.

This position combines client engagement, technical coordination, and delivery oversight to ensure successful onboarding and execution of AI use cases, ranging from edge AI deployments to privacy-preserving inference systems. The Engagement Manager plays a central role in aligning client objectives with product capabilities, coordinating internal and external stakeholders, and driving implementations from initial scoping through production rollout.

Responsibilities

Client & Partner Engagement

  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients and partners during AI implementation initiatives, ensuring clear communication, expectation alignment, and structured execution.

  • Guide clients in translating business requirements into AI deployment strategies leveraging QVAC capabilities (local inference, delegated compute, privacy-preserving architectures).

  • Support Expansion team in shaping AI-related opportunities by providing input on feasibility, integration complexity, and delivery approach.

  • Identify opportunities to extend implementations across additional use cases, geographies, or Tether technologies.

Implementations Oversight

  • Lead end-to-end coordination of QVAC-based implementations from kickoff through production deployment.

  • Define implementation roadmaps, milestones, and dependencies across AI models, infrastructure, and integration layers.

  • Ensure alignment between client expectations and actual product capabilities, avoiding scope drift or mispositioning.

  • Track progress across multiple concurrent AI deployments, ensuring timely delivery and readiness for production environments.

Cross-functional Coordination

  • Coordinate closely with product, engineering, and research teams to align on QVAC capabilities, limitations, and roadmap evolution.

  • Facilitate integration between client systems and QVAC components, including model deployment pipelines, APIs, and compute environments.

  • Work with legal and compliance teams where required, particularly in sensitive AI deployments involving data locality or privacy constraints.

  • Maintain structured communication flows across all stakeholders involved in the implementation lifecycle.

Governance & Reporting

  • Establish and maintain governance frameworks including implementation plans, risk tracking, and decision logs.

  • Produce executive-level updates summarizing progress, risks, blockers, and next steps.

  • Ensure documentation of implementation architectures, deployment patterns, and key learnings for reuse across future projects.

  • Support escalation management and ensure timely resolution of technical or operational challenges.

Requirements

Core Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, technical account management, or delivery roles within AI, data infrastructure, or complex technology environments.

  • Proven experience managing cross-functional implementations involving multiple stakeholders (internal teams, clients, external partners).

  • Strong ability to operate at the intersection of technical and business domains.

Technical Understanding

  • Familiarity with AI/ML deployment concepts, including model inference, edge/local AI, and distributed compute architectures.

  • Understanding of APIs, SDK integrations, and system architecture patterns.

  • Ability to engage in technical discussions with engineering teams while maintaining business-level clarity with clients.

Communication & Execution

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience working with enterprise or government entities.

  • Structured approach to project tracking, documentation, and governance.

  • Ability to manage ambiguity and operate in fast-evolving, early-stage environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with decentralized technologies, blockchain, or privacy-preserving systems.

  • Exposure to AI infrastructure tooling or MLOps workflows.

  • Experience in regulated industries or public sector projects.

  • Basic familiarity with programming or scripting environments (Python, APIs, CLI tools).

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.description:
The Sales Manager leads a team of sales professionals within a designated sales segment, driving revenue growth, profitability, and customer success through effective leadership and execution. This role is responsible for developing and coaching Sales Specialists while fostering a high-performance culture focused on accountability, customer outcomes, and continuous improvement. The Sales Manager partners closely with internal stakeholders, field sales teams, and vendor partners to achieve business objectives and deliver exceptional customer experience.

What you will do:

  • Lead, develop, and retain a high-performing team of Sales Specialists through effective coaching, mentoring, and performance management.
  • Recruit, train, and develop diverse talent while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Develop and execute sales strategies, territory assignments, and operating plans to achieve sales and profitability goals.
  • Monitor business performance and drive execution of initiatives that support segment and organizational objectives.
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships while ensuring a superior customer experience.
  • Collaborate with field sales teams, vendor partners, and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities and drive business growth.
  • Analyze sales performance, team metrics, and market trends to identify opportunities, optimize execution, and improve results.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and provide ongoing feedback, coaching, and development to maximize team effectiveness.
  • Drive employee engagement, accountability, and attainment of key sales and operational objectives.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and escalation point for customer, partner, and team-related matters.
  • Ensure achievement of critical business results through effective leadership, planning, and execution.

What we expect of you:

  • Associate Degree and 3 years of sales leadership or people management experience OR 5 years of equivalent sales leadership or people management experience.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and build relationships across all levels of the organization.
  • Proven ability to coach, develop, and motivate team members to drive performance and continuous learning.
  • Experience with performance management, employee development, and team engagement.
  • Proficiency with CRM tools and sales management software.
  • Ability to analyze sales data, performance metrics, and market trends to drive informed business decisions.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing business needs while meeting deadlines.
  • Thorough knowledge of CDW products, services, and sales processes.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and act as a trusted business partner.

Pay Range: $80,000– $120,000 based on experience and skill set

Annual Bonus Target: $95,000 subject to plan terms and conditions

Benefits Overview:

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

You don’t need deep technical expertise, but you should be comfortable exploring how AI can enhance strategy, decision-making, and team performance. Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

About Us

CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.

As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.

Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do. Together, we Make Amazing Happen.

About the Team/Role

The Business Intelligence Analyst II serves as a technical architect and automation lead within one or more of the domain areas within the Global Risk Operations organization. You will leverage enterprise-approved tools—Tableau, Python, SQL, and RPA—to modernize legacy workflows and drive operational scale. This role is the bridge between theoretical efficiency and the deployment of hardened, audit-ready automation.


You are a change agent dedicated to the continuous improvement of the department’s technical and automation capabilities. Your success will be determined by your ability to modernize the risk landscape through governed self-service. You will be evaluated on three primary pillars - operational scale, efficiency and impact, and integrity and compliance.

How you'll make an impact

SOLUTION ENGINEERING & AUTOMATION DELIVERY

  • Workflow Transformation: Identify manual bottlenecks and engineer automated, self-service replacements that adhere to enterprise technical standards.
  • Infrastructure Lead: Build and maintain the technical infrastructure required to automate complex financial risk workflows across assigned regions.
  • Scaling through AI: Proactively integrate AI-driven technologies to eliminate manual touchpoints, creating a self-scaling environment that grows without increasing headcount.
  • Change Agency: Serve as a departmental catalyst for technical evolution, applying strategic thinking and process re-engineering to transform manual workflows into scalable, automated solutions.

ADVANCED ANALYTICS & DATA STEWARDSHIP

  • Strategic Data Assets: Transform raw data into strategic assets, utilizing advanced analytics to provide stakeholders with predictive insights.
  • Self-Service Ecosystems: Develop and manage standardized reporting environments (Power BI/Tableau) that empower stakeholders with real-time data while maintaining a single source of truth.
  • Efficiency Engineering: Design and deploy technical solutions specifically intended to drive measurable cost savings and mitigate operational risks.
  • Insight Delivery: Perform deep-dive analysis of trends to identify and illustrate emerging issues, providing management with clear direction and data-backed explanations.

OPERATIONAL EXECUTION & TECHNICAL INTEGRITY

  • Performance Tracking: Implement processes and reporting to track work items, volume, and turnaround time, ensuring accurate capture of required operational data.
  • Reporting Administration: Oversee the lifecycle of departmental reporting, including KPIs, management dashboards, and both scheduled and ad-hoc requirements.
  • Sustainable Automation: Deliver innovative alternatives to manual processes by continuously educating the team on current applications and automated technology.

COMPLIANCE, GOVERNANCE & SOLUTION INTEGRITY

  • Financial Controls and Compliance: Maintain rigorous standards for data integrity, ensuring all automated reports and workflows are fully compliant with regulatory and internal audit standards.
  • Technical Integrity: Oversee report administration and version control to ensure the longevity and reliability of deployed solutions.
  • Risk Mitigation: Ensure all self-service tools are built with robust error handling and audit trails to prevent operational drift.

These statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed rather than give an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities.


Experience you'll bring

Minimum Required Qualifications for Consideration

  • 2-4 years in a Finance or Risk Operations environment.

  • Proficiency in complex joins and ETL processes.
  • Python: Intermediate proficiency, specifically utilizing Pandas and NumPy for data manipulation.
  • RPA: Hands-on experience with enterprise platforms like UiPath or Power Automate.
  • Must have intermediate or better SQL and Oracle database experience, working with large data sets.
  • Must successfully pass a background investigation.

Competencies:

  • Analytical mind that can trouble-shoot, problem solve, and think logically through multifaceted issues and provide clear direction and explanation.
  • Ability to effectively and calmly operate within a complex, fast-paced and changing environment.
  • Self-motivated, solution oriented and results driven.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent time management, prioritization skills, goals setting, planning and work scheduling skills.

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to recognize and react to discrepancies.
  • Emerging Tech: Experience with Prompt Engineering and building RAG systems or using LLM APIs to enhance automation.
  • SAS programming skills.
  • Experience interpreting contractual terms.
  • Knowledge of WEX systems and business processes.

jobs.title: Lead Engineer
jobs.excerpt: MEISTÄ“Tekniq on suomalainen teknisen alan asiantuntijayritys, joka toimii energia-, meri- ja teollisuussektorien vaativissa projekteissa Suomessa ja kansainvälisesti.
jobs.description:
MEISTÄ

Tekniq on suomalainen teknisen alan asiantuntijayritys, joka toimii energia-, meri- ja teollisuussektorien vaativissa projekteissa Suomessa ja kansainvälisesti. Noin 80 ammattilaisen tiimimme tukee asiakkaitamme projektien eri vaiheissa suunnittelusta ja projektinhallinnasta työmaapalveluihin ja käyttöönottoon sekä toimii tilaajan teknisenä asiantuntijana ja edustajana.

Olemme mukana siellä, missä projektit tapahtuvat – suunnittelupöydältä työmaille ja käyttöönottoon. Työskentelemme alan johtavien yritysten kanssa teknisesti vaativissa hankkeissa.

Lead Engineer

Etsimme sähkötekniikan pääsuunnittelijaa vahvistamaan Tekniqin asiantuntijatiimiä sähköasemaprojektiin vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Tehtävässä vastaat sähköteknisen suunnittelun kokonaisuudesta ja varmistat, että suunnittelu etenee laadukkaasti ja aikataulussa. Toimit sähkösuunnittelijoiden teknisenä tukena ja pidät projektin suunnittelun langat käsissäsi aina piirustusten tarkastamisesta suunnittelun etenemisen seurantaan.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa

  • sähköasemaprojektin sähkösuunnittelun koordinointi

  • sähkösuunnittelijoiden työn ohjaaminen ja tekninen tukeminen

  • sähköpiirustusten ja muun suunnitteludokumentaation tarkastaminen

  • suunnitteluratkaisujen teknisen laadun varmistaminen

  • suunnittelun aikataulun ja etenemisen seuranta

  • eri suunnitteluosapuolten välisen yhteistyön koordinointi

  • teknisten kysymysten ja suunnitteluun liittyvien haasteiden ratkaiseminen

  • suunnittelukokonaisuuden hallinta projektin eri vaiheissa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää vahvaa ymmärrystä sähköasemaprojekteista ja niiden teknisistä kokonaisuuksista. Tekninen taustasi auttaa sinua ymmärtämään projektien tarpeita, arvioimaan tarvittavaa osaamista ja tukemaan tiimisi asiantuntijoita heidän tehtävissään.

Odotamme sinulta:

  • sähköinsinöörin (AMK/DI) tai vastaavaa teknistä koulutusta

  • hyvää sähköpiirustusten ja teknisen dokumentaation tuntemusta

  • Fingridin teknisten vaatimusten ja suunnitteluohjeiden tuntemusta

  • kokemusta sähköasemien ensiö- ja/tai toisiolaitteista

  • kokemusta 110 kV:n tai sitä korkeampien jännitetasojen sähköasemista

  • vahvaa kokemusta sähköasemien suunnittelutehtävistä

  • kykyä hahmottaa laajoja teknisiä kokonaisuuksia ja viedä niitä järjestelmällisesti eteenpäin

  • valmiutta ottaa vastuuta suunnittelun laadusta ja aikataulussa pysymisestä

  • hyviä yhteistyö- ja kommunikointitaitoja

  • sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.

Miksi Tekniq?

Tekniqillä työskentelet vaativien sähkö- ja energiahankkeiden parissa. Asiakasprojektien vaihtuessa myös työn sisältö, toimintaympäristö ja ratkaistavat tekniset kysymykset vaihtuvat. Yhdessä projektissa painopiste voi olla suunnittelun koordinoinnissa, toisessa teknisten ratkaisujen arvioinnissa tai suunnitelmien tarkastamisessa. Erilaiset hankkeet tuovat työhön vaihtelua ja haastavat hyödyntämään osaamistasi uusissa tilanteissa.

Pääsuunnittelijana saat paljon vapautta vaikuttaa omaan työhösi ja työtapoihisi. Kokeneena asiantuntijana voit hyödyntää omaa näkemystäsi ja kokemustasi siinä, miten viet suunnittelua eteenpäin. Vapauden mukana tulee myös vastuu: pidät huolen siitä, että suunnittelukokonaisuus, tekninen laatu ja aikataulu pysyvät hallinnassa.

Työn tekemisessä joustavuus näkyy myös käytännössä. Tekniqin toimistot sijaitsevat Vaasassa ja Tampereella, mutta tehtävä ei ole sidottu kumpaankaan paikkakuntaan, vaan voit työskennellä joustavasti eri puolilta Suomea.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Jätä hakemuksesi ja CV:si ainoastaan virallisen rekrytointikanavamme kautta. Emme käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

Hakemalla tehtävää liityt samalla hakijaverkostoomme, jolloin voimme huomioida sinut myös tulevissa osaamistasi, kokemustasi ja uratoiveitasi vastaavissa mahdollisuuksissa.

Valmis seuraavaan haasteeseen? Tule mukaan Tekniqille toteuttamaan projekteja, joilla on merkitystä.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

The ASC Solutions Architect is the commercial solutioning and deal-architecture lead for complex ambulatory surgery center opportunities. This role partners with ASC Development Leaders, regional and account sales teams, product specialists, finance, Healthcare Financial Services, service, legal, compliance, operations, and other stakeholders to translate customer requirements into coordinated, customer-centered, financially sound, and executable multi-modality solutions. The Solutions Architect owns the development of integrated equipment and service bundles, configurations, quotes, financing pathways, deal economics, approval materials, and commercial execution plans while supporting a consistent experience from discovery through booked order and implementation handoff.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

Solution Design and Configuration

  • Partner with the ASC Development Leader and commercial teams to translate the customer’s clinical strategy, procedure mix, facility plan, workflow, timeline, budget, and growth objectives into a coordinated solution architecture.
  • Design scalable ASC bundles across relevant GE HealthCare equipment, software, digital, service, training, and partner capabilities, balancing customer requirements, clinical workflow, standardization, implementation readiness, and commercial objectives.
  • Coordinate modality inputs, technical requirements, room and infrastructure assumptions, product dependencies, compatibility considerations, and configuration decisions. Document open items, owners, risks, and required decisions.
  • Develop repeatable standard configurations and modular ASC offerings that can be adapted to independent, health system, MSO, private equity, and joint-venture customer models.

Commercial and Financial Solutioning

  • Build and evaluate deal economics, including equipment and service scope, pricing, margin, customer value, projected savings, financing structure, cash-flow considerations, revenue recognition inputs, risk, and expected commercial outcomes.
  • Partner with Finance and Healthcare Financial Services to evaluate capital purchase, lease, financing, phased deployment, and other approved commercial structures that align with the customer’s capital strategy and GE HealthCare requirements.
  • Perform horizontal pricing analysis across modalities and offerings, identify tradeoffs, and develop recommendations that improve competitiveness while maintaining pricing discipline, compliance, and profitability.
  • Prepare clear financial models, scenario comparisons, approval summaries, and executive-level decision materials that simplify complex data and enable timely action.

Quoting, Governance, and Approvals

  • Coordinate the development, consolidation, quality review, and submission of multi-modality quotes, proposals, single-signature packages, and supporting commercial documentation.
  • Engage required stakeholders early and facilitate pricing, risk, legal, compliance, contracting, finance, and Delegation of Authority reviews. Track approvals and resolve gaps or escalations.
  • Maintain strong process discipline in CRM, quoting tools, opportunity documentation, version control, assumptions, milestones, and handoffs.
  • Ensure proposed solutions comply with applicable company policies, pricing governance, commercial approval requirements, contracting standards, and customer commitments.

Pursuit and Cross-Functional Execution

  • Serve as the solution-development partner to the ASC Development Leader, who remains the opportunity quarterback and owner of market development, executive relationships, opportunity strategy, pipeline, forecast, and commercial outcomes.
  • Lead cross-functional working sessions to align account sales, product specialists, clinical resources, service, applications, project management, installation, finance, legal, compliance, supply chain, and external partners around one solution and action plan.
  • Support customer-facing discovery and solution reviews when technical, financial, workflow, implementation, or commercial expertise is required.
  • Anticipate execution risks, dependencies, lead times, partner requirements, and implementation constraints, and develop practical mitigation plans before customer commitments are finalized.
  • Provide a structured handoff after contract execution or order booking so project, installation, service, applications, and clinical teams understand scope, assumptions, dependencies, and customer commitments.

Standard Work and Continuous Improvement

  • Develop, document, and continuously improve ASC solutioning standard work, intake requirements, configuration guides, financial templates, quote checklists, approval workflows, and handoff tools.
  • Apply Lean and structured problem-solving methods to identify root causes, remove delays and rework, simplify processes, and improve speed, quality, transparency, and scalability.
  • Capture lessons learned and provide upstream feedback to product, finance, commercial enablement, service, operations, and leadership to strengthen future ASC offerings.
  • Champion appropriate tools, analytics, automation, and knowledge-sharing practices that improve repeatability and team effectiveness.

Measures of Success

  • Time from qualified request to coordinated solution, approved quote, and customer-ready proposal.
  • Accuracy and completeness of configurations, pricing, financial models, documentation, and approval packages.
  • Multi-modality attach rate and adoption of repeatable ASC bundles and standard configurations.
  • Pricing and margin performance within approved guardrails, with transparent management of exceptions and risk.
  • Quality of cross-functional coordination, customer experience, implementation readiness, and post-booking handoffs.
  • Reduction in quote rework, cycle-time delays, missed dependencies, and preventable escalations.
  • Contribution to ASC opportunity progression, win rate, orders, revenue, profitability, and strategic account growth.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 5 years of commercial, financial, operational, proposal, deal-desk, or solution-development experience in healthcare, medical technology, capital equipment, financial services, or a related industry.
  • Demonstrated experience with financial analysis, pricing, deal modeling, risk assessment, capital planning, financing solutions, or complex commercial structures.
  • Proven project-management capability, including facilitation, scheduling, prioritization, risk management, follow-up, tracking, documentation, and communication.
  • Ability to develop and coordinate complex, multi-stakeholder solutions in a highly matrixed organization.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert detailed financial, technical, and commercial information into clear recommendations.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across commercial, clinical, technical, operational, financial, and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to travel 30% of the time.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Commercial solutioning background with experience structuring integrated equipment, service, digital, and financing offerings.
  • Strong financing solutions profile, including experience with leases, capital financing, cash-flow modeling, return-on-investment analysis, and alternative transaction structures.
  • Firsthand experience supporting ambulatory surgery centers, MSOs, private equity-backed healthcare platforms, IDNs, physician groups, de novo facilities, or complex outpatient capital projects.
  • Knowledge of the ASC market and the stakeholders involved in planning, building, financing, equipping, implementing, and operating an ASC.
  • Experience with cardiovascular, interventional, imaging, ultrasound, patient monitoring, anesthesia, digital, service, or other multi-modality healthcare solutions.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency with PowerPoint, Word, Teams, SharePoint, CRM, quoting, and proposal tools.
  • Ability to visually present complex, data-rich information in a simple format that enables efficient decision-making.
  • Functional knowledge of pricing compliance, revenue recognition, contracting, Delegation of Authority, commercial approvals, and risk management.
  • Experience with large-scale process improvement, Lean methods, workflow automation, and development of repeatable standard work.
  • Excellent process discipline and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple urgent priorities without sacrificing quality.
  • Comfortable coordinating across modalities, regions, functions, operating businesses, and external partners without direct authority.
  • Customer-facing experience and the ability to understand and represent the customer’s business, clinical, operational, and financial perspective.
  • Ability to remain calm, objective, and solutions-focused under pressure.

jobs.excerpt: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution.
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We're taking Keet to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. Product sets the direction. We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up at global scale.

You lead the teams that build Keet's features: the API team, which adds feature-focused APIs to Keet's core, and the frontend team, which builds the React app on top, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product.

You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for distributed, local-first systems, so you can work fluently on top of a P2P engine without needing to build it yourself.

Responsabilities

Engineering

  • Run the API and frontend teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.

  • Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.

  • Own the technical design of features and the API surface between Keet's core and the app.

  • Make sure the API team works closely with our deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches the engine.

Product Partnership

  • Work alongside Keet's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.

  • Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.

  • Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially where P2P opens doors that centralized apps can't.

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Investor and advisor network across B2B AI and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CTO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner — building alongside you.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will set the venture's technical direction and lead its execution. This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire.

  • Technical Direction — Own problem framing, architecture, system design, and product judgment from day one, translating rough product intent into structure, context, and specs that both humans and AI systems can execute against

  • Build — Use modern tools and frontier models to move fast without sacrificing quality or maintainability, designing agentic systems with first-principles thinking and knowing when orchestration adds genuine leverage versus when simplicity is the better call

  • Customer & Market — Be the primary technical voice in early customer conversations, understanding real workflows and shaping the right product rather than just shipping quickly

  • Team — Recruit and grow a technical team when the time is right, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Proven track record of shipping AI products to real users under real-world constraints — not research, experiments, or prototypes

  • Deep practical experience with frontier models, LLM-based systems, and agentic architectures, with strong system design instincts and a bias for simplicity and maintainability

  • Strong translation layer skills — able to turn messy product intent into clear structure, constraints, and specs that both humans and AI systems can act on

  • Close to the customer, comfortable in customer conversations, and able to let real workflows shape what you build

  • Rigorous about verification — feedback loops, evaluation, and systems that can be trusted

  • Prior experience as a technical co-founder or early engineering leader, with fundraising experience a strong plus

  • Founder at heart — energized by ambiguity, able to go far alone, and ready to commit fully

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

Sitting within the Brand & Communications team, you will own the end-to-end strategy, structure, and ongoing development of our Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform (Brand Bank) and Notion Brand Hub.   • Innovation & AI Curiosity: Curious about emerging AI tools and eager to experiment with practical applications to improve creative workflows and self-service capabilities.

💰 As part of our Financial Wellbeing, we provide competitive Compensation, an Employee Share Purchase Scheme, Pension, Life Assurance, and Income Protection.

🦸‍♀️ We support the women who work in Phorest by offering 2 weeks leave for Fertility Treatment, Pregnancy Loss and Menopause.

🌳 We grow our own timber! We provide a great learning environment and extensive development opportunities. We run development programs and provide access to many online resources including LinkedIn learning.

jobs.description:
RESUME AND COVER LETTER REQUIRED TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS POSITION

Deadline to apply is November 19, 2026

Salary: $75,000-$87,000 annually. Salary is dependent on experience and qualifications.

SUMMARY

The Meeting Manager assumes full responsibility for the planning, management, production, and execution of face to face events (ranging in size of 10-800 people) or online events, including the Online Annual Conference. Responsibilities generally include complex project management, detailed planning, contingency planning, troubleshooting, executing and evaluating association conferences from inception to completion. This position develops and manages all related budgets associated with the meeting planning process and leads the ops teams. The Meeting Manager works with other staff, member volunteers, program committees and presenters; liaises with hotel suppliers, related vendors, and builds a positive and professional image for all EDUCAUSE events.

In addition, this position plays a critical role navigating the complexities of online conferences. This includes managing digital integrations, fostering engagement within virtual communities, and delivering value to members through seamless online experiences. This position is instrumental in enhancing member engagement and facilitating impactful learning experiences.

In this role, the Meeting Manager must be a creative problem-solver, an excellent communicator with exceptional project management abilities, confident in decision-making, and able to remain composed under pressure.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Management and Event Architecture

  • Works with the event stakeholders to ensure the event strategy will meet event objectives and align with organizational objectives, when applicable.
  • Designs and builds the event components in conjunction with stakeholders and vendors, but has the acumen to know when decisions can be made unilaterally.
  • Responsible for the full scope of event project management, creating a detailed timeline, and adhering to strict deadlines to ensure successful execution of event logistics.
  • Oversees and manages all aspects of meeting logistics, including but not limited to registration, food and beverage, audio/visual, exhibits/corporate displays, floorplans, website/marketing review, internet requirements and connectivity, security, rigging, electrical, and on-site operations. Develop detailed logistical meeting specifications and effectively communicate those plans to all vendors and facilities to ensure a successful conference or event.
  • Updates meeting information in EDUCAUSE database (netFORUM) ensuring information is accurate.
  • Oversees the entire event on-site or online and serves as liaison for the association and participants during the event to address and resolve concerns or issues.
  • Advise on external online learning trends and effective practices that support continuous improvement, event attendance growth, participant engagement, participant satisfaction, and cost effectiveness.
  • Analyze post-event data, including attendee and exhibitor feedback, satisfaction and net promoter scores, and other metrics or indicators to identify trends and insights to provide actionable recommendations for improving the planning, execution, and outcomes of future events.
  • Working with the Sr. Director of Conferences and the Sr. Meeting Manager, manages assigned functions for the in-person Annual Conference, in addition to the Online Annual Conference.

Conference OpsTeam Management

  • Leads and manages conference ops team composed of internal stakeholders and those responsible for a segment or function of the planning and execution of the event.
  • Facilitates regular scheduled monthly or bi-weekly meetings
  • Develops timelines and establishes metrics to ensure deadlines are met for all event tasks.
  • Consults with team members to troubleshoot challenges; recommends, provides, and implements logistical solutions

Request for Proposals (RFPs)

  • Creates, formalizes, and submits RFPs to include preferences of conference stakeholders as well as historical outcomes of previous or similar events
  • Compile, assess, and prioritize the facility and vendor recommendations resulting from the RFP.
  • Draft and present proposals of facility and vendor recommendations to event stakeholders and in collaboration with the Sr. Director of CE.
  • Analyzes information and preferences to determine favorable locale, facility, and vendor selection.

Vendor Relationship and Service Negotiation

  • Establish and communicate expectations with vendors regarding hotel accommodations, audio visual needs, food and beverage, security, decorating, and special requests.
  • Negotiate and/or look for cost-saving measures with vendor quotes.

Financial Management: Budgeting, Forecasting, and Invoices

  • Develop, propose, and manage the event budget with stakeholders, ensuring revenue, expenditures, profitability and additional financial targets contribute to the financial fitness of the event, and prioritize the allocation of resources.
  • Maintains awareness of budgetary limitations as well as the impact on revenues relative to adjustments to expenses during negotiations.
  • Oversees the expense management to ensure revenue goals are met or exceeded.
  • Manages the process for re-forecasting the budget for the Online Annual Conference by tracking actual revenue and expenses that will affect the budget.
  • Carefully review detailed invoices for accuracy, ensuring they are correctly coded and processed in alignment with the budgeted natural accounts.

Association Service and Support

  • Participate in EDUCAUSE events and activities as needed. Travel may be required to support EDUCAUSE conferences/events, site visits, and external events relevant to the position.
  • Act as a departmental liaison with employees, members, volunteers, volunteer groups, and clients.
  • Supports members in a manner that facilitates their growth, engagement, and enhances their EDUCAUSE experience.
  • As a frontline user of EDUCAUSE systems and data services, complies with data quality standards; adheres to data governance policies, procedures, and processes for ensuring data integrity. May act as the application or data collection lead for the department.
  • Assists EDUCAUSE with support or production of other activities or events (such as Board Meetings, Home Week, PL events, etc.).
  • Represent EDUCAUSE in a professional manner at all times; engage with co-workers in a civil, caring, respectful way; and advance the mission and vision of EDUCAUSE
  • Duties, responsibilities and activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • This role has no supervisory responsibilities.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education and Experience

  • Required Bachelor’s degree. Training in related fields such as Hospitality Management,or Hotel Management is preferred.
  • Requires a minimum of eight years’ experience in meeting planning; hotel or convention center environments or a combination of education and experience.
  • A Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) certification is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Event industry knowledge
  • Online Conference knowledge
  • Requires excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Requires high attention to detail with exceptional organizational skills
  • Knowledgeable and proficient in budget development and management
  • The ability to manage multiple projects with good team facilitation skills
  • Knowledgeable in basic accounting
  • The ability to prioritize tasks
  • Requires sound judgment, and good intuition
  • The ability to be a self- starter and motivated
  • Requires good interpersonal skills.
  • Skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Must be available to travel
  • Must be able to work outside of normal office hours, including evenings and weekends, as needed

Competencies

  • Leadership - Exhibits confidence in self and others; Inspires and motivates others to perform well; Effectively influences actions and opinions of others; Accepts feedback from others; Gives appropriate recognition to others.
  • Managing People - Includes staff in planning, decision-making, facilitating and process improvement; Takes responsibility for subordinates' activities; Makes self-available to staff; Provides regular performance feedback; Develops subordinates' skills and encourages growth; Solicits and applies customer feedback (internal and external); Fosters quality focus in others; Improves processes, products and services.; Continually works to improve supervisory skills.
  • Delegation - Delegates work assignments; Matches the responsibility to the person; Gives authority to work independently; Sets expectations and monitors delegated activities; Provides recognition for results.
  • Motivation - Sets and achieves challenging goals; Demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles; Measures self against standard of excellence; Takes calculated risks to accomplish goals.
  • Project Management - Develops project plans; Coordinates projects; Communicates changes and progress; Completes projects on time and budget; Manages project team activities.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Physical demands of travel such as sitting for long periods, handling luggage, time zone changes, and adjusting to new environments.

Remote Work Requirements

  • Scheduled working hours either in the employees time zone or EDUCAUSE core working hours or core working hours to be determined with the supervisor.
  • Be available and responsive during scheduled work hours.
  • Any time off or change in working hours must be pre-arranged according to department guidelines and consistent with the rules applicable to employment (e.g., vacation, sick, personal, leave of absence).

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

  • Up to 15%.

TOTAL COMPENSATION

EDUCAUSE not only offers meaningful work and dedicated colleagues; we also have a robust benefit package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • 2-for-1 employer match to your 403(b) retirement plan; up to 10% of your base salary
  • Employer-paid Life and AD&D, Short‐Term Disability, and Long‐Term Disability
  • 15 days of vacation and 6 days of personal time annually
  • 9 paid holidays
  • One week of paid time off when offices are closed between Christmas and New Year’s Day
  • 36-hour work week (without any reduction in pay) amounting to 26 additional days of paid time off each year
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Emergency Travel Assistance
  • Professional development assistance
  • Monthly connectivity reimbursement

EEO Statement

EDUCAUSE is committed to an equal opportunity workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. EDUCAUSE provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

EDUCAUSE recognizes that the unique backgrounds, talents, skills, and contributions of every individual improve and enhance the quality of the association. Creating an environment of equal opportunity is an EDUCAUSE organizational goal, which includes, but is not limited to:

jobs.description:
Job Title: Grant Reviewer, Community Schools (CSII)
Work Arrangement: Remote
Location: Remote, United States
Employment Type: Part-Time, Independent Contractor (1099)
Engagement Type: Short-term, per grant competition; paid per application reviewed
Final Interview:

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring Grant Reviewers on behalf of the Office of the State Superintendent of Education (OSSE), the District of Columbia's state education agency, for its Community Schools Incentive Initiative (CSII) grant competition. OSSE is seeking reviewers with hands-on experience in community school models and integrated student supports who can evaluate the quality of school-community partnerships and implementation plans.

Grant reviewers provide independent subject matter expertise to read, score, and comment on competitive grant applications submitted by local education agencies, schools, community-based organizations, and other eligible entities. All reviews are completed remotely in OSSE's online Enterprise Grants Management System (EGMS), and reviewer scores are used to recommend applications for funding. OSSE selects reviewers from the qualified pool and gives preference to reviewers who have satisfactorily completed reviews for its competitions in previous years.

Work Schedule

This is a remote, part-time assignment. Reviews are completed on your own schedule within each deadline. The approximate commitment for this competition is:

  • Orientation and EGMS training: a virtual webinar held approximately within two weeks of the engagement start date.
  • Review window: usually two weeks from the date applications are assigned, unless OSSE specifies otherwise.
  • Facilitated discussion (only if needed): a phone or video conference, usually about three business days after the scoring due date, held when panel scores differ significantly.
  • Approximate completion of reviewer work: June 15, 2027. Final dates are confirmed before orientation.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Complete OSSE's EGMS training and attend the virtual, grant-specific orientation webinar before reviewing any applications.
  2. Independently read and conduct a detailed review of each assigned application (typically two or more per competition) as one of three reviewers on an EGMS review panel, working remotely and separately.
  3. Assess each application's alignment with community school pillars and the feasibility of its proposed implementation plan.
  4. Evaluate partnership quality and collaboration structures, including partnership memoranda of understanding (MOUs), stakeholder engagement plans, community needs assessments, and strategies for shared leadership.
  5. Analyze data, budgets, and needs assessments for accuracy, alignment, and responsiveness to identified community priorities.
  6. Complete a fully scored rubric for every section of each application, applying the established scoring criteria consistently and objectively.
  7. Write clear, constructive comments describing strengths and weaknesses that justify and align with the scores given. Reviews may be shared with applicants on request, with reviewer names and contact information removed.
  8. Base all scores and comments only on the content of each applicant's submission in EGMS.
  9. Submit all scores and comments in EGMS by the review deadline, usually two weeks from receiving the applications.
  10. Participate in a facilitated panel discussion by phone or video conference when scores differ significantly, then submit a final rubric with updated scores and comments reflecting any changes.
  11. Disclose any conflict of interest with applicant organizations and do not review any application where a conflict exists.
  12. Direct EGMS technical questions to the EGMS manual, the resources at grants.osse.dc.gov, or the EGMS call center at (202) 719-6500, and direct questions about the grant or about scoring to OSSE grant program staff.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher.
  • Demonstrated experience with community school models or integrated student supports, such as community schools, wraparound services, family engagement, or school-community partnerships.
  • Knowledge of whole-child and whole-family approaches, including strategies that address academic, social-emotional, and non-academic needs such as attendance interventions, health services, mental health supports, and community resource coordination.
  • Ability to review and score applications objectively, applying scoring rubrics consistently, assessing alignment with community school pillars, and evaluating the feasibility of implementation plans.
  • Skill in assessing partnership quality and collaboration structures, including partnership MOUs, stakeholder engagement plans, community needs assessments, and shared leadership strategies.
  • Strong analytical skills for reviewing data, budgets, and needs assessments for accuracy, alignment, and responsiveness to community priorities.
  • Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to provide clear, constructive, objective written feedback that helps applicants strengthen program design and implementation.
  • Reliable access to a computer, the internet, and a phone.
  • Availability for the full review process, including EGMS training, the orientation webinar, the complete review window, and a facilitated discussion if one is required.
  • No conflict of interest with any applicant organization in this competition, confirmed through a signed Conflict of Interest Form.
  • No unsatisfactory performance evaluation from past grant review work for OSSE or any other grant-making organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience reviewing competitive grant applications for OSSE or another government agency.

Compensation

  • $100 per application successfully reviewed. Reviewers are typically assigned two or more applications per competition.
  • Payment is made only after OSSE verifies successful completion of the entire review process: EGMS training, the orientation webinar, timely review and rigorous scoring of every assigned application in EGMS, and, if required, participation in a facilitated discussion with final scores submitted.
  • Payment is issued by Dhaka Technologies Limited Company by direct deposit or check within 30 calendar days of OSSE's verification.
  • Failure to complete timely, high-quality reviews will affect payment and will disqualify a reviewer from future assignments.

How to Apply

Interested candidates who meet the qualifications should send their resume to with the job title in the email subject line. Your resume should show your degree and your experience in the field. Please also mention in your resume the grants you have reviewed previously, including the grant-making organization, the grant program, and the year. Qualified applicants will be asked to complete a Grant Reviewer Application and a Conflict of Interest Form before they are recommended to OSSE.

Description

The Risk Manager (Clinical Research) plays a pivotal role in developing and executing risk-based monitoring strategies, ensuring data quality and integrity in clinical research projects. This position involves cross-functional collaboration to identify, assess, and mitigate risks throughout the clinical trial lifecycle, supporting the seamless implementation of Risk-Based Study Management (RBSM) principles in a CRO or pharma industry.

RESPONSIBILITIES

More specifically, the Risk Manager must:

  • Provide subject matter expertise for developing and updating the risk-based monitoring strategy tailored to project needs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and mitigate risks associated with complex indications.
  • May have to coordinate with central monitor team and verify work.
  • Point sur provide budget recommendations, change orders.
  • Draft initial risk assessments and support the finalization of Risk Assessment and Categorization Tools (RACT).
  • Guide Project Managers (PMs) in transferring identified risks to the appropriate tracking systems and ensure ongoing reviews.
  • Advise on developing functional plans to mitigate risks effectively.
  • Utilize available tools to conduct remote data reviews and centralized statistical monitoring, identifying risks to data quality and integrity.
  • Facilitate internal and sponsor reviews of findings, seeking cross-functional support for complex risks and mitigations.
  • Deliver initial and ongoing training for study teams on risk assessment, centralized monitoring, and risk-based monitoring strategies.
  • Escalate risks or deliverables at risk to the PM, including scope changes.
  • Provide strategic input on risk characterization and reporting to leadership.
  • Take on additional responsibilities as required, ensuring qualifications and training align with assigned tasks.

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research;

Experience

  • Must have experience in a CRO or pharma industry
  • Minimum of 3 years in risk management within a clinical research setting.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience across clinical monitoring, data management, drug safety.

Requirements:

  • Expertise in Good Clinical Practice/ICH E6 (R3) Guidelines and other regulatory requirements.
  • Proficiency in Risk-Based Monitoring strategies, processes, and tools.
  • Mastery of MS Excel (sorting, filtering, pivot tables).
  • Advanced skills in analytical data visualization tools.
  • Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma and web based RACT tools.
  • Strong analytical and statistical understanding.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to anticipate critical issues and develop proactive contingency plans.
  • Skilled in project workflows and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Training, mentoring, and organizational capabilities.
  • High level of autonomy.
  • Fluent in English (excellent oral and written).
  • Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively at all levels within the organization and with external customers.
  • Must be a fast learner and able to understand new concepts quickly.
  • Prioritization skills with the ability to plan, monitor, and manage workload fluidly in response to changing project demands.
  • Excellent understanding of project protocol, project documentation including centralized monitoring and risk-based monitoring.
  • Broad working knowledge of the roles, functions and process of conducting clinical trials.
  • Must be able to manage time effectively, working with multiple functions and requirements.
  • Must have been involved in the use of trial management or data management systems.

Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

OUR COMPANY

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Ongoing learning and development

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale..

jobs.excerpt: Soyez acteur de la solution avec Technip Energies et rejoignez-nous pour une carrière unique.
jobs.description:
Soyez acteur de la solution avec Technip Energies et rejoignez-nous pour une carrière unique. Vous contribuerez à développer des solutions de pointe pour résoudre les problèmes énergétiques auxquels notre monde est confronté.

Technip Energies est une entreprise de technologies et d’ingénierie de premier plan. Leader dans le GNL, l’hydrogène, l’éthylène, la chimie durable et la gestion du CO2, nous contribuons au développement de marchés stratégiques tels que l'énergie, les dérivés énergétiques, la décarbonation et la circularité. Nos segments d’activité complémentaires, Technologies, Produits et Services (TPS) et Livraison de Projet, transforment les innovations en réalité industrielle à grande échelle.

Animés par des valeurs de collaboration et d’excellence dans l’exécution, plus de 17 000 collaborateurs dans 34 pays s'engagent pour allier prospérité et durabilité en faveur d’un monde conçu pour durer.

Missions proposées :

Les unités flottantes offshore (FPSO, FLNG, etc…) sont constituées de plusieurs modules pesant plusieurs milliers de tonnes et supportés par la coque.
Chacun de ces modules repose sur la coque au travers de « bearing nodes », nœuds structuraux qui permettent de transmettre les efforts du module vers la coque tout en accommodant les mouvements relatifs entre ces deux structures.

Ces « bearing nodes » sont des structures complexes, comportant un nombre important de pièces et de soudures engendrant des temps significatifs d’analyses, de fabrication et d’inspection.

L’objectif du stage est d’étudier la faisabilité d’un concept de « bearing node » simplifié et standardisé couvrant plusieurs plages de chargement et pouvant être décliné sur de futurs projets.

L’étude portera sur :

  • Analyse du design de référence
    • Revue des concepts existants sur différents projets
    • Identification des paramètres dimensionnants
    • Analyse des difficultés de fabrication et de modélisation
  • Développement d’un concept simplifié et standardisé
    • Simplification de la géométrie
    • Réduction du nombre de pièces et d’assemblages soudés
    • Simplification des procédés de soudage
    • Définition d’une gamme de variantes par plage de charges admissibles
  • Evaluation des bénéfices
    • Constructibilité et facilité de fabrication
    • Performance
    • Temps et complexité des calculs
    • Impact poids

L'étude devra mettre en évidence les avantages, les limitations et le domaine d'application du concept proposé, ainsi que son potentiel de standardisation pour les futurs projets.

Lors de ce stage, vous serez accompagné(e) par un(e) tuteur/tutrice pour répondre à vos différentes questions. Ce stage sera pour vous, l’occasion de monter en compétences, connaissances.

Profil recherché:

Nous serions heureux de vous rencontrer et d’échanger sur votre adéquation à ce poste. Pour réussir cette mission, vous devrez remplir les conditions suivantes :

  • En cours de Bac +5 dans une école d'ingénieurs
  • Vous suivez une formation en ingénierie des structures offshore ou navale
  • Vous avez des connaissances en RDM et calculs de charpentes métalliques
  • Vous avez des connaissances en Elément Finis
  • Vous avez un anglais opérationnel (oral & écrit)

Vous cherchez à réaliser votre stage dans un environnement international et dynamique, à prendre part à des projets d'envergure et à relever des défis techniques et organisationnels ?

Envoyez-nous votre candidature!

Votre carrière chez nous :

Travailler chez Technip Energies est une aventure passionnante, remplie de projets novateurs et de collaborations actives.
