Job Title: Senior Insurance Claims Expert (Liability, Property & Contents)

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

Job Summary

We are seeking experienced Senior Insurance Claims Experts to contribute industry expertise to an AI training project focused on real-world insurance claim scenarios. The role involves evaluating auto liability disputes, property and catastrophe damage, and contents claims using video evidence, photographs, aerial imagery, and supporting documentation. Candidates will provide professional claim determinations and clear, well-supported reasoning. Prior AI experience is not required.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Review disputed-fault auto claims by analyzing video footage, written statements, and supporting documentation.
  2. Assess property and catastrophe-related damage using aerial roof imagery and catastrophe photographs to determine the extent of loss and applicable liability.
  3. Evaluate contents claims using photographic evidence and prepare detailed inventories and valuation assessments.
  4. Prepare clear, accurate, and well-reasoned claim determination reports consistent with professional insurance adjusting standards.
  5. Apply comparative fault principles and liability assessment methods to support defensible claim outcomes.
  6. Communicate findings and technical reasoning through concise, professional written reports and feedback.
  7. Contribute expert insights to improve the accuracy and reliability of AI-driven insurance claims processing.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. At least five years of insurance claims experience, particularly in auto liability, property, catastrophe claims, and contents assessment.
  2. An active state adjuster license or relevant professional certifications, such as AIC, CPCU, HAAG, or ACTAR.
  3. Demonstrated experience in comparative fault determination and complex liability assessments.
  4. Strong ability to interpret video evidence, photographs, aerial imagery, and other claim-related documentation.
  5. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings clearly.
  6. Proven experience preparing detailed claim documentation, damage assessments, and valuation reports.
  7. Ability to work independently in a remote environment and use digital tools for evidence review and report submission.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A highly experienced insurance claims professional with strong expertise in liability determination, property damage evaluation, and contents valuation. The ideal candidate demonstrates sound judgment, meticulous documentation skills, and the ability to deliver accurate, evidence-based claim assessments remotely.

  • Excellent attention to detail and visual analysis skills.

At Doccla we’re redefining where and how healthcare is delivered.

We made our name as the UK’s leading provider of Virtual Wards designed to help hospitals discharge patients sooner and to care for them safely at home. Now Doccla is investing in technology-enabled proactive care to prevent people from unnecessary hospitalisation at a scale that can have a meaningful impact.

We provide everything clinicians need to deliver safe, effective Virtual Care across the full acuity spectrum, under one managed service. That spans Virtual Wards, helping hospitals discharge patients sooner and care for them safely at home, and Proactive Care, preventing unnecessary hospitalisation for the highest-risk patients in the community. Behind both sits a CQC-regulated clinical team, medical-grade devices, logistics, patient onboarding, EHR integration, and an AI-powered care platform built around real-world workflows.

We currently work with over 60% of NHS ICBs and support health systems across the UK, Ireland and the DACH region to reduce hospital pressure, improve outcomes, and create a more resilient model of care.

This is your chance to join Doccla at a key stage in our growth.

We’re building the category leader in Virtual Care and Remote Patient Monitoring. You’ll be part of a highly entrepreneurial, mission-driven team that combines expertise across clinical, technical, commercial, and operational domains.

We’re solving real problems for patients and health systems and growing fast.

We offer a 24/7 service so availability for a 24 hour rota will be necessary.

This is a Full Time Permanent Role

The ANP/ACP plays a critical role in supporting virtual care by providing support and advice to our remote monitoring clinicians.

The post holder will work as an experienced, autonomous Practitioner who, acting within their professional boundaries will provide care for patients remotely and from history taking, clinical assessment, diagnosis, treatment and evaluation of care, you must demonstrate critical thinking in the clinical decision-making process to ensure safe and expert care.

The post holder will also work collaboratively with the multidisciplinary team to meet the needs of patients, supporting the delivery of policy and procedures, and providing Clinical leadership as required.

The post holder will use the web-based Doccla platform to help monitor patient wellbeing, support their care needs, and assist in delivering high-quality care in collaboration with the wider clinical team.

✅ What Experience You’ll Bring to the Team

Responsibilities include:

  • Deliver high-standard, autonomous care in primary care settings through advanced clinical skills and theoretical knowledge

  • As an independent prescriber, the post holder will prescribe safe, effective and appropriate medication as defined by current legislative framework

  • Work with patients in order to support compliance with and adherence to prescribed treatments, provide information and advice on prescribed or over-the-counter medication on medication regimens, side-effects and interactions

  • Prioritise health problems and intervene appropriately to assist the patient in complex, urgent or emergency situations, including initiation of effective emergency care

  • Encourage and support patients with long term conditions to develop their ability to self-manage

  • Produce accurate, contemporaneous and complete records of patient consultation, consistent with legislation, policies and procedures on the clinical system

  • Provide support to patients in their home environment, ensuring their comfort, safety, and wellbeing.

  • Communicate effectively with patients, offering reassurance and advice as directed by clinical protocols.

  • Escalate patient concerns to the appropriate healthcare professionals as per established protocols.

  • Participate in clinical audits and quality improvement initiatives.

  • Provide general administrative support to the clinical team, including managing appointments and patient follow-ups.

  • Support the integration of care pathways for remote patient monitoring to enhance patient outcomes.

You will work closely with:

  • Clinicians and medical staff from both Doccla and from our customers

  • Doccla’s Customer Service team

  • Registered Manager CQC

  • Key account managers

  • Advanced clinical practice experience

  • Experience working in Primary Care, with significant post-registration experience

Desirable:

To thrive here, you’ll need a can-do attitude and an action-oriented approach, along with a willingness to learn and grow through open feedback.

jobs.description:
Bold

Nuestra compañía fue fundada en Mayo de 2019 por un equipo de personas increíbles y con una experiencia única, el grupo de fundadores está conformado por los creadores de PayU Latam y otras empresas expertas en tecnología financiera. Estamos creando soluciones de pago y de banca para MiPymes, independientes y emprendedores en Colombia. Actualmente contamos con más de 600.000 clientes registrados en nuestra plataforma y hemos recibido más de USD $120 millones de fondos de inversión nacionales y extranjeros, somos una de las startups de más rápido crecimiento en LatAm en el sector fintech.

Bold es una fintech que provee una solución de pagos a los microempresarios para recibir pagos con tarjetas débito, crédito y billeteras a través de datáfonos y links de pago. Sin embargo, la visión de Bold es más ambiciosa que ser una empresa de pagos y estamos trabajando para volvernos una plataforma de servicios financieros y tecnológicos para las pequeñas empresas en el país complementando las soluciones de pagos y banca con otros productos de software conexos a toda nuestra propuesta de valor.
Nuestra misión en Bold es liberar el potencial de los emprendedores. En Bold creemos firmemente que podemos ayudar a los pequeños emprendedores a desarrollar sus negocios ofreciendo servicios financieros y tecnológicos hechos a su medida, que sean amigables y cercanos.

En Bold definimos los siguientes valores como los pilares de nuestra cultura organizacional: Maestría, Pensamiento crítico, Trabajo en equipo, Sentido de urgencia, Somos abiertos y el cliente el centro de lo que hacemos.

Para más información acerca de Bold visita nuestro sitio web:

El Rol

Como Head of Strategic Partnerships & Business Development, serás responsable de liderar, estructurar y acelerar el crecimiento de Bold en los segmentos de Enterprise, Partners Pro, construyendo alianzas tecnológicas y comerciales de alto impacto que integren nuestras soluciones de pago en ecosistemas de software y grandes corporativos. Será responsable de articular la visión comercial con producto y tecnología para cerrar negociaciones complejas, crear nuevos productos, procesos y soluciones y expandir el volumen transaccional de la compañía, posicionando a Bold como el aliado estratégico preferido de las grandes empresas del país.

Deberás

  • Definir y ejecutar la estrategia unificada para los frentes de Enterprise, Partners Pro y Online, alineando los objetivos de expansión con el roadmap de la empresa.

  • Liderar la adquisición, retención y crecimiento de grandes cuentas corporativas (Enterprise), asegurando el cumplimiento de los targets de TPV (Total Payment Volume), ingresos y comisiones.

  • Diseñar y liderar la estrategia de alianzas con empresas de sistemas POS, y plataformas tecnológicas para habilitar e integrar el uso de nuestros datáfonos y soluciones de cobro.

  • Estructurar negociaciones complejas de ciclo largo (más de un año de gestión/onboarding) y proyectos con implementaciones técnicas a la medida para clientes de gran escala (retail, cadenas de sucursales, consumo masivo, salud, entre otros).

  • Trabajar de la mano con Producto , Tecnología y Operaciones, entre otras áreas, para definir requerimientos técnicos, viabilidad de integraciones y evolución de la oferta; coordinar con Legal y Finanzas para estructurar contratos a la medida, modelos de revenue-share, pricing y rentabilidad.

  • Formar, inspirar y liderar a los equipos comerciales y de desarrollo de negocio a cargo de cada vertical.

¿Qué tenemos para ti?

🤝 Contrato a término indefinido

💲 Salario competitivo

💻 Trabajo remoto la mayor parte de tiempo

👨🏽‍⚕️ Póliza de salud

📚 Apoyo económico para educación

🌎 Tecnologías y procesos de clase mundial

🏖️ Días libres adicionales a las vacaciones

👓 Bono para salud visual

❤️‍🩹Bienestar emocional

Requirements

  • Profesional en Ingeniería Industrial, Administración, Economía o carreras afines.

  • Mínimo 6 a 8 años liderando equipos comerciales B2B / Enterprise y desarrollo de negocios en empresas del sector Fintech, Pasarelas de Pago (PayU, Mercado Pago o similares), Startups de tecnología o ecosistemas de software SaaS/POS.

  • Deseable especialización o maestría.

  • Capacidad probada de entender arquitectura de pagos, APIs e integraciones técnicas con POS, manteniendo a la vez un enfoque orientado al cierre comercial y la negociación estratégica

  • Gran capacidad de relacionamiento con stakeholders de nivel C-Level y liderazgo en negociaciones comerciales complejas.

  • Inglés alto

  • Manejo de herramientas de análisis de datos.

En Bold, el talento no tiene etiquetas. Fomentamos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo y accesible para todos, garantizando un proceso de selección equitativo. Si necesitas algún ajuste razonable para participar en el proceso, por favor infórmanos al postularte.

Como Titular de Datos Personales, te asisten los derechos previstos en la Ley 1581 de 2012 y demás normas que la complementen o modifiquen, en especial, los derechos a conocer, actualizar, rectificar o solicitar la supresión de tus datos, y revocar la autorización que has otorgado para el uso de tus Datos Personales. jobs.description:
CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi-trillion-dollar insurance economy, creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at .

The Role

As an Engineering Manager you'll lead one of our new AI product teams and own delivery, hiring, and people. You'll start with a small, senior team, and your first big job is hiring the engineers who will grow it. You'll partner with product as an equal, turn an ambitious strategy into a plan your team can execute, and make sure the quality of what you ship is measured. You stay close to the technology: you can review a design doc, read a pull request, and judge when an AI feature is ready for customers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Hire, grow, and retain a strong team of software, ML, and AI engineers, with clear feedback and fair performance and career conversations
  • Own delivery: planning, priorities, execution, and production quality, with metrics that show how the team and its products are doing
  • Partner with product and domain experts to shape the roadmap, and lead across teams
  • Set how the team uses AI-assisted and agentic engineering tools, and model it yourself

Requirements:

  • Typically 8+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years managing engineers
  • Experience shipping AI, ML, or LLM-powered products to production, with enough hands-on depth in TypeScript, Python, and AI-assisted tools to make sound technical calls
  • A track record of hiring well and growing teams
  • A data-driven approach: you use metrics to run your team and to judge whether what you ship is working
  • Comfort leading across more than one reporting line, and strong written communication with executives

Nice to have

  • Experience running a platform team whose customers are other engineering teams

Interview Policy & Privacy Notice:

A video interview is required for this position. Video interviews are transcribed. Transcriptions are retained and may be reviewed by CCC and our recruiters. Candidates are not permitted to use generative AI or automated assistance during the interviews unless explicitly allowed by the interview team for a specific exercise. Our Job Applicant Privacy Notice is available HERE.

About CCC's Commitment to Employees:

CCC Intelligent Solutions understands that our employees play an integral role in our vision to shape a world where life just works. Our team is defined by our values of Integrity, Customer-Focus, Innovation, Inclusion & Diversity, Tenacity, and Connection. Through diverse perspectives, purposeful innovation, and the strength of connections, our technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most.

At CCC, together everyone can thrive as we innovate and collaborate, creating employee experiences that just work. We are committed to providing opportunities for our people to make real-life impacts, advance in their careers, and contribute to CCC’s success.

CCC offers competitive compensation and benefits to support you and your families, including:

  • 401K Match

  • Paid time off

  • Annual Incentive Plan Performance Bonus

  • Comprehensive health insurance

  • Adoption Assistance

  • Tuition Reimbursement

  • Wellness Programs

  • Stock Purchase Plan options

  • Employee Resource Groups

For more information about our benefits, please check out our careers site.

Here, you belong. You are seen, valued, and respected. We celebrate you for who you are and all you bring. Every voice is heard and is important to our success. You can hear what employees have to say about our culture here

jobs.description:
Employment Type: Full-TimeWork Setting: Remote

Work Location: Europe

Work Hours: Office hours

Find out more here:

About SemiAnalysis

SemiAnalysis is an independent research and analysis firm specializing in the Semiconductor and AI industries. Our in-depth coverage spans the entire supply chain, from semiconductor fabrication processes to cutting-edge AI Models, software, and infrastructure. We are recognized as the leading authority on the semiconductor supply chain, with the highest concentration of industry experts within one team, and a deep-rooted passion for delving into the intricacies.

We’re a global team of over 50 analysts, each with extensive networks across the semiconductor supply chain and AI ecosystem, publishing industry shaping articles while participating in 40+ conferences annually.

Our newsletter reaches more than 200,000 subscribers worldwide, including senior management and c-suite leaders at the leading semiconductor and AI companies.

We also offer three core products:

  • Industry Models – we develop and publish industry models on accelerator shipments, datacentre demand and supply, GPU total cost of ownership, and more. We work with hyperscalers, neoclouds, many of the world’s largest hedge funds, and government agencies.

  • Core Research – our public equity markets product, geared towards financial investors, distils our deep technical research and knowledge into key insights on technology and product trends.

  • Consulting and Technical Due Diligence – We conduct custom research and project work to guide key strategic and investment decisions for the largest private equity funds, leading venture capital firms, companies across the AI ecosystem, and government agencies.

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced, driven Energy Analyst to join our global team. This role focuses on analyzing how the rapid growth of AI and datacenter infrastructure is reshaping the American energy system — from power generation and transmission to interconnection, regulation, and emerging energy technologies.

As an Analyst, you will lead and contribute to in-depth, forward-looking research that informs the world’s largest asset managers, energy companies, and infrastructure investors. You will uncover emerging market trends, evaluate grid constraints, track power supply developments, and assess how new energy technologies are enabling the next wave of AI infrastructure. Your insights will directly guide strategic decisions across the energy and AI ecosystem.

This is a full-time, remote position. Candidates must be based in a European time zone or Eastern time zone, with a minimum of 2–5 years of relevant experience, ideally in equity research, energy analysis, or investment research.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze how GenAI and datacenter infrastructure are impacting the American energy system.

  • Build on SemiAnalysis’ industry-leading tracking of 150+ AI chips and 5,000+ datacenters to assess power demand and regional constraints.

  • Research power plants, interconnection queues, utilities, IPPs, ISOs, and PUCs to understand how future AI datacenters are securing energy supply.

  • Evaluate transmission constraints and their impact on utilities, grid operators, and electrical equipment suppliers.

  • Contribute to SemiAnalysis’ forward-looking research on batteries, solar, fuel cells, SMRs, and other technologies powering the future of AI.

  • Produce high-impact research reports, forecasts, and briefings for institutional clients using public and proprietary data.

  • Collaborate with semiconductor, datacenter, and AI infrastructure analysts to generate cross-sector insights.

  • Support hedge funds, infrastructure investors, hyperscalers, and policymakers with bespoke energy and power market analysis.

  • Present research findings to senior leadership teams and participate in client calls and conference presentations.

Requirements

  • 2–5+ years of professional experience in equity research, energy analysis, investment research, or a related strategy role.

  • Strong understanding of the U.S. power system, including generation, transmission, interconnection, utilities, IPPs, ISOs, and regulatory bodies.

  • Experience analyzing energy markets, infrastructure investment, and grid constraints.

  • Deep interest in how AI and compute infrastructure are transforming the energy landscape.

  • Proven ability to synthesize complex technical, regulatory, and market data into actionable insights.

  • Exceptional writing and presentation skills, with experience producing research reports, investment memos, or market primers.

  • Proficiency in Excel; experience with data visualization and/or scripting (Python, SQL, etc.) is a plus.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-moving, globally distributed team.

Growth Areas

  • Deepen expertise in power markets and grid infrastructure, particularly in modeling AI-driven electricity demand and regional supply constraints.

  • Expand coverage into emerging energy technologies supporting AI growth, including storage, nuclear (SMRs), hydrogen, and next-generation renewables.

  • Develop advanced forecasting and scenario modeling capabilities for power demand, capacity buildout, and transmission bottlenecks.

  • Build cross-domain expertise linking semiconductors, datacenters, and energy systems to generate differentiated, system-level insights.

  • Strengthen client-facing capabilities, including leading discussions with institutional investors, infrastructure players, and policymakers.

  • Enhance data analysis and automation skills using Python, SQL, and visualization tools to scale research output and improve analytical depth.

  • Progress toward a senior analyst or sector lead role with ownership over energy and power coverage related to AI infrastructure.

jobs.excerpt: About iBusiness Funding iBusiness Funding is a leading provider of lending solutions for banks and lenders of all sizes, specializing in Small Business Lending including - Conventional, SBA and government-guaranteed lending programs.
jobs.description:
About iBusiness Funding

iBusiness Funding is a leading provider of lending solutions for banks and lenders of all sizes, specializing in Small Business Lending including - Conventional, SBA and government-guaranteed lending programs. The company is dedicated to streamlining the business lending process and enabling lenders to efficiently deliver capital to small- and medium-sized businesses.

To date, we have processed more than $11 billion in SBA and non-SBA volume and handle more than 1,000 business loan applications daily through a tech enabled platform that provides a key advantage alongside our best-in-class team. Our team is driven by our core values of innovation, integrity, enjoyment, and family.

Join us and be part of a team that is transforming the finance industry and empowering businesses to thrive.

Position Description

The Credit Risk Manager will develop, implement, and monitor data-driven credit strategies that support iBusiness Funding's lending growth while maintaining credit performance within risk parameters established by the Risk team. This individual will analyze origination, pipeline, and portfolio data to identify opportunities to improve application intake, approval quality, and funding pull-through while continuously evaluating risk-adjusted returns.

The role will own and enhance business intelligence reporting for pipeline and credit performance, including dashboards built in Amazon QuickSight and other BI tools. Working closely with Credit Risk, Modeling, Analytics, Product, Operations, and Technology, the Credit Risk Manager will translate insights into credit policy, decision rules, model implementation, and ongoing monitoring.

This individual will also work directly with embedded lending partners to implement partner-specific credit models, support investors and warehouse lenders with credit performance reporting, and help launch new lending products and channels. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical skills with sound credit judgment and a commercial approach to profitable growth.

Major Areas of Responsibility

Credit Strategy, Risk-Adjusted Growth, and Conversion Optimization

  • Develop and refine credit strategies using application, offer, funding, and portfolio performance data to optimize growth within approved risk appetite and agreed-upon credit performance targets.
  • Identify opportunities to improve application intake, approvals, offer acceptance, closing, and funded-loan pull-through by segment, channel, product, and lending partner.
  • Continuously assess risk versus return, including expected credit losses, delinquency, defaults, pricing, profitability, and portfolio yield; recommend appropriate adjustments to credit policy and decisioning.

jobs.excerpt: your missionFires and unplanned downtime cost industrial companies millions.
jobs.description:
your mission

Fires and unplanned downtime cost industrial companies millions. We catch both before they happen.

AVIAN's Swiss-engineered infrared cameras and AI monitoring detect abnormal heat inside industrial facilities at the point of inception. One signal does two jobs: it flags fire risk before a fire starts, and equipment wear before it becomes an unplanned shutdown.

Our system has already prevented thousands of fire events and saved millions of dollars in downtime prevented in live operations across wood processing, recycling and paper. We are also driving in new, exciting verticals like data centers and battery storage facilities with our powerful, adaptable solution.

Customers are coming to us and insurers are partnering with us, but that demand is a fraction of the opportunity. Thousands of facilities have never heard our name. You are joining our founding sales team in Germany as one of its first remote Account Executives, reporting to the CEO and helping us scale toward $10M+ ARR.

What you'll own:

  • The full cycle. New ARR and expansion deals from first contact to signature: discovery, demo, site visit, ROI case, proposal, negotiation, close. You sell to operations, maintenance and reliability, safety, procurement, and executive buyers, often inside the same account.
  • Your pipeline. You prospect directly into plant managers, maintenance and reliability leaders, safety leaders, and executives at high-risk facilities, consistently, not only when the funnel thins. Marketing, trade shows, partner referrals, and SDR-booked meetings are a bonus on top. The number is yours, and reaching it means working the phones hard every week.
  • The business case. You turn operational pain into an urgent financial argument: unplanned downtime, damaged equipment, lost inventory, rising insurance requirements. Some buyers move over what a fire would cost once, others over what a failing bearing costs every quarter.
  • The account after signature. You do not hand the customer off. You keep the relationship and grow it.
  • The feedback loop. You work closely with marketing, product, and implementation, and what you learn from the market shapes our pitch, pricing, and roadmap.

Land and expand:

  • Land. The first purchase is usually one site, often one high-risk area inside it: a shredder line, a baler, a dryer, a chip pile. You win it by making the risk and the financial case impossible to ignore.
  • Prove. You stay close through installation and the first months of monitoring. Early results earn you the right to ask for more: a heat event caught before it spread, a bearing flagged before it seized, a cleaner insurance conversation.
  • Expand within the site. Coverage grows from that first area to the whole facility as trust builds and the early saves add up.
  • Expand across the account. Most customers run several facilities, some run dozens. One plant that trusts us becomes the reference for the next, and eventually the group standard. You work upward to corporate operations, safety, and risk, and outward to every other site.

This takes patience and emotional intelligence. Plant managers guard their budgets and their independence. Corporate teams want one standard across every site. You need credibility with both, and going to corporate too early can cost you the plant champion who got you in.

The account stays yours as it grows, and every expansion inside it pays you again. Some of your biggest wins in year two will come from accounts you landed in year one.

What success looks like in year one:
  • You close new customers and expansions that put AVIAN on the path to $10M+ ARR.
  • You self-source most of your own pipeline.
  • You turn your first sites into proof points, and at least one into a second site.
  • For your largest accounts, you build plans that map every facility, every stakeholder, and a path to standardizing on AVIAN.
  • You document what works, so the hires after you ramp faster.

your profile

Who you are:

  • You've closed complex B2B deals. Technical products, multiple stakeholders, real negotiation, and you've consistently hit or beaten quota doing it.
  • You build your own pipeline. Startup, scale-up, or a scrappy team inside a larger industrial company, you have sold where nobody handed you leads. Many of your best deals started with you reaching out cold, and you can name them.
  • You grow accounts over years, not quarters. You can point to a customer that started small and got much bigger because of how you managed it, and name the people you won over at each stage.
  • You read operational buyers well. Plant managers, maintenance and reliability leaders, and safety directors can tell within five minutes whether you understand their world. You can also read who is skeptical, who feels threatened, and who quietly decides. Here that is the job, not a soft skill.
  • You're structured. Clean CRM (we run HubSpot), honest forecasts, disciplined next steps, strong follow-up.
  • You're based in Germany and ready to be on the road. You travel to customer sites, trade shows, and team meetings as the deal demands.

You might be coming from fire protection, industrial automation, condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, machine vision, safety tech, or insurance loss control. If you've sold into plants and facilities, we want to hear from you.

Bonus points if you've sold in our core verticals (wood processing, recycling, paper), rolled out a solution across multiple sites of one customer, or built relationships with insurers, brokers, integrators, or OEMs that open doors.

If you don't tick every box but you know you can sell this, apply anyway and tell us why.

why us?

What we offer:

  • Compensation: competitive base plus uncapped variable, where every new site pays as new business and every expansion or upsell inside your sites pays on top
  • Access: you report to the CEO and work directly with our leadership team and founders, with real influence on pricing, pitch, and go-to-market
  • A product that sells into urgency you do not have to manufacture: fires are an existential risk, downtime costs our customers every month, and insurers increasingly require prevention
  • Flexible, high-trust working model with an international, customer-obsessed team

How we work:

Clarity, ownership, speed. Everyone owns outcomes end-to-end. We fail fast and fix faster. Knowledge is shared, decisions are open, feedback is constant.

Hiring process:

  • Intro call (30 min): mutual fit and your track record
  • Deep-dive interview: how you sell, including a deal you sourced yourself and an account you grew
  • Practical exercise: a discovery and pitch simulation on a real facility scenario (recycling plant or sawmill), then how you would grow that site into the rest of the group
  • Meet the team and a conversation with our founders
  • Offer: we move in weeks, not months

AVIAN is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request.

Works with designated Travel Management Companies (TMC), approved online reservation systems, and other vendors to arrange airfare, accommodations, ground transportation, and related services; confirms traveler readiness; and communicates booking details, documentation requirements, deadlines, and relevant travel information.


Supports expense reporting and reimbursement, vendor payment requests, travel advance and credit card reconciliation, journal entries, account adjustments, record maintenance, and financial closeout. Reviews supporting documentation, approvals, project allocations, and charges for accuracy, completeness, and compliance, and assists with resolving discrepancies and responding to audit-related requests.

Troubleshoots user and process issues, coordinates escalation and resolution, and contributes to departmental workflows, databases, system testing, projects, program implementation, and continuous process improvements.

  • Arranges airfare, accommodations, ground transportation, and related travel services through the designated Travel Management Companies (TMC), approved booking platforms, procurement systems, and vendors, applying available contracts and negotiated rates to support cost-effective travel.
  • Confirms travel arrangements and traveler readiness, verifies required approvals and documentation, and communicates itineraries, booking details, destination requirements, deadlines, and relevant travel information to travelers and internal stakeholders.

Redwood Finance Automation Engineer, Global (UK and Europe)

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote. Open to consultants based in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, Romania, Bulgaria, Spain, Portugal, Italy and Czechia. Day rate: GBP 350 in the UK. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will build what the solution design sets out. You will configure the close and reconciliation processes, build the integrations with the ERP and the systems around it, and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

Close processes built and configured end to end: task lists, dependencies, approvals and the automated steps between them. Automated account reconciliation, including matching rules and exception handling. Journal entry automation, from data preparation and validation through to posting in the ERP. Integration with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and other source systems, through standard connectors, file and API interfaces. Intercompany, accrual and reclassification steps automated alongside the close. Workflow logic in REL or JavaScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on delivery on Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance), where you built close, reconciliation or journal processes yourself on at least one live implementation. 5 or more years in finance systems or automation engineering. Working knowledge of SAP FI/CO postings and master data, or the Oracle equivalent, and where ERP integrations tend to break. Workflow scripting in REL or JavaScript, and hands-on ERP integration. jobs.excerpt: About us Practifi is a client management platform for wealth management firms, built natively on Salesforce.
jobs.description:
About us

Practifi is a client management platform for wealth management firms, built natively on Salesforce. Advice businesses across North America and Australia run their working day inside our product, and the measure we hold ourselves to is whether it makes that day better. Shipping is the easy half. Watching a firm work differently because of it is the part we’re here for. We’re remote-first, and we built the company the way we build the product, with the people who use it in mind.

The role

Our Client Success Managers are the people growing advisory firms call first. You’d own a book of mid-market and growth-stage registered investment advisers (RIAs): firms that are adding advisors, acquiring practices, and leaning on their technology to keep up.

The work is relationship-led. Firms that are healthy, well-adopted, and engaged renew and grow on their own, so your attention goes to adoption, client health, and trust rather than a hard sell. Because you’ve worked in financial services, you’d advise on how Practifi should fit the way a firm actually runs, not just how the screens work.

You’d report to our Head of Revenue and work alongside Account Management, Implementation, Support, and Product. There’s a clear path from here toward Senior and Lead Client Success roles.

What you’d own

  • A book of client relationships across their lifecycle, as the primary point of contact
  • Semi-annual business reviews that tie a firm’s use of Practifi to what it’s trying to achieve
  • Renewals, with a Lead or Senior Client Success Manager in your corner when a situation calls for it
  • Growth inside your book that comes from adoption, not pressure
  • Release readiness for your clients, before and after each release
  • 45-minute training demonstrations that leave people able to do something new
  • Getting complex questions to the right experts fast, and flagging firms that are outgrowing the segment for our Account Management team

Who we’re hoping to meet

Three to five years in client success or account management at a B2B SaaS company, owning a book with renewals attached. At least two years of that, or alongside it, in financial services: at a wealth technology or fintech company, or managing a book of RIA, broker-dealer, or wealth management clients. We’re looking for directly relevant experience. You’ve sat on the software side of the table with financial services clients, and you know how an advisory firm makes decisions, handles compliance pressure, and grows.

You’re comfortable running a training session for a client audience, and you live in your CRM. Salesforce makes the first few months easier, and so does time with an advisor CRM, portfolio management, or financial planning platform. If AI tools have changed how you manage a book, tell us what changed.

Mostly, you’re the person who notices a client has gone quiet and reaches out before anyone asks. You’d rather raise a risk early than explain it late.

Pay and benefits

  • $85,000 to $105,000 base, plus uncapped variable compensation on renewal and expansion revenue. We publish our ranges because we’d rather have that conversation up front than dance around it later.
  • Generous time off: 20 days of paid vacation, 10 sick days, 3 personal days, and 3 volunteering days annually
  • Medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance benefits, plus a 401(k) with company match
  • A learning stipend we call Learnbucks, because we couldn’t help ourselves
  • A Practibuddy mentor from your first week
  • Two company summits a year in Chicago

How we work

Growth, Collaboration, Transparency, Curiosity, and Integrity aren’t posters on a wall here. In this role they look like telling a firm the truth about what isn’t working yet, asking how a firm really operates before recommending anything, and pulling in Support or Product the moment a problem needs them instead of holding onto it. We’d rather hear about a renewal risk early than read about it in a churn report.

The role is fully remote within the US and does not provide Visa sponsorship (must be legally authorized to work in the US for any employer without sponsorship).

If that’s the kind of ownership you’re looking for, we’d like to hear from you.

You will work closely with Legal, Engineering, Product, Commercial, Security and executive leadership to ensure regulatory requirements are understood, appropriately implemented and integrated into business operations.

Responsibilities

  • Lead regulatory compliance activities across satellite operations and remote sensing, including applicable FCC, NOAA and European regulatory frameworks, licensing, authorizations and reporting obligations.

  • Advise Engineering, Mission Operations, Product and Commercial teams on regulatory implications of satellite missions, technology development, data distribution and international customer engagements.

  • Support government and defense business by assessing relevant contractual, security and controlled-information obligations, working with Legal and Information Security.

  • Develop and maintain company-wide compliance policies, Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) frameworks, risk assessments and internal controls, including business ethics and anti-corruption measures; coordinate training, regulatory monitoring and external legal advisers as needed.

  • Regulatory Calendar & Corporate Compliance: Establish and maintain a centralized compliance calendar across all Hydrosat entities, tracking corporate registrations, statutory filings, license renewals, regulatory reporting obligations, and applicable deadlines at national, state, and local levels. Coordinate with Finance, Legal, Operations, and external advisers to ensure timely compliance.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in regulatory compliance or export controls within the space, aerospace, satellite, defense or similarly regulated technology industries.

  • Strong working knowledge of US export controls (ITAR/EAR), international trade restrictions and practical implementation of compliance controls.

  • Experience with commercial space, satellite communications or remote sensing regulation, with the ability to navigate licensing and regulatory authority interactions.

  • Proven ability to independently establish or improve compliance processes and partner effectively with technical, legal and commercial stakeholders.

  • Clear communication, pragmatic judgment and fluency in English; degree in Law, Compliance, Engineering or a related field.

Role Purpose

The Project Controls Engineer supports the design, configuration, commissioning, and documentation of plant control systems for utility-scale solar, storage, and hybrid renewable energy projects. This engineer executes project work with guidance from senior engineers, applies working knowledge of grid functionality and Utility/ISO standards, and contributes to the continuous improvement of product standards. Approximately 90% of this role is project execution, while up to 10% is continuous improvement and product development.

This is a temporary role expected to last approximately 6 months.

Responsibilities

Project Execution & Technical Delivery (~90%)

  • Execute controls design for utility-scale solar, BESS, and hybrid projects under the guidance of senior engineers, including review of the project scope to identify project-specific requirements and deviations from the standard Terabase controls product offering.
  • Program and commission SEL controllers using AcSELerator; develop control logic in Codesys using IEC 61131-3 structured text and continuous function charts
  • Follow the controls development process for any project-specific development work, including documentation of requirements, logic development, testing in a simulated/lab environment and documentation of test results.
  • Implement and validate closed-loop Active Power and Reactive Power, AVR and PFR Algorithms
  • Maintain version control for all code artifacts according to established version control procedure (Bitbucket)
  • Troubleshoot SCADA and controls issues using Wireshark, breakpoints, cross-reference, and watch list tools, escalating complex issues to senior engineers as needed
  • Produce project deliverables: System Architecture Diagrams, Control Narratives, Logic Diagrams, commissioning documents, and operator manuals

Product & Process Improvement (~10%)

  • Contribute to new feature development and bug fixes in collaboration with the Product Engineering team
  • Prepare technical and non-technical documentation for review by senior controls engineers
  • Participate in the Continuous Improvement and Lessons Learned program, sharing field insights to inform product standards and templates
  • Prepare for FATs and customer-facing presentations with coaching from senior engineers

Stakeholder Communication & Collaboration

  • Support senior engineers as a controls technical contact for EPCs, asset owners, and grid operators through project execution, FAT, and commissioning
  • Support FATs and lead assigned portions as formal presentations; communicate to non-technical audiences with supporting materials prepared in advance
  • Flag technical risks and schedule pressures to project management team with context and proposed solutions
  • Maintain Jira tickets daily with thorough detail, following Jira best practices

Expectations & Success Indicators

  • Deliver high-quality work across multiple concurrent projects with ownership and urgency, seeking guidance when needed
  • Leverage standardized platforms and tools to work efficiently
  • Maintain 100% adherence to Terabase quality processes
  • Actively develop technical skills through code reviews, feedback, and FAT participation alongside senior engineers
  • Project deliverables completed on time, within scope, and meeting Utility/ISO regulatory standards
  • Jira, version control, and documentation consistently maintained without follow-up from management
  • Build growing expertise in Terabase SCADA and Utility-Scale grid controls, progressing toward independent project ownership
  • Travel up to 10% for on-site commissioning, FAT, and customer engagements

Requirements

  1. Education & Experience
    • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, Control Systems, Computer Science, or related field
    • 3+ years of IEC 61131-3/PLC programming experience, preferably in Codesys or AcSELerator environment
    • 2+ year of utility-scale renewable power plant controls experience (solar, BESS, or hybrid) preferred, including exposure to project-specific development work, Factory Acceptance Test (FAT), commissioning and Site Acceptance Test (SAT)
  2. Technical Skills
    • Proficient IEC 61131-3 programming; primary IDE is AcSELerator (SEL controllers) and Codesys, familiarity with Diagram Builder; proficiency with using traces, cross-references, breakpoints, and watch lists
    • Working knowledge of industrial protocols: Modbus-TCP, DNP3, OPC-UA, C37.118, etc.
    • Solid understanding of grid functionality: Primary Frequency Response (PFR), Automatic Voltage Regulation (AVR), Active/Reactive power closed loop control, and capacitor bank functionality – including the underlying principles
    • Familiarity with Utility/ISO testing and interconnection requirements (ERCOT, PJM, BPA, IEEE 2800, NERC, etc.)
    • Exposure to Power Plant Controller (PPC) design, configuration, and commissioning
    • Familiarity with PSCAD, PSSE, and/or TSAT modeling processes for utility-scale sites is a plus
    • Exposure to hardware in the loop (HIL) hardware, such as RTDS, OPAL-RT, Speedgoat, Typhoon, etc., is a plus

Groß genug, dass deine Entscheidungen direkt auf Umsatz und Deckungsbeitrag durchschlagen, und beweglich genug, dass du unser Wachstumssystem selbst baust, statt es nur zu verwalten.

Unser Geheimnis? Ein leidenschaftliches Team, das sich nicht mit dem Status quo zufrieden gibt und ständig danach strebt, besser zu werden. Wir glauben an Werte, die wirklich gelebt werden, keine leeren Phrasen. Bei uns heißt es:

  • Work with engineers to reproduce failures, identify causes, and verify fixes. Contribute product code where needed to improve accuracy and control.

Design Tests and Measure Results

  • Set pass criteria and scoring rules with business and risk teams. Distinguish minor defects from errors that must block release.
  • Maintain representative test cases, including incomplete records and rare, high-impact errors. Reserve unseen examples for final testing to avoid overstating performance.
  • Have banking experts establish expected answers and resolve scoring disagreements. Measure factual accuracy, missing information, incorrect additions, and support from cited sources.
  • Check automated scoring against expert review. Test whether reviewers agree and whether AI-based scoring misses important errors.
  • Compare versions on the same tests. Report results by task and error severity, with sample sizes and uncertainty, not just averages.

Verify Accuracy and Explain Failures

  • Test whether the system finds the right information and whether its answer reflects that information. Separate source problems from answer errors.
  • Check extracted facts against original records. Independently verify amounts, dates, and totals, and test whether citations actually support each important claim.
  • Test when the product should answer, request clarification, or refer work to a person. Verify that reviewers can detect and correct material errors.

Manage Risk and Monitor Performance

  • Test for invented facts, unsupported recommendations, unfair outcomes, disclosure of sensitive information, and attempts to make the system ignore its safeguards.
  • Protect client data, restrict access and permitted actions, and use only approved services. Verify that safeguards work in practice.
  • Document repeatable test results, unresolved failures, and limitations. Recommend release, restricted use, or further development; support independent review and required client approvals.
  • Sample live outputs and track error rates and user corrections. Add confirmed failures to repeatable tests; trigger investigation or suspension when quality falls below agreed standards.
  • Explain findings clearly, coach colleagues, and develop reusable tests and controls. Support proposals, technical estimates, and recruiting.

Qualifications

Required

  • Minimum 5 years of working experience with a minimum of 1 year experience in AI evaluation.
  • Demonstrated ownership of AI evaluations that informed real release decisions, including test design, expert-reviewed answers, scoring, and failure investigation.
  • Strong Python skills and experience building automated test software, connecting data sources, and recording repeatable results across product versions.
  • Ability to select representative samples, interpret error rates and uncertainty, and distinguish genuine improvement from weak tests or inconsistent scoring.
  • Experience building or improving AI products used in operations, with practical controls for sensitive data, output accuracy, and human review.
  • Experience in financial services or another regulated environment, with the ability to translate business requirements into practical tests and controls.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills, ability to mentor colleagues, and willingness to travel to client sites as needed.

Preferred

  • Banking experience in lending, payments, servicing, collections, or default operations.
  • Experience independently evaluating AI products, checking automated scoring against expert judgment, or testing security and fairness in financial institutions.
  • Experience evaluating document review, summaries, information search, or automated workflows, including comparisons across AI services and conventional software.
  • Consulting or product delivery experience, including client discovery, implementation planning, and user adoption.

What Success Looks Like

Success means reliable evidence of what a product gets right, where it fails, and whether it is ready for use. Evaluations catch important errors before release, guide measurable improvements, and detect declining quality in live operations. Testing supports sound decisions, not simply a passing score.

Music & Sound Annotation Expert

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

Job Description

We are seeking Music & Sound Annotation Experts to contribute to a project focused on advancing music and audio technology.

In this role, you will listen to short field recordings and accurately document audible details, including instruments, tempo, musical key, background sounds, and crowd reactions. You will use a structured web-based platform to complete annotations and, in later project phases, evaluate AI-generated descriptions against the actual audio recordings.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Listen to 30–90-second field recordings using headphones in a quiet workspace and complete structured annotations covering:
    • Instruments present in the recording.
    • Tempo and musical key.
    • Timestamps of background events such as traffic, sirens, and applause.
    • Relevant audio scene details.
  2. Compare paired recordings of the same song captured at different locations and identify similarities and differences.
  3. Review AI-generated descriptions of audio clips and identify accurate, incorrect, or fabricated information, providing brief written explanations.
  4. Attend paid onboarding and calibration sessions, along with short weekly project syncs.

Preferred Backgrounds

Candidates with experience in any of the following areas are encouraged to apply:

  1. Working or gigging musicians, session players, music producers, or mixing engineers.
  2. Music educators, ear-training instructors, band or choir directors, and conservatory students or graduates.
  3. Location sound recordists, sound designers, foley artists, or podcast and documentary audio editors.

Required Qualifications

  1. At least 3 years of hands-on experience in music or audio-related work.
  2. Strong analytical listening skills, with the ability to identify individual instruments in busy, noisy, real-world audio recordings—not just studio recordings.
  3. Ability to identify tempo within a few BPM and recognize musical keys. Relative pitch with a reference is acceptable.
  4. Comfort with detailed and repetitive annotation tasks using web-based platforms, including dropdowns, timestamps, and structured notes.
  5. Clear written English skills for brief, evidence-based feedback (e.g., identifying when an accordion enters a recording).
  6. Access to quality headphones, a quiet workspace, and a reliable internet connection.
  7. Availability of 20–25 hours per week throughout the engagement period.

jobs.excerpt: Until November 18, 1883, American railroads ran on dozens of local times.
jobs.description:
Until November 18, 1883, American railroads ran on dozens of local times. Noon in Chicago was 12:31 in Pittsburgh, and every railroad kept its own clock, so schedules collided and connections failed. That day the railroads agreed on four time zones, and clocks across the country stopped and restarted on a shared standard. Nothing about the trains changed. What changed was that everyone could finally plan against the same clock.

That is the job of the Staff Strategic Operations Program Manager for Go-to-Market (“GTM”) at Mercury.

Mercury builds the financial stack for ambitious businesses: banking*, cards, payments, credit, and the financial workflows that run on top of them. Our go-to-market organization spans Revenue, Marketing, Growth Product, and GTM Data, more than 200 people who acquire customers and help them use more of Mercury.

This role owns the whole program end to end. You would be that person, sitting on Mercury’s Strategic Operations team and embedded with GTM leadership.

Own the program

Drive decisions

  • Drive decisions through ambiguity: clarify ownership, force tradeoffs into the open, and use productive conflict to get to the right answer
  • Prepare GTM Review so leaders spend their time deciding rather than reconstructing status.

Build the operating system

  • Design the planning cycles, reviews, and launch-readiness checks that let four teams work the same customer at the same time.
  • Make the engine legible: dashboards, written updates, and a single source of truth that a marketer, a sales leader, and a data scientist can all read.
  • Build automation and agentic flows to run programs with efficiency and high quality

What we’re looking for:

  • 7+ years running cross-functional programs, ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech.
  • GTM systems fluency. You have worked inside a CRM, lifecycle, CDP, or attribution stack (Salesforce, Customer.io, Segment, or equivalents) closely enough to know what is hard about getting a new signal into a rep’s or a marketer’s workflow.
  • Structured thinking. You take disparate inputs (four leaders, three functions, dozens of docs) and turn them into one picture of what is happening and what needs deciding.

  • Bias to action. You pick up the unowned next step, you do not let ambiguity sit, and you go talk to whoever has the answer.

About Business Financial Group

Business Financial Group (BFG) is a U.S.-based accounting, tax, and financial advisory firm providing tax preparation, tax planning, IRS and state tax resolution, accounting, bookkeeping, payroll, and advisory services.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experiencedU.S.-based Tax Resolution Specialist with an active Enrolled Agent (EA) credential or CPA licenseto handle tax resolution cases and represent clients before the IRS.

Candidates must haveat least five years of direct experience representing taxpayers before the IRS. General tax preparation experience alone does not meet this requirement.

This is aproject-based, part-time opportunity. Working hours are flexible, provided agreed deadlines are met, cases progress promptly, and the specialist remains accessible for communication and scheduled IRS calls.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage assigned U.S. tax resolution cases from initial review through completion.

  • Review IRS notices, account transcripts, tax records, and supporting documents to identify issues and recommend appropriate resolution strategies.

  • Represent authorized clients before the IRS and communicate directly with IRS agents, revenue officers, and other relevant personnel.

  • Handle matters such as outstanding tax liabilities, installment agreements, offers in compromise, penalty abatement, collection notices, liens, levies, and other assigned resolution issues.

  • Prepare and submit required authorizations, correspondence, financial statements, and supporting documentation.

  • Coordinate with BFG’s team to obtain missing information, explain case requirements, and provide clear progress updates.

  • Monitor response dates, submission deadlines, and follow-up commitments to ensure timely delivery.

  • Maintain complete and accurate case records in BFG’s designated system.

IRS Communication and Documentation

Every conversation with an IRS agent or representative must be logged in BFG’s designated system promptly, preferably on the same business day.Each entry must include:

  • Date and time of the conversation.

  • IRS representative’s name and identification number, if provided.

  • Relevant client, tax period, and case reference.

  • Summary of the discussion and information exchanged.

  • Outcome, commitments made, and documents requested.

  • Next steps, responsible person, and applicable deadlines.

Relevant correspondence and supporting documents must also be uploaded to the case record.

Required Qualifications

  • Currently based in the United States.

  • Active EA credential or CPA license in good standing.

  • Minimumfive years of hands-on IRS taxpayer representation and tax resolution experience.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage cases independently and communicate effectively with IRS personnel.

  • Strong knowledge of IRS collection processes and tax resolution options.

  • Excellent written communication, organization, and case documentation skills.

  • Ability to deliver accurate work within agreed timelines.

  • Willingness to use BFG’s systems for case updates, documentation, and task tracking.

Availability and Communication

  • Remain reachable throughWhatsApp or text messagefor work coordination during mutually agreed availability windows.

  • Respond promptly to messages and communicate any delays or obstacles early.

  • Be available for scheduled IRS calls, client discussions, and internal case reviews.

  • Use BFG-approved secure channels and systems to exchange and store confidential client information.

Engagement and Compensation

Work will be assigned on a project or case basis according to business needs and the specialist’s availability. Scope, deliverables, deadlines, and compensation will be agreed upon before each assignment.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, EA or CPA credential details, and a brief summary of your IRS representation experience, including the types of tax resolution cases handled. Include your availability and expected project-based or hourly compensation.

Please submit yourupdated resume in PDF format only. Resumes submitted in other formats may not be considered.

jobs.excerpt: WHO WE AREElliott Davis pairs forward-thinking tax, assurance and consulting services with industry-leading workplace culture.
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Elliott Davis pairs forward-thinking tax, assurance and consulting services with industry-leading workplace culture. Our nine offices — located in the fastest growing cities in the US — are built on a foundation of inclusivity, collaboration, and collective growth. We work daily to provide exceptional service to our people, customers, and our communities. Audit and assurance services are provided by Elliott Davis, LLC(doing business in NC and D.C. as Elliott Davis, PLLC), a licensed CPA firm.

The IT Audit Senior Associate is responsible for executing and leading key components of IT audit, technology risk, and assurance engagements. This role works with clients and engagement teams to understand technology environments, identify and assess technology risks, evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of controls, and communicate findings and recommendations.


The Senior Associate will have hands-on responsibility for engagement planning and execution, including walkthroughs, IT general controls (ITGCs), automated and application controls, key reports, SOC reports, and other technology-dependent controls. The role also supports the development of Associates through coaching and review while maintaining effective communication with client stakeholders and engagement leadership.


Key Responsibilities

IT Audit, Risk & Controls

  • Participate in the planning and execution of IT audit, technology risk, and assurance engagements, including IT General Controls (ITGCs), internal IT audits, SOX 404 support, SOC 1 and SOC 2 engagements, and other technology risk assessments.
  • Develop an understanding of clients' business processes, technology environments, systems, infrastructure, and relevant technology risks and controls.
  • Facilitate process and control walkthroughs with client stakeholders to understand, evaluate, and document technology processes and control environments.
  • Identify technology risks and the controls designed to mitigate those risks, considering their impact on business processes and the financial reporting control environment, as applicable.
  • Design and execute procedures to evaluate the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of technology controls.
  • Test ITGCs across enterprise applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments, including relevant logical access, change management, and IT operations controls.
  • Evaluate automated controls, application controls, key reports, interfaces, and other IT-dependent controls supporting business processes and audit objectives.
  • Review and assess SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports for third-party service providers, including relevant control objectives, complementary user entity controls, exceptions, and their impact on the client's control environment.
  • Support technology advisory and risk engagements associated with system implementations, technology initiatives, and significant process or system changes.
  • Analyze audit evidence, identify control deficiencies and process improvement opportunities, and assess the potential impact of identified issues.
  • Develop practical recommendations to strengthen controls, mitigate risks, improve processes, and enhance operational efficiency.
  • Assist in developing remediation action plans, monitoring remediation efforts, and validating the resolution of identified control deficiencies.

Engagement Execution & Documentation

  • Prepare clear, accurate, and well-supported audit workpapers in accordance with applicable methodology, professional standards, and engagement requirements.
  • Review client documentation and audit evidence for accuracy, completeness, and relevance, ensuring conclusions are appropriately supported.
  • Apply professional skepticism and sound judgment when evaluating evidence, control effectiveness, deficiencies, and audit conclusions.
  • Identify complex or unusual issues and elevate them to engagement leadership in a timely manner, working collaboratively with team members, clients, and technical resources to resolve issues.
  • Apply relevant AICPA, PCAOB, and other applicable professional standards and guidance based on the nature and scope of the engagement.
  • Prepare and communicate the results of audit procedures, observations, control deficiencies, and recommendations to client stakeholders and engagement leadership.
  • Manage assigned engagement responsibilities to established schedules, budgets, milestones, and quality expectations.

Client & Team Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain effective working relationships with client personnel and management.
  • Serve as a key day-to-day client contact during engagement execution, coordinating requests, walkthroughs, testing, issue resolution, and status updates.
  • Communicate engagement progress, emerging risks, issues, and findings to Managers, Senior Managers, Directors, and other engagement leaders in a timely manner.
  • Coordinate and oversee assigned work performed by Associates, reviewing workpapers and providing timely, constructive feedback.
  • Coach and support Associates through on-the-job learning and the development of technical, audit, documentation, and client-service skills.
  • Promote a collaborative team environment by supporting team members and consistently delivering on commitments to clients and colleagues.

Qualifications


Education

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Accounting Information Systems, Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field.

Preferred:

  • Master's degree in Information Systems, Accounting, Cybersecurity, or another relevant discipline.

Experience

Required:

  • Minimum of 2 to 3 years of professional experience in IT audit, technology risk, IT assurance, internal audit, public accounting, management consulting, or a related risk and controls discipline.
  • Experience evaluating and testing IT General Controls, including controls over logical access, change management, and IT operations.
  • Experience conducting process and control walkthroughs and evaluating the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of controls.
  • Experience preparing audit workpapers and documenting testing procedures, evidence, findings, and conclusions.
  • Working knowledge of internal audit and technology risk principles, methodologies, and professional standards.
  • Strong analytical, project management, written communication, and interpersonal skills.

Preferred:

  • Experience in a public accounting or professional services environment.
  • Experience supporting SOX 404 compliance engagements, including testing technology controls that support financial reporting.
  • Experience testing automated controls, application controls, key reports, interfaces, and other IT-dependent controls.
  • Experience evaluating technology controls across enterprise applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments.
  • Experience reviewing and evaluating SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports and related third-party technology risks.
  • Experience supporting or evaluating system implementations and significant technology or business-process changes.
  • Familiarity with AICPA and PCAOB auditing standards, as applicable to assigned engagements.
  • Experience providing direction, review, or coaching to junior team members.

Preferred Certifications

One or more relevant professional certifications are preferred, including:

  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA)
  • Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
  • Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
  • Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC)
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Certified in Cybersecurity (CC)
  • ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer
  • Other relevant technology, cybersecurity, audit, or risk certifications

Core Competencies

Successful Senior Associates will demonstrate:

  • Strong understanding of technology risk, internal controls, and IT audit concepts.
  • Ability to understand complex technology environments and translate technical risks into clear business implications.
  • Sound professional judgment and an appropriate level of professional skepticism.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet engagement deadlines.
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication.
  • Confidence interacting with client personnel and management.
  • Ability to identify issues, develop practical recommendations, and communicate findings effectively.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to high-quality audit documentation.
  • Ability to coach junior professionals and provide constructive feedback.
  • Commitment to continuous learning as technologies, risks, regulations, and professional standards evolve.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US

We believe that when our employees are able to thrive in all facets of life, their work and impact are that much greater.
That's right – all aspects of life, not just your life as an employee, because we understand that there's life beyond your job. Here are some of the ways our work works for your life, your growth, and your well-being:
• generous time away and paid firm holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s

jobs.description:
Future Opportunity: Web Developer

Location: Remote (United States, Costa Rica)

Who We Are:

SweetRush is a consulting, design, and staffing firm specializing in HR-related services that help foster life-centered businesses and organizations. We design unique learning experiences using agency-level graphics, storytelling techniques and leading-edge technology, build high-performing cultures and teams, and help our clients grow their learning departments with qualified professionals.

About the Role:

Future opportunities: SweetRush is always growing, and we’re looking for outstanding professionals (hopefully you) to work with us on exciting upcoming projects. The role described below is not for a project today. Our goal is to explore whether we’re a mutual fit so we can reach out to you and move quickly as soon as we need to expand.

We’re seeking highly experienced and versatile Freelance Web Developers to join our dynamic Custom Development team for future opportunities. This is a hands-on technical role for a developer who is comfortable building custom front-end web architecture and is actively leveraging AI to accelerate their coding workflows. You will frequently serve as a key technical resource on projects, taking ownership from conceptualization to deployment.

Your expertise will be crucial in building custom, high-impact learning solutions using modern web technologies like React, custom HTML5/JS, and our SweetRush Adapt framework. We are rapidly evolving our development methodologies; your comfort with agentic coding, AI API integrations, and rapidly prototyping design concepts will be essential.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Custom Front-End Development: Act as a key technical contributor on highly tailored eLearning projects, focusing on front-end development using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React to build within our custom Adapt framework.
  • AI & Agentic Workflows: Actively utilize AI coding assistants and agentic workflows to increase development efficiency, automate repetitive tasks, and rapidly prototype custom HTML5 logic.
  • Advanced Integrations: Connect front-end learning experiences to middle-layer API servers, enabling advanced features like LLM-driven simulations, dynamic AI feedback, chatbots, and advanced xAPI data tracking.
  • Technical Expertise: Contribute to complex projects by proposing technical architecture solutions and collaborating directly with instructional designers, graphic designers, and project managers.

Technical Requirements:

  • Experience: Proven experience as a web developer with a strong portfolio of web applications, custom learning modules, or interactive web experiences.
  • Front-End Stack: Deep expertise in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, and modern component-based frameworks (e.g. React).
  • AI Proficiency: Demonstrated experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude Code) to write, debug, and optimize code, as well as an understanding of how to implement standard AI APIs into web applications.
  • Modern eLearning Standards: Experience with responsive design, accessibility standards (WCAG/508 compliance), LMS integration (SCORM/xAPI), and localization workflows.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to identify and implement creative technical solutions.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a track record of successfully collaborating with diverse teams.
  • Language: Must have strong English language skills, both written and verbal.
  • Autonomy: The ability to work independently, adapting to the client's timeline and driving a project to completion with a high degree of ownership.
  • Adaptability: A flexible mindset and the ability to quickly learn new tools and technologies as projects require.
  • Working Hours: Must be available to work US daytime hours to facilitate seamless communication and collaboration with the project team and clients.

SweetRush Is an Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, or belief; national, social, or ethnic origin; sex (including pregnancy); age; physical, mental, or sensory disability; HIV status; sexual orientation, gender identity, and/or expression; marital, civil union, or domestic partnership status; past or present military service; family medical history or genetic information; family or parental status; or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. SweetRush will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We encourage applicants of all ages.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Call to Action: Submit Your Resume!

Team chemistry is everything to us, so our ultimate goal is to find the right fit. If the above describes your interests and experience, and you believe this will be a dream job, please submit your resume. We are excited to hear from you!

Please note: We're all about remote work and have collaborators based all around the world; however, SweetRush is a US-based company, and English is our primary language. If you'd like to be considered for this opportunity, please submit your resume in English.
