jobs.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next New Business Account Executive.

About the job

This position is needed to lead prospecting, solution selling and closing new business opportunities across our Messaging, Voice and Email products. In this role, you will be directly responsible for expanding our messaging business with some of the largest and fastest growing mid-market and enterprise companies in the Financial Services vertical. New Business Account Executives are experts in the CPaaS ecosystem and Twilio’s product offerings. This role is highly cross functional, with deep integration with product management, carrier relations, finance, and solutions engineering teams.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Drive new customer acquisition, while being assigned a quota for iACV (incremental Account Contract Value)
  • Own highly analytical and consultative sales cycles to win business in competitive vendor sourcing cycles with Twilio’s messaging (e.g. SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Google Business Messages, Account Security, etc.), voice and email solutions.
  • Work with customers across assigned verticals (Financial Services) to understand their business and technical requirements, and match them to the capabilities of Twilio’s communications API platform, designing a solution for their specific use cases.
  • Work with teams in Finance, Legal, Pricing, and Operations to design mutually beneficial contracts to address customer requirements, while balancing the needs of our business.
  • Be passionate about what you do, think outside the box, and use world-class interpersonal and communication skills to present complex contractual, technical, and financial details to prospects in a way that builds confidence and comfort in the proposed solution.
  • Balance competing priorities and manage multiple projects and deals at the same time.
  • Partner cross functionally with sales, services, product, and finance to develop long range territory strategies and sales plans.
  • Act as the voice of the customer to Twilio’s product and carrier relations teams.
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of the CPaaS industry - staying up to date on key industry initiatives and new capabilities - on behalf of your customers and the wider Twilio go-to-market organization.
  • Generate and maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast utilizing our CRM, Salesforce.
  • Stay current with industry changes and collaborate with your team and peers to learn and share best practices.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Possess a total of 12 years of full cycle sales experience, with a minimum of 5 years in a closing role
  • Directly selling technical SaaS or CPaaS and experience solution selling and multi-threading
  • Experience outbound prospecting into new accounts and a strong “hunter” mentality for bringing in Mid-Market and Enterprise sized accounts
  • Technical solutions selling experience working with real customers and prospects, listening to them, and solving problems
  • Comfortable working with business and highly technical leaders, while influencing their understanding and building supportive partnerships
  • Analytical account development strategy based on using data to find opportunities and prove value
  • Demonstrated track record of managing business forecasts and financial models
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with appetite to define process and build programs
  • Record of delivering market driven results, especially to scale and enterprise customers
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English)
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent years of experience

Desired:

  • Deep experience working with telecom companies, including CPAAS, SMS aggregators, carriers, or global communications platforms.
  • Domain expertise from a highly quantitative industry such as DevOps, Fintech, advertising optimization, investment banking, security or commodity trading especially in non-standard segments.
  • Software, SaaS, CPaas or PaaS selling experience

Location

  • This role will be remote.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 30% - 40% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.
  • This role is eligible to earn commissions.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 28, 2026, but may change based on business needs.

jobs.excerpt: Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant or outsourcing company.
jobs.description:
Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant or outsourcing company.

Cloud Engineer

Are you a cloud builder with a passion for elegant infrastructure, performance and secure scale? We want to hear from you!

Performativ is a European fintech building secure, scalable infrastructure to power the next generation of wealth management. We’re looking for a Cloud Engineer to help build the platform every engineering team depends on, drive cost and security best practices, and enable developers to ship with confidence.

This is a builder’s role, perfect for someone who thrives on automation, clarity, and enabling others through clean, efficient infrastructure.

You’ll join Mission Control, our Platform Engineering and Reliability team, led by our Lead Cloud Engineer. Mission Control creates secure, self-service platform capabilities that enable product teams to build, deploy, and operate services independently.

What you’ll do 📈

  • Design and maintain AWS infrastructure using AWS CDK, with a focus on security, performance, and cost-efficiency.

  • Apply the AWS Well-Architected Framework across security, reliability, operations, performance, and cost.

  • Build reusable CDK constructs, infrastructure standards, and golden paths that reduce complexity and improve the developer experience across engineering.

  • Help build secure-by-default platform capabilities that enable product teams to build, deploy, and operate services independently.

  • Contribute to our reliability practices through SLOs, runbooks, incident tooling, and post-incident improvements.

  • Treat cloud cost as a first-class engineering concern through tagging, budgeting, usage forecasting, anomaly detection, and eliminating waste.

  • Support developers on infrastructure best practices, CI/CD pipeline design, and DevSecOps fundamentals.

  • Contribute to compliance and audit initiatives aligned with ISO 27001, SOC 2, and NIST CSF.

  • Work with our security specialists, AWS solution architects, and auditors as needed.

What we’re looking for 🎯

  • 3–5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, AWS cloud, or platform engineering.

  • Hands-on experience building and operating workloads on AWS, including Infrastructure as Code. Experience with AWS CDK is strongly preferred, in any language.

  • An understanding of the AWS Well-Architected Framework and its principles.

  • A platform engineering mindset focused on reusable capabilities, self-service, and automation.

  • A proven track record of top academic performance in STEM/Computer Science, or demonstrable success in open-source projects or a portfolio.

  • Actively leverages AI and agent-assisted engineering workflows to improve productivity, while applying sound engineering judgment and maintaining high quality standards.

  • Excellent English skills.

  • Goal-driven and looking for career growth.

  • A work-from-home setup. This is a full-time role, remote from the Philippines, with working hours that substantially overlap with the team’s working day in Copenhagen.

  • Experience working within fintech or other regulated industries is a plus.

Technologies you’ll work with💻

You don’t need experience with every technology listed below. We care far more about strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and your ability to learn, build, and improve systems.

  • Infrastructure as Code: AWS CDK, primarily in TypeScript, with projects also in Golang and Python.

  • Compute & Integration: Lambda, Fargate, Docker, Step Functions, EventBridge.

  • Data & Storage: Aurora, DynamoDB, S3, ElastiCache.

  • Networking: VPC, VPC Endpoints, Transit Gateway, VPN, PrivateLink, Route 53.

  • Security & Governance: IAM, AWS Organizations, Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, AWS Backup.

  • End User Computing: AWS Workspaces.

  • Identity & Access: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) for SSO, federated access, and conditional access. Bonus: Intune, Defender, and endpoint/device compliance.

  • Engineering Tooling: GitHub Actions, Docker, container pipelines, cloud cost optimization, and observability tooling.

  • Wider Engineering Stack: You’ll collaborate with teams building services primarily in Golang and TypeScript, alongside React, React Native, Python, and PHP.

What we can offer you🌱

  • Competitive salary and compensation package.

  • 30 days of paid annual leave & HMO contribution.

  • Fully remote work.

  • Generous hardware stipends.

  • Direct access to engineering, product, and leadership.

  • High-trust, high-ownership culture where your work has real impact.

Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is a Denmark-based Fintech, leading the transformation of Investment Advisors and Wealth Managers into tech-enabled businesses. You can read more about our product at .

We value your passion 🔥

We’re embarking on an ambitious journey, filled with a multitude of novel features and integrations in which you’ll play a pivotal role. Our approach mirrors that of a professional sports team: prioritizing high performance, accountability, and agility. If you’re not seeking an environment that values swift action and execution, then this might not be the right fit for you.

If you have the passion and drive to build the future of fintech, we want to hear from you! Apply by submitting your application with an updated CV/resume.

jobs.title: Administrador em segurança da informação – Sênior
jobs.excerpt: Responsável pelos serviços de análise e acompanhamento de suporte operacional, seguindo os padrões e processos do cliente.
jobs.description:
Responsável pelos serviços de análise e acompanhamento de suporte operacional, seguindo os padrões e processos do cliente.

Principais atividades e responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, implementar e aprimorar políticas, normas, procedimentos e controles de segurança da informação alinhados às melhores práticas e requisitos institucionais;
  • Definir e aplicar políticas de hardening para sistemas operacionais, servidores, aplicações, bancos de dados, dispositivos de rede e demais ativos tecnológicos;
  • Propor melhorias contínuas nos processos operacionais relacionados à segurança da informação, gestão de riscos e proteção dos ativos corporativos;
  • Monitorar o ambiente tecnológico para identificação de ameaças emergentes, vulnerabilidades e comportamentos suspeitos, propondo e implementando medidas mitigadoras;
  • Realizar análises detalhadas de logs, eventos e indicadores de segurança para identificação de incidentes, anomalias e potenciais comprometimentos;
  • Conduzir auditorias internas de segurança da informação, avaliando a efetividade dos controles implantados e propondo melhorias;
  • Realizar avaliações periódicas de maturidade e postura de segurança, identificando lacunas e oportunidades de evolução dos processos e tecnologias adotadas;
  • Apoiar a elaboração, revisão e atualização de normas, procedimentos e políticas de segurança da informação;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e executivos relacionados a incidentes, riscos, vulnerabilidades, conformidade e desempenho dos controles de segurança;
  • Investigar incidentes de segurança da informação, identificando causas, impactos, vulnerabilidades exploradas e medidas corretivas para prevenção de novas ocorrências;
  • Conduzir análises forenses digitais em incidentes críticos, identificando vetores de ataque, evidências técnicas, cadeia de eventos e impactos ao ambiente corporativo;
  • Desenvolver e executar planos de resposta a incidentes de segurança, contemplando ações de contenção, erradicação, recuperação e lições aprendidas;
  • Planejar, coordenar e executar exercícios de simulação de ataques cibernéticos, incluindo cenários avançados como APTs (Ameaças Persistentes Avançadas), ransomware e ataques distribuídos;
  • Avaliar e mitigar riscos relacionados a Shadow IT, identificando ativos, serviços e aplicações não homologadas utilizadas no ambiente corporativo;
  • Avaliar, homologar e recomendar novas tecnologias, soluções e ferramentas de segurança da informação, considerando requisitos técnicos, riscos e benefícios;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de infraestrutura, desenvolvimento e operações para integrar requisitos e controles de segurança nos processos e sistemas corporativos;
  • Apoiar a implementação de práticas de segurança em aplicações, serviços, arquiteturas e processos de desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Realizar avaliações e auditorias com base em frameworks e boas práticas reconhecidas, como ISO 27001/27002, CIS Controls, SANS, OWASP e normativos do CNJ;
  • Definir, acompanhar e analisar indicadores, métricas e KPIs de segurança da informação, avaliando a eficácia dos controles implementados e o nível de resiliência organizacional;
  • Participar da gestão de riscos de tecnologia e segurança da informação, propondo planos de tratamento e mitigação;
  • Elaborar estratégias de recuperação de desastres (Disaster Recovery) e continuidade de negócios para sistemas, aplicações e serviços críticos;
  • Definir, documentar e testar procedimentos de restauração de ambientes tecnológicos após incidentes de segurança, falhas operacionais ou desastres;
  • Identificar e classificar sistemas críticos, definindo tempos objetivos de recuperação (RTO) e pontos objetivos de recuperação (RPO);
  • Planejar, implementar e validar estratégias de continuidade operacional para garantir a manutenção dos serviços essenciais em cenários adversos;
  • Realizar exercícios e testes periódicos de contingência, recuperação de desastres e continuidade de negócios, avaliando a efetividade dos planos estabelecidos;
  • Elaborar planos de ação para cenários de contingência envolvendo falhas de infraestrutura, ataques cibernéticos, indisponibilidade de serviços e desastres naturais;
  • Testar e validar ambientes redundantes, servidores de contingência, backups e mecanismos alternativos de comunicação e operação;
  • Definir papéis, responsabilidades e fluxos de atuação das equipes envolvidas em processos de resposta a incidentes, contingência e continuidade operacional;
  • Estruturar e manter fluxos de comunicação interna e externa para situações de crise, garantindo alinhamento e disseminação adequada das informações;
  • Consolidar informações de chamados, incidentes, vulnerabilidades e demandas relacionadas à segurança da informação;
  • Prestar suporte técnico e orientação especializada às equipes de segurança, infraestrutura, desenvolvimento e governança;
  • Atuar como referência técnica em temas relacionados à segurança da informação, gestão de riscos, continuidade de negócios e recuperação de desastres;
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas à segurança da informação, proteção de ativos digitais e gestão da continuidade dos serviços de TIC.

Perfil desejado: experiência sólida em Segurança da Informação, Gestão de Riscos, Resposta a Incidentes, Análise Forense, Governança de Segurança, Continuidade de Negócios (BCP), Recuperação de Desastres (DR), Gestão de Vulnerabilidades e Conformidade. Conhecimentos em ISO 27001/27002, CIS Controls, SANS, OWASP, SIEM, SOC, Cloud Security, análise de logs, indicadores de segurança e normativos do CNJ serão considerados diferenciais.


Formação:

Superior Completo na área de Tecnologia da Informação.

EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL

Comprovar, através de registros na Carteira de Trabalho e Previdência Social ou de declaração de instituição pública ou privada onde já tenha trabalhado na especialidade citada, em ambientes corporativos críticos e com alta disponibilidade.

Cerificações/Cursos:

  • Treinamento ITIL 4, com carga horária de no mínimo de 12 (doze) horas.

    • CSIH (Certified Specialist Incident Handler).

jobs.title: Product Manager I
jobs.excerpt: Empowering the people that make global commerce happen.
jobs.description:
Empowering the people that make global commerce happen.

About CargoSprint

CargoSprint is made up of a world-class team of highly motivated individuals who are passionate about transforming the cargo industry. We have developed cutting-edge digital solutions that streamline cargo operations, enhance efficiency, and improve the overall experience for everyone involved. Our workplace fosters innovation, collaboration, and the drive to solve industry challenges.

CargoSprint is dedicated to delivering game-changing solutions that connect the cargo industry like never before, and we are looking for driven, enthusiastic people who share our vision of innovation and excellence.

If you think we are agreat mutual fit, we want hear from you!

About You

You are passionate about the role and thrive on solving complex problems with a talented team of colleagues who both challenge and support you. You believe in lifelong learning, constantly honing your skills and staying on the cutting edge of technology. Most importantly, you want to engage your talents to make a meaningful difference by revolutionizing the cargo industry.

About the role

The Product Manager I takes on the defined, repeatable work of product management so senior product managers can spend more time on strategy, customer judgment, and prioritization. It converts requirements into Jira work, secures and tracks cross-functional approvals, writes acceptance criteria and test cases, and equips Customer Success and Product Marketing with the value proposition and target audience for each feature. Every task has a clear input, a defined output, and a senior product manager who owns it, so its work is predictable, auditable, and repeatable across products including SprintPay, SprintPass, SprintConnect, and eModal.

What you'll do

Discovery and Research Support

  • ICP-Based Participant Sourcing: Given an ideal customer profile, pull a list of matching potential users from Salesforce or HubSpot for user interviews, surveys, and feedback on requirements and designs.
  • Outreach Preparation: Draft interview and survey invitations and discussion guides for senior product manager review and approval before anything is sent.
  • Insight Synthesis: Consolidate interview notes and survey results into themes, and tie each theme to the requirement or design decision it informs.

Requirements and Work Breakdown

  • Epic and Work Item Creation: Convert a product requirements document or prototype into a structured set of Jira epics, stories, and tasks, with links back to the source requirement.
  • Acceptance Criteria: Write specific, testable acceptance criteria for every work item for engineering to build against.
  • Traceability: Keep requirements, work items, and acceptance criteria in sync as scope changes, and flag gaps or conflicts to the senior product manager.

Alignment, Approvals, and Decision Log

  • Approval Requests: Request approval or alignment from key dependencies and stakeholders, including Legal, Finance, and Customer Support, using a standard request that states the decision needed, context, and deadline.
  • Approval Tracking: Track the status of every request, follow up on a defined cadence, and escalate overdue items to the senior product manager.
  • Decision Log: Maintain a running log across the development life cycle of each decision, who made it, when, the rationale, and any conditions attached.

Testing and Quality

  • Test Case Design: Build test cases from actual user observations, including interview findings, support tickets, and session recordings, and map each to acceptance criteria.
  • Repeated Test Cycles: Re-run the full test set throughout testing, both before and after issues are reported and after each fix is deployed, and record results for each cycle.
  • Defect Reporting: Log issues in Jira with steps to reproduce, expected versus actual results, and the linked test case.
  • UAT Coordination: Schedule and track user acceptance testing with participants, and compile results for senior product manager sign-off.

Go-to-Market Enablement

  • Value Proposition and ICP Summary: Summarize the value proposition and ICP of any feature in a consistent one-page format for Customer Success and Product Marketing.
  • Target User Lists: Pull the list of potential target users from Salesforce or HubSpot to support launch campaigns and drive adoption.
  • Adoption Follow-Up: Report adoption among targeted accounts after launch and surface accounts that have not engaged.

Qualifications

Required Capabilities

  • 1-3 years of experience in a similiar role.
  • Read and interpret PRDs, prototypes, research notes, and support tickets, and turn them into structured work.
  • Write clear, testable acceptance criteria and test cases in a consistent format.
  • Read from and write to Jira, Confluence, Salesforce, HubSpot, and email or chat tools through approved integrations.
  • Follow a defined process the same way each time, and record what was done.

jobs.excerpt: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍UK Remote (with essential travel to our global offshore sites) | 💰£90,400 - £114,250 + Incentive Awards + Benefits ✨

Our Global Ops Team ⭐️

At Monzo, our customers should receive great service regardless of where it is delivered. As our UK and EU operations grow, we need clear direction and dedicated leadership to turn our partner estate strategy into customer, quality and commercial outcomes.

The Partner Strategy and Delivery Lead exists to define the direction, priorities and focus areas for the Partner Strategy and Delivery pillar. You will translate Monzo’s wider goals and agreed estate principles into a coherent portfolio of work, create the conditions required for delivery and influence the wider business to enable successful outcomes.

Delivery is expected at every level within the pillar. In this role, most of your time will be spent defining what the team should focus on, why it matters and what success looks like, then enabling and assuring delivery through the wider team and business.

You will lead a team of 5 senior/mid-senior colleagues. You may also directly lead or intervene in the most material, complex or sensitive activity where senior ownership is required.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

Strategy, direction and portfolio focus

  • Strategic alignment & roadmap execution: Translate Monzo and GCOO objectives into a clear partner estate strategy, establishing actionable roadmaps, governance frameworks, and supporting strategies aligned with operational goals.
  • Portfolio governance & resource prioritisation: Direct the initiative portfolio—prioritising, sequencing, and resourcing high-impact workstreams—setting success guardrails while dynamically rebalancing capacity against changing business needs.
  • Cross-operational strategic leadership: Leverage insights across the live estate to identify emerging themes, leading cross-functional priorities and driving strategic alignment across Global Operations.

Partner estate and thematic agenda

  • Estate optimisation & market strategy: Evaluate the global partner estate holistically to resolve systemic operational themes, leverage market trends, and sponsor recommendations across location strategy, footprint changes, and operating models.
  • Strategic sourcing leadership: Act as senior business accountable lead for major RFIs, RFPs, and partner selection, ensuring sourcing decisions balance operational, commercial, risk, and customer requirements.
  • Cross-functional strategy integration: Partner with Partner Estate & Relationship Management and Global Ops leaders to translate performance insights, contractual trends, and estate capabilities into aligned strategic priorities.

Strategic influence and business enablement

  • Executive alignment & business cases: Align GCOO and Operations leadership on strategic priorities, framing clear trade-offs, building robust business cases, and establishing direction across ambiguous organizational boundaries.
  • Product & tech partnership: Collaborate with Product and Technology teams to advocate for process and system optimisations, delivering credible data on customer, operational, and commercial impact.
  • Senior external representation: Represent Monzo with executive stakeholders at existing and prospective partners during critical sourcing, mobilisation, and strategic delivery programs.

Delivery leadership and outcome assurance

  • Estate governance & enablement: Establish clear mandates and standards across the partner estate, guiding project leads to define solutions while intervening on complex barriers to ensure focus on delivered outcomes over activity completion.
  • Strategic oversight & high-impact delivery: Monitor cross-program risks, resolve competing priorities, and directly lead high-sensitivity or complex initiatives requiring senior stakeholder navigation.
  • Outcome sustainability & framework refinement: Retain accountability for strategic initiatives until full BAU transfer, leveraging delivery outcomes and key learnings to continuously refine future frameworks and estate decisions.

Leadership and team development

  • Team leadership & capability development: Lead and develop high-performing team, setting meaningful goals, coaching on strategic and commercial capabilities, and fostering an environment of proactive ownership and psychological safety.
  • Empowered delegation & resource management: Delegate program ownership effectively while maintaining oversight of quality and risks, dynamically reallocating team capacity to align with shifting business priorities.
  • On-site strategic execution: Travel periodically within the UK and internationally to direct high-stakes partner selection, mobilisation, transitions, and executive program delivery.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • Significant experience leading complex strategy, transformation or programme portfolios that affect multiple operational areas, teams and external partners.
  • Essential experience working with outsourced operations, suppliers or third party partners.
  • Ability to travel within the UK and internationally when required. We currently have sites in India, Romania and South Africa, with plans underway for the EU.
  • A strong understanding of how partner capability, customer outcomes, commercial arrangements, operational delivery, resilience and risk interact.
  • Proven ability to translate broad business goals and agreed strategic principles into clear priorities, focus areas, roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong leadership experience, including leading experienced managers and individual contributors and achieving outcomes through delegation.
  • Strong commercial and business judgement, with the ability to make balanced decisions across customer, quality, risk, resilience, flexibility, cost and long term value.
  • Experience leading material partner selection, sourcing, mobilisation, transition, footprint or comparable strategic activity.
  • Experience developing, sponsoring or critically reviewing business cases and recommendations for senior decision makers.
  • The ability to influence senior leaders and align teams with different priorities without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Excellent strategic thinking and analytical judgement, with the ability to identify connections between operational evidence, partner insight and wider business goals.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to make complex information, trade offs and recommendations clear to senior audiences.
  • A deep understanding of relevant partner markets and industry trends, with the ability to apply external insight to strategic and commercial decisions.
  • Experience operating in a regulated or customer sensitive environment, with sound judgement on customer impact, governance and control.
  • Confidence representing Monzo with senior external stakeholders during commercially important, complex or sensitive activity.
  • The ability to remain effective where information is incomplete, priorities are changing or delivery depends on action across several teams.
  • A collaborative and challenging leadership style, with the confidence to question assumptions, make difficult prioritisation choices and create clarity from ambiguity.
  • Experience within financial services, global operations, partner estate planning or Product and Technology enabled operational transformation would be particularly valuable.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps:

  • Application questions
  • 30 minute Recruiter Call
  • Practical take-home task centred on business case creation
  • Competency-based interview around Leadership, Stakeholders and Values

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £90,400 - £114,250 + Incentive awards + Benefits ✨

📍Distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) and essential international travel to our offshore partner sites.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. ➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we'll always work around your availability. You'll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process, but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact

We feel proud every day about what we do. We're all part of the same crucial mission, no matter what function we support -- it's to provide safe, clean water for the world, and to protect our planet's most valuable resource.

We are at the forefront of innovation, working with cutting-edge technology to provide smart and connected, sustainable water solutions for the future. Watts is a leading brand with a quality reputation — and we have a dynamic future ahead.​

Scope of Position


The National Sales Manager, Food & Beverage is responsible for building and scaling Watts' Food & Beverage business Nationally. This is an entrepreneurial, market-building role with the opportunity to shape how Watts goes to market, develop strategic customer relationships, create new business opportunities, and expand adoption of the Watts portfolio across Food & Beverage manufacturing and processing environments.


Working across owners and plant operators, engineering/EPC firms, OEMs, contractors, system integrators and channel partners, this role combines technical application expertise, business development and commercial leadership to influence specifications, solve customer challenges and drive sustainable growth. The individual will leverage Watts' broad portfolio and established commercial capabilities while helping shape future market, application and portfolio opportunities.


Leads commercial development and execution for Watts' Food & Beverage market. Owns market development, strategic accounts, pipeline development and commercial execution. Serves as the commercial lead for Food & Beverage, leveraging Watts' existing sales, specification, representative and channel resources. Helps shape market, application and portfolio priorities as the business develops.


  • Reports to the Vice President, Sales – Light Industrial, Latin America, & Sales Operations.

  • Remote U.S. based position requiring significant customer-facing travel.

Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities


  • Build and execute the national Food & Beverage go-to-market strategy to expand Watts' presence, increase market penetration, and drive sustainable growth.
  • Identify, develop, and expand strategic customer relationships across processors, engineering and EPC firms, OEMs, contractors, system integrators, distributors, and channel partners.
  • Develop and manage manufacturer representative agency performance, including territory objectives, growth initiatives, opportunity development, business reviews, and execution against established sales and market development goals.

  • Deliver revenue, margin, pipeline, specification, and market-development objectives for the Food & Beverage vertical.
  • Monitor market trends, customer requirements, competitive activity, investment activity, and emerging technologies while providing actionable market intelligence and Voice of Customer insights that support business growth, portfolio development, and strategic decision-making.
  • Identify portfolio gaps, emerging customer requirements, and new application opportunities and provide recommendations regarding future product development, service offerings, and investment priorities.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Customer Service, and Business Development teams to develop solutions, support project execution, and accelerate business growth.
  • Support and influence representative agencies, channel partners, and internal commercial teams through training, coaching, application expertise, sales tools, value propositions, market development activities, and enablement programs.
  • Represent Watts at customer meetings, industry conferences, trade associations, engineering forums, trade shows, and strategic business events.
  • Build long-term relationships with key industry influencers and stakeholders to strengthen Watts' brand presence and support future growth opportunities.
  • Support commercialization efforts, new product introductions, strategic growth initiatives, and market expansion programs.
  • Assume responsibility for other projects and duties as assigned by management.
  • Demonstrate commitment to Watts' values of Integrity, Accountability, Continuous Improvement and Innovation, and Transparency.
  • Travel up to 60% as business needs require.

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree preferred, ideally in engineering, business or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience.
  • 5+ years of technical/industrial B2B sales, application engineering, business development or market-development experience.
  • Strong technical application expertise within Food & Beverage manufacturing, processing or related industrial environments.
  • Knowledge of fluid handling, process systems, plant utilities or related engineered solutions.
  • Experience with hygienic/process applications and non-hygienic plant infrastructure is highly desirable; pharmaceutical, biotech or life-sciences experience is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of the Food & Beverage ecosystem, including owners/processors, engineering/EPC firms, OEMs, contractors/integrators and distribution.
  • Demonstrated ability to create new business, develop strategic accounts and build markets.
  • Ability to influence specifications and translate customer and market needs into technical, commercial and portfolio opportunities.
  • Entrepreneurial, collaborative, coachable and solutions-oriented, with the initiative to operate independently while effectively leveraging a broader matrix organization.
  • Strong communication, presentation and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage plant-level technical teams through senior customer leadership.
  • Strong CRM, pipeline management, forecasting and opportunity-management discipline.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 60%.

General Applicable Company Competencies


  • Commitment to Watts’ values of integrity, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation, and transparency.
  • Punctuality and dependability.
  • Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing work priorities and stressful conditions.
  • Adherence to all personnel policies, procedures, and standards of process as implemented by Watts.
  • Maintain productive and collaborative relationships with other Watts employees.

Working Conditions

While performing the job duties, you will be working remotely in an office environment. You may be required to occasionally travel to and work in the office atany Watts Water location for meetings, trainings, or as otherwise required by Company management.

Physical Requirements


Specific physical abilities required for this position include, but are not limited to:


  • Ability to remain seated at a desk or workstation for extended periods.
  • Ability to perform repetitive tasks like typing on a keyboard or using a mouse for extended periods.
  • Ability to physically move around the office, organize or transport files, packages, or other office-related materials.
  • Ability to read documents, use a computer, and perform data entry tasks.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with management and coworkers, particularly in meetings or phone calls.
  • Ability to operate standard office equipment such as computers, printers, phones, and copiers.
  • Ability to occasionally lift and carry light objects (up to 15-20 pounds), such as office supplies, documents, or small equipment.

Pay Range


The expected salary range for this position is $145,000 - $168,000 yearly. Actual compensation will be dependent upon individual skills, experience, qualifications, and applicable law.


Nothing in this job description restricts Watts’ right to assign or reassign duties, responsibilities, and working hours/conditions to this position at any time. This position is “at will,” which means that either the employee or Watts may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without notice, and for any lawful reason.

Role Overview:

The Vocational Rehabilitation Specialist is a frontline professional resource within the Vocational Services Department who applies accredited rehabilitation counseling expertise to support absence management and disability insurance services delivered under employer-based group benefit policies and contracts. This role provides vocational, occupational, and workplace accommodation expertise across multiple functional areas, including Pre-Disability and ADA accommodations, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability return-to-work services, vocational analyses and reporting, and participation in live claim staffings.

The position is designed as a hybrid role. While individual work assignments may emphasize specific functional areas at different times, the Vocational Rehabilitation Specialist is expected to maintain the knowledge, skills, and competencies necessary to support all core Vocational Services functions. The role does not adjudicate or pay claims. Instead, it delivers expert vocational input, analysis, and customer-facing services that claims professionals and employer partners use to inform benefit decisions and support safe, productive work outcomes.

This role requires in-depth practical expertise, independent problem-solving, sound professional judgment, and the ability to serve as a reliable vocational resource for internal and external clients, partners, and customers.

What You’ll Do:

Vocational Expertise and Analysis

  • Analyze occupational, vocational, and labor market information to support disability, accommodation, and return-to-work decision-making.
  • Complete vocational analyses and reports, which may include own occupation analyses, transferable skills analyses, and related vocational assessments, following established standards, workflows, and templates.
  • Interpret medical, vocational, occupational, and functional information within the context of policy definitions and program guidelines, escalating complex issues as appropriate.
  • Clearly document professional opinions, findings, and rationale in claims and vocational systems to ensure accuracy, transparency, and long-term usability.
    •

Return-to-Work and Stay-at-Work Services

  • Provide direct vocational rehabilitation services to employees of client organizations to support stay-at-work and return-to-work outcomes following disability.
  • Conduct telephonic or virtual vocational interviews to assess motivation, functional abilities, work history, transferable skills, and vocational goals.
  • Collaborate with customers, employers, health care providers, and internal partners to develop realistic, safe, and sustainable work plans.
  • Support employer accommodation and modified duty discussions within defined processes, including participation in the interactive process when applicable.
    •

ADA, Pre-Disability, and Workplace Accommodation Support

  • Apply working knowledge of ADA concepts, job demands, and workplace accommodations to support Pre-Disability and accommodation-related referrals.
  • Analyze job duties and functional requirements to identify potential accommodations or work adjustments.
  • Communicate vocational and accommodation considerations clearly to internal partners and employer representatives.
    •

Live Claim Staffing and Collaboration

  • Participate in live claim staffings and consultations with claims managers, nurses, behavioral health professionals, and other partners.
  • Provide real-time vocational input related to occupational demands, work capacity, accommodation feasibility, and return-to-work planning.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource, explaining vocational concepts, industry practices, and labor market considerations in a clear and practical manner.
    •

Collaboration, Quality, and Continuous Improvement

  • Work independently while collaborating closely with vocational peers, claims teams, and other internal partners to deliver consistent, high-quality services.
  • Apply established best practices, procedures, and quality standards across all functional areas.
  • Identify trends, issues, or opportunities for improvement and share observations with team leaders or senior vocational staff.
  • Participate in training, onboarding, calibration, and professional development activities.
    •

What You’ll Bring:

Required

  • Master’s degree in Rehabilitation Counseling or a closely related field.
  • Active Certification as a Rehabilitation Counselor (CRC).
  • Demonstrated vocational rehabilitation counseling experience with practical application of occupational analysis, vocational assessment, and return-to-work principles (This may include practicum and/or internship experience).
  • Strong working knowledge of occupational classification systems, assessment of material duties and demands as well as reasonable modifications, and transferable skills.
  • Ability to assimilate and apply policy language, program guidelines, and vocational standards.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Outlook, SharePoint, and the ability to learn proprietary claims and vocational systems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex vocational information to diverse audiences.
  • Effective time management and ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to ethical practice in accordance with company standards and CRCC requirements.
    •

Preferred

  • Experience supporting ADA accommodations and the interactive process.
  • Experience completing own occupation analyses and transferable skills analyses in a disability insurance environment.
  • Additional relevant licenses or certifications (e.g., LPC, CVE, CCM, CDMS, CEAS).
  • Experience providing job retention, stay-at-work, or return-to-work services within group disability or absence management programs.
  • Experience working within a Continuous Improvement (CI) Management System, including application of the core CI disciplines of connecting work to strategy and customer value, discovering better ways of working, delivering value efficiently, and enabling people to contribute to their fullest potential. Preferred experience includes participating as a frontline contributor in CI practices such as standard work, visual management, demand and capacity discussions, problem-solving, and performance conversations, and using CI tools to build behaviors that support quality, transparency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
    •

Scope and Level Expectations

  • Applies in-depth practical vocational knowledge to a broad range of work assignments.
  • Works independently within established policies and procedures, exercising sound judgment.
  • Serves as a trusted vocational resource for claims partners and peers.
  • Solves problems using analysis, experience, and established best practices.
  • Escalates unusually complex or novel issues to senior vocational staff or leadership as appropriate.

About Us

The Ammortal Chamber brings together multiple scientifically backed technologies into one experience. It is a healing technology that can be utilized by wellness clinics and inside the home. Our clients include specialty spas and clinics, sports teams, and individuals who are biohackers or athletes.

We are a small team with a startup culture. After our first full year shipping a finished product on the market, we’ve shown strong growth. Our team is made up of engineers, health professionals, and startup entrepreneurs.

As we continue expanding, this role offers hands-on experience, opportunities to grow into leadership, and the chance to make a tangible impact by developing and delivering cutting-edge wellness technology. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to innovate and shape technologies that enhance well-being for our clients.

What is this role and why does it exist?

The Ammortal Chamber is a complex electromechanical wellness product that integrates structural, thermal, fluid, sensing, audio, lighting, and user-interface systems into one cohesive experience. As we scale production and continue to refine the Chamber, we need a mechanical engineer who can turn great ideas into parts and assemblies that are manufacturable, serviceable, and built to last.

The Mechanical Design Engineer owns detailed mechanical design from concept through production release, working closely with our Senior Mechanical Design Engineer. Every bracket, panel, mount, and mechanism you release helps more people experience the Chamber reliably, and helps our clients and their guests feel cared for from the first touch.

Responsibilities

  • Detailed Mechanical Design Ownership: Own detailed mechanical design of assigned products, assemblies, and subsystems from concept through production release.
  • Production-Ready Design Outputs: Develop production-ready 3D CAD models, assemblies, drawings, tolerance schemes, and BOMs. Create and maintain controlled mechanical design outputs and engineering changes.
  • Structural and Packaging Design: Design structural components, brackets, enclosures, panels, mechanisms, equipment mounts, fluid-system packaging, cable-management features, and user-interface components.
  • Subsystem Mechanical Solutions: Develop mechanical solutions for hydrogen generation and delivery, user controls, sensing systems, service access, user accommodation, and accessory hardware. Integrate electrical, firmware-controlled, optical, audio, sensing, and fluid subsystems into the mechanical design.
  • Design Intent to Manufacturable Reality: Translate industrial-design concepts into manufacturable mechanical solutions while preserving design intent.
  • Analysis and Design for X: Perform tolerance analysis, stack-ups, design calculations, material selection, and basic structural analysis. Design for manufacturing, assembly, serviceability, transportation, installation, and field replacement.
  • Prototyping and Validation: Build and evaluate prototypes and support rapid design iterations. Participate in design reviews, DFMEAs, verification activities, engineering builds, failure investigations, and corrective actions.
  • Supplier and CM Partnership: Work directly with suppliers and contract manufacturers to resolve design and manufacturing issues.

Skills to Excel

  • Production CAD Fluency
    • You communicate design intent clearly through models, assemblies, and GD&T drawings that suppliers can build from.

    • You understand how machining, sheet metal, plastics, fabricated structures, fasteners, adhesives, and assembly processes shape a design, and you design with them in mind.
  • Systems Thinking
    • The Chamber blends structure, fluids, electronics, light, and sound. You see how mechanical decisions affect every other subsystem.
  • Hands-On Problem Solving
    • You're comfortable at the bench with prototypes, instrumentation, and test equipment, and you learn fast from builds and failures.
  • Clear Cross-Functional Communication
    • You work well with industrial design, electrical, firmware, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.

Requirements

What Technical Knowledge Do You Need to Perform in This Role?

Required

  • Production 3D CAD (SolidWorks preferred)
  • GD&T and manufacturing drawings
  • Tolerance analysis and stack-ups
  • Materials selection and basic structural analysis
  • Machining, sheet metal, plastics, fabricated structures, fasteners, and adhesives

Preferred

  • DFMEA
  • Electromechanical integration
  • Fluid-system packaging

  • Approximately 3+ years of mechanical product-development experience
  • Strong production CAD experience; SolidWorks preferred

  • Practical understanding of machining, sheet metal, plastics, fabricated structures, fasteners, adhesives, and assembly processes

Qualifications (Nice to haves)

Job Title: Grant Reviewer, School Facilities (SOAR Facilities)
Work Arrangement: Remote
Location: Remote, United States
Employment Type: Part-Time, Independent Contractor (1099)
Engagement Type: Short-term, per grant competition; paid per application reviewed
Final Interview:

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring Grant Reviewers on behalf of the Office of the State Superintendent of Education (OSSE), the District of Columbia's state education agency, for its Scholarships for Opportunity and Results (SOAR) Facilities grant competition. OSSE is seeking reviewers with school-based education experience, ideally combined with construction project management or commercial real estate financing experience, to evaluate school facility applications.

Grant reviewers provide independent subject matter expertise to read, score, and comment on competitive grant applications submitted by local education agencies, schools, community-based organizations, and other eligible entities. All reviews are completed remotely in OSSE's online Enterprise Grants Management System (EGMS), and reviewer scores are used to recommend applications for funding. OSSE selects reviewers from the qualified pool and gives preference to reviewers who have satisfactorily completed reviews for its competitions in previous years.

Work Schedule

This is a remote, part-time assignment. Reviews are completed on your own schedule within each deadline. The approximate commitment for this competition is:

  • Orientation and EGMS training: a virtual webinar held approximately within two weeks of the engagement start date.
  • Review window: usually two weeks from the date applications are assigned, unless OSSE specifies otherwise.
  • Facilitated discussion (only if needed): a phone or video conference, usually about three business days after the scoring due date, held when panel scores differ significantly.
  • Approximate completion of reviewer work: June 4, 2027. Final dates are confirmed before orientation.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Complete OSSE's EGMS training and attend the virtual, grant-specific orientation webinar before reviewing any applications.
  2. Independently read and conduct a detailed review of each assigned application (typically two or more per competition) as one of three reviewers on an EGMS review panel, working remotely and separately.
  3. Evaluate the feasibility and soundness of each applicant's school facility plans, drawing on education, construction or renovation project, and real estate financing expertise as applicable.
  4. Complete a fully scored rubric for every section of each application, applying the established scoring criteria consistently and objectively.
  5. Write clear, constructive comments describing strengths and weaknesses that justify and align with the scores given. Reviews may be shared with applicants on request, with reviewer names and contact information removed.
  6. Base all scores and comments only on the content of each applicant's submission in EGMS.
  7. Submit all scores and comments in EGMS by the review deadline, usually two weeks from receiving the applications.
  8. Participate in a facilitated panel discussion by phone or video conference when scores differ significantly, then submit a final rubric with updated scores and comments reflecting any changes.
  9. Disclose any conflict of interest with applicant organizations and do not review any application where a conflict exists.
  10. Direct EGMS technical questions to the EGMS manual, the resources at grants.osse.dc.gov, or the EGMS call center at (202) 719-6500, and direct questions about the grant or about scoring to OSSE grant program staff.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher.
  • Minimum of three years of school-based education experience and/or relevant graduate-level study.
  • Reliable access to a computer, the internet, and a phone.
  • Availability for the full review process, including EGMS training, the orientation webinar, the complete review window, and a facilitated discussion if one is required.
  • No conflict of interest with any applicant organization in this competition, confirmed through a signed Conflict of Interest Form.
  • No unsatisfactory performance evaluation from past grant review work for OSSE or any other grant-making organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Project management experience for a construction or renovation project of a commercial-use facility or school building.
  • Experience with commercial real estate financing.
  • Prior experience reviewing competitive grant applications for OSSE or another government agency.

Compensation

  • $150 per application successfully reviewed. Reviewers are typically assigned two or more applications per competition.
  • Payment is made only after OSSE verifies successful completion of the entire review process: EGMS training, the orientation webinar, timely review and rigorous scoring of every assigned application in EGMS, and, if required, participation in a facilitated discussion with final scores submitted.
  • Payment is issued by Dhaka Technologies Limited Company by direct deposit or check within 30 calendar days of OSSE's verification.
  • Failure to complete timely, high-quality reviews will affect payment and will disqualify a reviewer from future assignments.

How to Apply

Interested candidates who meet the qualifications should send their resume to with the job title in the email subject line. Your resume should show your degree and your experience in the field. Please also mention in your resume the grants you have reviewed previously, including the grant-making organization, the grant program, and the year. Qualified applicants will be asked to complete a Grant Reviewer Application and a Conflict of Interest Form before they are recommended to OSSE.

The Associate Director of Formulation Development will provide scientific and strategic leadership for early- and late-stage formulation development activities supporting phase-appropriate formulations of biologic drug products, with a focus on monoclonal antibodies, bispecific formats, and co-formulations. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with deep expertise in formulation development for complex biologics, spanning early through late-stage development, with a focus on commercial readiness. We support utilities, developers, and municipalities with EPC services and project development expertise. Ranked by ENR as the #1 Power Contractor, we specialize in natural gas, oil, biomass, and waste-to-energy projects. MasTec’s Clean Energy & Infrastructure (CE&I) segment generates over $4 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across industrial, renewables and infrastructure sectors. jobs.description:
The Customer Success function is a cornerstone of NIQ Brandbank, playing a crucial role in customer onboarding, adoption, retention, development, and satisfaction for both Brandbank and Etilize solutions.

The Customer Integration function is a vital, client-facing component of NIQ Brandbank. It is responsible for managing the suite of solutions across both Brandbank and Etilize, including associated service levels. This function ensures the efficient ingestion and distribution of all relevant digital product content to meet the needs of our internal teams, stakeholders, customers, industry, and NIQ.

The Client Integration Data Transformation Specialist is responsible for supporting the successful deployment of new and updated services. This includes managing standard and custom data feeds, creating custom Excel extracts, and integrating with GS1 data platforms. The role is pivotal in ensuring seamless data transformation and integration processes that meet client needs and project specifications.

Job Responsibilities

  • Bespoke Integration Delivery:
    • Participate in the delivery of bespoke integrations, whether client-specific or GDSN (Global Data Synchronization Network).
    • Support data mapping, testing, and deployment activities to ensure accurate and efficient data integration.
    • Work with detailed data specifications and customer requirements.
  • Project Management:
    • Meet project milestones and adhere to client specifications for both inbound and outbound projects.
    • Collaborate with project managers to ensure timely and successful project delivery.
  • Knowledge Maintenance:
    • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Nielsen Brandbank and local GDSN data models and capture rules.
    • Continuously update skills and knowledge to stay current with industry standards and best practices.
    • Understand complex data mapping and transformation procedures.
  • Collaboration with Consultants and Developers:
    • Work closely with consultants and developers to create patches and changes that support bespoke data outputs.
    • Ensure that all changes are thoroughly tested and meet quality standards before deployment.
  • Data Transformation Logic:
    • Build out data transformation logic to ensure data is accurately transformed and integrated.
    • Identify test scenarios and create test data to validate the transformation processes.
    • Experience in the field of complex data transformation/mapping exercises.
  • Data Quality Assurance:
    • Ensure data quality is maintained throughout the transformation process to the NBB Product Library, GDSN Connector, and retailer sites.
    • Implement quality control measures to detect and correct data issues.
  • Supplier/Retailer Consultancy:
    • Provide consultancy services to suppliers and retailers to maintain the relevance and quality of data coverage.
    • Advise on best practices for data integration and transformation to meet bespoke and standard integration requirements.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Maintain regular and effective communication with key stakeholders, including project managers, clients, and internal teams.
    • Provide updates on project progress, address any issues, and ensure alignment with project goals.
    • Effective communicator, verbally and in writing, in local and English languages.

Flexible and available to work in line with UK working hours.

  • Education & Certifications:
    • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related field.
    • Relevant knowledge in GS1 standards, data integration platforms, or project management are advantageous.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Proven experience in complex data transformation and mapping.
    • Proficiency in managing and configuring standard and custom data feeds, including Excel extracts.
    • Familiarity with GS1 and GDSN (Global Data Synchronization Network) standards.
    • Experience building data transformation logic and conducting testing to ensure accuracy.
    • Understanding of data formats such as XML, JSON, CSV, and Excel.
    • Strong data quality assurance capabilities, including implementation of quality control measures.

    • Experience working collaboratively with cross-functional teams including consultants and developers.
    • Ability to provide consultancy to suppliers and retailers on data integration and transformation best practices.

Job Description: Medical Coding Author (CCS / CIC / CPC Certified)

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote – United States Only

About the Role

We are seeking experienced and certified Medical Coding Authors to contribute their expertise to an AI training and evaluation project. In this role, you will create high-quality medical coding scenarios, educational materials, and assessment content to help train next-generation AI systems. Your expertise in real-world medical coding practices will support the development of AI models capable of accurately interpreting clinical documentation and applying complex coding guidelines. No prior AI experience is required; your professional coding knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Develop realistic medical coding scenarios, clinical documentation excerpts, and coding questions across inpatient, outpatient, and professional fee settings, including accurate ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, and HCPCS code assignments.
  2. Create detailed answer keys and explanations covering code selection, sequencing, modifiers, and Present on Admission (POA) indicators, with references to relevant official guidelines and coding conventions.
  3. Develop evaluation rubrics and test cases of varying complexity, including ambiguous and challenging clinical documentation, to assess AI models' ability to apply medical coding rules accurately.
  4. Review, validate, and revise existing coding content for accuracy, clarity, and alignment with current ICD-10-CM/PCS Official Guidelines, AHA Coding Clinic guidance, and CPT coding standards.
  5. Collaborate with project stakeholders through written and verbal communication to clarify requirements, resolve documentation ambiguities, and maintain data integrity.
  6. Provide detailed feedback on coding guidelines, complex coding cases, and content quality to improve project workflows and strengthen AI model performance.

Required Qualifications

  1. Hold an active AHIMA Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), AAPC Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC), or AAPC Certified Professional Coder (CPC) credential.
  2. Strong knowledge of ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, and CPT coding systems, supported by hands-on coding experience in a hospital, physician practice, or coding audit environment.
  3. Experience developing or reviewing medical coding content, including training materials, audit findings, coder education resources, or examination preparation materials.
  4. Ability to explain complex coding decisions, code assignments, and guideline interpretations clearly and accurately in writing.
  5. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  6. Access to current ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, and CPT code sets, along with the applicable Official Coding Guidelines.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Experience creating educational content, coding assessments, or technical reference materials for medical coding professionals.
  2. Familiarity with evaluating coding accuracy, identifying documentation gaps, and resolving complex or ambiguous coding scenarios.
  3. Experience with AI training, data annotation, content validation, or model evaluation projects.

Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Czechia

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Czechia. Day rate: EUR 450 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineering team can build. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design across close, reconciliation, journals and intercompany, written up as the solution design. Decisions on what standard Redwood capability covers and where an extension is justified. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Guidance to the engineers through build, and review of what they deliver against the design. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. A roadmap for the next waves of automation once the first processes are live.

What you bring

Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. A working understanding of SAP FI/CO, or the Oracle equivalent, and how close and reconciliation data flows between the ERP and the automation layer. Experience running workshops with finance users and turning what they say into a design that can be built and tested. The standing to work with senior finance stakeholders and hold a design position when it is challenged.

Useful but not essential:

Hands-on build experience on Redwood, so you know what your design asks of the engineers. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.
