About the job:

The Regional Leader for US Commercial Sales, will be responsible for leading revenue-generating activities across the US’s Commercial Segment. This role requires a results-oriented leader with a strong customer, partner, and revenue-oriented mindset, coupled with executive presence. The successful candidate will be comfortable leading in a matrixed organization, managing local customer and partner needs while adhering to Red Hat’s globally defined go-to-market strategy and operating model.


This leader will ensure smooth and predictable sales execution in partnership with technical and services leadership for the benefit of customers and partners. This position is critical for accelerating Red Hat as a diverse, inclusive, and customer-centric world-class leader in open source innovation. As a senior leader, this individual must be inspirational and capable of contributing to the overall Geo strategy. The position reports directly to the VP of North America Sales


What you will do:

  • Lead the US Corporate & Territory Sales teams for the North America field sales organization.
  • Leverage partner sales motions within the Region to achieve sales and revenue goals.
  • Develop, motivate, and lead a sales organization that operates with confidence and market understanding to act decisively on emerging opportunities
  • Drive C-level conversations and have the ability to identify large transactions that can be executed to grow our RH footprint, inclusive of new logos in our whitespace accounts
  • Collaborate closely with global segment and function leaders to guide Red Hat’s go-to-market strategy and approach within the segment across various sales channels inclusive of partners and vendors.
  • Fully embrace the partner ecosystem as a key driver for meeting sales and revenue targets.
  • Drive end-to-end co-sell partner engagement to maximize leads, opportunities, and joint revenue potential.
  • Allocate regional Commercial Segment budget and targets as assigned by global segment and Geo leaders.
  • Align account segmentation to criteria developed by Commercial Segment and Geo leaders, with the ability to flex assignments within predefined limits based on regional needs.
  • Align field resources against accounts and supported partners based on defined worldwide segment coverage blueprints, with the ability to flex assignments within predefined limits based on Geo needs.
  • Maintain a high-performing regional management system, implementing globally consistent operational and financial key performance indicators, and holding associates accountable for results and performance management of associates to ensure a high performing team..
  • Champion the experience of customers and partners within the segment
  • Serve as the point of escalation for all Commercial account approvals and conflicts across the segment and ecosystem, including pricing approvals and prioritization of resource allocation to accounts.
  • Attract, develop, and retain the best in class team, ensuring their operation and assimilation into the successful Red Hat culture while bringing in fresh perspectives and ideas driving efficiencies and simplification accelerating deal velocity and high value activities for the field.
  • Collaborate across North America, the Global Segments and Function leadership to ensure Red Hat associates affiliate both locally and within their function.
  • Experience working within the matrix, actively collaborating with peers on the leadership team to drive Red Hat’s standards of performance and excellence.

What you will bring:

  • 8+ years of experience selling software or service infrastructure solutions into medium enterprise organizations through a partner-led sales motion.
  • Demonstrated track record of building and leading high-performing, geographically-dispersed, multifaceted teams.
  • Proven experience leading sales in an organization where the solution set requires a solid understanding of the broader technology ecosystem and the complexity of effective architecture/integration of solutions.
  • Must possess the technical ability to understand Red Hat’s solution portfolio and help shape solution strategy and development.
  • Demonstrated ability to surpass goals, seize opportunities to innovate, challenge the status quo to drive continuous improvement, and define new opportunities to serve customers through partners and drive results.
  • Demonstrated ability to execute on the sales strategy and value proposition for Commercial organizations within their respective geo and region, ensuring alignment with broader organizational/product strategies inclusive of cross selling activities and driving net new logos and growth accounts that will become the enterprise accounts of the future.
  • Must be able to challenge assumptions and conventional wisdom with specific, supported, reasoned proposals, and lead the organization forward to new ways of doing business, new operating models, and improved customer engagement.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead an organization by engaging, developing, and motivating team members, leading by example and bringing expertise and value to the challenges the field and our ecosystem faces through innovation, AI and other means to continuously improve.
  • Strong communication skills to articulate long-term direction and collaborate with the team on how to achieve it. Drive buy in and work through influence within the matrix.
  • Demonstrated ability to hold oneself and associates accountable for commitments, leading by example, providing clarity and outlining clear and shared expectations for success, over communicating as well as being humble and open to feedback from the field and our ecosystem of partners and functions that individuals will collaborate with on a daily basis. Must be able to raise the level of overall organizational performance and capability through mentorship, professional development, performance management, rigor, driving standard work and KPI and data to drive the comprehensive skills enhancement for the associates to understand what they will be measured on and the priorities and goals that they need to achieve in a time bound period. .
The salary range for this position is $341,680.00 - $580,770.00 (inclusive of base pay + target incentive compensation). Actual offer will be based on your qualifications.

Pay Transparency

Red Hat determines compensation based on several factors including but not limited to job location, experience, applicable skills and training, external market value, and internal pay equity. Annual salary is one component of Red Hat’s compensation package. This position may also be eligible for bonus, commission, and/or equity. For positions with Remote-US locations, the actual salary range for the position may differ based on location but will be commensurate with job duties and relevant work experience.

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterpriseopen source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Benefits
● Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
● Flexible Spending Account - healthcare and dependent care
● Health Savings Account - high deductible medical plan
● Retirement 401(k) with employer match

● Paid time off and holidays

● Paid parental leave plans for all new parents
● Leave benefits including disability, paid family medical leave, and paid military leave
● Additional benefits including employee stock purchase plan, family planning reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, transportation expense account, employee assistance program, and more!

Note: These benefits are only applicable to full time, permanent associates at Red Hat located in the United States.

Inclusion at Red Hat
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.


Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.

Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email . General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

jobs.excerpt: Why Work at SMA America At SMA America, we believe in Energy that Changes.
jobs.description:
Why Work at SMA America

At SMA America, we believe in Energy that Changes. Since 1981, we’ve been developing innovative solar technology that simplifies, secures, and enhances the performance of photovoltaic systems — all while pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in clean energy.

But we’re not just transforming power — we’re empowering people.

We’ve built a culture where bold ideas are welcomed, collaboration is second nature, and your career growth truly matters. With our Rocklin, CA headquarters as the hub, we offer a hybrid work model, competitive benefits, and a team-driven environment where your impact is seen and felt.

Whether you’re a sales expert, service pro, or engineering innovator, if you’re ready to join a purpose-driven team committed to shaping the future of energy — we’d love to meet you.

Senior Applications Engineer – Solar PV & Battery Storage Systems

This is a power electronics and applications engineering role, not a software engineering position. We are looking for candidates with hands-on electrical or mechanical engineering backgrounds in solar PV and battery storage systems.

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. SMA America does not offer employment visa sponsorship of any kind, including H-1B, OPT, CPT, or TN visas. Candidates who currently require or will in the future require visa sponsorship are not eligible for this role. Candidates operating under a temporary work permit or any visa-tied employment authorization are also not eligible. This position is open to candidates located within the continental United States only.

AI-GENERATED APPLICATION MATERIALS

We review all resumes and application materials for AI-generated content. Submissions that show evidence of AI manipulation, including AI-written resumes, cover letters, or responses, will be disqualified from consideration without further review. We want to hear your authentic voice and see your genuine experience.

RECRUITMENT FRAUD NOTICE

All SMA America openings are posted on our official careers page and all recruiter communication comes from an @sma-america.com address. We never request payment, banking information, or a Social Security number during the recruitment process. If you are contacted about an SMA America role from a personal email account, or asked for any of the above, please forward the message to .

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, or equivalent hands-on industry experience, is required. A master's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering is a strong plus.
  • Minimum 5–7 years of hands-on experience in renewable energy engineering, with direct work on PV or battery storage systems and solutions.
  • In-depth knowledge of power electronics, including inverters and transformers.
  • In-depth knowledge of power systems design.
  • Working knowledge of PVSyst or similar PV system modeling tools, applied in real project work.
  • Sound knowledge of the U.S. energy sector, including applicable norms, standards, and regulations.
  • Knowledge of battery systems and solutions.
  • Note: Degrees completed more than three years ago are preferred, as we are seeking candidates with substantial hands-on industry experience beyond their academic foundation.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Senior Applications Engineer serves as a technical product specialist for PV and Battery Energy Storage solutions and systems. The role is responsible for advising SMA's customers across North America by analyzing system specifications and requirements, reviewing and proposing system designs, and supporting the sales organization through technical expertise and joint customer engagement. The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of power electronics, utility-scale PV and BESS, a collaborative approach, and the ability to work cross-functionally across U.S. and global teams.

PRIMARY DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a senior technical specialist for SMA, assisting customers with technical questions via telephone, email, and face-to-face meetings.
  • Review customer and utility interconnection requirements and help select the appropriate SMA products and services; assist customers in the project design process and support key and EPC customers.
  • Serve as a liaison between the U.S. sales team and the technical team at SMA headquarters in Germany.
  • Create and deliver internal and external technical training materials and presentations.
  • Develop sales materials for use by the sales team during customer meetings and new client engagements.
  • Conduct competitor analysis and provide technical argumentation to effectively compete against analyzed products and solutions.
  • Attend industry conferences and trade shows as necessary.
  • Interface with product management, engineering, and service teams to ensure alignment on technical requirements.
  • Other duties as may be required or assigned.

ADDITIONAL PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • NABCEP certification (PVIP or similar) or equivalent industry credential.
  • Knowledge of solar electric (PV) installation and system design.
  • Knowledge of the energy sector in Mexico and/or Central America.
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment managing multiple projects concurrently.
  • Willingness to travel periodically domestically and internationally, including to Canada, Latin America, and SMA headquarters in Kassel, Germany.
  • Proficiency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).

WE OFFER

  • Base salary range of $125,000 to $145,000 annually, dependent on experience, plus bonus eligibility.
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision coverage, including $0 premium options.
  • Remote-first work schedule. Continental U.S. candidates only.
  • Relocation assistance available; budget to be confirmed.
  • 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Opportunities for professional development, training, and industry engagement.
  • Inclusive, collaborative, and innovative work environment with global cross-functional exposure.

Our EEO Policy

We are an equal opportunity employer and we make our employment decisions on the basis of merit and without regard to one’s race, color, creed, sex (includes gender, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender identity, religion, marital status, age (over 40), national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability (includes HIV/Aids), medical condition (cancer, genetic characteristics), veteran’s status, sexual orientation, or any other consideration made unlawful by law.

In accordance with applicable law protecting qualified individuals with known disabilities, SMA will attempt to reasonably accommodate qualified applicants with known disabilities, unless doing so would create an undue hardship on SMA. Any qualified applicant with a disability who believes he or she requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job for which he or she is applying should identify the accommodation(s) needed in the application.

Our Privacy Policy

During your job application or recruitment process with us: (a) SMA may collect your personal information directly from you, such as when you submit your application and resume on our online portal or when you have job interviews with us. We may also obtain your personal information from third parties, including but not limited to your former employers, background or employment check service providers or third-party recruiters; and, (b) SMA may use or process applicants' personal information for relevant purposes including but not limited to general communications with you, identity verification, background or employment checks, determination of eligibility, and making hiring decisions. For successful job applicants who become SMA’s staff, we may retain and integrate your personal information collected during the recruitment process into your records at SMA. For unsuccessful job applicants, [SMA may retain your application for internal records or for future recruitment purposes].

If you are a California resident, you have specific rights regarding your personal information under the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018, as amended including by the California Privacy Rights Act of 2020, and its implementing regulations (the “CCPA”). This Company Personnel and Covered Individuals Privacy Notice for California Residents issued by SMA is applicable to you and explains your CCPA rights and our collection, use or disclosure of your personal information.

If you have any question regarding our privacy policy, please contact us at

Job Description: Federal Grants Management Specialist

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote – United States Only

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Federal Grants Management Specialists to support an important project requiring in-depth knowledge of federal grant administration, compliance, and regulatory requirements. In this role, you will contribute your professional expertise to help train and evaluate next-generation AI systems. Your knowledge will help improve how AI models understand, interpret, and respond to complex federal grants management scenarios through accurate, high-quality input.

Scope of Work

  1. Draft federal funding announcements and Notices of Funding Opportunity (NOFOs), clearly defining program objectives, eligibility criteria, application instructions, and evaluation standards.
  2. Review and evaluate federal grant applications by assessing applicant eligibility, project merit, budget justifications, and compliance with funding requirements.
  3. Prepare formal grant monitoring findings, identifying compliance deficiencies, supporting documentation, applicable regulations, and recommended corrective actions.
  4. Review and annotate grant applications, award documents, budgets, and compliance reports to develop high-quality AI training materials.
  5. Evaluate AI-generated grants management content for regulatory accuracy, procedural compliance, and alignment with federal requirements, including 2 CFR Part 200 (Uniform Guidance).
  6. Develop realistic grant management scenarios, reference responses, and evaluation criteria covering pre-award, award, and post-award processes.

Required Qualifications

  1. Proven professional experience in federal grants management, particularly in GS-1109 positions or equivalent roles within federal, state, or local government grant administration.
  2. Hands-on experience drafting funding announcements, reviewing and scoring grant applications, and documenting monitoring or audit findings.
  3. Strong knowledge of federal grants management processes, compliance standards, and reporting requirements.
  4. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex regulatory and procedural information clearly and accurately.
  5. Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and the ability to interpret federal grant regulations and documentation.
  6. Ability to collaborate effectively and maintain a high level of customer service in a remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Prior experience working with AI training, model evaluation, or technical content review.
  2. Familiarity with evaluating AI-generated content for factual accuracy, regulatory compliance, and procedural consistency.
  3. Experience developing training materials, assessment scenarios, or reference documentation related to federal grants administration.

By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices, it gives users greater control over their data and how they use artificial intelligence. Our focus is on local, on-device, and privacy-preserving AI, with opportunities to connect these experiences across Tether’s peer-to-peer ecosystem.

We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong interest in AI and a practical understanding of how to turn emerging capabilities into useful products.

You will work closely with the Product Lead to help advance the QV.AC vision: identifying valuable use cases, defining AI features, exploring product concepts, and working with engineering and design to bring them to users. You’ll contribute to product direction and take responsibility for moving assigned features from discovery through delivery and iteration.

This role suits someone who knows how to leverage AI to the maximum and enjoys experimenting with new AI technologies, understands its possibilities and limitations, and cares about making complex technology easy to use.

Responsibilities

  • Help shape AI features: Work with the Product Lead to translate thevision into concrete use cases, feature proposals, and product requirements. Bring ideas grounded in user needs, research, and hands-on experimentation.

  • Understand users and their problems: Gather feedback, conduct research, and explore how people use AI in their everyday workflows. Identify where AI can solve a meaningful problem and where a simpler solution may work better.

  • Turn ideas into clear specifications: Write product briefs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and user flows that help engineering and design understand the intended experience, constraints, and measures of success.

  • Prototype and explore: Create wireframes, mockups, and working prototypes to test ideas and communicate product behavior. Use AI-assisted tools to explore concepts quickly and refine them with the team.

  • Collaborate on technical trade-offs: Work with engineers to understand what is feasible across devices and models. Help assess the impact of response quality, latency, memory usage, battery consumption, and privacy on the user experience.

  • Support prioritization and planning: Help the Product Lead evaluate opportunities, clarify scope, identify dependencies, and maintain a focused backlog aligned with product priorities.

  • Drive feature delivery: Follow assigned features through development, resolve product questions, review the experience, and coordinate feedback and release readiness with relevant teams.

  • Stay close to AI developments: Explore new AI products, models, tools, and interaction patterns, and explain their practical relevance to. Share clear recommendations about what is worth testing or adopting and why.

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • 7+ years of product management experience, ideally working on AI software products with technical engineering teams.

  • Practical experience building, shipping, or prototyping AI-powered features, with the ability to explain your contribution and what you learned.

  • A working understanding of AI concepts such as inference, harnesses, model capabilities and limitations, context, and evaluation, alongside an interest in local and on-device AI.

  • The ability to translate an ambiguous idea into a clear user problem, proposed solution, and actionable requirements.

  • Strong product judgment, with attention to usability, scope, and measurable user value.

  • Confidence creating prototypes using design or coding tools

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to discuss technical trade-offs with engineers and explain them to non-technical colleagues.

  • A proactive, collaborative approach: comfortable taking responsibility for your work, asking questions early, and incorporating feedback.

  • Familiarity with product analytics, user research, and iterative software development.

Preferred:

  • Experience with local AI, on-device inference, or open-source models.

  • Experience building AI assistants, conversational interfaces, or multimodal features.

  • Familiarity with desktop or mobile product development.

  • An understanding of peer-to-peer technologies and decentralized applications.

  • Experience evaluating AI output quality and designing user experiences that account for uncertainty and errors.

  • Experience working in a distributed team.

About Us

WellHive is a fast-growing organization focused on transforming the way health systems coordinate and deliver care through secure, modern technology. Our teams leverage the latest in cloud-based tools and services to design and build complex and compelling applications. Every employee is treated as a valued contributor that brings their own unique experience and perspective to the issues we are solving for our users. WellHive proudly offers competitive pay and benefits in addition to flexible working conditions.

Role Summary

Because of our growth, we are seeking a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join the team. In this role, you will be instrumental in architecting, developing, and deploying robust solutions for our healthcare platform. After in person identity proofing and a brief onboarding, this is a remote position offering significant autonomy while closely collaborating with your agile scrum team and cross-functional partners.

A successful candidate will help the team drive best coding and testing practices across the full stack, playing a pivotal role in elevating our team's coding standards. We are seeking an individual who can champion and implement best practices across both our frontend and backend development, writing robust, scalable, and maintainable code, and who is comfortable incorporating AI coding tools into their day-to-day workflow to move faster without sacrificing quality. This includes helping define and implement best practices for automated testing, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.

This role requires not only a strong technical background but also a passion for mentorship and a commitment to fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the engineering team. It is critical to be able to show examples and discuss improvements in code design within complex, real-world systems.

Do you thrive on tackling the complexities of building scalable systems? Are you passionate about solving challenging real world problems within large-scale healthcare environments? Do you value writing clean, well-architected, and maintainable code within an agile framework? If so, we encourage you to apply.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of professional software development experience.
  • Proficiency with modern software development practices across the full stack; this role will largely use Go and TypeScript, though prior proficiency in other programming languages is welcome.
  • Strong knowledge of testing frameworks and a firm belief in leveraging automation to write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure software quality.
  • Experience mapping together multiple API results into easy to understand and maintain design patterns.
  • Comfortable using AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) as part of the regular development workflow.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively within a team, provide technical guidance, mentor junior engineers, and foster knowledge sharing.
  • Expertise in software engineering best practices and familiarity with associated tools, such as Git/GitHub for version control, code review processes, static analysis tools (e.g., ESLint, SonarQube), and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies such as Scrum and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) principles.
  • Solid understanding of fundamental software engineering principles, including data structures, algorithms, software design patterns, testing paradigms, and effective debugging of distributed systems.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related technical field.
  • Successful completion of in-person IAL3 compliant identity proofing will be required (you must be able to present the necessary identification documents).
  • Willingness and ability to travel for occasional customer or onsite company meetings (approximately 1-2 times per year).
  • Ability to work remotely within the continental USA from an Eastern or Central time zone (excluding New York).
  • Must be a US citizen or permanent resident.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Practical experience with Angular or another modern frontend framework.
  • Strong understanding of Web Services, including RESTful API design, integration, and consumption.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, particularly AWS.
  • Familiarity with the Go programming language, paradigms, constructs, and idioms.
  • Knowledge of relational databases, whether PostgreSQL or other.
  • Familiarity with TypeScript/JavaScript and modern web application design patterns.


Essential Job Functions
  • Collaborate closely with your Scrum team to contribute to program increment and sprint planning, providing technical insights and estimations.
  • Translate user stories and product requirements into well-defined technical designs and implementations.
  • Apply your deep technical knowledge and problem-solving skills to address complex challenges within the healthcare domain.
  • Develop high-quality, performant, and maintainable code with comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end test coverage.
  • Provide technical leadership through participation in design discussions, code reviews, and mentorship of other team members.
  • Actively participate in code reviews, design sessions, and all agile ceremonies (stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement).
  • Work both independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative solutions to challenging healthcare problems.
  • Mentor and support the technical growth of other engineers on the team.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of our development tools, processes, and architecture.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, including occasional participation in a daytime on-call rotation (1 weekday every 3-4 weeks).

Tech Stack

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will be working within an ecosystem that includes: a modern UI built with Angular, TypeScript, and leveraging RxJS/NGXS for state management. Our backend services are primarily Golang applications running on Amazon Linux ECS/Fargate, with data persistence in PostgreSQL/Redshift. Data analytics pipelines utilize Python/Glue. Our infrastructure is managed as code using Pulumi, and our CI/CD pipeline is orchestrated with Jenkins. We use Git/GitHub for version control and Jira for agile project management. Our engineers also make use of AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate development and improve code quality.

An overview of this role

As a Customer Success Engineer, you'll help customers get real, measurable value from GitLab after the sale by providing technical product expertise and best practice guidance. You'll be part of the customer success engineer team that delivers GitLab's On-Demand Success Tier through webinars, hands-on labs, office hours, and on-demand engagements.

This is a pooled model, so you won't be dedicated to a specific set of accounts. You'll collaborate closely with Customer Success Managers, Account Executives, and Renewals Managers to support implementation, architecture, and use case adoption across GitLab's key workflows, including source code management, continuous integration and delivery, DevSecOps, and Agile Planning. You'll report to the Customer Success Engineer Team Manager, and your first-year outcomes will focus on building trusted advisor relationships, enabling successful customer implementations, and creating reusable workshops and technical content that helps customers adopt GitLab at scale.

What you'll do

  • Engage with customers via Zoom calls and email as a technical consultant during the post-sales journey, providing product, solution, and best-practice guidance.

  • Deliver practical, customer-specific enablement through webinars, hands-on labs, office hours, and on-demand engagements in a pooled support model (not dedicated to a single account)

  • Contribute to customer-facing learning resources, including GitLab documentation, YouTube content, and enablement programs such as the Digital Journey.

  • Strong time management and prioritization skills, including the ability to juggle multiple customer engagements and cross-functional requests in a pooled model.

We're a globally distributed customer success engineer (CSE) team supporting customers in GitLab's On-Demand Success Tier. jobs.excerpt: Our client is seeking a commercially astute, strategic and execution-oriented Head of Business Development, Marketing & Partnerships to lead its commercial growth agenda and strengthen its market position within Kenya's financial services and digital credit sector.
jobs.description:
Our client is seeking a commercially astute, strategic and execution-oriented Head of Business Development, Marketing & Partnerships to lead its commercial growth agenda and strengthen its market position within Kenya's financial services and digital credit sector.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer and serving as a member of the Executive Committee, the role holder will be responsible for developing and executing integrated business development, sales, marketing and partnership strategies that drive sustainable revenue growth, loan book expansion, customer acquisition, profitability and market penetration.

The role will provide strategic and operational leadership across multiple product lines, distribution channels and customer acquisition platforms, including the branch network, field sales, digital channels and strategic partnerships.

A key priority will be to accelerate the commercialisation and market penetration of new and existing products, including digital lending solutions and revamped loan products, while ensuring that growth is supported by sound portfolio quality, effective customer acquisition, responsible lending practices and strong commercial discipline.

The successful candidate will lead a large, geographically distributed commercial team, build strong functional leadership capability, and establish a performance-driven culture anchored in data, accountability, customer focus and measurable business outcomes.

This is a high-impact executive role in a fast-paced, target-driven environment that requires a leader who can translate strategy into tangible results, make informed decisions quickly, and drive execution across multiple business functions.

3. Key Roles & Responsibilities

A. Commercial Strategy, Business Development and Growth

  • Develop and execute the organisation's commercial strategy, translating enterprise objectives into integrated business development, sales, marketing and market expansion plans.
  • Drive sustainable loan book growth, revenue growth, customer acquisition and profitability across product lines, channels and geographical markets.
  • Identify and evaluate new markets, customer segments, business opportunities and distribution channels to expand the organisation's market reach.
  • Develop strategies to strengthen customer acquisition, increase repeat business and improve customer lifetime value.
  • Translate enterprise KPIs into clear departmental, functional and individual performance targets, ensuring alignment across the commercial organisation.
  • Monitor commercial performance, identify emerging opportunities and performance gaps, and implement timely corrective measures.
  • Provide strategic commercial insights and recommendations to the CEO and EXCO to support business planning and decision-making.

B. Sales and Business Development Leadership

  • Lead the sales and business development function, ensuring effective execution of commercial plans across branches, regional teams, field sales, team leaders and other customer acquisition channels.
  • Establish clear sales targets, performance standards, productivity expectations and accountability mechanisms across the commercial network.
  • Drive customer acquisition, lead conversion, disbursement performance, portfolio growth and repeat business in line with approved business targets.
  • Strengthen sales execution through effective pipeline management, customer segmentation, territory planning and performance monitoring.
  • Identify opportunities to improve sales productivity, channel effectiveness and conversion rates.
  • Work closely with Credit, Risk, Collections and Operations to improve the customer acquisition and disbursement journey while maintaining portfolio quality and responsible lending standards.
  • Review commercial capacity, staffing requirements and sales coverage to ensure the organisation is appropriately positioned to deliver its growth objectives.

C. Marketing, Brand Positioning and Customer Acquisition

  • Develop and implement an integrated marketing strategy that supports business growth, customer acquisition, product uptake and brand positioning.
  • Lead the development and execution of marketing campaigns across digital, traditional, field activation, referral and other relevant channels.
  • Oversee brand positioning, marketing communications, public relations and customer engagement initiatives.
  • Drive qualified lead generation and improve the conversion of marketing leads into active customers.
  • Monitor marketing effectiveness, campaign performance, customer acquisition costs and return on marketing investment.
  • Use market intelligence, customer insights and competitor analysis to refine marketing strategies and improve campaign effectiveness.
  • Ensure consistent brand identity, messaging and customer communication across all channels.
  • Lead the development of marketing strategies that support new product launches, market expansion and customer retention.

D. Product Commercialisation and Market Expansion

  • Lead the commercial development and market introduction of new products, product enhancements and digital lending solutions.
  • Conduct market assessments, customer research and competitor analysis to identify opportunities for product innovation and commercial growth.
  • Collaborate with Credit, Risk, IT, Operations, Finance and other relevant functions to ensure products are commercially viable, operationally deliverable and aligned with the organisation's risk appetite.
  • Develop and execute product commercialisation strategies, including customer segmentation, pricing input, positioning, distribution and promotional plans.
  • Monitor product performance against approved business cases and commercial targets, identifying opportunities to improve uptake, profitability and customer experience.
  • Recommend corrective actions for underperforming products and support decisions on product enhancements, repositioning or market expansion.
  • Support the development of new distribution channels and digital customer acquisition models.

E. Strategic Partnerships and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Identify, develop and manage strategic partnerships that support customer acquisition, market access, product distribution, revenue growth and business expansion.
  • Build and maintain relationships with relevant financial institutions, distribution partners, corporates, industry stakeholders and other strategic partners.
  • Identify partnership opportunities that strengthen the organisation's competitive positioning and expand its commercial reach.
  • Lead partnership negotiations and collaborate with relevant internal stakeholders to establish commercially viable and mutually beneficial arrangements.

  • Define partnership objectives, performance measures and value realisation mechanisms.

  • Monitor the commercial contribution of partnerships and recommend actions to maximise their business value.
  • Represent the organisation at relevant industry forums, business engagements and stakeholder meetings.

F. Customer Experience, Retention and Commercial Effectiveness

  • Work closely with the Customer Experience and Retention function to strengthen customer acquisition, engagement, retention and repeat business.
  • Ensure commercial strategies are informed by customer insights, service performance, customer feedback and changing customer needs.
  • Collaborate with Customer Experience, Operations and other relevant functions to identify and address bottlenecks across the customer journey.
  • Support initiatives to improve customer satisfaction, customer loyalty, retention and Net Promoter Score.
  • Promote customer-centric sales and marketing practices that support responsible lending, transparency and long-term customer relationships.
  • Use customer retention and lifetime value insights to improve acquisition strategies and commercial returns.

G. Commercial Performance, Analytics and Business Intelligence

  • Establish and maintain a robust commercial performance management framework aligned with enterprise KPIs.
  • Ensure timely and accurate reporting on loan book growth, revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, disbursements, portfolio quality, marketing effectiveness and sales productivity.
  • Work closely with the Data and IT teams to strengthen commercial dashboards, reporting systems and data-driven decision-making.
  • Use business intelligence, market trends, customer behaviour and competitor insights to identify growth opportunities and commercial risks.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews across products, branches, regions, channels and functional teams.

  • Provide actionable insights and performance recommendations to the CEO and EXCO.

  • Ensure commercial decisions are supported by reliable data, clear accountability and measurable business outcomes.

H. Financial Performance, Portfolio Quality and Risk Management

  • Drive commercial growth while maintaining alignment with the organisation's risk appetite, credit policies and responsible lending requirements.
  • Work closely with Credit, Risk, Collections and Recoveries to monitor portfolio quality and improve collection efficiency and recovery performance.
  • Monitor portfolio-at-risk indicators and ensure commercial growth strategies account for the quality and sustainability of the loan book.
  • Collaborate with Finance to improve commercial profitability, net interest margin and cost efficiency.
  • Monitor customer acquisition costs relative to customer lifetime value and drive efficient allocation of commercial and marketing resources.
  • Ensure that sales incentives, acquisition strategies and commercial practices support sustainable business performance rather than short-term volume growth alone.
  • Promote compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, consumer protection standards and data protection obligations.

I. People Leadership and Organisational Effectiveness

  • Provide strategic leadership to the commercial function, building a high-performing team with clear accountability and a strong results orientation.
  • Lead, coach and develop functional managers, regional leaders and other commercial team members.
  • Establish clear performance expectations, KPIs, performance review mechanisms and development priorities across the function.

As our new Software Engineer, Platform Scale & Reliability 📈

You will help strengthen the technical foundations that allow Performativ to serve more customers, process more data, and support increasingly demanding enterprise use cases.

This is an all-round engineering role rather than a narrowly defined infrastructure position. You will work across services, data flows, APIs, background processing, databases, cloud infrastructure, and operational tooling wherever improvements are needed.

  • You will identify and resolve performance, scalability, and reliability limitations across the platform, using production evidence to focus effort where it has the greatest impact.

  • You will improve observability through useful metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerts that help the team understand system behaviour and diagnose problems quickly.

  • You will strengthen services, data processing, deployment workflows, and operational safeguards so failures are detected early, contained, and permanently resolved.

  • You will contribute across our technology landscape, including Python, Golang, PHP, TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, AWS, containers, and CI/CD tooling, without being limited to one language or system.

  • You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, critically review their decisions and output, and establish the tests and operational evidence needed for safe deployment.

You should bring broad software-engineering experience and a practical understanding of how production systems behave under real usage. Experience with distributed systems, performance analysis, database optimisation, cloud infrastructure, observability, or high-volume data processing would be valuable. Expertise in our exact technology stack is less important than your ability to understand systems, investigate evidence, and deliver sound solutions.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. We expect people to lead when appropriate, follow through on what they take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be able to recognise weak designs, incorrect assumptions, missing failure modes, and unsafe production behaviour.

This role is remote from the Philippines and requires working hours that substantially overlap with the team’s working day in Copenhagen.

  • The opportunity to influence the foundations of a financial platform as it moves into enterprise scale.

  • Broad engineering challenges across applications, data, infrastructure, reliability, and developer tooling.

  • An AI-native development environment where engineering judgment matters more than manually producing code.

  • Strong opportunities to develop your technical breadth and contribute across the platform.

About the job

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Vision & Strategy

  • Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.

  • Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

Technical Product Leadership

  • Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.

  • Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.

  • Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.

Rapid Prototyping with AI

  • Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.

  • Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

Execution & Team Leadership

  • Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.

  • Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.

  • Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.

  • Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.

  • Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

Mobile & Distribution

  • Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.

  • Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.

  • Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.

Requirements

  • Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).

  • Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.

  • Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.

  • Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.

  • Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.

  • A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.

  • You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have:

  • Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.

  • Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.

  • A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.

  • Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

Summary

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced professional to be accountable for delivering a scalable, outcome-driven full stack observability architecture that improves operational efficiency, reduces alert noise, and produces actionable service intelligence across Managed Services.

The Observability Architect is accountable for the business and operational outcomes the observability platform must produce.

This role directly impacts service quality, cost-to-serve, and customer-perceived value by ensuring monitoring data translates into meaningful operational and business outcomes.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Observability Platform Architecture & Ownership


  • Owns the enterprise observability reference architecture with direct accountability for platform effectiveness, signal quality, and operational impact across Managed Services’ (Logic Monitor today; additional platforms as the strategy evolves).
  • Ensures platform capabilities deliver measurable improvements in monitoring effectiveness, operational efficiency, and service value—holding vendors accountable to Logicalis outcomes, not feature parity.
  • Evaluates platform capabilities, limitations, and roadmap alignment against customer and Managed Service’s needs.
  • Ensures alerts entering ITSM are prioritized, correlated, and aligned to meaningful operational actions.
  • Ensures telemetry aligns to contractual obligations, SLA performance, and delivery reality.
  • Ensures platform configuration and evolution aligns to multi-service environments, security, compliance, and MSP operational requirements.
  • Acts as the escalation point for Operations and Monitoring Engineers for complex alert, incident, and telemetry escalations, ensuring timely triage, root-cause analysis, and durable monitoring improvements.

Observability Transformation & Adoption


  • Leads the observability governance cadence and community of practice, and keeps one agreed tool roadmap aligned with Global peers.
  • Drives organizational adoption of outcome-based observability practices, shifting teams from monitoring coverage to monitoring effectiveness.
  • Partners with Service and Technology Architects to enable the conversion of observability data into trusted service intelligence, supporting leadership reporting, QBRs, and customer value articulation.
  • Partners with service owners and architects to define observability requirements as part of service design, lifecycle governance, and service readiness.
  • Leads cross-functional alignment across service architecture, operations, ITSM, and automation teams to operationalize observability standards.
  • Ensures observability outputs support transparent customer reporting, proactive service communication, and stronger articulation of Managed Services’ value.
  • Establishes KPI-driven review processes to continuously improve monitoring quality and outcomes.Work with the AIOps team to ensure telemetry is able to support event correlation, root cause determination, and automated remediation, including expansion of Log Ingestions.
  • Designs observability compliant with all necessary regulatory requirements applicable to Logicalis and/or it’s customers.
  • undefined
  • Ensure the environment is stable through standards application to all relevant architectural components ensuring they align with system requirements and best practices.
  • Assesses new service offerings, such as application performance monitoring (APM), synthetics and NetFlow, and the observability capabilities behind different service tiers (e.g., Elite vs. Traditional).

Accountability & Measures of Success


  • Accountable for reducing non-actionable alert volume and improving the signal-to noise ratio across all managed services’ platforms, including ensuring parent/child relationships are appropriately defined and CMDB alignment.
  • Accountable for reducing operational rework caused by duplicate, unclear, or low-value alerts.
  • Measured by improving alert actionability defined by percent of alerts result in meaningful incidents.
  • Success measured by decreased MTTR through improved telemetry, event correlation, and alert prioritization.
  • Drives reduction in cost-to-serve through improved monitoring efficiency and platform standardization.
  • Demonstrates and actively promotes an understanding and commitment to the mission of Logicalis through performing behaviors consistent with the organization's values.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of applicable Federal, State, and Local laws and regulations as well as policies and procedures of Logicalis in order to ensure adherence in a manner that reflects honest, ethical and professional behaviors.
  • Supports and conducts self in a manner consistent with customer service expectations.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education/Experience/Technical Requirements/Certifications

Equivalent combination accepted.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field (IT, Computer Science, Business Administration, etc)

Experience / Technical Requirements

  • 8+ years in monitoring/observability, including 5+ in an MSP or multi-tenant environment
  • Strong background in monitoring/observability platforms (e.g., LogicMonitor, Datadog, Dynatrace, IBM Instana, Grafana, or similar APM/ITOM/AIOps platforms.
  • )OpenTelemetry; log pipelines and cost optimization; CMDB and CI relationship modeling in ServiceNow; synthetics and NetFlow; experience scoring vendor RFPs and proofs of value.
  • Experience designing platform-level architectures for MSP, enterprise, or large multi-tenant environments.
  • Experience with translating telemetry into business and service insights.
  • Experience improving operational efficiency through telemetry strategy.
  • Familiarity with compliance requirements and frameworks (CMMC, NIST, PCI, HIPAA/HITECH/HITRUST, SOX).
  • Deep understanding of alerting strategies, signal quality, and operational workflows.
  • Ability to balance short-term operational realities with long-term architectural maturity.
  • Experience supporting NOC/Operations/Monitoring teams through escalations, including alert tuning, telemetry troubleshooting, and resolution of complex monitoring issues.
  • Excellent organizational, time management, and multitasking skills.
  • Proven ability to manage complex service environments and drive transformation.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • DevOps Institute - Observability Foundation Certification
  • LogicMonitor Certified Professional

Other Skills and Abilities


  • ITIL Foundation Certification or equivalent knowledge of IT service management principles.Exposure to NOC, SOC, or MSP environments.Knowledge of common MSP tools (RMM, PSA, documentation platforms).Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, or similar reporting tools.

Physical Demands


The physical demands described here are representative of those that should be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is constantly required to sit, talk, see, hear, and use hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to stand; move about, climb steps or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.


The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this classification. This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of personnel so classified.

jobs.description:
Director, Energy Sales

Status: Full-time, salaried – individual contributor role

Department: Energy Sales

Reports to: Vice President, Global Energy Sales

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (preferred). Remote candidates based elsewhere in South America will be considered for an exceptional profile.

Territory: South America

Travel: Approximately 25-50%

Position Summary

Plug is building a global leadership position in green hydrogen, supplying PEM electrolyzer systems and the equipment, services and infrastructure that surround them. The Director, Energy Sales – South America is a senior, quota-carrying individual contributor responsible for originating, developing and closing electrolyzer opportunities across the region. Working directly with developers, industrial off-takers, utilities, energy majors and EPC contractors, the Director will own the full sales cycle from first engagement through feasibility, proposal, commercial negotiation and contract signature, and will act as Plug’s senior commercial face in the South American market.

South America combines world-class renewable resources with fast-maturing hydrogen policy, including Brazil’s low-carbon hydrogen legal framework and incentive programs and Chile’s national green hydrogen strategy. Export hubs and industrial clusters are moving toward investment decisions for green ammonia, methanol, e-fuels, steel and refining applications. This role is expected to position Plug as the preferred electrolyzer technology partner for those projects.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identify, qualify and develop new electrolyzer opportunities, from multi-MW industrial projects to 100 MW+ export-scale developments, and build a robust, well-documented pipeline in Salesforce.
  • Lead opportunities end to end, including customer needs assessment, budgetary and firm proposals, pre-FEED/FEED support, pricing strategy, term sheet and contract negotiation (supply agreements, LTSAs, performance guarantees) and hand-off to project execution.
  • Deliver against annual bookings, margin and pipeline targets, and provide accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts to the VP, Global Energy Sales.
  • Build trusted, C-level relationships with project developers, industrial off-takers, energy and oil & gas companies, utilities, EPCs and port authorities across the region.
  • Shape offers that support project bankability, working with customers, lenders and advisors on topics such as scope of supply, Incoterms, warranties, availability guarantees, LTSAs and independent engineer reviews.
  • Coordinate Plug’s application engineering, proposals, product management, legal, finance and project execution teams to deliver competitive, technically sound and profitable proposals – without direct reports.
  • Develop relationships with EPCs, local integrators, renewable developers, development banks and export credit agencies (e.g., BNDES, IDB Invest) and other financing partners that can accelerate project development.
  • Track policy, incentives, certification schemes, tenders and competitor activity in the region, and share structured market and competitive insight with leadership to inform strategy, pricing and product roadmap.
  • Represent Plug at industry conferences, government and industry association forums, and customer events in South America.
  • Maintain complete and accurate opportunity, account and activity data in CRM (Salesforce) and follow Plug’s deal review, approval and risk management processes.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field; MBA or Master’s degree preferred.
  • Ten (10) or more years of B2B sales and business development experience selling complex capital equipment, integrated solutions, or large-scale projects within the energy, oil & gas, chemicals, power, industrial gases, or related sectors.
  • Proven track record of originating, negotiating, and closing multi-million-dollar (USD) capital equipment, technology, or EPC-type contracts characterized by long sales cycles and complex stakeholder environments.
  • Direct experience in hydrogen, electrolysis, renewable energy, fuel cells, industrial gases, ammonia, methanol, or related energy transition value chains strongly preferred.
  • Established network of senior decision-makers across South American project developers, industrial companies, energy majors, EPC contractors, financial institutions, and relevant government stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of project development, structured contracting, and project finance, including commercial agreements, guarantees, risk allocation, bankability requirements, and investment decision processes.
  • Demonstrated consultative and solution-oriented selling approach, with sufficient technical aptitude to discuss electrolyzer systems, balance of plant, renewable power integration, and related technology solutions.
  • Proven ability to negotiate complex commercial agreements, manage pricing and margin considerations, and exercise sound commercial judgment in high-value transactions.
  • Experience influencing and coordinating cross-functional, multicultural, and geographically dispersed teams without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage credibly with executives, engineers, financiers, government representatives, and strategic partners.
  • Strong familiarity with the regulatory frameworks, procurement practices, and business cultures across South American markets.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce (or similar CRM platforms) and Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Fluency in Portuguese, Spanish, and English, both written and spoken.
  • Authorization to work in Brazil or the candidate’s South American country of residence (for remote-based candidates).
  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively within South America and internationally, including to company facilities in the United States and Europe.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the highest standards of professionalism, integrity, business ethics, and compliance with applicable anti-corruption, trade, and regulatory requirements.
  • Self-motivated and effective as a senior individual contributor, capable of operating independently in a remote or small-office environment while remaining highly connected to a global organization.

Plug Power is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About Bybit and this role

Bybit is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, with teams across many countries working around the clock. Our products, markets, and regulations change fast, so how quickly our people learn is a real competitive advantage.
This is a new role. The Head of Learning & Development will build one learning engine for the whole company: how new hires get productive, how leaders grow, how engineers and sales teams stay sharp, and how the company comes together at all-hands.
Mission: Help every Bybit employee get up to speed fast, keep growing, and perform at their best, and build the leaders we need as we scale.

Key responsibilities

Learning & development

  • Build and own Bybit's global learning strategy, tied to business priorities and our values.
  • Design and deliver leadership development for first-time managers, senior leaders, and high-potential talent.
  • Build core skills programs, including communication, feedback, coaching, and decision-making.
  • Own required and compliance training with Legal and Compliance, ensuring completion across all regions.
  • Run the learning platform (LMS) and content library; blend live, digital, and on-the-job learning.
  • Partner with HR Business Partners on development plans, career paths, and succession.
  • Measure learning impact on performance, retention, and readiness, not just attendance.

Employee onboarding

  • Own the global onboarding program from offer acceptance through the first 90 days.
  • Build a consistent company onboarding experience, plus role-specific tracks for engineering, sales, operations, and leaders.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition, IT, Workplace Operations, and hiring managers so day one runs smoothly in every location.

All-hands

  • Own the company all-hands program: cadence, agenda, content, and speaker preparation.
  • Partner with the CEO, executives, and Internal Communications on key messages and storytelling.
  • Deliver all-hands across time zones and formats (in person, hybrid, virtual) so every office and team can take part.

Technical enablement

  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and Security leaders to build learning paths for technical teams.
  • Deliver programs on Bybit's platform and architecture, crypto and blockchain fundamentals, security practices, and new tools including AI.
  • Build onboarding and certification paths that get engineers productive faster.
  • Create a strong internal teaching culture through tech talks, documentation, and subject-matter-expert programs.

Sales enablement

  • Partner with Sales, Business Development, and Marketing leaders to build the sales enablement program.
  • Own sales onboarding and ramp plans, product and market training, and messaging certification.
  • Build playbooks, training content, and coaching programs for sales managers.
  • Work with Compliance so sales teams communicate accurately in regulated markets.
  • Track ramp time, win rates, and quota attainment to show impact.

Leadership

  • Build, lead, and develop a global team of learning, onboarding, and enablement professionals.
  • Own the function's budget, vendors, and learning technology.
  • Serve as a member of the People Leadership Team and a trusted partner to senior business leaders.

What success looks like in the first 12 months

Area
Outcome
Learning & development
Global learning strategy approved; manager development program launched for all people leaders
Onboarding
One global onboarding program live in every office, with measurable gains in new-hire experience and time-to-productivity
All-hands
Regular all-hands cadence set, with rising attendance and feedback scores
Technical enablement
Engineering onboarding path and a recurring tech-talk program in place
Sales enablement
Standard sales onboarding and ramp plan launched; ramp time tracked and improving
Team
Function fully staffed, with a single learning platform and clear budget

What you bring

Requirements

  • 12+ years in learning & development, talent development, or enablement, with 5+ years leading teams.
  • Proven track record building company-wide L&D and onboarding programs from the ground up.
  • Hands-on experience running technical enablement, sales enablement, or both.
  • Experience in a high-growth, global company with employees in multiple countries.
  • Strong program design skills, grounded in adult learning principles.
  • Comfort using data to measure learning impact on business results.
  • Excellent facilitation and presentation skills, including with senior executives.
  • Fluent English.

Preferred

  • Experience in fintech, crypto, financial services, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience producing large company events or all-hands.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools to build and personalize learning content.
  • Familiarity with learning and enablement platforms (e.g., Workday Learning, Docebo, Highspot, Seismic).
  • Coaching certification (e.g., ICF) is a plus.
  • Arabic or Mandarin is a plus.

How you lead

  • Builder. You create programs from a blank page and scale them as the company grows.
  • Business partner. You start with business problems, not training requests.
  • Results-focused. You measure impact and invest where it makes a real difference.
  • Executive presence. You earn the trust of senior leaders and can coach them.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.
