Company Overview

Our client is a marketing team that works inside businesses with many locations, such as senior living communities, med spas, dental and healthcare groups, cannabis retailers, and schools. Its clients are in the US and Canada, and they pay a flat fee instead of a percentage of ad spend.

The company runs on Claude and has built its own operating system and client portal. AI agents do most of the production, so a small team can run a lot of client work.

Your Role

As Digital Marketing Director, you're the final decision-maker on 6 to 10 client accounts, across paid media, websites, CRM, and creative. Agents and teammates bring you options, and you pick one, approve it, or send it back with the exact fix.

You report to the CEO and work as a peer to the founders. You'll start by taking over the approval queue on every active account. By day 90, delivery runs without the CEO in the loop, and you've built the tool or process that lets the team take on 5 more accounts with the same people.

Part of the job is building. You'll release features to the internal platform by directing Claude Code: you write the spec, test it on staging, and merge it. You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to know exactly what you want and check that you got it.

This isn't an account manager role. If you've mostly passed the calls on spend, creative, or pricing to someone else, or you'd rather delegate to a team of specialists, it probably isn't the right fit.

You'll

  • Run the client relationship with owners, executive directors, and sales teams

  • Approve Google Ads and Meta builds before launch

  • Adjust budgets and bids, and cut the search terms that bring no leads

  • Own conversion tracking across GTM, GA4, and offline imports from the CRM

  • Direct WordPress rebuilds, then own go-live, redirects, and Search Console

  • Connect CRMs, call tracking, and forms so each lead can be followed to the sale

  • Approve client pricing changes, promotions, and policy pages

  • Sign off on weekly and monthly client reports before they go out

You Bring

  • 7+ years running marketing or growth for clients or at an agency

  • Final say on a client's ad spend, creative, or pricing, and you can name the decision

  • Google Ads and Meta campaigns you built and managed yourself

  • Daily work with Claude or a similar tool, and something real you released through it, like a site, an ad build, an automation, or code

  • The habit of checking AI output before it goes live

  • Comfort with tag managers, CRMs, DNS, and webhooks

  • Near-native English, and confidence saying no to a client on a call

  • The drive to grow with the company as it takes on more accounts

Bonus Points

  • Marketing work in senior living, med spas, dental, healthcare, cannabis retail, or education

  • Experience with industry CRMs such as ALIS, Pagoda, or Dutchie

  • Advertiser verification, A2P 10DLC registration, or HIPAA and cannabis ad rules handled yourself

  • WordPress beyond the editor, like themes, plugins, or a staging-to-production deploy

  • SQL, GitHub pull requests, or Supabase

What's Offered

  • Fully remote, full-time contractor role from LATAM

  • Working hours on US business hours

  • Paid in USD as a contractor. Share the range that fits your level and we'll go from there

  • Unlimited PTO, used responsibly, and you choose which holidays to take

  • A direct line to the CEO, with the founders as your peers

  • Room to grow as the company takes on more accounts

Interview Process

1️⃣ First Call: A 30-minute conversation with atomic✳HR
2️⃣ CEO Interview: The accounts you've run and the decisions that were yours
3️⃣ Co-founder Interview: How you'd work as a peer, and the final decision
4️⃣ Work Test: Possibly a short exercise, and you'll know how it's judged first

jobs.excerpt: About the opportunityAI Engineering builds the shared agent platform behind Xplor's AI capabilities: the agent runtime, model gateway, retrieval, guardrails, evaluations, and cost controls.
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

AI Engineering builds the shared agent platform behind Xplor's AI capabilities: the agent runtime, model gateway, retrieval, guardrails, evaluations, and cost controls. We build the hard parts once, so every product team can ship AI features faster and safely.

We're looking for a hands-on Site Reliability Engineer to own how our agent platform behaves in production. AI workloads bring new reliability problems: long streaming responses, background agents, model-provider quotas, outputs that can fail silently, agents that take real actions, and spend that grow with usage. You'll treat them as first-class engineering problems. As AI agents take on more of our operational work, you'll decide what they're allowed to do and make sure they do it safely.

Why this role is exciting

  • Reliability for a new kind of workload. The playbook for running AI agents in production is still being written, and you'll help write it.
  • Scale with real stakes. A multi-tenant platform serving thousands of businesses, and AI features they depend on to run their day.
  • Greenfield foundations. Define the SLOs, alerting, game days, agent guardrails, and standard deployment paths that every product team will build on.
  • Cost is an engineering problem. Token economics, model routing and cost per task matter as much as uptime.
  • AI-native operations. Use AI agents to automate toil, speed up investigations and improve infrastructure code; with the approval gates, scoped permissions and audit trails that make it safe.

What you’ll do

  • Define SLOs and error budgets for agent APIs, streaming and background work, including quality signals like task success, tool-call failures and evaluation regressions, and alert on what matters to customers.
  • Own the platform's AWS infrastructure (ECS on Fargate, Aurora PostgreSQL, Redis and Amazon Bedrock) as Terraform delivered through Spacelift.
  • Build observability in Datadog and Coralogix with OpenTelemetry, including AI signals like token usage, provider latency and cost per task.
  • Make data stores resilient, with tested backups and restores, failover, defined disaster recovery targets (RTO/RPO) and safe migrations.
  • Build resilience into the model layer: provider failover, quota and rate-limit management, and safe rollout and rollback of model and prompt changes.
  • Protect the platform under multi-tenant load with per-tenant quotas, isolation and circuit breakers that stop runaway agents and runaway spend.
  • Partner with Security on operational controls for AI risks, including prompt injection, excessive agent permissions and unbounded consumption (OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications).
  • Set the guardrails for AI agents that work on our infrastructure: what they can change, which actions need human approval, and how every action is audited.
  • Work with Security and Privacy to keep model inference and customer data in the right regions for customers in Australia, New Zealand, the US, the UK and the EU.
  • Lead incident response and blameless reviews, take part in on-call, and run game days for the failures that matter most.
  • Make deployments safe by default, and give product teams simple, standard ways to run agent workloads.
  • Track and reduce cloud and model spend.

Our stack

  • Cloud: AWS: ECS on Fargate, Aurora PostgreSQL with pgvector, ElastiCache Redis, CloudFront, Route 53, Secrets Manager and SSM
  • AI: Amazon Bedrock and other model providers behind a multi-provider gateway
  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform, delivered through Spacelift
  • Observability: Datadog, Coralogix and OpenTelemetry
  • Delivery: GitHub Actions, containers, Amazon ECR and preview environments

This position has an annual base salary range of $150,000 to $200,000 USD.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates based anywhere in the U.S., excluding Hawaii and Alaska. We’d prefer candidates in the Eastern or Central time zones.

What would make me a good candidate?

  • 7+ years in SRE, DevOps or platform engineering, running multi-tenant SaaS in production
  • Strong AWS experience and Terraform at scale (Spacelift, Terraform Cloud, Atlantis or similar)
  • Experience building SLO-based alerting and observability with Datadog or similar tools, ideally with OpenTelemetry
  • A track record of leading incidents calmly and turning post-incident reviews into lasting fixes
  • Hands-on PostgreSQL operations: backups, point-in-time recovery, performance tuning and upgrades
  • Production-quality coding skills for automation and tooling
  • A least-privilege mindset and a disciplined approach to using AI tools

It would be great if you also have

  • Experience running LLM or AI workloads in production, or a real interest in learning how they fail differently from traditional services
  • Use of AI agents to automate operational work, such as incident triage, runbooks or infrastructure-code review, and a clear sense of where human review still matters
  • Experience in regulated environments such as SOC 2 or PCI DSS
  • Amazon Bedrock quotas and inference profiles, policy as code, LLM evaluation, AI security tooling, or multi-region data-residency requirements

At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersection of differences - people of different cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you don’t quite tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Values and Life at Xplor

Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:

  • Find a better way
  • Do the right thing

  • Develop code quality scripts and checks for complexity, function and file size, dependency cycles, and performance regressions. Work with package owners on practical thresholds and targeted refactoring.

  • Improve development environments, testing, and build and release workflows so engineers and agents can verify changes reliably.

  • Prioritize improvements with engineering teams, support adoption through documentation and onboarding, and measure effectiveness, reliability, and operating costs.

Example projects include agents that investigate CI failures, diagnose compatibility and performance regressions, and flag changes that affect package interfaces or architecture. You will choose and refine these workflows with the engineers who use them.

Requirements

  • Experience building and maintaining developer tools or engineering automation used by others, with strong JavaScript/TypeScript and skills.

  • Hands-on experience using and integrating AI coding tools or agents, with sound judgment about their limitations, output validation, and human review.

  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, and systematic debugging of build, test, or integration failures.

  • A strong approach to code quality: maintainable code, useful automated checks, and refactoring that preserves behavior.

  • Ability to work independently, collaborate with engineers, and communicate clearly in English within a remote, globally distributed team.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About MarketFully Group

MarketFully has InContent Marketing Agencies that specialize in the managed solutions for the platform: Key Content (multilingual and global content marketing), Social Element (global social media, moderation and community management), and MotionPoint (website translation and localization).

MarketFully pairs AI technology with real human expertise to help brands create, adapt, and distribute content that reaches the right people in the right way. The result: stronger connections with global audiences, more engaged communities, and better visibility - all leading to marketing results you can actually measure.

The role

MotionPoint makes websites work in every language, and our Support team is the first point of contact when something on a client's site needs attention. As a Customer Support Specialist, you'll own client requests from the moment they arrive: working out what's wrong, documenting it clearly, getting it to the right team, and keeping the client informed until it's fixed.

This is a 100% client-facing role. It needs focus, consistency, and confident English, both written and spoken. You'll be dealing directly with clients and their technical teams every day.

We're hiring 3 Customer Support Specialists to support MotionPoint clients globally.

Schedule and on-call

Please read this section carefully. These hours are a core part of the role.

  • Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, covering US business hours. (US Eastern Time)

  • Your shift times: Three open shifts, 8:00AM-5:00PM and two 10:00AM-7:00PM US Eastern Time. Argentina and Colombia don't change their clocks, but the US does, so your local hours move by one hour twice a year. See the table below for your local times.

  • On-call (Essential): Once you're fully trained and confident in our processes, you'll join a paid on-call rotation covering evenings, weekends and public holidays.

  • Coverage: Mon–Thu 7:00 PM–7:00 AM ET, Fri 7:00 PM–12:00 AM ET, and weekends from Sat 12:00 AM to Mon 7:00 AM ET, including US holidays. Only Critical and Express cases.

  • Frequency: about 4–5 weeknights a month plus 1–2 weekend days every 4 weeks, as primary or backup.

What you'll do

  • Manage client requests and reported issues through our ticketing system: triage each case by priority, troubleshoot, and route it to the right team for resolution

  • Respond to client emails and phone calls, and join bridge calls with client and partner technical teams to troubleshoot issues that span several organizations and systems

  • Track ticket progress to make sure issues are resolved on time, and keep clients updated proactively when timelines change or follow-up is needed

  • Take part in the paid on-call rotation (evenings, weekends and public holidays) once you're up to speed

What we're looking for

  • You don't need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable looking under the hood of a website.

  • 2+ years in a customer or technical support role, handling a high volume of tickets

  • Confident using web browsers, Microsoft Office, Salesforce Service Cloud (or a similar ticketing system) and email platforms

  • A working knowledge of HTML.

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to resolve website issues for clients.

  • The ability to explain technical concepts in clear, simple language to different audiences.

  • A client-focused, consultative approach to support and building relationships.

Why join us

  • Full training on MotionPoint's technology, processes and tools

  • Paid on-call rotation

  • Fully remote

The Hiring Process

The hiring process for this position will be made up of the following stages:

  • ❤️ Culture + Connect Interview – with one of the talent team

  • ✨ Skills + Experience Interview – with Mario Ozuna, Director of Customer Support

  • 🤝 Final Chat – with Vanessa Lopez, VP of Delivery and Customer Experience

Our Diversity, Equality & Inclusion Commitment

We welcome applications from diverse and under-represented groups regardless of background.

We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so even if you feel you don’t fulfill all the requirements, we encourage you to apply. We’d love to hear from you.🙂

We value divergent thinkers who bring different experiences and viewpoints to MarketFully. We strongly encourage members of under-represented groups to apply.

We can also make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process. Please let us know if there is any additional support you may need.

How To Apply 🖊️

If all this sounds like you, upload your CV or résumé and complete the application form. While a cover letter is optional, we welcome any other way for you to share what draws you to this role and MarketFully Group.

We’re excited to receive your application! ❤️

About CoVet

At CoVet, we're building AI-powered tools that help veterinary professionals spend less time on paperwork and more time caring for animals.

Veterinary teams are stretched thin. Long hours, administrative burden, and burnout are challenges across the industry. We're on a mission to change that. Our AI copilot helps veterinary professionals save time, improve workflows, and focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional patient care.

We're a globally distributed team united by a shared mission to support veterinary professionals through thoughtful technology. We move quickly, collaborate openly, and believe great ideas can come from anyone.

If you're excited by the opportunity to shape the future of veterinary medicine while working alongside an ambitious and supportive team, we'd love to meet you.

About the role

We're looking for a Bilingual Content Writer who is excited to make a meaningful impact from day one.

In this role, you'll create engaging, high-quality content that helps veterinary professionals discover, understand, and get the most out of CoVet. English will be your primary writing language, with most of your work focused on our core markets, including North America and Oceania.

This is a hands-on writing role where you'll also create and adapt content in a second language (French, Spanish, Italian, or another language) to help us connect with veterinary teams across our global markets. Your content should feel natural and relevant to local audiences rather than read like a direct translation. The markets you support will depend on your additional language skills.

You'll collaborate with teams across Marketing, Sales, Product, Partnerships, and Localisation to develop content that educates audiences, supports business growth, and strengthens CoVet's presence internationally.

From SEO-driven articles and educational resources to customer stories, campaigns, and product messaging, your writing will help veterinary professionals reclaim valuable time in their day.

This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing company where your ideas will be heard, your contributions will be visible, and your growth will be supported.

Exciting Opportunities in this Role

  • Create engaging, SEO-driven content, including website pages, blog articles, comparison and solution pages, and educational and continuing-education resources for veterinary professionals.
  • Write and adapt content in English and a second language, ensuring messaging feels natural, relevant, and culturally appropriate for local markets.
  • Develop customer stories, case studies, email and lifecycle campaign copy, social media content, sales enablement resources, and partner and event materials.
  • Support product launches and marketing initiatives by creating landing pages, feature announcements, and localised in-app messaging and product copy where needed.
  • Collaborate with the Content team to plan content calendars, share knowledge, and maintain consistent messaging across regions.
  • Partner with Sales, Enterprise, and Partnerships to develop materials that support account conversations and partner activities in English and your second-language markets.
  • Work with Product Marketing, Lifecycle and Performance Marketing, and Design to create launch materials, campaign content, and engaging visual communications.
  • Work closely with Localisation to align on terminology, workflows, and quality standards across markets.
  • Research technical and veterinary topics alongside veterinary professionals and internal experts to ensure content is accurate, credible, and engaging.
  • Manage a steady flow of content requests from across the business, balancing priorities and delivering high-quality work within deadlines.
  • Maintain consistent brand voice, terminology, and messaging across English and second-language materials.
  • Apply SEO best practices and contribute to the growth of CoVet's organic visibility and educational programmes.
  • Monitor content performance and identify opportunities for improvement, with success measured through output, quality, turnaround times, organic performance, and how effectively content supports commercial teams in-market.

Qualifications

We're more interested in finding the right person than checking every box.

  • Native or near-native English writing proficiency, with professional fluency in at least one additional language, such as French, Spanish, or Italian, and the ability to write for a professional audience.
  • Proven experience in content writing, with a portfolio demonstrating strong writing skills across multiple formats and channels.
  • Strong understanding of SEO principles, keyword research, and writing content that supports organic growth.
  • Experience adapting and localising content for different audiences and markets, beyond direct translation.
  • Ability to simplify complex or technical topics into clear, engaging, and accessible content.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
  • Excellent attention to detail, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and quality across all content.
  • Experience writing for B2B SaaS, healthtech, medtech, AI, or other technical industries is an asset.
  • Familiarity with veterinary, animal health, or clinical content is an asset.
  • Experience with content management systems, SEO tools, translation management platforms, or lifecycle and email copywriting is an asset.
  • Fluency in additional languages beyond English and your second language is a plus.

About You

You'll thrive in this role if you:

  • Love writing: You enjoy turning complex ideas into clear, engaging content that connects with your audience.
  • Think globally: You understand how language and cultural differences influence the way audiences connect with content.
  • Take ownership: You're proactive, organised, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Are naturally curious: You enjoy researching new topics, asking questions, and learning from subject matter experts.
  • Have an eye for detail: You care about accuracy, consistency, and delivering polished work.
  • Enjoy collaboration: You work well with cross-functional teams and know how to turn different perspectives into compelling content.
  • Are adaptable: You can shift between different writing styles, audiences, and content formats while maintaining quality.
  • Are results-oriented: You understand how great content contributes to engagement, organic growth, and business success.

Why Join Us

  • Competitive compensation
  • Generous vacation and time-off policies

  • A culture built on trust, collaboration, and impact

We believe in paying our team members fairly and competitively. Compensation is determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and local market benchmarks.

As a globally distributed company, salary ranges are localized to reflect the market for comparable roles in a candidate's country or region. We'll discuss compensation expectations and provide transparency around our approach throughout the interview process.

jobs.description:
Description

This position is strictly open to candidates located in Ukraine.

Nayax is looking for a Senior Fullstack Developer (.NET + Flutter) to implement changes in the existing backend and continue the rebuild of the mobile app in Flutter. You will work across the server and mobile sides, from REST APIs to releases in the App Store and Google Play.

This role is a good fit if you can drive tasks independently across the whole stack, care about code quality, and are confident working with payment flows.

About the project

Monyx Wallet (product page) is Nayax's mobile wallet for automated businesses: vending machines, laundromats, car washes and other self-service devices. Users pick a device by number or address, or scan a QR code, and pay from their phone. The app supports prepaid cards for closed-loop systems, promotions and loyalty programs, automatic refunds, branded cards, and an SDK for integration into operators' apps.

Where the project is now. A significant part of Monyx has already been rewritten in Flutter as a standalone plugin with its own repositories. Next, a new standalone Monyx app will be built on top of it in Flutter. Some of the logic still needs to be covered, and the payment and automatic refund flows need further work.

What you will do

Backend (.NET)

  • Implement changes, new features and bug fixes in the existing backend (C#, .NET / ASP.NET Core).
  • Design, extend and document REST APIs for the mobile app (Swagger / OpenAPI).
  • Work with relational databases: schemas, efficient queries, migrations.
  • Refactor legacy code and improve the performance, reliability and maintainability of services.
  • Implement authentication and authorization and handle sensitive and payment data securely.
  • Write unit and integration tests and take part in code reviews.
  • Support releases, investigate production incidents and perform root cause analysis.

Mobile (Flutter)

  • Continue the rebuild of the mobile app in Flutter for Android and iOS.
  • Develop new screens, user flows and reusable UI components based on design specifications.
  • Integrate the app with backend APIs: error handling, offline states, data caching.
  • Implement authentication, onboarding, deep links, push notifications and payment flows.
  • Support localization, RTL languages (Hebrew, English) and accessibility requirements.
  • Manage state, navigation and app architecture using clean, scalable patterns.
  • Prepare builds and publish releases to the App Store and Google Play.

Team and process

  • Analyze requirements and user stories, estimate tasks and propose technical solutions.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools for design, implementation and testing, carefully reviewing code quality and security.
  • Work closely with Product Managers, designers, QA engineers and other developers.
  • Take part in Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups and retrospectives.
  • Maintain technical documentation and help improve engineering processes.
  • Share knowledge and mentor middle and junior developers.

Requirements

We are looking for 5+ years of commercial experience building backend services in .NET and cross-platform mobile apps in Flutter. Experience delivering production releases for Android and iOS in Agile teams and a strong focus on code quality, performance and security are also important.

Backend. C# and .NET (.NET 6+ / ASP.NET Core), REST API design, Entity Framework Core and Dapper, SQL (MS SQL Server or PostgreSQL) with query optimization, OAuth 2.0 and JWT, Dependency Injection, Clean / Layered Architecture, SOLID, xUnit / NUnit and Moq.

Mobile. Flutter and Dart (production apps for Android and iOS), state management (Bloc / Riverpod / Provider), REST API integration (Dio / http) and JSON serialization, navigation and deep links, push notifications (Firebase Cloud Messaging), localization, RTL and accessibility, local and secure storage, widget and integration testing.

Tools. Azure DevOps (boards, repos, pipelines), Git and pull request workflow, Swagger / OpenAPI, Firebase (Crashlytics, Analytics, Cloud Messaging), App Store Connect and Google Play Console, CI/CD for backend and mobile.

Platforms and methodologies. Android, iOS, Web API / AWS cloud; Agile and Scrum.

Additional. Code review, application security basics, performance optimization, debugging and root cause analysis, requirements analysis, technical documentation.

Personal qualities

  • Ability to work independently across backend and mobile and to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ownership and a focus on high-quality, maintainable solutions.
  • Effective communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proactive problem solving and the ability to make sound architectural decisions.
  • Experience in a fast-paced product development environment.
  • English at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants (for example Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) for design, implementation, refactoring and test generation, with a critical approach to reviewing generated code.
  • Experience in fintech, payments or POS / cashless solutions.
  • Native Android (Kotlin) or iOS (Swift) experience for platform channels.
  • Microservices, message queues, event-driven architecture.
  • Docker and AWS services.
  • Mobile test automation (Appium, Flutter integration tests).
  • Experience migrating a mobile app to Flutter from native or another framework.

Learn More about Nayax

Working conditions and format

  • Location and format. Work from Ukraine, fully remote.
  • Equipment. A work laptop is provided on request.
  • Learning. Access to the Juno learning platform.
  • Vacation and sick leave. 20 working days of vacation and sick leave.
  • Medical insurance. Covers dental care, massages, doctor visits and vaccinations.

About the company and team

Nayax (about the company) is a global fintech company that provides an operating system and payment platform for unattended retail: cashless payments, IoT services and management solutions for self-service devices. The company was founded in 2005 and has been listed on Nasdaq (NYAX) since 2022. Nayax has more than 500 employees and around 30,000 customers.

You will join the Nayax / Weezmo team. Weezmo is an omnichannel solution for retailers that connects customers' online and offline data: email and SMS marketing, customer segmentation, landing pages, digital receipts, analytics and a single API. Weezmo became part of Nayax in 2021. In this role you will work on the Monyx Wallet mobile wallet, which was launched in 2015, with its second version released in 2019.

You will build what the solution design sets out. You will configure the close and reconciliation processes, build the integrations with the ERP and the systems around it, and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

Close processes built and configured end to end: task lists, dependencies, approvals and the automated steps between them. Automated account reconciliation, including matching rules and exception handling. Journal entry automation, from data preparation and validation through to posting in the ERP. Integration with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and other source systems, through standard connectors, file and API interfaces. Intercompany, accrual and reclassification steps automated alongside the close. Workflow logic in REL or JavaScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on delivery on Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance), where you built close, reconciliation or journal processes yourself on at least one live implementation. 5 or more years in finance systems or automation engineering. Working knowledge of SAP FI/CO postings and master data, or the Oracle equivalent, and where ERP integrations tend to break. Workflow scripting in REL or JavaScript, and hands-on ERP integration. A finance-side understanding of the record-to-report cycle and month-end controls.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood RunMyJobs workload automation. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A current Redwood certification. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and what you built yourself.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

About the job

As a member of our AI research team, you will drive innovation in model compression and efficient deployment for advanced multimodal AI systems, including large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). Your work will focus on reducing model footprint and computational cost while preserving accuracy, enabling high-performance AI to run efficiently across resource-constrained edge devices. You will apply and advance compression techniques such as quantization, knowledge distillation, and pruning to streamline complex multimodal architectures that integrate text, images, and audio.

We expect you to have deep expertise in model compression methods and a strong background in multimodal model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel compression strategies that balance model size, latency, throughput, and accuracy. Your responsibilities include building robust compression pipelines, establishing performance and fidelity metrics, and addressing bottlenecks in production inference. The ultimate goal is to deliver scalable, low-memory, low-latency AI systems on edge devices (i.e., smartphones) that maintain high fidelity and tangible real-world value.

Responsibilities

  • Apply low-bit quantization to reduce model size and inference latency for generative AI models (LLMs, VLMs, multimodal) while maintaining accuracy and output quality.

  • Leverage knowledge distillation to transfer capabilities from larger teacher models to smaller student models, enabling efficient multimodal reasoning across text, image, and audio inputs.

  • Implement pruning techniques to remove redundant parameters and attention heads, reducing computational overhead without sacrificing task performance.

  • Analyze trade-offs between model efficiency (size, latency, memory) and accuracy across quantization, distillation, and pruning methods; propose improvements based on empirical findings.

  • Research and apply mixed-precision quantization and other advanced compression strategies (e.g., adaptive pruning schedules, distillation with intermediate feature matching) to optimize the accuracy–performance balance.

  • Stay current with the latest research in model compression, including emerging techniques for multimodal and generative architectures.

  • Document methodologies, experiments, and results clearly to support reproducibility, internal collaboration, and stakeholder communication.

  • Author technical papers and publish findings in top-tier conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, AAAI) to advance the field of model compression for multimodal AI.

Requirements

  • A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

  • Experience with PyTorch deep learning frameworks or equivalent frameworks

  • Hands-on experience with model quantization including both Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) and Post-Training Quantization (PTQ).

  • Research and hands-on experience with knowledge distillation for compressing large models into smaller, efficient ones.

  • Research and hands-on experience with model pruning for compressing large models into smaller, efficient ones.

  • Solid understanding of neural network architectures and training processes – Including transformers (e.g., LLMs, VLMs), backpropagation, optimization, and fine-tuning techniques.

  • Familiarity with C++ is a plus (especially for implementing low-level quantization kernels or inference optimizations).

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

jobs.description:
Job Title: Grant Reviewer, School Nutrition (NSLP Equipment Assistance)
Work Arrangement: Remote
Location: Remote, United States
Employment Type: Part-Time, Independent Contractor (1099)
Engagement Type: Short-term, per grant competition; paid per application reviewed
Final Interview:

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring Grant Reviewers on behalf of the Office of the State Superintendent of Education (OSSE), the District of Columbia's state education agency, for its National School Lunch Program (NSLP) Equipment Assistance grant competition. OSSE is seeking peer reviewers from a range of professions and backgrounds, including neutral, qualified professionals with knowledge of early childhood applications, educational grants, or education.

Grant reviewers provide independent subject matter expertise to read, score, and comment on competitive grant applications submitted by local education agencies, schools, community-based organizations, and other eligible entities. All reviews are completed remotely in OSSE's online Enterprise Grants Management System (EGMS), and reviewer scores are used to recommend applications for funding. OSSE selects reviewers from the qualified pool and gives preference to reviewers who have satisfactorily completed reviews for its competitions in previous years.

Work Schedule

This is a remote, part-time assignment. Reviews are completed on your own schedule within each deadline. The approximate commitment for this competition is:

  • Orientation and EGMS training: a virtual webinar held approximately within two weeks of the engagement start date.
  • Review window: usually two weeks from the date applications are assigned, unless OSSE specifies otherwise.
  • Facilitated discussion (only if needed): a phone or video conference, usually about three business days after the scoring due date, held when panel scores differ significantly.
  • Approximate completion of reviewer work: November 13, 2026. Final dates are confirmed before orientation.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Complete OSSE's EGMS training and attend the virtual, grant-specific orientation webinar before reviewing any applications.
  2. Independently read and conduct a detailed review of each assigned application (typically two or more per competition) as one of three reviewers on an EGMS review panel, working remotely and separately.
  3. Evaluate applicant requests for school food service equipment under the National School Lunch Program from a neutral, objective perspective.
  4. Complete a fully scored rubric for every section of each application, applying the established scoring criteria consistently and objectively.
  5. Write clear, constructive comments describing strengths and weaknesses that justify and align with the scores given. Reviews may be shared with applicants on request, with reviewer names and contact information removed.
  6. Base all scores and comments only on the content of each applicant's submission in EGMS.
  7. Submit all scores and comments in EGMS by the review deadline, usually two weeks from receiving the applications.
  8. Participate in a facilitated panel discussion by phone or video conference when scores differ significantly, then submit a final rubric with updated scores and comments reflecting any changes.
  9. Disclose any conflict of interest with applicant organizations and do not review any application where a conflict exists.
  10. Direct EGMS technical questions to the EGMS manual, the resources at grants.osse.dc.gov, or the EGMS call center at (202) 719-6500, and direct questions about the grant or about scoring to OSSE grant program staff.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher.
  • Knowledge, skills, or expertise in early childhood applications and/or in at least one of these areas: grant experience, including knowledge of educational grants, or an educational background.
  • Reliable access to a computer, the internet, and a phone.
  • Availability for the full review process, including EGMS training, the orientation webinar, the complete review window, and a facilitated discussion if one is required.
  • No conflict of interest with any applicant organization in this competition, confirmed through a signed Conflict of Interest Form.
  • No unsatisfactory performance evaluation from past grant review work for OSSE or any other grant-making organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree in education, special education, or education policy.
  • Prior experience reviewing competitive grant applications for OSSE or another government agency.

Compensation

  • $150 per application successfully reviewed. Reviewers are typically assigned two or more applications per competition.
  • Payment is made only after OSSE verifies successful completion of the entire review process: EGMS training, the orientation webinar, timely review and rigorous scoring of every assigned application in EGMS, and, if required, participation in a facilitated discussion with final scores submitted.
  • Payment is issued by Dhaka Technologies Limited Company by direct deposit or check within 30 calendar days of OSSE's verification.
  • Failure to complete timely, high-quality reviews will affect payment and will disqualify a reviewer from future assignments.

How to Apply

Interested candidates who meet the qualifications should send their resume to with the job title in the email subject line. Your resume should show your degree and your experience in the field. Please also mention in your resume the grants you have reviewed previously, including the grant-making organization, the grant program, and the year. Qualified applicants will be asked to complete a Grant Reviewer Application and a Conflict of Interest Form before they are recommended to OSSE.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

The Manager of Field People Relations provides day-to-day leadership and operational oversight of Blattner’s field-facing People Relations Partner team, ensuring that employee relations casework across a geographically dispersed, project-based construction environment is delivered with consistency, quality, and legal defensibility. This role manages the team’s caseload, quality standards, and professional development while leading complex, sensitive, and high-risk workplace investigations, disciplinary matters, and separations. The Manager I serves as the first-line escalation point for the People Relations Partner and Senior People Relations Partner team on ambiguous or legally complex field matters, partners closely with the Manager II – People Relations & HR Compliance on cross-team standards and resourcing, and coordinates with Legal, HR Compliance, and business leadership as needed. This role builds and sustains trusted relationships with field and business unit leaders, ensuring People Relations support is accessible, responsive, and embedded in the operational rhythm of the business, while identifying systemic ER risk patterns and recommending proactive interventions to reduce future escalations.

STEP INTO THE ROLE

  • Provides direct leadership, daily management, and professional development to the field People Relations Partner and Senior People Relations Partner team, ensuring consistent investigation quality, caseload balance, and alignment to Blattner’s ER standards.
  • Oversees the team’s full portfolio of active ER cases, monitoring case progression, documentation completeness, and timely resolution across a geographically dispersed, project-based construction environment. Assigns tickets in the Service Desk, and reports on volume and trends to HR Leadership.
  • Conducts and documents complex, high-risk, and legally sensitive workplace investigations — including harassment, retaliation, and discrimination matters — ensuring thorough, objective fact-finding and defensible outcomes.
  • Serves as the first-line escalation point for People Relations Partners and Senior People Relations Partners on investigations, disciplinary decisions, terminations, and matters involving litigation risk; escalates matters requiring legal strategy or executive visibility to the Manager II – People Relations & HR Compliance.
  • Applies and reinforces investigation standards, interview protocols, and documentation templates to ensure legally defensible and consistently applied ER practices across all field cases. Identifies areas for additional education or training to Manager II – People Relations & HR Compliance.
  • Collaborates with Legal counsel and Manager II – People Relations & HR Compliance on matters requiring legal strategy, representation, or regulatory response, and ensures the team understands when and how to involve Legal.
  • Identifies learning and development opportunities for team members aligned to their career growth and investigation skill development needs.
  • Fosters a team culture of accountability, intellectual curiosity, and professional integrity — modeling Blattner’s values and a people-first approach to ER casework.
  • Develops and maintains standard operating procedures, case management workflows, and quality checklists that enable consistent, scalable delivery across the field People Relations team.
  • Manages team-level metrics and reporting, including ER case volumes, resolution times, and caseload distribution; presents findings to the Manager II – People Relations & HR Compliance on a regular cadence.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience required.
  • 5 or more years of progressive human resources, employee relations, or labor relations experience required, including demonstrated expertise leading complex workplace investigations and high-risk separation scenarios.
  • Prior experience leading, mentoring, or serving as a lead resource for other HR or People Relations professionals required.
  • Strong working knowledge of federal and state employment law with the ability to apply legal frameworks independently

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Prior experience in a construction, field-based, or similarly dynamic operational environment strongly preferred.
  • Human Resource Certification Institute (HRCI) credentials preferred.

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

  • Competitive pay
  • 100% employer paid HDHP insurance premiums for employees
  • 401(k) with company match
  • HSA and FSA options
  • Dental and Vision insurance
  • Education Assistance (Tuition Reimbursement)
  • Work/Life balance
  • Employee/Family focused culture
  • Gym on site
  • And more!

Blattner is not able to sponsor H-1B visas or permanent residency for this or any position. We are able to consider candidates who hold valid, independent work authorization (e.g., U.S. citizenship, permanent residency, or other valid, non-expired work authorization).

$110,617.00 - $160,396.00 Individual Compensation to be determined based on the applicant's applicable experience and qualifications balanced against internal equity.

WHO ARE WE?


With more than 115 years of construction experience, Blattner has played a vital role in building America’s critical infrastructure, ranging from railroads and highways to dams and mines. Since 1997, the company has focused on renewable energy solutions and is responsible for some of the most significant solar, wind and storage projects in the U.S. Today, Blattner has installed over 20% of America’s utility-scale wind, solar and energy storage capacity. Blattner Company is the parent company of Blattner Energy and D.H. Blattner & Sons, of which all are members of the Quanta Services family of companies. Company headquarters are in Avon, Minnesota.

And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

Responsibilities

  • Engineering - Run the app and feature teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.- Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.- Own the technical design of features and the API surface between our AI core and the app.- Make sure your teams work closely with our AI research and deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches models or inference.

  • Product Partnership - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

  • Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints: model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

  • Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

Preferred:

  • Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer to join our growing team. You will work as part of the engineering team to:

  • Deliver projects related to pricing plans and billing
  • Develop our billing integration with third party services, strengthening our end-to-end billing experience.
  • Take ownership of the entire product lifecycle, from writing code to product ideation and strategic decision-making.
  • Work closely with UX/UI designers and product managers to shape features.

Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for a strongly motivated individual who can help move the product forward. The ability to think on your feet, collaborate with highly technical teams, and comfort working asynchronously are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work as part of a team of engineers to design, build, test, and document core billing software components.
  • Integrate with third-party billing platforms (e.g., Stripe, Metronome) as needed
  • Develop metering, pricing, and rating logic for usage-based and subscription billing models.
  • Ensure accurate tracking and reporting of customer usage data.
  • Monitor and maintain billing systems to ensure high availability and data integrity.
  • Build automation tools for recurring billing tasks, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with product, sales, and finance teams to support custom billing requirements.
  • Work closely with finance, product, support, and engineering teams to support accurate billing, revenue reporting, and customer inquiries.
  • Act as a technical expert in billing-related discussions and planning.
  • Champion engineering excellence by driving code quality, architectural reviews, and design documentation.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other engineers, fostering a culture of learning and knowledge sharing.
  • Establish observability, alerting, and error handling across the billing pipeline to ensure high availability and responsiveness.
  • Lead incident response and root cause analysis for billing-related issues.

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience in backend software engineering, with a strong focus on billing, payments, or financial systems.
  • Deep knowledge of SaaS billing models, including subscriptions, usage-based pricing, proration, discounts, and entitlements.
  • Proven experience integrating with third-party billing platforms such as Stripe, Metronome, Orb, Zuora, etc, or building custom billing systems.
  • Experience designing and managing distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
  • Proficient with SQL and data modeling, especially for financial and usage data.
  • Solid understanding of APIs and experience building or integrating internal billing APIs.
  • Strong proficiency in Go, or comfortable writing production-quality code in another language and eager to work with Go
  • Flexibility to adjust to the dynamic nature of a startup.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

CAN Pay Range
$191,620—$239,860 CAD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit .

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.excerpt: Why should you consider joining Auvik? • You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology.
jobs.description:
Why should you consider joining Auvik?

  • You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology. Auvik’s network management software helps IT teams by automating time-consuming tasks, streamlining operations, and mitigating risk. It’s more important than ever to be able to remotely monitor and manage network infrastructure, and with Auvik, IT professionals have that essential visibility and control.
  • You want to work with a leadership team who are transparent and trustworthy. Our senior leaders have a vision for Auvik. They are experienced, knowledgeable, approachable, and consistently working hard to drive success, both for the company and the team of people who make it happen.
  • You want to work with a product customers love. People rave about what we’ve built—our latest NPS was 57 (phenomenal!). Our customers are smart, aspirational, and highly technical. It pays to get the details right.
  • You want regular opportunities for learning and growth. With ongoing feedback from leadership, you’ll find that Auvik encourages you to be your very best. Our onboarding process is thorough and informative because we want to make sure you’re prepared to have a great work experience. We also have programs designed to help you take the next steps you want for your career.
  • You want the flexibility to manage your work, your way. We’re a fully distributed team and we’re prepared to continue to support working from home (or the space you choose!). We trust you to get the job done where you feel most comfortable and effective.


What’s this role about?

Hold the torch high! As a business development representative, you’ll play an integral role in Auvik’s success and growth, using your energy, smarts, resourcefulness, and charisma to develop sales opportunities. Excel in this role and there’s a clear growth path to Auvik account executive.

What will I be doing?

You’ll be responsible for identifying, qualifying, researching, and warming up prospective buyers for our network management software. Every day, you will focus on:

  • Researching and developing business intelligence for new and existing accounts
  • Conducting high-level conversations with senior executives
  • Delivering compelling explanations of Auvik’s capabilities to prospects
  • Achieving your monthly quota of qualified opportunities and meetings attended
  • Evangelizing Auvik’s network management software
  • Generating new business opportunities to fuel Auvik’s growth

What are we looking for?

  • A people person, with a friendly and positive manner, who loves the thought of getting paid to have conversations
  • The ability to quickly build rapport with almost anyone
  • Great communication skills, both verbally and in writing
  • Solid internet research skills
  • A passion for learning new things quickly and a strong technical aptitude
  • A tenacious self-starter with a drive to succeed
  • Post-secondary education in any field

Are there bonus points?

Yes! We’ll give your application extra credit if you have one or more of these:

  • Experience in any type of sales, business development, or fundraising role
  • Knowledge of Salesforce

We’re actively hiring for this role and looking to bring someone great onto the team as soon as possible.


About Auvik

Auvik delivers cloud-based network management software that gives IT teams instant visibility and control over their infrastructure — whether on-site, remote, or dispersed across global networks. Our platform automates network discovery, mapping, monitoring, configuration backups, traffic analysis and alerting, so IT professionals and MSPs can manage complex, multi-site environments with ease.

We’re focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to make any accommodations you may need throughout the interview process as well. Don't have a working webcam? We will help you find a space you can conduct your interview from Have kids or pets in the background? Don’t worry about it. Just let us know what you need when we reach out to schedule and we will make it work!

Auvik is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.

Hiring Process

At Auvik, our hiring process is designed to be personal, transparent, and human-led. Our Talent Acquisition Partners review all resumes, connect with candidates whose skills and experience aligns with the role, and stay in communication with you throughout your journey. If our interests align, you'll meet with a hiring manager, as well as additional members of the hiring team in follow-up conversations. All of your interviews will take place via Zoom.

Before meeting with a hiring manager, we also ask candidates to complete a 5-minute Predictive Index (PI) assessment. This helps us understand and match your strengths and work preferences with roles that will set you up for success.

We use AI tools to support administrative tasks in the hiring process; such as helping source candidates, drafting communications, and interview summaries, so our team can stay focused and present during conversations. We do not use AI tools to interview, screen or assess candidates; or determine who moves forward in the process. We debrief and consider the full context of every conversation before making hiring decisions. We believe hiring requires judgment that can be augmented but, not replaced by AI.

Compensation Details

At Auvik, our compensation philosophy is to be market competitive, reward performance, reflect our commitment to equity and maintain transparency with our employees. We have defined job levels and compensation ranges for each of our markets we employ, based on research from various sources of market data, which are reviewed on a regular basis.

The hiring range for this position is listed below. Compensation offered for candidates in this role is based on a number of factors including job-related skills, knowledge, and experience. These factors may cause your compensation to vary within the range outlined below.

In addition to cash compensation, all full-time employees are granted stock options to share in Auvik’s future successes. Auvik employees are eligible to participate in additional benefits and programs including our comprehensive health and dental benefits plan, Wellness spending account, GRSP matching program, flexible paid time off, paid parental leave program, and are eligible for remote working subsidies.

Salary Range:
$42,500—$42,500 CAD
OTE (On-Target-Earnings) Range:
$61,000—$61,000 CAD

jobs.title: Customer Success - UK Clients - Remote
jobs.excerpt: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.
jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset.

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Requirements

We are looking for Customer Success, for a revenue-driven renewals person who is excited about the below Mission and Outcome.

Mission: The main mission is to help Sleek achieve its revenue target by renewing all services in our existing clientele.

We are looking for a customer focused, sales and data driven customer success person to join the team and contribute to Sleek’s growth!

Outcomes:

  1. Achieve renewal rate targets on a monthly basis, along with CSAT, Expansion and churn targets
  2. Conduct detailed investigations into the customer’s end-to-end interactions with Sleek, working cross-functionally with relevant departments to drive resolution. Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction that supports trust, retention, and a seamless renewal.
  3. Achieve cash collection targets on a monthly basis through renewal, upsell and upgrades.
  4. Have a good understanding of own pipeline, track it in a data driven manner, prioritise ticket resolution to drive monthly targets
  5. Collaborate with cross functional teams (accounting, corp sec, product, data) to improve renewal processes, share best practices with team and also be proactive in nature

To do this, you will have a minimum of 8 years experience as Sales, Account Management or Customer Success, in role carrying sales target and customer facing abilities and you will be located in the India or in the Philippines.

Must Haves:

  • Experience working with SMEs, startups, fast paced setups in the UK market
  • Exposure to different culture because Sleek clients are from all over the world
  • Ability to resolve issues by collaborating internally and externally
  • Familiar with Tableau, Zendesk, Hubspot
  • Experience handling complex customers and trouble shooting/escalations
  • Proactive to take up new projects to completion

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Sales Driven & Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the sales team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking & Target Focused: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, keeping in view our business goals and being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Data driven: We are a data rich business with ~15,000 small customers. Each decision we make can impact many more people than we realise - so it’s critical that we use sound data to support our strategies and review the success of our initiatives.

Can have tough conversations in a positive way: It’s not a matter of if, but when difficult interpersonal situations arise. Disagreement, conflict and disappointment are a given in a fast moving business where people care about their work. People that proactively have tough conversations with kindness, build empathy, trust and great working relationships. Strong language proficiency in English is required

Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn’t their first language. For you to excel, you’ll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

Customer-centric: You always act with the best interest of the customer in mind and empathize with their situation to find the best solution for them and for Sleek.

Problem Solving: You’ll need to be able to think on your feet as this role requires you to identify, diagnose, and resolve production issues quickly, reducing downtime. You will leverage your strong infrastructure and development skills in post-incident reviews to find the underlying cause of failures and prevent future incidents.

Collaboration-Driven: You thrive in a cross-functional team environment, working closely with developers, product managers, and operations teams to ensure alignment on requirements and testing goals. You communicate effectively, advocate for quality throughout the development process, and proactively address potential issues before they arise, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for delivering exceptional software.

Autonomous/ Entrepreneurial: Things move fast at Sleek and we are not a hierarchical organisation. We want the candidate to proactively seek out and own solutions without waiting for their manager to ask them. We want the candidate to have the confidence to execute solutions on their own and the experience to know when to ask questions.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

One Way Video Interview / Screening call with TA

Selected candidates will be invited to complete a short, one-way video interview. Depending on the results, candidates may then progress to a ~30-minute screening call with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to explore their experience and discuss the role in more detail.

Technical round
A ~60-minute session with the Hiring Manager, including a live case study and roleplay—acting as if you’re already in the role—to test your role fitment. They will also discuss your last 1–2 roles to explore your background in more detail.

Behavioural fit assessment

A ~45 minute chat with a member of the leadership team, where they will dive into some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.

Reference verification

Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

+++++

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify the below:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You’ll be able to work from home. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

Job Description Summary:

Serves as the IT strategic leader for the purpose of business/IT strategy development which includes but not limited to solution discovery, service management, risk management and relationship management. Proactively provides executive updates, shares knowledge of technology risk, roadmaps, and programs. Help aggregate IT business demand, prioritization of programs or projects and includes cost visibility. Facilitates clear agreements and effective communications between clients and IT. Partners with the executive to evaluate the benefits of IT initiatives and priorities. Serves as a partner to Information Technology (IT) leadership and various business units in the integration of new systems and enhancement of existing systems and/or processes. Contributes to the development of area business plans, including business and production metrics to meet objectives.


Major Responsibilities:

  • Collaborates with clinical or operational leadership to discover strategic opportunities where information technology and innovation can significantly improve the delivery of health care.
  • Works with IT leadership and business units to develop and understand the business case and business requirements to solve for technology related business problems. Anticipates business and regulatory issues; recommends product, process or service improvements. Leads projects with notable risk and complexity and develops the strategy for project execution.
  • Builds highly effective partnerships, and resolves all relationship issues between IT and operations, and senior leadership.
  • Assists in business relationship management, business strategy and planning, portfolio/demand management as needed. Solves unique problems with broad impact on the business; requires conceptual and innovative thinking to develop solutions.

Shapes, manages, prioritizes and constructs unique, compelling value proposition that is ROI/performance-based for each client that improves patient outcomes, solves their pain points and is based upon Advocate Aurora Health’s unique competitive advantages and core competencies.
