Licensure, Registration, and/or Certification Required:

  • None Required.

Education Required:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology or related field.

Experience Required:

  • Typically requires 7 years of experience in evaluating internal information systems technical needs and functioning as the interface between operational and technical experts.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required:

  • Knowledge of leading-edge applications of information technology in health delivery
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Demonstrated strength as a strategic thinker with ability to understand the business direction and goals and their potential implications in terms of systems required to support them.
  • Attention to detail in developing the associated functional requirements, risk assessments, cost estimates and plans and tracking the delivery of approved projects.
  • Highly motivated self-starter capable of working largely on their own initiative to identify and address key opportunities and issues.
  • Strong ability to exercise judgment and creativity in analyzing/solving unusual complex/ambiguous problems.
  • Ability to be an effective team player, capable of playing both leadership and supportive roles, who recognizes that the IT portfolio attempts to optimize the response to a broad set of business needs, together with an assessment of business and technical risks, the short-term and long-term funding available, and the skills and capabilities of the IT organization.
  • Knowledgeable leader; recognized expert in the integration within functional and business areas.
  • Ability to influence and direct work teams. Strong mentoring and knowledge transfer capabilities.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Position may require travel which may result in exposure to road and weather hazards.
  • Exposed to normal office environment.
  • Operates all equipment necessary to perform the job.

This job description indicates the general nature and level of work expected of the incumbent. It is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the incumbent. Incumbent may be required to perform other related duties.

Our Commitment to You:

Advocate Health offers a comprehensive suite of Total Rewards: benefits and well-being programs, competitive compensation, generous retirement offerings, programs that invest in your career development and so much more – so you can live fully at and away from work, including:

Compensation

  • Base compensation listed within the listed pay range based on factors such as qualifications, skills, relevant experience, and/or training

  • Premium pay such as shift, on call, and more based on a teammate's job

  • Incentive pay for select positions

  • Opportunity for annual increases based on performance

Benefits and more

  • Paid Time Off programs

  • Health and welfare benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life, and Short- and Long-Term Disability

  • Flexible Spending Accounts for eligible health care and dependent care expenses

  • Family benefits such as adoption assistance and paid parental leave

Note: Eligibility for programs listed above may depend on your FTE or status (e.g., full-time, part-time, per diem, temporary, etc.); please ask a Recruiter for more information during an interview.

About Advocate Health

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. It is nationally recognized for its expertise in cardiology, neurosciences, oncology, pediatrics and rehabilitation, as well as organ transplants, burn treatments and specialized musculoskeletal programs. Advocate Health employs 155,000 teammates across 69 hospitals and over 1,000 care locations, and offers one of the nation’s largest graduate medical education programs with over 2,000 residents and fellows across more than 200 programs. Committed to providing equitable care for all, Advocate Health provides more than $6 billion in annual community benefits.

jobs.description:
Who Are We?

jobs.excerpt: About CoLabAt CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
jobs.description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

We're looking for a commercially minded, relationship-driven Manager of Industry Partnerships to own key GTM partnerships, and turn CoLab's partner network into a reliable source of pipeline.
In this role, you'll own CoLab's relationships with our industry and executive referral partners and make sure every partner relationship translates into real opportunities for our sales team.

You'll work hand in hand with the Partnerships team, Account Executives, Field Marketing and Revenue leadership to manage partner introductions into hard-to-reach accounts, co-sell into target opportunities, and keep partner-sourced deals moving. You'll also source more: finding, qualifying, and signing the next wave of partners who can open doors at the engineering organizations we want to work with.

This role is for someone who understands enterprise GTM, and is energized by building. If you're looking for a mature GTM partner program to maintain, this probably isn't it. If you're excited to shape how a fast-growing company works with executive and industry partners - and to see the revenue impact of that work directly - we'd love to talk.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • You measure partnerships by pipeline and revenue produced.
  • You're equally comfortable building trust with a seasoned industry executive and sitting down with an Account Executive to map out account strategy.
  • You're organized and operational. You know that partner programs are made on strong relationship management, well documented and understood partner strategy, clear expectations, consistent cadences, and clean handoffs - and you build the systems that make those things happen.
  • You're curious about how hardware products get designed and built, and you can speak credibly with engineering leaders about the problems CoLab solves.

Job Responsibilities

Manage and grow existing partner relationships

  • Own day-to-day relationships with CoLab's industry and executive partners.
  • Set clear joint goals with each partner - target accounts, introductions, and pipeline - and run a regular cadence of check-ins and business reviews against them.
  • Equip partners to represent CoLab well: onboarding, messaging, demo support, and co-branded materials, in partnership with Marketing and Solutions Engineering.
  • Manage partner agreements, commission or referral terms, and renewals in partnership with Finance and Legal.

Turn partner relationships into pipeline

  • Work closely with Account Executives, Field Marketing, Business Development, and Sales leadership to identify where partners can open doors in target and existing accounts.
  • Route partner introductions to the right sellers quickly, and make sure every introduction gets timely, high-quality follow-up.
  • Track partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and report regularly on partner performance.

Source and sign new partners

  • Build and maintain a target list of prospective referral partners aligned to CoLab's key verticals and regions.
  • Lead outreach, qualification, and negotiation with prospective partners, and move them from first conversation to signed agreement.
  • Onboard new partners so they are producing introductions within their first 90 days.

Build the partner program

  • Define and document CoLab's partner playbook: partner types, tiers, rules of engagement with the sales team, and how partner deals are tracked and credited.
  • Continuously improve the program based on what's working, and share insights with leadership on where to invest next.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in sales, partnerships, channel, alliances, or business development at a B2B software company, ideally selling into enterprise customers.
  • Proven track record of building partner relationships that generated measurable pipeline and closed revenue.
  • Strong working knowledge of enterprise sales cycles and experience collaborating closely with Account Executives.
  • Comfort building trust with senior executives and industry advisors.
  • Experience in manufacturing, engineering, PLM, or CAD-adjacent software is a strong plus.
  • Experience working with partners in Europe is a plus.

Overview

The IT Program Manager leads TISTA's prime contract performance on the Department of Veterans Affairs Supply Chain Management DevSecOps (SCMDSO) Integration task order supporting VA's supply chain and logistics Product Line. This is a designated Key Personnel position that VA requires be maintained for the life of the contract, and the individual is TISTA's single point of accountability to the VA Contracting Officer, VA Program Manager, and Contracting Officer's Representatives.

Beyond the contract, this position is a senior account leader within TISTA's SCM Domain. The IT Program Manager owns the SCMDSO account from a business standpoint, including program financials, staffing and talent pipeline, subcontractor and OEM partner relationships, customer satisfaction, and organic growth through the Optional Task Scrum Teams and follow-on opportunities. The role also contributes to TISTA's broader VA and federal health growth strategy, mentors the next generation of TISTA program leaders, and helps mature TISTA's delivery methods, so they can be reused across the company.

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission‑driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.

TISTA associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!

Leadership & Management:

  • Own the SCMDSO account end to end: program P&L, revenue forecasting, cost and margin management, invoicing accuracy, and monthly financial reporting to Health Solutions leadership.
  • Serve as the executive face of TISTA to VA Product Line leadership, building a trusted advisor relationship that positions TISTA as the partner of choice for supply chain modernization.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop the team, including performance management, career development, retention planning, and succession planning for Key Personnel.
  • Manage the Team TISTA partner ecosystem, including subcontract performance, workshare, small business participation goals, and named executive escalation paths.
  • Participate in TISTA Domain reviews, program management reviews, and corporate risk reviews, and represent the program in TISTA leadership forums.

The Work:


As an SAP Basis Manager on SAP transformation projects, you will:

  • Lead Basis workstream delivery across S/4HANA Greenfield, Brownfield conversion, BTP extension, and AMS engagements — owning the technical landscape design, cutover planning, and go-live readiness from a platform perspective.
  • Architect and govern SAP HANA database environments on Azure (Mv2/Mv3) or equivalent hyperscaler infrastructure — including NUMA tuning, NSE tiering strategy, delta merge configuration, HSR topology, and backup/recovery design.
  • Drive high-availability and disaster recovery implementation — HANA System Replication, Pacemaker clustering, Azure Site Recovery, and Azure Files integration — and validate failover readiness pre-go-live.
  • Own transport and release governance — establishing CTS+/ChaRM workflows, transport lanes, and release calendar alignment with project and AMS delivery teams; integrating with CI/CD pipelines where DevOps practices are in scope.
  • Serve as the primary Basis escalation point for P1/P2 incidents during project hypercare and AMS steady state — leading RCA, coordinating cross-functional resolution, and authoring post-incident reviews (PIRs).
  • Lead and develop a team of Basis consultants — assigning work, reviewing deliverables, running technical knowledge transfers, and building capability across junior and mid-level engineers.
  • Engage client stakeholders at the technical lead and project manager level — providing landscape status updates, risk flags, and platform readiness assessments.

Travel may be required. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's What You Need:

  • Minimum of 5 years experience in SAP Basis, with at least two full-cycle S/4HANA implementations or Brownfield conversions in a lead or co-lead capacity.
  • Minimum of 3 years experience/deep hands-on expertise in SAP HANA database administration on cloud infrastructure — memory architecture, HSR, backup strategy, performance tuning, and EarlyWatch Alert interpretation.
  • Minimum of 2 years experience designing and executing SAP HA/DR solutions in Azure or equivalent hyperscaler environments.
  • Minimum of 2 years experience managing transport landscapes and release governance across multi-system, multi-track project environments.
  • Experience and proven track record of leading small-to-medium Basis teams (3–8 people) across project and AMS delivery models.
  • Prior experience supporting the CMT Industry and clients
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). If an Associate's Degree, minimum 6 years' work experience.

Bonus Points If:

  • You have a SAP certification in SAP Technology, HANA Administration, or SAP S/4HANA System Administration.
  • You have experience with SAP BTP platform operations in a transformation context — subaccount governance, Cloud Connector management, and identity/authentication integration (SAP Cloud Identity Services).
  • You have familiarity with SAP RISE and the BTP shared responsibility model, including what falls within vs. outside SAP-managed scope.
  • You have exposure to SAP IDoc/ALE operations, archiving frameworks, and data volume management at scale.
  • You have experience integrating SAP Basis operations with enterprise ITSM platforms in SAP delivery contexts.
  • You have experience with tools such as SLO, SNP and SLT
  • You have scripting exposure (Python, Shell, or PowerShell) applied to Basis task automation or monitoring.

jobs.description:
About InvestEngine

We’re a London-based fintech on a mission to make ETF investing simple and accessible. Over 150,000 clients have trusted us with over £3.5 billion in assets — and we’re just getting started.

We’ve been featured by MoneyWeek, Finder and Forbes, and we’re growing fast with big ambitions.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to join our Pensions Team as its first dedicated frontend engineer. The team looks after around 100,000 SIPP accounts and thousands of pension transfers every month.

You’ll own our pensions web journeys end to end — from clarifying requirements with Product, Design and Backend to building, testing, releasing and checking how features behave in production. Your first big goal is the frontend scope of a pension administrator migration: new account-opening flows, updated legal documents and in-app changes for existing customers.

The team is backend-heavy, so you’ll be the frontend voice in technical decisions: shaping API contracts with backend engineers, setting how frontend work is reviewed and tested in Pensions, and later onboarding a second frontend engineer.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain customer-facing pension journeys in React and TypeScript

  • Own features from refinement to production, shipping web in the same sprint as backend

  • Agree API contracts, states and error handling with backend engineers and designers

  • Build complex, multi-step forms for account opening, transfers and declarations

  • Write unit and component tests, and release safely behind feature flags

  • Monitor features in production and fix issues quickly

  • Work in a large, long-lived codebase and follow our documented frontend architecture

  • Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex) in daily work — and review what they produce

  • Set frontend review and testing practices in the team, and onboard our next frontend engineer

  • Collaborate with Product, Design, QA, Operations and the wider frontend group

What We’re Looking For

  • Commercial experience with React and TypeScript as your main tools over the last 2+ years, in a large, long-lived codebase

  • Production experience with a state manager beyond component state (Effector, Redux or similar)

  • Solid REST API integration skills, including loading and error states

  • Experience working closely with backend engineers — discussing and shaping API contracts, not just consuming them

  • Experience building complex or multi-step forms in production

  • Unit or component testing as part of your daily work (Jest, React Testing Library or similar)

  • General understanding of web accessibility (semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, ARIA)

  • Experience working within a documented frontend architecture

  • Strong ownership: you clarify unclear requirements before you start and see features through to production

  • Clear communication with engineers and non-technical stakeholders

  • English B2+ and fluent Russian

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on backend experience — commercial or personal projects

  • Experience building a Backend for Frontend (BFF) layer

  • Experience planning frontend architecture and breaking work down for other engineers

  • Experience with Effector

  • Playwright or other end-to-end testing tools

  • Feature flags and error monitoring (GrowthBook, Sentry or similar)

  • React Native experience

  • Experience in fintech or another regulated industry — not required, we’ll get you up to speed

How We Work

We’re a lean, collaborative team where engineers have a real influence on product, architecture and engineering culture.

We value ownership, curiosity and continuous improvement. We start from the customer problem rather than the ticket, and we pick the simplest solution that works.

In Pensions, you’ll be the team’s frontend owner — the person who makes sure pension features reach customers on web at the same pace as the backend.

What We Offer

  • Impact from day one — own the web side of a business-critical pensions product

  • Real ownership — shape how frontend works in the team from the start

  • Growth — onboard and mentor the next frontend engineer joining the team

  • Modern tooling — TypeScript, React, Effector, Jest, Playwright, Storybook, Claude Code and Codex

  • Remote-first and flexible — work from anywhere, at your own pace

  • Unlimited vacation — take time off when you need it, no fixed limits

  • Supportive team — thoughtful, skilled colleagues who care about quality and results

Hiring Process

  1. Intro call with our Talent team

  2. Technical interview with the Frontend team (about 1 hour, case-based discussion, no live coding)

  3. Gamified cognitive assessment to understand how you think and problem-solve

  4. Final conversation with our CTO

We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

You will join the team behind a leading network source-of-truth (NSoT) platform, used by thousands of organizations - from fast-growing tech companies to Fortune 500 enterprises - to model, document, and automate their network infrastructure.

CodiLime engineers work within the platform's Observability team, which connects the network source of truth with what is actually running on the network. The team builds products for network discovery, network assurance (detecting drift between the intended and the actual state of the network), management of the agents that collect discovery and telemetry data, and a reliable pipeline that ingests this data into the platform.

The platform is built AI-first, with its own Claude Code agent skills and MCP server, and that mindset carries over to how the team works: Claude Code is used heavily day to day to help the team move fast and consistently deliver high-quality results.

In this role, you will build the real-time monitoring and telemetry dashboards at the heart of the observability products - interfaces that help network operators make sense of large, constantly changing network data. The scale is significant: some of the platform's largest customers manage hundreds of thousands of devices across globally distributed environments.

As the observability offering keeps growing, the team is looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who enjoys React, thinks in terms of data visualization and works AI-first.

Technology stack:

  • Programming languages/Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript, React

  • Build tooling: Vite, npm

  • State management & data fetching: Zustand, TanStack Query, Context API

  • Styling: TailwindCSS

  • Testing: Jest, React Testing Library (unit tests), Playwright (E2E)

  • APIs: REST with OpenAPI contracts, gRPC

  • Data visualization: charting libraries for real-time telemetry dashboards (e.g. Recharts, D3)

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, MCP servers, Anthropic tooling

  • Security: OAuth2 / OIDC

  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, metrics and instrumentation, Grafana, Prometheus

  • Containerization & Orchestration: Docker (Docker Compose for local/test environments), Kubernetes

  • Cloud: AWS

What else you should know:

  • Small, cross-functional team with strong ownership of code quality, security and tests

  • The team is distributed across Europe and the US, and we are looking for someone whose working hours can overlap with the US East Coast

  • AI tools are part of the daily workflow - Claude Code is used heavily across the team

  • This is a frontend-focused role, working closely with backend engineers on API contracts

  • Startup-like vibe: proactive, ownership-driven, fast-paced

We work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so it may happen that we’ll invite you to an interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.

Your role

As a part of the project team, you will be responsible for:

  • Building real-time monitoring and telemetry dashboards for the platform's observability products

  • Designing and developing React and TypeScript interfaces for network discovery, network assurance and agent fleet management

  • Turning large, frequently changing network and telemetry data into clear and usable visualizations

  • Defining and consuming frontend-backend contracts (OpenAPI) together with backend engineers

  • Managing client state and server data efficiently (Zustand, TanStack Query, Context API)

  • Writing unit tests (Jest, React Testing Library) and E2E tests (Playwright) running in CI (GitHub Actions)

  • Making sure the product is accessible to all users

  • Using Claude Code day to day: setting constraints, reviewing the output and staying accountable for correctness, security and tests

  • Writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code and participating in code reviews

Do we have a match?

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you must meet the following criteria:

  • 7+ years of professional frontend development experience

  • Strong experience with React, TypeScript and JavaScript

  • Experience with Vite

  • Experience with Zustand (or another state management library) and the Context API

  • Experience with TanStack Query

  • Experience with TailwindCSS

  • Good understanding of frontend-backend contracts, ideally defined with OpenAPI

  • Experience with unit testing (Jest, React Testing Library)

  • Experience with E2E testing, ideally with Playwright

  • Experience with npm

  • CI/CD experience (ideally GitHub Actions)

  • Experience with PostgreSQL

  • Experience with Docker and Docker Compose (local and test environments)

  • Understanding of accessibility, ideally hands-on experience

  • Hands-on, everyday use of AI coding tools (ideally Claude Code)

  • Experience building SaaS and infrastructure products

  • Networking knowledge gained from working on observability or monitoring products

  • Working hours overlapping with the US East Coast

  • Good knowledge of English (minimum C1 level)

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the following nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with data visualization libraries such as Recharts or D3

  • Experience with observability tools such as Grafana

  • Experience with OAuth2 / OIDC (e.g. Auth0)

  • Experience with RBAC (role-based access control)

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

  • The ability to change the project you work on

The Senior Principal Product Manager role will own the full product lifecycle of this new category defining AI first solution, from market discovery through feature definition, roadmap prioritization, and delivery, while leveraging deep domain expertise in tax audit management and notice response workflows to build a differentiated, AI-enabled product experience.

jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Release Manager to own how Tailscale ships our product, both internally and to customers. You’ll build and run our release coordination process and create the operational practices that coordinate product and engineering.

You’ll work closely with engineering leads, product managers, TPMs and support. At first you’ll focus on building release management from the ground up: setting the release cadence, defining roles, building tooling, and agreeing on norms with the teams involved in releases. Later, it will grow into creating processes around other parts of how product and engineering collaborate, like operational metrics.

You should understand how software gets shipped, including branching strategies, build pipelines, feature flags, and rollout mechanics. Your technical aptitude will allow you to design release processes that engineers trust and use.

Tailscale moves fast and your processes should help us maintain our speed. When a process works well, it is nearly invisible - it keeps the right people informed, stays out of engineers’ way, and gives the team a plan.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and continuously improve Tailscale’s release management process: including release cadence, readiness criteria, rollout coordination, and go/no-go decisions
  • Build and maintain the tooling, templates, runbooks, and documentation that make release processes repeatable and low-friction
  • Partner with engineering leads and product managers to surface risk early and drive resolution before it becomes a crisis
  • Define and track operational metrics that reflect the health of our release practices (e.g., release frequency, change failure rate)
  • Keep releases on schedule by facilitating cross-team planning rituals that keep engineering and product coordinated
  • Identify and drive systemic improvements to how we operate, using data and judgment to prioritize what actually matters

What We Are Looking For
  • 5+ years in engineering operations, release management, or a closely related role at a software company
  • Direct experience building or significantly improving release management processes
  • Technical fluency: you understand software development deeply enough to have credible conversations with engineers about build systems, deployment pipelines, branching strategies, and production operations
  • Strong instincts for what process is worth having and what’s just overhead, and optimizing process for trust and adoption
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to build structure from scratch

Nice to Have

  • Experience with both client and server software release processes
  • Experience at a developer tools, infrastructure, or security-focused SaaS company
  • Familiarity with DORA metrics and how to use them to drive meaningful improvement
  • Experience with feature flag systems, progressive rollouts, or canary deployments as release tools
  • Experience scaling operational practices through periods of rapid team or product growth
  • Hands-on experience with Tailscale at work or home

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

CAN Pay Range
$242,540—$302,840 CAD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. jobs.description:
About AgelessRx

AgelessRx is a first-of-its-kind, longevity-focused telehealth platform with an e-commerce component. Our mission is to collectively give people millions of extra healthy years, so everyone can enjoy more of what they love in a world where people are empowered to live as long as they want. We believe aging should no longer be treated as a dreadful inevitability, but instead, as a puzzle that can be solved, a fight that can be fought – just as a disease with a cure. Through our free-to-use platform, we offer trusted, data-driven longevity solutions and scientifically backed prescription therapies to help safely lower the risk of age-related diseases.

About the role
AgelessRx is seeking a hands-on, highly organized Senior IT Systems Administrator to own the day-to-day operation of our internal technology environment. As a fully remote telehealth company, our employees rely heavily on company devices, cloud-based applications, identity and access systems, and secure technology infrastructure to do their work effectively.

This role will serve as the primary owner of employee-facing IT operations across AgelessRx, including company devices, SaaS applications, account provisioning, onboarding and offboarding, technical support, and IT asset management. This person will be responsible not only for resolving issues as they arise, but also for building scalable, well-documented systems and processes that make our technology environment easier to manage as the company grows.

The Senior IT Systems Administrator will work closely with our Senior Security Engineer to ensure that IT systems and processes support AgelessRx's security, privacy, and compliance requirements. While the Senior Security Engineer owns the broader security program and technical security strategy, the IT Administrator will be responsible for implementing and maintaining many of the day-to-day administrative controls that keep our workforce and systems operating securely.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys being both a builder and an operator: someone willing to troubleshoot an employee's device one moment and then improve an organization-wide device management, access, or SaaS administration process the next.

What you'll do

IT Systems & SaaS Administration

  • Own and continuously improve administration of Google Workspace, Anthropic, and other company-wide SaaS platforms, including configuration, permissions, licensing, integrations, and governance.
  • Set IT administration standards; maintain authoritative inventories of applications, administrators, licenses, users, vendors, and system owners.
  • Lead technical evaluations, vendor coordination, implementation planning, migrations, and change management for new and existing systems.
  • Identify redundant tools, licensing waste, configuration risks, and opportunities for automation; recommend solutions with clear trade-offs and costs.
  • Create durable technical documentation, runbooks, system ownership records, and repeatable operating procedures.

Identity, Access & Employee Lifecycle

  • Own end-to-end IT provisioning, access changes, and deprovisioning for employees and contractors; establish reliable controls and service expectations.
  • Administer identity and access configurations, including SSO, MFA, role-based access, groups, privileged accounts, and least-privilege practices.
  • Lead operational access reviews, investigate exceptions, maintain audit-ready records, and remediate issues with the Senior Security Engineer.
  • Improve onboarding, offboarding, and role-change workflows through standardization, automation, and cross-functional coordination.

Device & Endpoint Management

  • Own the complete lifecycle of company laptops and technology: purchasing, configuration, deployment, shipping, support, inventory, recovery, and replacement.
  • Select, implement, and administer mobile device management (MDM) and endpoint management; define enrollment, configuration, patching, and maintenance standards.
  • Coordinate implementation of endpoint security controls and remediation requirements established with the Senior Security Engineer.
  • Maintain accurate asset ownership and device compliance records for a distributed workforce.

Employee Support and Service Operations

  • Act as the senior escalation point for complex device, operating-system, SaaS, connectivity, and access issues while remaining willing to handle hands-on support.
  • Design and own an organized IT request process with prioritization, tracking, response expectations, and clear employee communications.
  • Analyze recurring incidents and eliminate root causes; build self-service resources and knowledge documentation.
  • Provide thoughtful, timely support to nontechnical colleagues across a fully remote environment.

IT Infrastructure, Data & Operations

  • Lead internal technology migrations and implementations, including file storage, collaboration platforms, permissions, ownership, and employee adoption.
  • Oversee operational administration of company-managed data, storage, backup, retention, and recovery processes in coordination with Security and system owners.
  • Evaluate operational resilience, integrations, vendor dependencies, and process risks; prioritize improvements based on impact and effort.
  • Own delivery plans, milestones, stakeholder updates, and documentation for cross-functional IT projects.

Security & Compliance Partnership

  • Operationalize approved identity, access, endpoint, device, and SaaS security controls in partnership with the Senior Security Engineer.
  • Support audits, evidence collection, access reviews, incident response, and remediation; promptly escalate suspected incidents or inappropriate access.
  • Help administer controls for company-approved AI tools and emerging technology, including access and configuration requirements.
  • Support healthcare data protection and HIPAA-related operational requirements without serving as the owner of the security or compliance program.

During the first several months, this role will be expected to help lead foundational IT initiatives, including:

  • Complete the OneDrive-to-Google Drive migration, including departmental files, permissions, ownership, employee transition, and validation.
  • Lead selection, implementation, and company-wide rollout of MDM with ongoing device lifecycle and control processes.
  • Assess the SaaS and IT landscape and establish a centralized, reliable application, license, access, and administrator inventory.
  • Standardize employee and contractor onboarding/offboarding and build a scalable IT service request and documentation system.
  • Support Zendesk administration and technical integrations, including AI-related integrations, as business ownership requires.

Qualifications

  • 5 - 8+ years of progressive experience in corporate IT, IT administration, systems administration, or comparable roles, including substantial independent ownership of business-critical systems.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex IT projects or migrations from assessment through implementation, adoption, and documentation.
  • Advanced hands-on Google Workspace administration and broad SaaS administration experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of identity and access management, SSO, MFA, privileged access, and employee account lifecycle controls.
  • Experience selecting, implementing, or significantly improving MDM/endpoint management for a distributed workforce.
  • Excellent troubleshooting across macOS and/or Windows devices, SaaS applications, accounts, and connectivity.
  • Experience managing hardware procurement, remote deployment, inventory, and recovery.
  • Ability to automate or streamline repetitive administrative work using platform-native tools, scripting, or integrations.
  • Independent prioritization, project ownership, sound judgment, clear documentation, and effective communication with nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, computer science, or related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in healthcare, telehealth, or another regulated environment, including familiarity with HIPAA and PHI-related technology controls.
  • Experience building or maturing internal IT operations at a growing startup.
  • Experience migrating Microsoft 365/OneDrive environments to Google Workspace/Drive.
  • Experience with endpoint security tooling, access reviews, audit evidence, and incident-response coordination.
  • Experience with Zendesk, technical integrations, enterprise AI administration, and IT vendor management.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 30 days: Map the IT environment, identify immediate risks, establish stakeholder relationships, and deliver a prioritized improvement roadmap with owners and dependencies.
  • By 60 days: Establish reliable system, access, device, and license inventories; standardize onboarding/offboarding and request intake; define milestones for MDM and Drive migration.
  • By 90 days: Demonstrate measurable progress on the migration and MDM rollout; document repeatable IT processes; improve access consistency and employee support; establish a recurring operating rhythm with the Senior Security Engineer.

100% Remote | Full-time Contractor
Schedule: Monday through Friday, covering 9am–5pm Eastern European Time (EET)
Location: Open to candidates in EMEA or APAC who can cover European hours. Not open to US-based candidates.

About Gymdesk

Gymdesk is category-leading gym management software, built for gym owners, martial arts school owners, and studio owners who want to run and grow their business. Thousands of fitness and wellness businesses run on Gymdesk, and we're proud to sit at 4.8 stars on Capterra. We recently closed a $32.5 million growth investment from Five Elms Capital, and we're building out the team to match.

About the Role

Our customers are small business owners. They are teaching classes, signing up new members, and running front desks, often all at once. When something in Gymdesk doesn't work the way they expect, they need a fast, clear answer from someone who knows the product and cares about getting it right.

The Customer Support Representative is that person. You will answer questions by phone, chat, and email, troubleshoot account and technical issues, and make sure every customer leaves the conversation with a clear answer or a clear next step. You will join our Customer Support team, part of our wider Customer Success team, and report to our VP of Customer Success and our Customer Support Team Lead. You will work alongside Onboarding, Customer Integrations, Sales, and Engineering.

At its heart, this role is about problem solving: answering customer questions, addressing their concerns, and troubleshooting issues until they're resolved.

Why This Work Matters

For most gym owners, Support is the part of Gymdesk they talk to most. Every conversation shapes how they feel about the product and about us.

  • For our customers, a quick, accurate answer means billing runs on time, classes stay booked, and they can get back to their members.

  • For their members, many of the issues you solve are ones members feel directly: a payment that didn't go through, a class they couldn't book, an app that won't log in.

  • For Gymdesk, customers who feel well supported trust the product more, use more of it, and stay with us longer. What you hear also helps Product and Engineering decide what to fix next.

This role is where a customer's question turns into confidence in Gymdesk.

What You'll Own

Customer conversations

  • Answer customer questions by phone, chat, and email, handling a high volume of conversations each day (often 50 or more).

  • Give clear, accurate answers about how Gymdesk works, in plain language that a busy gym owner can act on right away.

  • Follow up on open issues so every customer knows what is happening and what comes next.

Troubleshooting and escalation

  • Investigate and resolve technical and account-related issues, including billing, scheduling, member records, and settings.

  • Recognize when an issue needs more help, and escalate it to Engineering with clear steps to reproduce, screenshots, and customer impact.

  • Coordinate with Onboarding, Customer Integrations, and Sales when a question belongs with another team, so customers get a smooth handoff instead of a runaround.

Records and knowledge

  • Keep accurate, complete ticket records in HubSpot, including the issue, steps taken, and outcome.

  • Tag recurring questions and bugs so the team can spot patterns.

  • Become an expert in Gymdesk, and keep up with new features and changes as they ship.

Improving the experience

  • Suggest and help write help-center articles, saved replies, and templates that answer common questions faster.

  • Share customer feedback with the Support Team Lead, Product, and Engineering about what confuses or frustrates customers.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means customers feel heard, get accurate answers quickly, and come away more confident in Gymdesk. Here is what we hope your first few months look like:

  • First 30 days: Comfortable with Gymdesk's core features. Handling chat and email conversations with support from the team. Escalations written clearly and completely.

  • 60 days: Handling phone, chat, and email independently at a steady daily volume. HubSpot ticket records current and complete. Comfortable knowing what to solve and what to escalate.

  • 90 days: A go-to resource on the team for common issues. Contributing saved replies or help-center updates. Sharing patterns from customer conversations with Product and Engineering.

Who You Are

  • 1–3 years of experience in customer support, customer success, or a similar customer-facing role.

  • Service-minded at heart. You get energy from helping people, and you take pride in following through.

  • Patient and clear when explaining something technical. You can walk a gym owner through a billing setting or a scheduling issue in plain, reassuring language.

  • Calm and organized at a fast pace, able to juggle many conversations and prioritize what matters most.

  • A curious troubleshooter who digs into the "why" behind an issue instead of stopping at the first answer.

  • A clear, professional communicator in writing, on the phone, and over chat, with fluent English.

  • Comfortable working through a CRM or ticketing system (such as HubSpot), Slack, and other remote-work tools.

  • A quick learner who enjoys becoming an expert in complex software.

  • Familiar with AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for drafting replies, summarizing conversations, or finding answers, and interested in using them thoughtfully.

  • Comfortable in a growing company where processes are still being built.

  • Nice to have: experience in SaaS support; familiarity with HubSpot help desk or service pipelines; experience with billing or payments questions; or experience serving fitness, martial arts, or wellness businesses.

Tools You'll Use

HubSpot, Slack, Google Workspace, phone and chat support tools, and AI tools for drafting replies, summarizing conversations, and research. We will train you on Gymdesk and our support processes.

Why This Role

You will join a close-knit Support team within our growing Customer Success team, so your work and your ideas will be seen. Every conversation you handle is a gym owner who gets back to running their business, and every pattern you spot helps make Gymdesk better for thousands of customers.

If you think you'd be a good fit, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

We are hiring a Product Manager to own our space management and GIS product line across AiM and ReADY. This is the part of our portfolio where a university's space inventory meets its campus map: room inventories and space surveys that drive indirect cost recovery and state reporting, CAD floor plans that need to become GIS feature layers, and a map viewer (Visualize) that puts AiM data on Esri's ArcGIS platform.

This is not a generalist product role. You already know how ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Enterprise work, you can explain why a CAD floor plan lands in the middle of the ocean until someone georeferences it, and you have sat in the room (on either side of the table) while a university worked through a space survey. You will be the person at AssetWorks who understands the whole workflow end to end and who teaches it to engineering, services, sales, and customers.

The line has momentum and open questions in equal measure. We are rebuilding the ReADY space survey and moving Visualize to our modern stack. We have a CAD-to-GIS conversion toolkit, built with a partner and proven at a large university, that needs to become a repeatable offering. We have customers asking for Revit support, assets on the map, mass updates from the map, and mechanical and electrical layers. And Esri's own indoor GIS products are changing how universities think about space systems. You will set the roadmap that answers those questions and carry it through delivery.

Job Description:

What You'll Do

  • Own the Space & GIS roadmap across AiM and ReADY: strategy, prioritization, PRDs, backlog, release scope, and the metrics that tell us it is working.
  • Run discovery with the universities that have the richest signal on space surveys, single room updates, property type surveys, and state reporting, and turn what you learn into prioritized requirements.
  • Be our authority on Esri: feature services and hosted layers, the ArcGIS Indoors information model and floor-aware maps, credits and user types, OAuth 2.0 client credentials and API keys, and what does and does not require an Indoors license.
  • Productize the CAD-to-GIS on-ramp with our partner: georeferencing configuration, the ArcGIS Pro toolbox, hosted feature layer publishing, the drawing-prep service, and the Revit/BIM path.
  • Set the technical posture with engineering on caching, performance of large detail layers, sync frequency, and Esri terms of use, and be able to defend those choices to customers and to Esri.
  • Build the internal enablement kit so that services can scope a Visualize implementation and sales can qualify a prospect without you in the room.
  • Define customer-fit criteria: which institutions are ready for map-based space management today, and which need a different path first.
  • Manage our GIS partner relationship and our working relationship with Esri; support RFP responses and pre-sales discovery.
  • Stand up a Space & GIS customer council to keep signal flowing and pressure-test the roadmap.
  • Work AI-natively: use AI tooling daily in your product practice, and shape our point of view on where natural language and agentic map exploration fit into space management.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years owning software outcomes as a product manager, solutions engineer, or campus space/GIS practitioner who has led feature delivery or platform migrations.
  • 3+ years hands-on with Esri ArcGIS (Online and/or Enterprise): you have published feature services, configured floor-aware maps or comparable data models, and worked with Esri authentication and licensing.
  • Direct exposure to higher education space management: space inventory, space surveys, FICM coding, F&A/indirect cost recovery, or state facilities reporting, as a practitioner or as a vendor/consultant.
  • CAD/BIM literacy: you understand what an AutoCAD floor plan contains, why it is not georeferenced, and what Revit or IFC adds. You do not need to draft.
  • Comfort owning capabilities that live in two codebases (an established Java platform and a modern JavaScript stack) and making the integration behavior explicit.
  • Experience running partner or vendor relationships and customer advisory groups; you communicate trade-offs to executives and technical detail to engineers.
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools in product work and a grounded view of where they help.
  • Excellent writing. You are the person who writes the document that ends the debate.
  • Bachelor's degree in geography, GIS, planning, architecture, computer science, or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with an IWMS/CAFM space module (AiM, Archibus, Planon, FM:Systems, FAMIS, TMA, Nuvolo) and its GIS or CAD integrations.
  • Participation in the campus GIS and facilities technology community (CFTA, Esri Education Summit, Esri UC, APPA, SCUP).
  • SQL and Python literacy; comfort reading a geoprocessing script or a REST response.
  • Accessibility awareness (ADA Title II / WCAG) for map-based interfaces.
  • Exposure to indoor mapping and wayfinding platforms, occupancy analytics, or academic scheduling systems.

Why This Role

  • Real ownership. One product manager, one product line, decisions that are yours to make and see through.
  • A domain that matters. Space is a university's second largest resource after people, and the pressures on it (utilization, deferred maintenance, indirect cost recovery) have never been higher.
  • A platform you already know. We build on Esri and we want someone who speaks it natively.
  • Durability. We are a buy-and-hold software company. We hire for the third year of a product line, not the first quarter.

Why Rolls-Royce?


At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

Position Summary


Rolls-Royce is looking for a Principal Engineer - FPGA/ASIC Design (Field Programmable Gate Arrays / Application Specific Integrated Circuit) Design Specialist to join our growing team.


This is an exciting opportunity to work on flagship Rolls-Royce programs and play a vital role in solving some of the most complex and interesting technological challenges in the industry while being part of a global, multi-disciplinary team. In this role, you will travel up to 25%.


In this technical role, you will design, verify, integrate, and test FPGA/ASIC solutions, which will be integrated in current and future Rolls-Royce engine control system products. You will be responsible for developing FPGA/ASIC architectures, coding, running simulations, synthesis, creating test benches, and preparing documentation to be reviewed by certification authorities.


What you will be doing

  • Participate in all phases of project, to produce detailed design documentation, verification plans and reports
  • The design and development of all custom digital devices (ASIC or FPGA), to support RR electronic engine control units
  • The verification of complex products that use FPGAs and/or ASICs to DO-254
  • Develop RTL utilizing a hardware description language (e.g. VHDL, Verilog, and/or SystemVerilog) and debug the design via simulation tools
  • Expertise achieving timing closure on FPGA designs and generating test benches
  • Evaluate the process flow including but not limited to high level design, synthesis, place and route, timing constraints and power utilization

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering and/or Computer Engineering with 5+ years of experience, OR
  • Master's degree in Electronics Engineering and/or Computer Engineering with 3+ years of experience, OR
  • PhD in Electronics Engineering and/or Computer Engineering
  • In order to be considered for this role, you must be a U.S. Citizen

Preferred Requirements:

  • Validate the FPGA hardware in the lab using test equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers) and debug tools (e.g ILA, JTAG)
  • Experience in scripting with languages such as TCL, Python, Shell scripts
  • Able to work with Windows and Linux development environment
  • Demonstrable experience in version control, such as Git, SVN
  • Experience of Actel & Xilinx tool flows to implement complete designs
  • Development of model-based systems with digital engineering toolsets (MATLAB, Simulink and/or similar)
  • Knowledge of systems engineering, and robust design tools and techniques coupled with the latest model-centric development approaches
  • Experience with Cameo Systems Modeler (MagicDraw) or similar SysML modelling software

Our vision is to ensure that the quality and dynamism that shaped our history continues into our future. It’s a bold pursuit, and we never stop striving to go further, faster, and better. We lead progress, creating the technologies that move us forward. If you’re driven to grow, to learn, and to make a lasting difference, this is where you belong.

jobs.description:
Grant Development & Compliance Specialist

Missing Children Society of Canada (MCSC) Full-Time | Permanent | Calgary / Remote

Help Build the Funding That Makes the Mission Possible

The Missing Children Society of Canada (MCSC) is looking for a Grant Development & Compliance Specialist to take ownership of our institutional funding portfolio and help strengthen and grow our government funding capacity.

This is an opportunity for an experienced grant professional who loves the combination of research, writing, strategy, relationship management, reporting and organization.

You will play a key role in identifying new funding opportunities, developing compelling grant applications, managing existing grants and communicating the impact of MCSC's work to funders.

This is more than a grant-writing position — but grant writing is at the heart of the role.

You will help build a disciplined, sustainable government funding function that supports MCSC's continued impact across Canada.

What You Will Do

Grant Development & Writing

  • Research and identify relevant government, foundation and institutional funding opportunities across Canada.
  • Assess opportunities against MCSC's mandate, priorities, capacity and likelihood of success.
  • Build and maintain a disciplined funding pipeline and calendar.
  • Lead the writing and development of grant applications, proposals, expressions of interest and renewals.
  • Develop compelling narratives that communicate MCSC's programs, outcomes and impact.
  • Tailor applications to individual funder priorities, requirements and evaluation criteria.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to gather program information, outcomes, data, budgets and supporting materials.
  • Maintain strong, reusable grant content and organizational information.
  • Think creatively about new funding opportunities and approaches to institutional funding.

Grant Management, Reporting & Impact

  • Own a portfolio of active grants from funding award through reporting and renewal.
  • Track grant commitments, deadlines, deliverables, funding conditions and reporting requirements.
  • Coordinate information required for interim and final funder reports.
  • Translate program outcomes, data and results into clear, compelling reporting that demonstrates the impact of funded work.
  • Work collaboratively with program, finance, technology and partnership teams to ensure grant commitments are measurable, realistic and reportable.
  • Communicate directly with funders regarding applications, reporting, renewals, grant requirements and other portfolio-related matters.
  • Maintain organized and authoritative records of applications, agreements, reports, correspondence and grant commitments.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen reporting, demonstrate outcomes and support successful renewals.

Financial & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work closely with Finance to develop and review grant budgets and funding allocations.
  • Understand how grant funding flows through program delivery and how financial information supports funder reporting.
  • Support the preparation and review of financial information required for grant applications and reporting.
  • Monitor budgets and variances within the context of grant requirements and work with Finance to address questions or issues.

Build the Function

You will also help MCSC strengthen how it manages institutional funding by developing practical tools, templates, processes and tracking systems that create consistency, visibility and institutional knowledge.

You will help build a sustainable approach to grant development and management that remains valuable to MCSC beyond any individual grant or funding cycle.

What You Bring

You are a strong grant professional who can own the full funding cycle - from identifying the right opportunity and writing a compelling application through grant management, reporting, demonstrating impact and renewal.

You will bring:

  • Demonstrated experience writing successful grant applications, proposals or institutional funding submissions.
  • Demonstrated experience working with government funding programs and grant processes.
  • Excellent writing, editing and communication skills.
  • Strong research, analytical and opportunity-assessment skills.
  • The ability to develop compelling funding narratives that connect programs, outcomes and impact.
  • The ability to manage a portfolio of grants, deadlines, commitments and reporting requirements independently.
  • Strong financial literacy, with the ability to understand grant budgets, funding allocations, variances and financial reporting requirements, and work effectively in partnership with Finance.
  • The ability to interpret program outcomes and data and clearly articulate impact in funder reporting.
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail and follow-through.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and quality.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to determine which funding opportunities are worth pursuing.
  • The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across different areas of an organization.
  • A proactive, curious approach and the ability to think outside the box when identifying funding opportunities.
  • Experience using tools or systems to manage grant pipelines, deadlines, reporting and portfolio information.

Considered an Asset

  • Experience managing grants from application through reporting and renewal.
  • Canadian federal and/or provincial government funding experience.
  • Foundation or institutional funding experience.
  • Nonprofit or charitable-sector experience.
  • Experience with outcomes measurement, impact reporting or evaluation.
  • Experience building grant-management systems, processes or templates.
  • Familiarity with grant-management software, CRM systems or other funding-tracking tools.

What We Are Not Looking For

This is not a broad fundraising position.

You will not be responsible for major gifts, individual donor portfolios, fundraising events, broad corporate sponsorship or routine donor administration.

Our focus is government funding: finding the right opportunities, writing strong applications, securing funding, managing the grant portfolio and clearly demonstrating the impact that funding makes.

Why MCSC?

This is a chance to join an organization with a meaningful national mission while helping build something that will have a lasting impact beyond the individual role.

You will have the opportunity to shape MCSC's institutional funding processes, strengthen existing funding relationships, identify new opportunities and help ensure the organization has the resources to continue and expand its work.

If you are an experienced grant professional who wants to own a funding portfolio, build strong government funding opportunities and see your work directly connected to meaningful social impact, we would like to hear from you.

Screening Requirements

A satisfactory criminal record check is required as a condition of employment. Additional screening requirements may apply based on the responsibilities of the position.

POSITION SUMMARY: The Sr Business Analyst analyzes the needs of the Company’s most complex functional business areas within Republic Services providing recommendations on system solutions or procedures. As the liaison between the business and IT department, the Sr Business Analyst ensures that the scope of work requested to enhance or modify existing application processes are clearly documented, communicated, and validated. The Sr Business Analyst works closely with IT experts to design, develop, document, test and validate solutions that meet business requirements and may be asked to lead projects and mentor other Business Analysts.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Acts as a liaison with stakeholders to analyze the needs of various functional business areas while enhancing software and reinforcing business standards.
  • Creates detailed documentation of functional, system (non-functional), user and reporting requirements that may include but is not limited to: Use Cases, Logical Models, Process Flow Diagrams, Report Specifications and Data Mapping & Flow Diagrams.
  • Performs research and analysis for proposed projects to determine feasibility and durability.
  • Performs profiling and analysis of data from source systems.
  • Ensures that solution requirements area clearly documented, communicated, and validated.
  • Provides support to functional and user acceptance testing groups throughout development life cycle.
  • Assists with the creation of value proposition (ROI) for proposed projects.
  • Helps the team to define and control scope for development initiatives and release schedule.
  • Works jointly with other IT Managers to create detailed work plans for software development and enhancement projects.
  • Responsible for status reporting, knowledge transfer and implementation plans as appropriate for the software solution being developed.
  • Builds and maintains relationships with software application vendors and implementation partners.
  • Instructs, directs, guides, and checks the work of Business Analysts.
  • Performs other duties as assigned or apparent.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience using Structured Query Language (SQL) for data analysis.
  • Business Analysis or Project Management Professional certification.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, computer engineering, information systems, finance, statistics, computer science or a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of direct work experience in a business analyst capacity working with business systems related to systems support, analysis, or development.
  • Minimum of 1 year project management/coordination tracking and organizing business analysis documentation for projects.

This role is primarily remote; however, candidates should be located within commuting distance of our Phoenix, AZ office. Occasional in-person attendance may be required for team meetings, training, or business needs.

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).


RECENT RECOGNITION

  • Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable Companies
  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global
