jobs.excerpt: As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era.
jobs.description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.


How You Will Contribute:

 

Ciena is seeking a strategic, results-driven Category Prime - Capital Equipment (CapEx) to lead global category management, strategic sourcing, and supplier relationship management for capital expenditure investments across the organization.

This role serves as the primary commercial interface between Procurement, Engineering, Global Operations, Manufacturing, Product Development, and Finance to ensure Ciena acquires and manages high-performance, cost-effective, and scalable capital assets. These investments may include test and measurement equipment, manufacturing automation, laboratory infrastructure, reliability testing systems, production tooling, and other technology-enabling equipment critical to Ciena's innovation and operational success.

The successful candidate will develop and execute multi-year category strategies, lead complex commercial negotiations, optimize total cost of ownership (TCO), mitigate supply and commercial risks, and establish supplier partnerships that support Ciena's technology roadmap and business growth objectives.

The Must Haves:

Strategic Category Management & Planning

  • Develop and execute multi-year category strategies aligned with business objectives, technology roadmaps, manufacturing requirements, and capital investment plans.
  • Analyze spend data, market intelligence, supplier capabilities, and industry trends to identify sourcing opportunities and long-term value creation.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product Development, Global Operations, Manufacturing, and Finance teams to align equipment sourcing decisions with business priorities.
  • Support capital planning and budgeting processes through cost forecasting, market insights, lead-time analysis, and sourcing recommendations.
  • Build and maintain category roadmaps that balance cost, capability, innovation, risk, and scalability.

 

 

Strategic Sourcing & Commercial Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end sourcing activities, including RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, supplier evaluations, bid analysis, negotiations, supplier selection, and contract award processes.
  • Develop commercial strategies that optimize cost, quality, service, delivery performance, and long-term supplier relationships.
  • Negotiate complex commercial agreements, including master purchase agreements, statements of work (SOWs), maintenance agreements, support contracts, warranties, service-level agreements (SLAs), leasing arrangements, and other supplier commitments.
  • Utilize total cost of ownership (TCO), should-cost analysis, and value engineering principles to support sourcing and investment decisions.
  • Drive savings, cost avoidance, working capital improvements, and productivity initiatives across assigned categories.
  • Establish preferred supplier frameworks and standardization strategies where appropriate to maximize leverage and operational efficiency.

 

 

Supplier Relationship & Performance Management

  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key equipment manufacturers, technology providers, and service partners.
  • Implement Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) practices, including business reviews, performance scorecards, continuous improvement initiatives, and executive-level engagement.
  • Evaluate supplier performance across cost, quality, reliability, responsiveness, innovation, and service metrics.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and stakeholders to resolve performance issues and implement corrective actions when required.
  • Support supplier innovation and technology advancement opportunities that create business value for Ciena.

 

 

Cross-Functional Partnership & Project Support

  • Collaborate with Engineering and Operations teams to develop sourcing strategies and equipment specifications early in project lifecycles.
  • Support New Product Introduction (NPI), manufacturing readiness, laboratory expansion, automation initiatives, and other strategic investments.
  • Provide commercial expertise and procurement leadership for capital business cases, investment approvals, and vendor selection activities.
  • Partner with Finance to monitor capital expenditures, forecast spending requirements, and ensure alignment with approved budgets.
  • Ensure compliance with procurement policies, contractual obligations, corporate governance, and applicable regulatory requirements.

 

 

Risk Management & Asset Lifecycle Optimization

  • Assess and mitigate commercial, supplier, technology, capacity, and supply chain risks across assigned categories.
  • Develop sourcing and supplier strategies that enhance business continuity and reduce dependency risks.
  • Support asset lifecycle management activities, including equipment upgrades, service support transitions, end-of-life planning, redeployment, and optimization initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve equipment utilization, standardization, and lifecycle cost performance across Ciena's global footprint.

 

 

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage spend analytics, market intelligence, supplier benchmarking, and category performance data to drive informed decision-making.
  • Establish and maintain category KPIs, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms for leadership visibility.
  • Track and communicate savings, cost avoidance, supplier performance, risk exposure, and strategic initiative progress.
  • Drive process improvements, sourcing excellence, and adoption of procurement best practices across stakeholder groups.

Assets:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, or category management.
  • Demonstrated experience managing capital equipment, laboratory infrastructure, manufacturing technology, automation systems, test equipment, or related CapEx categories.
  • Proven track record leading complex commercial negotiations and delivering measurable cost savings, TCO improvements, and business value.
  • Strong understanding of contract development, risk management, supplier performance management, and sourcing strategy.
  • Experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders across Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, Finance, and Legal organizations.
  • Strong analytical, communication, project management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience utilizing ERP systems and procurement technologies.

 

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA, Master's degree, or equivalent advanced education.
  • Professional certifications such as CPSM, CIPS, APICS/CPIM, or equivalent.
  • Experience within telecommunications, networking technology, electronics manufacturing, high-tech, or advanced manufacturing industries.
  • Global procurement and multi-site category management experience.
  • Familiarity with capital investment planning, equipment lifecycle management, laboratory operations, manufacturing automation, and technology development environments.
  • Experience with sourcing analytics, business intelligence tools, and e-sourcing platforms.

 

 

Key Competencies

  • Strategic Category Management
  • Commercial & Financial Acumen
  • Supplier Relationship Management
  • Contract Negotiation
  • Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Analysis
  • Risk Identification & Mitigation
  • Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Data-Driven Decision Making
  • Executive Communication & Influence
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset

 

Success Metrics

 

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Delivery of annual savings and cost avoidance targets.
  • Improvements in total cost of ownership across assigned categories.
  • Supplier performance, quality, service, and delivery improvements.
  • Risk reduction and supply continuity achievement.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and business partnership effectiveness.
  • Adoption of preferred supplier strategies and spend under management.
  • Successful support and execution of capital investment initiatives.
  • Achievement of category-specific business objectives and strategic goals.

About Nteractive

AtNteractive, we design and deliver world-class experiential, event, and conference solutions that connect brands with people in powerful, meaningful ways.

We partner with some of the world’s most influential organizations to create large-scale, high-impact global programs — from flagship conferences and destination events to complex, multi-market activations. We are a collaborative, ambitious, and values-driven agency that invests in talent, encourages innovation, and empowers our teams to take ownership and make a real difference. We believe in long-term partnerships, exceptional client service, and continuously raising the bar in everything we do.

Role Overview

We're looking for an experienced Senior Producer, Exhibitions & Demo Programme to lead the end-to-end planning and delivery of the Demo Programme across a signature client portfolio.

This is a key leadership role within a complex, high-profile technology event environment. You'll take each demo from initial submission through creative review, technical validation, onsite testing and final show-ready delivery, ensuring every element is planned, coordinated and delivered to the highest standard.

Sitting at the intersection of programme management and exhibition production, you'll work closely with client Demo Owners, Showcase, Creative, Technical Production and the wider delivery team. You'll establish the structure, governance and ways of working needed to manage a high volume of demos and interconnected requirements, bringing clarity, consistency and control to a complex programme.

We're looking for someone who can confidently lead multiple stakeholders, manage competing priorities and translate complex creative, operational and technical requirements into a clear, deliverable plan.

What you'll be doing
Programme Leadership & Governance

  • Own the overall Demo Programme plan, delivery strategy and approach across a signature enterprise client.

Exhibition, Creative & Technical Integration

Programme Planning & Readiness

  • Control critical milestones, approvals, changes, actions and outstanding decisions across the programme.

  • Use clear, exception-based reporting to highlight areas requiring leadership or client intervention.

  • Drive the programme towards agreed readiness gates ahead of onsite delivery.

  • Identify potential issues early and take ownership of driving them through to resolution.

  • Ensure requirements are validated and approved in advance to minimise late changes and onsite risk.

Onsite Production & Delivery

  • Lead the Demo Programme through installation, commissioning, testing and live delivery.

  • Prioritize onsite issues, assign ownership and maintain clear escalation through to resolution.

Continuous Improvement

  • Develop repeatable processes, tools and documentation that strengthen consistency, efficiency and knowledge retention.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce duplication and minimize late changes and avoidable delivery risks.

  • Drive continuous improvement in programme governance, stakeholder engagement and delivery processes.

What you will bring

We're looking for a highly experienced event production and programme management professional who can bring structure, clarity and control to complex, multi-stakeholder environments.

You'll ideally bring:

  • Significant experience in event production or programme management, with a proven track record delivering complex exhibitions, expos, technology showcases or live event environments.

  • Strong programme planning and control capabilities, including milestones, approvals, dependencies, risk management and readiness gates.

The kind of leader you are

You're highly organized and naturally bring structure, pace and clarity to complex programs. You're comfortable managing multiple workstreams and understand how individual requirements fit into the bigger picture.

You're a confident and credible communicator who can make complex information clear, concise and actionable. You build strong relationships, collaborate effectively and aren't afraid to challenge constructively or hold stakeholders accountable.

You're proactive and solutions-focused, with the judgement to anticipate issues, prioritize effectively and make timely recommendations. You remain calm and decisive under pressure, particularly during demanding onsite delivery periods.

Above all, you're detail-conscious without losing sight of the wider program, client objectives and attendee experience.

Why you'll love working at Nteractive

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a significant, high-profile technology event programme, working alongside talented teams and leading client stakeholders.

You'll play a central role in bringing complex technology showcases to life, helping deliver exceptional experiences while shaping the processes and standards that support future enterprise client events.

At Nteractive, you'll be part of a collaborative global team that values expertise, accountability, innovation and great delivery.

If you're an experienced Senior Producer who thrives on bringing structure to complex programs, coordinating multiple stakeholders and delivering technically challenging exhibitions and live experiences, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer (PostgreSQL, IaC)
jobs.excerpt: We are a leading trading platform that is ambitiously expanding to the four corners of the globe.
jobs.description:
We are a leading trading platform that is ambitiously expanding to the four corners of the globe. Our top-rated products have won prestigious industry awards for their cutting-edge technology and seamless client experience. We deliver only the best, so we are always in search of the best people to join our ever-growing talented team.

We are hiring a Senior Database Reliability Engineer for our Infrastructure Platform Team. You will design PostgreSQL platforms for resilience and high availability, automate everything you touch, and understand how our services use the database, from connection pools to ORM transactions. Your goal is to keep latency within SLO at a reasonable cost, through every change, failover and migration.

Our stack today: AWS RDS and Aurora (PostgreSQL, MySQL), Redshift, ClickHouse, Terraform, Ansible, Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics and Grafana, with Java services on Kubernetes.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and run highly available PostgreSQL across zones and regions, with automated, tested failover and fencing against split-brain.
  • Define all database infrastructure as code (clusters, parameters, networking, access, monitoring and backups), reviewed by peers and applied through CI/CD pipelines, with drift detection.
  • Build self-service database provisioning so product teams get a production-ready database without waiting on a ticket.Plan and execute migrations, upgrades and table moves with zero or near zero downtime, including cross-version, cross-cluster and cross-cloud work.
  • Partner with developers on schema changes, queries, connection pooling, transaction scope, retries and expand-and-contract migrations, so database issues are fixed at their source.
  • Define SLOs and build SLO-based alerts and dashboards (Prometheus, Grafana or similar) that catch latency and capacity problems before clients do.
  • Design backup and recovery, and prove it with scheduled restore and failover tests that measure RTO and RPO and produce evidence for auditors.
  • Keep cost in view: right-size instances and storage, and choose the cheapest option that meets the requirement.
  • Secure the data: least-privilege access, secrets from a secrets manager, encryption at rest and in transit, audited access and PII masking.
  • Lead and take part in incident response and on-call, write blameless post-mortems and make sure their actions get done.
  • Replace manual runbooks with automation, and document what remains.

Requirements:

  • Deep PostgreSQL production experience. You have run PostgreSQL at scale and understand MVCC, vacuum and bloat, locking, replication (physical and logical) and query planning from real incidents, not only from documentation.
  • Infrastructure as code as your normal way of working. Everything you build lives in version control and is reviewed before it is applied.
  • CI/CD in your day-to-day work. Your infrastructure and database changes, including schema migrations, reach production through pipelines. If console clicks, SSH changes or wiki steps are how changes normally happen in your current role, this position is not the right fit.
  • 5+ years running production databases as a DBRE, SRE, platform or database engineer, ideally with a large part on AWS (RDS or Aurora).
  • Experience designing high availability and disaster recovery: replication, automated failover, multi-region or multi-cloud redundancy, and the trade-offs between RTO, RPO and cost.
  • A track record of zero-downtime changes: online migrations, major version upgrades or moving data between clusters.
  • Understanding of how applications use databases: connection pools, ORMs (for example Hibernate), transaction scope, retries and idempotency, and safe deployment order.
  • Observability skills: you define what to measure, alert on SLOs and verify changes with data.Scripting in Python, Bash or Go to automate operational work.
  • Comfort in a regulated financial services environment, where access control, encryption and audit trails are non-negotiable.
  • Clear communication: you reason out loud, own outcomes and partner with developers instead of gatekeeping.

Nice to have:

  • Terraform and Ansible specifically, since they are our current tools.
  • MySQL in production.
  • Redshift, ClickHouse or DynamoDB.
  • Logical replication or CDC tooling (pglogical, AWS DMS, Debezium).
  • Kubernetes and running Java services in production.
  • Linux performance tuning and troubleshooting on self-managed database hosts.
  • Vault or another secrets manager.
What you will get in return:
  • Competitive Salary: We believe great work deserves great pay! Your skills and talents will be rewarded with a salary that makes you feel valued and motivated.
  • Work-Life Harmony: Join a company that genuinely cares about you - because your life outside of work matters just as much as your time on the clock.
  • Annual Performance Bonus: Your hard work doesn’t go unnoticed! Celebrate your achievements with a well-deserved annual bonus tied to your performance.
  • Generous Time Off: Need a breather? Our annual leave policy lets you recharge and enjoy life outside of work without a worry.
  • Employee Referral Program: Love working here? Share the love! Bring your talented friends on board and get rewarded for growing our awesome team.
  • Comprehensive Health & Pension Benefits: From medical insurance to pension plans, we’ve got your back. Plus, location-specific benefits and perks!
  • Workation Wonderland: Live your digital nomad dreams with 30 extra days to work remotely from anywhere in the world (some restrictions apply). Adventure awaits!
  • Volunteer Days: Make a difference! Take two additional paid days each year to support causes you care about and give back to the community.

jobs.excerpt: We believe independent restaurants deserve the same advantages as big chains without giving up their independence.
jobs.description:
We believe independent restaurants deserve the same advantages as big chains without giving up their independence.

Ilir Sela started Slice in his family’s pizzerias, where he saw firsthand what it takes to run a local shop. Now we’re taking everything we’ve learned beyond pizza, to taquerias, delis, burger joints, and other neighborhood staples.

We put technology, marketing, buying power, and support to work for more than 15,000 restaurants, so owners spend less time on admin, marketing, and order management and more time growing their business. They remain independent, but never alone.

We’re growing our team to help bring this next chapter to life. That’s where you come in.

The Challenge to Solve

Slice’s Services teams build the backend systems, APIs, integrations, and operational capabilities that power our platform. We are looking for a high-agency Engineering Manager who can identify the most valuable problems, turn ambiguity into clear direction, and build a team capable of delivering exceptional results. This is not a coordination-only role. You will stay close to the technology, product, and customer. You will be accountable for both your team's performance and the impact it creates. Management is a force multiplier—not another layer of process.

Your role is to create the conditions in which talented engineers can do the best work of their careers. That means setting a clear mission, raising standards, removing obstacles, developing judgment, and holding yourself and others accountable.

Putting people first does not mean avoiding difficult conversations or lowering the bar. It means giving people meaningful ownership, direct feedback, strong support, and the opportunity to grow.

Our strongest managers:

  • Focus teams on customer outcomes rather than activity.
  • Create clarity when the path is uncertain.
  • Make decisions with incomplete information and adapt quickly.
  • Stay close to the details without becoming the bottleneck.
  • Challenge assumptions and look for asymmetric opportunities.
  • Build trust through candor, consistency, and follow-through.
  • Take responsibility for outcomes, including when things go wrong.

The Role

Own customer and business outcomes

Partner with Product, Design, Data, and Operations to identify the problems most worth solving. Define success through measurable value for pizzerias, customers, and the business—not projects completed or code shipped.

Lead technical direction

Guide architecture and engineering decisions across the services your team owns. Help the team balance speed, reliability, simplicity, and long-term system health.

Our services are converging on Python, while parts of our ecosystem use Go and Ruby. We choose technology based on the problem and the customer value it enables—not preference or fashion.

You should be comfortable leading teams working with:

  • Python, Go, and Ruby services.
  • APIs, distributed systems, and asynchronous workflows.
  • Databases, AWS, observability, and production operations.
  • Service migrations, reliability, security, and performance.

Build a high-agency team

Give engineers context, clear decision boundaries, and meaningful ownership. Expect them to move with urgency, exercise judgment, raise issues early, and own what happens in production.

When the team is blocked, work across boundaries and find a path forward rather than simply escalating the problem.

Raise execution standards

Help the team deliver valuable improvements frequently without sacrificing quality. Reduce unnecessary ceremony, make risk visible, and build lightweight mechanisms that improve focus and learning.

Use customer feedback, product data, incidents, and operational metrics to understand whether the team’s decisions are working.

Develop exceptional people

Hire and retain outstanding engineers, including those from unconventional backgrounds who demonstrate unusual ability and drive.

Coach engineers across experience levels, recognize future leaders, reward strong performance, and address underperformance clearly and promptly.

Lead across Slice

Build strong relationships with other engineering, product, and business leaders. Influence through judgment and results rather than hierarchy.

Surface disagreement directly, resolve it constructively, and optimize for Slice and its customers—not only your own team.

The Team

You will lead engineers working on services that power key Slice experiences. The team collaborates across the US, Canada, UK, and North Macedonia, alongside partners in Product, Design, Data, and Operations.

We value thoughtful asynchronous communication, direct discussion, and high-quality written decisions. Geography should not determine who has context, influence, or ownership.

You will report to an Engineering Director and work with other managers and technical leaders to raise the standard across Slice Engineering.

The Winning Recipe

We care more about evidence of impact, judgment, and trajectory than a perfectly conventional background.

Strong candidates will bring:

  • Experience building and operating customer-facing software or platforms.
  • Experience managing high-performing engineering teams.
  • Strong technical judgment across backend services, APIs, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and production operations.
  • Experience with Python, Go, Ruby, or comparable backend technologies.
  • A record of improving both customer outcomes and engineering effectiveness.
  • The ability to turn complex, ambiguous problems into clear direction.
  • A founder-minded approach: resourceful, decisive, intellectually curious, and unwilling to wait for perfect conditions.
  • Strong instincts for leverage—knowing when to move quickly and when deeper investment is necessary.

We are seeking a Marketing & Business Development Coordinator to keep marketing activities and the sales pipeline organized, active, and measurable. The successful candidate will support the Founder by preparing qualified opportunities and maintaining consistent marketing and business development activity, while strategic decisions, pricing, sales closing, and final approvals remain with the Founder.

Job Details

Work set up: Work from Home (WFH)

Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Brisbane Time (AEST)

Holiday: To be confirmed

Headcount: 1

Responsibilities

Prospect Research and Database Development

Marketing Content Production and Administration

  • Turn approved ideas, voice notes, and source materials into draft LinkedIn posts, carousels, short-form video scripts, newsletters, and campaign content, using AI tools where appropriate.
  • Prepare simple on-brand graphics and edit short videos using approved templates and brand guidelines.
  • Load, schedule, and quality-check approved content and advertising in Zoho Social or other authorized platforms.
  • Maintain the content calendar, asset library, approval status, and publishing records.
  • Monitor comments, messages, and campaign responses; record relevant activity in the CRM and escalate sales or reputational concerns.
  • Monitor marketing performance, prepare reports, and recommend practical improvements for the client’s own campaigns and client campaigns.

Business Development Coordination

  • Draft personalized LinkedIn connection notes, replies, and follow-up messages for the Founder to review and send from their own profile.
  • Where approved, network transparently using the coordinator’s own genuine professional identity and send authorized follow-up communications in compliance with documented consent requirements.
  • Qualify interested prospects against agreed criteria; arrange discovery calls, confirm attendance, and coordinate rescheduling.
  • Prepare concise pre-call briefs outlining business context, likely needs, prior contact, decision-makers, and suggested questions.

Growth Snapshot, Proposal and Referral Support

  • Research approved prospects and prepare draft Growth Snapshot materials using approved processes, templates, AI prompts, and evidence standards.
  • Verify business names, contacts, links, factual claims, and formatting before submitting documents for review.
  • Assemble proposal drafts using approved scopes, pricing, and templates; maintain follow-up tasks after approval and issue.

  • Strong written and spoken English, including clear communication suited to Australian business audiences.
  • Excellent attention to detail, reliable task completion, sound judgment, and confidence working independently in a remote team.
  • Strong organization, commercial curiosity, quality control, and willingness to learn new tools and processes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Zoho One applications, including Zoho CRM, Zoho Social, Campaigns, WorkDrive, Forms, Bookings, or Books.

jobs.description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Penetration Tester to join us as soon as possible. You will run hands-on, authenticated security testing across a real attack surface: public partner-facing booking APIs, payment flows, web and mobile apps used by millions of travellers, and the cloud infrastructure behind them. You’ll plan and run your own testing, work directly with our engineering squads to get findings fixed, and see your impact in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Test our partner-facing booking APIs against the OWASP API Security Top 10, with a focus on object- and function-level authorization, tenant isolation, mass assignment, data exposure and rate limiting.

  • Assess API authentication and integrity end to end, including OAuth 2.0/OIDC, API keys, JWTs, webhooks and request signing.

  • Hunt for business-logic abuse in booking, checkout, payment and refund flows, including race conditions and pricing manipulation.

  • Run authenticated tests of traveller-, partner- and operator-facing web and mobile apps following OWASP WSTG and ASVS, including how passenger personal data is stored, shown and exported.

  • Review cloud, Kubernetes and CI/CD configurations and secrets handling for attack paths that could be chained from an application bug.

  • Map and regularly test our internet-facing attack surface.

  • Red-team our AI features (assistants, agents, support bots) against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

  • Write clear, reproducible, risk-rated findings with practical remediation guidance, walk engineers through fixes and verify them with retests.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.

Requirements

Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years of hands-on penetration testing, mainly of web applications and APIs, and can point to recent engagements you’ve led end to end.

  • You have deep, practical knowledge of the OWASP API Security Top 10, WSTG and ASVS, including authentication/authorization models (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT), IDOR/BOLA, mass assignment, SSRF, injection and XSS.

  • You have found business-logic and race-condition vulnerabilities in transactional systems such as booking, e-commerce, payments or fintech.

  • You are fluent with Burp Suite Pro (or similar) and write your own scripts and tooling (Python, Go or similar).

  • You are comfortable assessing cloud and container environments (GCP preferred, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.

  • You work independently: you scope, prioritise, test and report with minimal guidance, and you explain complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • You are available to start at short notice.

  • Bonus Points: OSCP, OSWE, BSCP or similar certifications; experience red-teaming LLM applications or AI agents; testing in PCI-DSS environments.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

  • You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe.

  • You will get a competitive salary.

Own the full sales cycle from lead to close, driving pipeline generation, qualification, solution positioning, and deal negotiation using a structured MEDDPICC approach. You will work closely with US insurance prospects to understand their business challenges and articulate how Earnix can deliver measurable value.

Develop and execute territory and account strategies, focusing on expanding Earnix’s footprint within the US insurance market. You will leverage market insights and customer intelligence to identify opportunities and strengthen Earnix’s competitive positioning.

Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers across actuarial, product, underwriting, pricing, IT, and executive leadership. You will lead conversations that help US insurers modernize and transform their operations through intelligent decisioning.

Collaborate with global remote teams in product, marketing, presales, and delivery to ensure a seamless customer journey. You will drive alignment across multiple time zones and functions to deliver an exceptional prospect experience.

Represent Earnix at US industry events, conferences, and customer engagements, delivering compelling presentations and communicating Earnix’s value proposition. You will be a visible ambassador of the brand in the US insurance ecosystem.

Requirements

You’ll do it using

8+ years of proven, successful sales experience in the P&C Insurance space, ideally gained at a fast-growing startup or scale-up, demonstrating the ability to navigate complex organizations and close strategic deals in a high-growth, less-established environment.

A strong understanding of how US insurers operate today, combined with deep knowledge of the digital transformation challenges and opportunities across the sector. You will use this knowledge to influence strategic discussions and guide prospects toward modern, analytics-driven decisioning.

Hands-on experience running deals through a MEDDPICC (or comparable) qualification methodology, with fluency in metrics, economic buyer identification, decision criteria/process mapping, pain identification, and champion building.

A passion for hunting and new business acquisition, consistently driving pipeline growth, identifying new revenue streams, and generating momentum in the competitive US insurance market.

Experience operating within global, distributed teams, using collaboration tools and communication best practices to ensure cohesion and momentum across regions.

A highly motivated, results-oriented work style, committing to doing what it takes to win while upholding Earnix values and delivering a world-class customer experience.

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, enabling you to convey complex concepts with clarity and build trust with diverse stakeholders.

Willingness to travel extensively across the US when required, meeting customers, attending events, and strengthening Earnix’s presence in key markets.

You’ll excel by

Demonstrating exceptional relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, enabling you to engage effectively with US insurance executives and influence high-impact decisions.

Applying MEDDPICC rigor instinctively — qualifying hard, forecasting accurately, and knowing when to walk away from a bad deal.

Communicating with clarity, confidence, and insight, tailoring messages to technical, commercial, and leadership audiences.

Exhibiting strong teamwork and collaboration, even while working independently, by aligning with global colleagues and sharing knowledge and field intelligence.

Showing resilience, tenacity, and a competitive drive, maintaining focus on results and adapting quickly in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Presenting yourself as a trusted advisor, helping US insurance customers navigate change while positioning Earnix as an indispensable strategic partner.

Salary $150,000 - $180,000 Base + Double OTE.

Position Intro

Earnix is the first AI company purpose-built for insurance decisioning, providing the industry with the intelligence, governance, and decisioning agility to drive profitable growth, improve resilience, and operate with speed and precision in a rapidly changing risk environment. A trusted provider of production-grade AI and decisioning technology, Earnix builds on more than 25 years of experience in artificial intelligence risk, pricing, rating, analytics, and decisioning. Earnix brings vertical AI into the workflows and decisions that shape insurance performance across insurers’ pricing, underwriting, claims, customer engagement, retention, and other insurers high-value insurance moments. Earnix’s AIOS enables insurers to orchestrate intelligence across the insurance decision lifecycle and drive governed, real-time decisions that deliver measurable business outcomes. Earnix is headquartered in Boston, MA and has been innovating for insurers and banks since 2001 with customers in over 35 countries across six continents and offices in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, and Israel.

jobs.description:
Head of Growth

Location: Remote - Europe, Asia, the Middle East or Australia
Employment: Permanent
Function: Growth and Marketing

About the company

We’re working with a crypto security company that helps protect users from scams, phishing and malicious on-chain activity. Its consumer product identifies potential threats before users interact with suspicious websites or transactions.

The company has built an established user base and is now focused on reaching more active crypto users and expanding its distribution.

The role

We’re looking for a Head of Growth to lead user acquisition and retention for a consumer crypto product. You’ll work directly with the founders to set the growth strategy, identify the most valuable user segments and build new distribution channels.

The focus is on attracting and retaining users who meaningfully engage with the product—not simply increasing installs or sign-ups. You’ll build the growth function and take direct responsibility for its results.

What you’ll do

  • Own user growth and retention: Lead acquisition, activation and 30-day retention, with clear measures for acquisition cost, retained users and revenue.

  • Identify valuable user segments: Assess crypto audiences, trading behaviours and markets to prioritise users based on long-term value.

  • Build distribution partnerships: Develop relationships with wallets, exchanges, DeFi protocols, NFT platforms and other crypto products.

  • Grow through KOLs and communities: Work with crypto influencers, communities and industry partners to reach relevant audiences. Develop timely campaigns around security incidents and emerging threats.

  • Develop referral and product-led growth: Partner with engineering on referral incentives, sharing features and other ways users can introduce the product to others.

  • Test and scale acquisition channels: Experiment with search, sponsored newsletters, content, community distribution and browser extension store optimisation. Measure results and invest in channels that perform.

  • Own growth reporting and commercial outcomes: Track the journey from installation through activation, retention and user activity. Use the data to improve acquisition efficiency and show the impact of growth initiatives.

  • Work directly with the founders: Set priorities and targets, shape the strategy and lead execution.

Requirements

What we’re looking for

  • Proven B2C growth experience: You’ve helped scale a consumer product and can show measurable results in users, activation, retention or revenue. You can explain your personal contribution, the starting point and the outcome. Experience scaling a product from hundreds of thousands of users to millions is especially relevant.

  • Strong crypto knowledge and industry relationships: You understand DeFi, wallets, exchanges, trading behaviour and crypto communities. Relationships with protocols, KOLs, communities or distribution partners are a plus.

  • Experience growing beyond paid advertising: You’ve driven measurable growth through partnerships, referrals, communities, influencers, organic distribution or similar channels.

  • Strong commercial and analytical judgement: You understand how acquisition cost, activation, retention and user activity affect revenue. You use data to assess user quality and distinguish sustained engagement from sign-up volume.

  • Ability to build and execute independently: You’ve taken growth initiatives from planning through execution, tested different approaches and made decisions based on results. You’re comfortable setting targets and owning performance in a lean environment.

Why consider this role

You’ll lead the growth strategy for a crypto security product with an established user base and room to expand through new channels and partnerships. Working directly with the founders, you’ll have the scope to identify valuable audiences, test ideas and build a growth function with clear commercial impact.

Your work will also help bring tools that protect crypto users from scams and malicious activity to a wider audience.

Application questions

Please include brief answers to these questions with your application:

  1. Tell us about a consumer product you helped scale. What was its starting user base, how much did it grow, over what period, and which initiatives did you personally lead?

  2. Describe your experience growing a crypto product or acquiring crypto users. Which audiences did you target, how did you reach them, and what measurable results did you achieve?

  3. Give an example of an acquisition initiative you led that did not rely primarily on paid advertising. What channels did you use, and what results did they generate?

  4. How have you measured and improved the quality of users acquired? Which metrics did you track across acquisition, activation, retention and revenue, and how did they affect your decisions?

  5. Tell us about a time you built a growth strategy or function from scratch. How did you identify opportunities, prioritise channels and measure success?

Department: Director of Corporate Partnerships

About PolicyLink

PolicyLink is a research and action institute working to advance a nation that truly governs for all. We advance structural solutions, shape conditions, build connections, and strengthen the field infrastructure needed to deliver on the promise of a nation where all can thrive. We are relentlessly focused on delivering results at a scale that matches the challenges — and the potential — of this country.

To achieve this vision, we concentrate our efforts in five key arenas that shape how the nation governs and delivers for its people:

  • Thelegal and regulatory systemsthat shape our democracy and economy, including amending and advancing the U.S. Constitution

  • Federal agencies, which are the engines of public policy and implementation that must deliver results

  • State and local governmentsthat deliver the benefits of citizenship to our everyday lives in the cities and states where we live

  • We the People,whose collective consciousness and action must be activated toward everyone’s thriving

  • The institutional leaders, decision-makers, and capital allocatorswho hold disproportionate influence over how the nation governs

Across these arenas, we are working to awakena shared consciousnessthat embraces the humanity of every person; to shape government to deliver results for all; and to align the full force of our public, private, and civic resources to realize this future.

Position Overview

PolicyLink is seeking aDirector of Corporate Partnershipsto build and lead a corporate fundraising and engagement portfolio that advances PolicyLink's mission and Governing For All.

The Director of Corporate Partnerships builds and leads PolicyLink's corporate fundraising and engagement portfolio, supporting the goal of a $10 million three-year annual average from corporate partners by 2030. The Director develops relationships across corporate philanthropy, sponsorship, executive engagement, and mission-aligned strategic partnerships; creates compelling opportunities connected to Governing For All; and coordinates complex relationships across PolicyLink's executives, Programs, Communications, Finance, and Development teams. The role requires both revenue leadership and sound judgment about mission alignment, reputational risk, and organizational capacity.

The role joins a growing Development team of seven people, working across institutional, individual, and corporate giving.

Responsibilities

Corporate strategy and portfolio leadership

  • Develop and execute a multiyear corporate fundraising and engagement strategy aligned with Governing For All and annual revenue goals.

  • Build, qualify, segment, and manage a portfolio of corporate prospects and partners across industries and relationship types.

  • Research corporate priorities, giving programs, leadership interests, business context, and pathways to engagement.

  • Set portfolio goals, forecasts, cultivation strategies, and performance reviews in partnership with the Chief Philanthropy Officer.

Partnership design and revenue generation

  • Create corporate philanthropy, sponsorship, executive-engagement, and strategic-partnership opportunities that advance PolicyLink’s mission, including executive learning, visibility, employee engagement, or issue education, without creating obligations Programs cannot support.

  • Design partnership menus and sponsorship standards.

  • Lead cultivation, solicitation, negotiation, renewal, and upgrade strategies for assigned relationships, and secure new and renewed commitments that contribute to annual and Governing For All campaign goals.

  • Coordinate proposals, pitches, benefits, budgets, agreements, and internal approvals with Institutional Partnerships, Programs, Finance, Communications, Events, and legal counsel as needed.

Executive, partner, and team engagement

  • Prepare PolicyLink and corporate executives for meetings, briefings, convenings, and relationship-building opportunities.

  • Partner with the Donor Events and Stewardship Manager on cultivation experiences, recognition, and follow-up.

  • Build relationships with corporate foundations, corporate social impact leaders, business executives, and relevant intermediaries.

Portfolio operations, stewardship, and risk

  • Maintain complete Salesforce records, probability-weighted forecasts, relationship maps, contact reports, and next steps.

  • Track deliverables, restrictions, benefits, reporting, and recognition associated with corporate commitments and sponsorships.

  • Monitor corporate-philanthropy trends and advise leadership on opportunities, sensitivities, and reputational risks.

  • Apply PolicyLink's gift-acceptance, ethics, recognition, and mission-alignment standards throughout the partnership life cycle and maintain due-diligence practices.

Internal leadership and integration

  • Serve as PolicyLink's internal subject-matter leader on corporate fundraising and partnership development.

  • Create repeatable internal workflows for corporate partnership development.

  • Help executives and program leaders understand the corporate portfolio, priority opportunities, and appropriate engagement roles.

  • Coordinate with Institutional Partnerships so corporate and foundation relationships are managed coherently.

Skills, Abilities, and Knowledge Required

  • Strong corporate relationship-development, consultative partnership-design, negotiation, presentation, and proposal skills.

  • Ability to connect corporate interests with mission-aligned opportunities without compromising organizational values or overextending program capacity.

  • Strong judgment regarding gift acceptance, sponsorship, recognition, reputational risk, and corporate influence.

  • Ability to coordinate executives, Programs, Communications, Finance, legal counsel, events, and external partners.

  • Strong portfolio-management skills, including forecasting, relationship mapping, documentation, and disciplined follow-through.

  • Commitment to racial and economic equity and the mission of PolicyLink.

Experience Qualifications

  • A minimum of 7-10 years of progressive experience in corporate philanthropy, corporate partnerships, sponsorship, business development, institutional fundraising, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated success securing and renewing six- to seven-figure corporate commitments and managing complex, multistakeholder partnerships.

  • Experience developing partnerships involving executives, Programs, Communications, Finance, legal counsel, and events.

  • Experience managing staff, consultants, or cross-functional project teams is valuable.

  • Experience in policy, civic engagement, racial equity, social impact, or a national nonprofit is strongly preferred.

Compensation and Benefits

PolicyLink offers competitive salaries commensurate with the experience and skills of our employees. The starting salary range for this position is $140,000–$163,000.

Additionally, PolicyLink provides a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision plans.

  • 401(k) with employer and employer-matching contributions.

  • Flexible spending account.

  • Short- and long-term disability insurance.

  • Group term life insurance plus voluntary life insurance.

  • Minimum of 8 years experience in SAP Basis, with a minimum of three enterprise-scale S/4HANA transformation programs delivered in a Senior Platform leadership role.

  • You have a SAP certification in SAP Technology, HANA Administration, or SAP S/4HANA — and familiarity with SAP's evolving AI-native architecture (Joule, SAP Business AI Platform, SAP Knowledge Graph).

jobs.excerpt: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution.
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of our AI research team, you will drive innovation in model compression and efficient deployment for advanced multimodal AI systems, including large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). Your work will focus on reducing model footprint and computational cost while preserving accuracy, enabling high-performance AI to run efficiently across resource-constrained edge devices. You will apply and advance compression techniques such as quantization, knowledge distillation, and pruning to streamline complex multimodal architectures that integrate text, images, and audio.

We expect you to have deep expertise in model compression methods and a strong background in multimodal model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel compression strategies that balance model size, latency, throughput, and accuracy. Your responsibilities include building robust compression pipelines, establishing performance and fidelity metrics, and addressing bottlenecks in production inference. The ultimate goal is to deliver scalable, low-memory, low-latency AI systems on edge devices (i.e., smartphones) that maintain high fidelity and tangible real-world value.

Responsibilities

  • Apply low-bit quantization to reduce model size and inference latency for generative AI models (LLMs, VLMs, multimodal) while maintaining accuracy and output quality.

  • Leverage knowledge distillation to transfer capabilities from larger teacher models to smaller student models, enabling efficient multimodal reasoning across text, image, and audio inputs.

  • Implement pruning techniques to remove redundant parameters and attention heads, reducing computational overhead without sacrificing task performance.

  • Analyze trade-offs between model efficiency (size, latency, memory) and accuracy across quantization, distillation, and pruning methods; propose improvements based on empirical findings.

  • Research and apply mixed-precision quantization and other advanced compression strategies (e.g., adaptive pruning schedules, distillation with intermediate feature matching) to optimize the accuracy–performance balance.

  • Stay current with the latest research in model compression, including emerging techniques for multimodal and generative architectures.

  • Document methodologies, experiments, and results clearly to support reproducibility, internal collaboration, and stakeholder communication.

  • Author technical papers and publish findings in top-tier conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, AAAI) to advance the field of model compression for multimodal AI.

Requirements

List the qualifications, certifications, and experience needed for the role. You can split this into mandatory and preferred sections if needed.

  • A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

  • Experience with PyTorch deep learning frameworks or equivalent frameworks

  • Hands-on experience with model quantization including both Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) and Post-Training Quantization (PTQ).

  • Research and hands-on experience with knowledge distillation for compressing large models into smaller, efficient ones.

  • Research and hands-on experience with model pruning for compressing large models into smaller, efficient ones.

  • Solid understanding of neural network architectures and training processes – Including transformers (e.g., LLMs, VLMs), backpropagation, optimization, and fine-tuning techniques.

  • Familiarity with C++ is a plus (especially for implementing low-level quantization kernels or inference optimizations).

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

The Keet engine team works on the core that makes Keet tick: connecting peers, replicating data, syncing rooms, and keeping calls and file transfers fast and reliable across every kind of network. We're looking for an organized, curious Junior Project Manager to help keep that work moving.

You'll work closely with a globally distributed team of senior engineers, help turn priorities into clear plans, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks between releases.   • Track engine work across sprints and releases, keeping issues, milestones, and roadmaps current

  • Spot risks and blockers early and help the team resolve them

  • Highly organized, with strong attention to detail and follow-through

  • Comfortable working with engineers and learning technical concepts quickly

  • Experience with issue trackers and project tools (e.g. GitHub Issues/Projects, Jira, Linear)

  • Self-starter who thrives in a fully remote, async-first team

Preferred:

  • Basic understanding of networking or distributed systems concepts (P2P, DHTs, NAT traversal, replication)

  • Familiarity with software development lifecycles, Git, and release processes

  • Some exposure to JavaScript/ or experience working alongside a dev team

  • Interest in privacy, decentralization, or open-source software

  • Agile/Scrum knowledge or a certification (PSM, CAPM, etc.)

  • Experience working across many time zones

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Position summary:

The administrator will follow approved runbooks and security procedures to ensure secure privileged access and SLA compliance.

Key Responsibilities:

PAM Monitoring & Operations

  • Monitor PAM dashboards, alerts, scheduled jobs and platform availability.
  • Perform initial checks for failed password rotations, account synchronization and credential access issues.
  • Monitor privileged account onboarding status and password rotation compliance.
  • Perform basic health checks on PAM services and supported integrations.
  • Identify failed jobs, access errors and account-related exceptions and escalate unresolved issues to L2.
  • Maintain operational checklists and PAM monitoring records.

Privileged Access Support

  • Log and track privileged access requests through approved ITSM workflows.
  • Perform authorized routine tasks for account onboarding, access updates and credential access support.
  • Validate request approvals and required information before processing access requests.
  • Assist with password checkout and access troubleshooting using approved procedures.
  • Track password rotation failures and privileged account compliance exceptions.
  • Follow least-privilege requirements and never disclose or store credentials outside approved systems.

Operations & Service Management

  • Log, categorize, prioritize and track incidents and service requests in ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM tools.
  • Perform initial troubleshooting using approved runbooks and standard operating procedures.
  • Escalate critical PAM alerts, access failures and unresolved incidents within defined SLAs.
  • Maintain accurate ticket updates, operational records and shift handover documentation.
  • Coordinate with L2/L3, Security, Identity, Windows/Linux and Application teams.
  • Follow ITIL Incident, Change and Request Management processes.
  • Support routine audit evidence collection and operational reporting.
  • Ensure effective APAC–EMEA–NLAM shift handovers and uninterrupted 24x7 support.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience in IT infrastructure operations, access management, service desk or security operations.
  • Basic understanding of Privileged Access Management and privileged account security.
  • Familiarity with Thycotic/Delinea Secret Server or equivalent PAM tools.
  • Understanding of privileged accounts, password vaulting, password rotation and access approvals.
  • Basic knowledge of Active Directory, Windows/Linux accounts and service accounts.
  • Ability to perform monitoring, initial troubleshooting and ticket management using documented procedures.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms.
  • Understanding of incident prioritization, SLA compliance and escalation procedures.
  • Good communication, documentation and shift handover skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and adherence to security policies.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications:

  • Exposure to CyberArk or BeyondTrust PAM solutions.
  • Basic PowerShell or scripting knowledge.
  • Understanding of MFA, least privilege, access reviews and audit trails.
  • Familiarity with password rotation monitoring and privileged account onboarding.
  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent knowledge.
  • Exposure to enterprise security monitoring and compliance operations.

ParentSquare is rooted in a belief our founder held as a parent long before she started the company in 2011: when families are involved, students thrive. She leads ParentSquare to this day.

As the trusted leader in school-home engagement, we help schools reach the parents and guardians of more than 22 million students in 190+ languages through the channels families prefer, including app, text, email, and phone. Our all-in-one platform brings together communications, attendance, forms, payments, and websites to simplify how schools and families connect and take action. ParentSquare Intelligence, the AI and data layer built into ParentSquare, turns engagement and attendance data into insights that guide proactive outreach, so districts can offer families the right support at the right time. Over 42,000 schools in all 50 states use ParentSquare to build trust with their communities and save staff time.

The ParentSquare app consistently ranks among the top five free apps in the U.S., and we’ve been named to the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies four years in a row and to the Inc. Best Workplaces list for the past two years. We’re a diverse, remote-first team that cares about each other, and about the schools and families they serve. Sound like your kind of place? We’d love to have you help us build what’s next.

Who we’re looking for:

Charter schools are some of the most varied customers we serve, from a single campus to national networks operating across multiple states, and each one needs a partner who understands how it runs.

ParentSquare is seeking a Senior Customer Success Manager to be that partner across our charter portfolio, from single-site charters to national charter management organizations (CMOs) and education management organizations (EMOs). You’ll build relationships that drive satisfaction, usage, and clear ROI, keep retention and renewals strong, and find room for each customer to grow. As the single point of ownership for our medium, large, and enterprise networks, you’ll give each one a consistent relationship instead of separate contacts by state or region. You’ll work closely with Charter Sales, Support, Implementation, Product, and Finance to deepen relationships and drive adoption and advocacy across the charter sector.

Above all, you’ll bring our two permissions to play:

  • Humility. We’re heads-down builders who’d rather let the work speak. You share wins with Sales and Implementation, bring customer feedback to the team without needing credit, and ask for help early when a network’s needs outgrow the playbook.
  • Passion for our mission. When a network runs well on ParentSquare, every family at every campus hears from their school in the way and language that works for them, and you’ll be the one making that happen at scale

This role will include:

  • Owning a hybrid charter portfolio, from strategic CMO and EMO networks to a high volume of single sites and smaller regions
  • Serving as the single point of ownership for medium, large, and enterprise networks across every state and region they operate in
  • Building success plans with large networks that align on goals, drive adoption, and show clear ROI
  • Partnering with Implementation on large network launches, including data integration and system configuration
  • Running scaled onboarding for new regions and sites, plus 1:many programs like cohorted office hours, product workshops, and virtual user groups
  • Partnering with CS leadership and Charter Sales to spot high-growth networks and use health data to support network-level expansion
  • Owning renewals and retention across your book, resolving escalations and keeping key stakeholders confident
  • Leading demos and training as a product expert, and bringing customer feedback to Product and other teams to improve the experience

We're looking for someone who has:

  • 3+ years in Customer Success or Account Management at a SaaS company
  • Experience managing both strategic enterprise accounts and a high-volume book of smaller customers
  • A track record of partnering with Sales on expansion, including growing a single-site or regional relationship into a larger agreement
  • Experience supporting complex, multi-site implementations
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to prioritize across many accounts at once
  • Clear, confident communication with executive stakeholders and strong attention to detail

Bonus points for:

  • Charter school, CMO, or EMO experience
  • K-12 EdTech experience, especially with large district implementations
  • Familiarity with school communication tools, integration tools, or a student information system (SIS)

Why join us?

At ParentSquare, we believe in winning together and building a product that truly serves schools, educators, and families. We value transparency, collaboration, and an entrepreneurial spirit, and we look for team members who share these values. You’ll have the opportunity to own and grow our charter network relationships, influence a fast-growing company, and make a meaningful impact on K-12 education.

The perks of working for us are great! You’ll get your foot in the door as our company continues to grow. We’re big believers in work-life balance and provide:

  • Employer-paid health insurance (including dependent coverage)
  • An employer-matched 401K retirement savings program from day 1
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Stock options
  • Health + wellness reimbursements
  • Generous PTO
  • 15 paid holidays, including your birthday!

As a fully remote team, we’ll make sure you have all the tools and equipment you need to make your home office a place where you can thrive.

We're an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. We are committed to maintaining a drug-free workplace in compliance with applicable state laws.

The salary range for this role will be $80,000 $100,000, DOE.

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

Close processes built and configured end to end: task lists, dependencies, approvals and the automated steps between them. Senior Director, AI Engineering -Agentic AI Platform(Remote Eligible)

At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.


Team Description:

The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand-in-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact.


What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.
  • Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc.
  • Make high judgment build-vs-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more.
  • Invent and introduce state-of-the-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems.
  • Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One.
  • Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state-of-the-art in AI.
  • Define and drive enterprise-wide AI strategy, aligning product, research, risk, and data organizations around shared technical and ethical principles
  • Establish a multi-year roadmap for scalable, reliable, and compliant AI systems that serve as shared infrastructure across the enterprise
  • Champion Responsible-AI, ensuring ethical, transparent and explainable model practices are embedded in all lines of business
  • Oversee the scaling of AI operations - including model lifecycle management, observability, and cost efficiency - across hundreds of production use cases

The Ideal Candidate:

  • You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good
  • Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
  • You get fulfillment from empowering others to achieve their potential and you actively drive professional development through mentoring and coaching. You are hands-on when necessary and lead by example
  • You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven
  • You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss
  • You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown

Capital One is open to hiring a Remote or Hybrid Employee for this opportunity. If the role is designated as Hybrid, you are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location. If the role is designated as Remote, you are expected to adhere to Capital One's Remote Worker Expectations

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 10 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 8 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies
  • At least 5 years of people leadership experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience managing and leading an engineering team
  • 8+ years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)
  • Experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies (e.g. LLM Inference, Similarity Search and VectorDBs, Guardrails, Memory) using Python, C++, C#, Java, CUDA, or Golang
  • Experience in building agentic AI systems and agentic workflows
  • Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems, and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI concepts to peers
  • Demonstrated experience leading leaders and multiple AI engineering organizations across product, platform and applied research domains
  • Proven success in building enterprise-scale AI platforms and capabilities serving diverse business lines and customer use cases
  • Ability to influence executive leadership on AI investment strategy, organizational design, and risk management priorities
  • Experience establishing external partnerships or thought leadership presence in AI industry, academia, or open-source communities
  • Experience right-sizing models, instance counts, and hardware types given requirements (e.g., context length, token inputs, token outputs)
