jobs.title: Senior Director, Clinical Safety Physician
jobs.excerpt: About Avalyn:Avalyn aims to transform the treatment paradigm for pulmonary fibrosis and other serious, rare respiratory diseases.
jobs.description:
About Avalyn:

Avalyn aims to transform the treatment paradigm for pulmonary fibrosis and other serious, rare respiratory diseases. The company is advancing optimized inhaled formulations of established antifibrotic medicines designed to deliver drug directly to the lungs, enhance local efficacy, and reduce systemic side effects. Avalyn’s AP01 program is an optimized inhaled formulation of pirfenidone currently being evaluated in MIST, a global Phase 2b clinical trial in patients with progressive pulmonary fibrosis (PPF). AP01 has demonstrated encouraging safety and clinical activity across Phase 1b and an ongoing, multi-year open-label extension trial, with long-term data supporting the potential to preserve lung function while improving tolerability relative to historical oral pirfenidone. Avalyn’s AP02 program is an optimized inhaled formulation of nintedanib currently being evaluated in AURA, a global Phase 2 clinical trial in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF). Avalyn is also advancing AP03, an inhaled fixed-dose combination of pirfenidone and nintedanib, designed to deliver multiple antifibrotic mechanisms through a single lung-targeted platform. By leveraging its proprietary drug-device approach and deep expertise in rare respiratory disease development, Avalyn aims to establish a new standard of care in pulmonary fibrosis through inhaled, lung-targeted therapies. For more information, please visit avalynpharma.com and follow the company on LinkedIn.

Position Overview:

The Senior Director, Clinical Safety Physician provides medical leadership and oversight of drug safety across Avalyn’s portfolio of inhaled antifibrotic investigational products. The role is accountable for the ongoing medical evaluation, surveillance, interpretation, documentation, and communication of emerging safety data, including adverse event assessment, signal detection, and characterization of potential risks, ensuring that safety findings are appropriately incorporated into clinical development and risk management decisions. This is a hands-on leadership role suited to a clinical-stage, scaling biotech company. The Senior Director directly reviews adverse event cases, safety listings, and aggregate safety data, identifies and assesses emerging safety signals, and provides medical recommendations to inform ongoing study conduct and development decisions. The individual also serves as the medical safety lead across Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Biostatistics, Data Management, Medical Writing, Quality Assurance, and external CRO and pharmacovigilance (PV) partners. The Senior Director integrates safety considerations into clinical development strategy and execution, establishes and oversees fit-for-purpose pharmacovigilance processes and systems, and provides medical safety leadership in interactions with senior leadership, governance committees, external partners, and health authorities. The Senior Director reports to the SVP Clinical Development and partners closely with cross-functional leadership to ensure appropriate medical oversight of safety across the portfolio.

Responsibilities:

Medical Safety Leadership & Oversight

  • Provide medical leadership and oversight of safety across Avalyn’s clinical-stage investigational products, including the inhaled pirfenidone (AP01), nintedanib (AP02), and fixed-dose combination (AP03) programs.
  • Perform medical review and assessment of serious adverse events (SAEs), adverse events of special interest (AESIs), deaths, discontinuations due to adverse events, and other medically significant events, including assessment of seriousness, causality, expectedness, and clinical significance.
  • Review case narratives and ensure appropriate follow-up of medically important information.
  • Apply clinical judgment to distinguish drug-related safety findings from manifestations of the underlying disease (e.g., progression of pulmonary fibrosis, acute exacerbations), concomitant illness, and background events.
  • Identify, evaluate, and escalate potentially important safety findings, and provide medical judgment on emerging concerns and their implications for development.

Clinical Trial Safety

  • Provide ongoing safety oversight of Phase 1–3 clinical trials through periodic review of aggregate adverse events, laboratory abnormalities, vital signs, ECGs, pulmonary safety parameters, and other clinically relevant safety data.
  • Review blinded and, when appropriate, unblinded safety information in accordance with established study procedures.
  • Provide medical safety input into clinical trial design and execution, including protocols, safety monitoring plans, informed consent documents, and protocol amendments, ensuring appropriate safety assessments, monitoring requirements, and risk mitigation measures are incorporated.
  • Provide medical safety expertise and support Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) / Independent Data Monitoring Committee (IDMC) activities as appropriate.
  • Lead cross-functional safety review meetings with Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, and Data Management.

Signal Detection & Benefit-Risk Assessment

  • Lead medical safety surveillance across Avalyn’s development programs; proactively identify, investigate, and medically evaluate potential safety signals, integrating individual cases with aggregate clinical, laboratory, and nonclinical data.
  • Develop documented medical assessments of emerging safety signals and recommend additional evaluation, monitoring, or risk-mitigation strategies.
  • Lead and maintain an evolving benefit-risk assessment for each investigational product, integrating safety with efficacy, pharmacology, and nonclinical information in the context of the disease and patient population.
  • Evaluate how emerging safety findings may affect dose selection, eligibility criteria, safety monitoring, endpoints, trial execution, and provide medical recommendations regarding protocol modifications, risk-mitigation measures, and broader clinical development strategy when warranted.
  • Partner with Biostatistics to interpret safety data by exposure, dose, treatment duration, subpopulation, and risk factors.

Aggregate Safety & Regulatory Reporting

  • Lead medical review of Development Safety Update Reports (DSURs) and other periodic safety reports, and review the safety sections of Investigator’s Brochures and Reference Safety Information.
  • Provide medical oversight and support IND safety reporting, suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions (SUSAR) assessment, and expedited reporting.
  • Contribute to integrated and aggregate safety analyses and provide medical safety input to clinical and regulatory submissions.
  • Ensure medical safety assessments and conclusions are medically sound, scientifically supported, and clearly documented to support regulatory compliance and defensible clinical development decisions.

Safety Governance & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead program-level safety review meetings and prepare safety assessments and presentations for clinical development and senior management governance, including the Development Review Committee (DRC).
  • Ensure significant safety concerns are promptly escalated and appropriately communicated to relevant stakeholders; partner with Clinical Development leadership, the Program Leads, and the Chief Medical Officer on safety-related development decisions.
  • Serve as the medical safety lead and primary clinical safety interface across Clinical Development, PV, Regulatory, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Data Management, Quality, and external vendors.
  • Exercise independent medical judgment on safety matters, and respect the autonomous authorities of Medical, Regulatory, and Quality.

PV Vendor Oversight, Infrastructure & Inspection Readiness

  • Provide medical oversight of outsourced pharmacovigilance activities, including medical review, escalation, reconciliation, and communication processes with PV vendors and CROs.
  • Review and provide medical oversight of PV plans, procedures, deliverables, quality metrics, and vendor performance; participate in vendor governance and address performance or process gaps.
  • Help establish and maintain a fit-for-purpose pharmacovigilance system appropriate to a growing biotech, without importing unnecessarily burdensome large-pharma infrastructure.
  • Contribute to safety SOPs, work instructions, safety management plans, and governance processes, with clear interfaces across PV, Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Data Management, Regulatory Affairs, and Quality.
  • Support PV audits, inspection readiness, CAPAs, and documentation of medical safety decisions.

Regulatory Interactions

  • Provide medical safety expertise for interactions with FDA, EMA, and other health authorities, including responses to regulatory safety questions and preparation of briefing materials.
  • Participate in regulatory meetings as appropriate and contribute safety expertise to INDs, CTAs, and other regulatory submissions.

Material Nonpublic Information (MNPI)

  • Recognize that safety findings (e.g., a Data Monitoring Committee recommendation, a clinical hold, a death, or a significant emerging signal) may constitute material nonpublic information and must be handled and disclosed appropriately.
  • Communicate potentially material safety information to functional leadership and the Program Lead simultaneously, and ensure it is shared with the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) in parallel with the Project Team.

jobs.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer (Playwright)
jobs.excerpt: Why Valtech?  We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands.
jobs.description:
Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

You’ll be the person a squad trusts to make test automation reliable. You design and own the Playwright framework, work closely with developers and the client, and use AI agents as a normal part of how you build and maintain tests. You also help the engineers around you get better at all of it. You work independently, plan your own work, and influence how your team and the wider QA community operate.

Role responsibilities

  • Design, build and roll out Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript) automation frameworks, and keep them stable as suites grow
  • Test APIs and microservice-based systems alongside the UI
  • Run BDD collaboratively with analysts, developers and the client
  • Diagnose flaky and intermittent failures, and find root causes instead of adding retries
  • Use AI coding agents to speed up test design, authoring and maintenance, and rigorously verify what they produce
  • Help define how AI-assisted and agent-driven testing is done on your project, including instruction files, reusable prompts and review gates
  • Extend automation coverage into mobile as the project needs, with support
  • Coach colleagues and share what works in the QA community
  • Explain quality risk and technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Must have qualifications

  • 5+ years in test automation, including 2+ years of hands-on Playwright with TypeScript/JavaScript in production
  • Strong command of Playwright’s core model: fixtures, locator strategy, auto-waiting, network interception and mocking, trace-based debugging, parallel execution
  • Experience testing responsive and mobile-web behavior with Playwright (device emulation, viewports, touch, cross-browser)
  • Proven experience defining and implementing a framework architecture, not only extending one
  • API automation and microservices testing, with HTTP and network inspection tools
  • CI/CD experience with any major pipeline tool
  • Practical BDD experience in an Agile team
  • A working AI-assisted practice: you can show how you generate tests with AI, and how you catch tests that pass but prove nothing
  • The confidence to question and challenge from a testing perspective, and the curiosity to become a subject-matter expert quickly

Nice to have qualifications

  • Hands-on native mobile automation on iOS and/or Android, ideally Appium with WebdriverIO
  • Experience with another automation stack (Selenium-based or a non-JS framework)
  • Experience building or orchestrating multi-step AI agent workflows for test generation, execution or triage
  • Performance or cloud testing exposure
  • Mentoring, conference talks, or blogging

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

  • Private health insurance
    We hope you will never need it, but nevertheless, we offer private health insurance to all our employees.

  • Education program
    We never stop learning, that’s why we offer our employees an educational program with training and certification.

  • Wellbeing program
    We all deserve to live a healthy and well-balanced life. It's not an option, it's a necessity!

  • Free beverages
    Enjoy free coffee, drinks, and snacks at work, or join one of our famous company dinners.

  • Events
    We enjoy spending time together, not only at work. Ski trips, carting, laser-tag, wine tasting, picnics, cooking classes… you name it – we’ve done it! There are plenty of cool events to join and to get to know your colleagues.

  • Competitive conditions
    Besides a competitive salary and 24 days of vacation, you will join annual company events with the whole team.

  • Challenging projects
    Ready for a challenge? We guarantee you'll find challenging projects at Valtech!
  • Cool colleagues
    What's the most important thing in a job? Cool colleagues with whom you spent most of the time during the week. We have a lot of them!
  • Honest feedback
    Honesty, openness and respect are among our core values. We encourage an open feedback culture in order to build trust and grow together.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud!

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

The role will engage leading enterprises, institutions, and governments globally, helping them deploy AI solutions built around local computing, data sovereignty, privacy, and independence from centralized cloud infrastructure.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining exceptional commercial and relationship-building capabilities with deep AI knowledge. You will identify and prioritize opportunities, structure complex projects, close strategic partnerships, monitor success of partnerships and build the team required to scale Tether AI globally.

The ideal candidate can comfortably move between technical discussions with AI and engineering teams and strategic conversations with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, and government leaders and should be used to work in multiple geographies/ cultures.

International travel is required.

Market Strategy & Execution

  • Identify priority markets, industries, and high-value AI use cases.

  • Co-develop with clients their requirements and translate them into deployable solutions together with product and engineering teams.

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead the AI Expansion team globally.

  • Recruit expansion managers, partnership leads, solution architects, and other key profiles.

  • Establish KPIs, execution playbooks, and commercial processes.

  • Work closely with Tether’s AI, engineering, product, and regional Expansion teams.

Strategic Representation

  • Position Tether as a strategic partner for organizations seeking AI sovereignty, privacy, resilience, and infrastructure independence.

  • Represent Tether AI in strategic meetings, government engagements, conferences, and industry forums.

Requirements

You Have

  • 7+ years of experience across AI, enterprise technology, infrastructure, or technology business development.

  • Strong knowledge of AI/ML, LLMs, inference, local/edge computing, data infrastructure, and decentralized architectures.

  • Proven experience personally originating, structuring, and closing large enterprise technology deals and partnerships.

  • Experience building and managing high-performing teams.

Important information for candidates

MPLC provides a legal way to show movies and TV in public or commercial spaces across the globe. Our business has been running for over 30 years, and we are the number one trusted partner to studios and producers for public performance licensing. We work with every major Hollywood studio and hundreds of independents, and we are a key player in the entertainment and intellectual property ecosystem.

We are on a truly exciting journey as a company. We're growing quickly, investing in our teams, and have bold plans for the future. To support that growth, we're looking for a Principal GTM Data Operations Engineer to join our Data team.

The Role in Three Bullets
  • Own the quality standard and roadmap for our US and UK go-to-market data pipeline, targeting 90% first-pass sales acceptance.
  • Lead a small technical team as a player-coach: set the standards and stay hands-on.
  • Evolve the platform from a batch pipeline into a signal-driven system that routes the right accounts to the right sales pod at the right time.

Let's be honest!

This is a player-coach role: you will lead an international team and stay hands-on with the systems, not just manage from a distance. You will be held to clear numbers (data quality, sales acceptance rates and the pipeline your team creates), and you will also be rebuilding a batch pipeline into a signal-driven platform while it runs. If you want a purely strategic or purely hands-on role, this is not it.

If you need a bit more information...

We are hiring a senior technical leader to own and scale MPLC's go-to-market data platform: an AI-driven pipeline that sources, enriches, qualifies and de-duplicates accounts, then delivers them rep-ready into Salesforce and our sales engagement platform. Success is measured on data quality, sales acceptance rates and the pipeline your team creates.

Why you'll love this role
  • Clay expertise: enrichment tables, waterfall logic and AI agents in production, with credit spend under control.
  • Python: build, maintain and debug scraping and data pipeline scripts without a developer on call.
  • Quality standards: you have defined "sales-ready" and built the QA process and SOPs to enforce it.
  • Salesforce fluency: field mapping, deduplication logic and CRM hygiene.
  • Systems thinking: connect scrapers, enrichment, governance tools, Salesforce and AI agents through APIs, webhooks and MCP, and document it for clean handover.
  • AI-first: you have shipped AI agents in a production GTM pipeline and measured the results.
  • Leadership: you have led or mentored at least one technical peer, and work well with IT, Salesforce admins and engineers on security and data access.

Experience we are looking for
  • 8+ years in GTM engineering, revenue operations engineering or B2B data engineering, with direct go-to-market impact.
  • Experience with a deduplication or governance platform (Openprise, RingLead or similar).
  • A strong plus: building net-new account detection pipelines using company registry data, ZoomInfo, Dun & Bradstreet or similar.

Benefits

  • Salary between £65,000 and £75,000 per year depending on experience
  • Remote role with occasional travel
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Private health insurance with optical and dental cover and an online GP service
  • Life insurance

Overview

The CDC Foundation is seeking a candidate for a full-time Senior Health Communications Specialist who will provide strategic support, technical assistance, and communications leadership for a team working to build an evidence base for effective drowning prevention strategies in the United States. This position is key to leading the development and implementation of a strategic communication plan in support of programmatic priorities and goals. This position will also lead the implementation of a wide array of health communication and dissemination activities designed to impact positive health outcomes related to water safety and drowning prevention.

The Senior Health Communications Specialist's primary responsibility will be leading communication and information dissemination for the Understanding and Preventing Drowning program. Specifically, this position will provide support in the areas of communication planning and strategy, message development, storytelling related to program initiatives, program website development and maintenance, coordination on communication strategy and output with partner organizations, and other related activities. As the Senior Health Communications Specialist, this role will lead communications strategy and initiatives for the Understanding and Preventing Drowning team, advising senior program leadership, providing communications guidance and mentorship to other program team members, and executing the program's communications activities.

A key aspect of the Senior Health Communication Specialist role will be aligning and delivering communications and other external facing outputs across a broad program portfolio that includes several partner organizations including groups delivering swim skills training to children and youth, state and local health departments, university-based research groups, and drowning prevention and water safety organizations operating at the local, state, national, and global levels.

Qualifications and Necessary Skills

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in the field of communications, preferably within the public health or drowning prevention-related arena, including experience developing and executing a broad range of communication and media strategies.
  • Experience independently representing organizations to media members, or past experience as a news reporter, producer, or editor.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead the production of communication products, documents and presentation materials that are high quality and error-free.
  • Experience working with diverse stakeholders, including senior leadership, subject matter experts, external partners and donor organizations.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Strong understanding of communication theory and its application to strategy.
  • Experience engaging community partners and providing capacity building/skill-based support.
  • Experience working on diverse health communications and social marketing campaigns.
  • Cross-cultural competence and ability to work with a variety of partners from varying backgrounds.
  • Experience translating scientific information into easy-to-understand language for non-scientific audiences.
  • Ability to engage with, listen to and learn from a broad range of partners, encouraging meaningful participation and developing productive working relationships with colleagues and partners.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to meet deadlines, prioritize and stay organized.
  • Experience working in a virtual environment with remote partners and teams.
  • Willingness to travel domestically (up to 10% annually).
  • Experience developing and managing effective social media content that translates complex public health information into clear, engaging, and audience-appropriate messages.
  • Experience managing website content, structure, and enhancement projects, including collaborating with web developers, designers, and subject matter experts to optimize user experience.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status, and all other characteristics protected by law. About the CDC Foundation

The CDC Foundation is an independent nonprofit authorized by Congress to mobilize philanthropic partners to support the public health system, including the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), in preventing and responding to threats to health. EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:


Within EverPro, Invoice Simple serves one-person businesses and microbusinesses across industries and countries. Its highly rated, mobile-first product helps customers create estimates, send invoices and get paid without becoming software experts. Our ambition is to become the financial operating system for one-person businesses, helping them get paid, manage their money and grow while staying radically simple.


Invoice Simple has global reach, hundreds of thousands of customers and a meaningful payments business. We are investing in customer growth, financial workflows and AI that completes useful work, not just answers questions.


This is a builder’s role. We want a designer who prototypes at speed, often with AI tools, puts ideas in front of customers early, and works as a true partner to product and engineering rather than at the end of a handoff. You’ll report to the Design Manager.


What You’ll Own in Your First Year

  • Shipped, measurable improvements to onboarding and early customer experiences.
  • Thoughtful information architecture for the features you design, so new capabilities fit naturally into the app.
  • A faster design rhythm, with ideas tested as interactive prototypes with customers in days.
  • Contributions to our design system that keep new features consistent and simple across iOS, Android and web.
  • AI-powered experiences that feel natural, trustworthy and easy to control.
  • Strong, trusted working relationships with your product and engineering partners.

Responsibilities

  • Prototype fast, learn faster: Turn ideas into interactive prototypes in hours or days, using Figma, AI prototyping tools or code. Put them in front of customers early, learn what works and iterate before engineering time is committed.
  • Protect simplicity as the product grows: As Invoice Simple expands into payments, bookkeeping and AI, help answer the information architecture questions in your areas: where new capabilities live, what stays out of the way, and how navigation scales without clutter. Help the product do more while feeling like it does less.
  • Think beyond the screen: Look across the journeys you work on to find the biggest experience problems and opportunities. Bring evidence-based recommendations that help your squad decide what to tackle next.
  • Design for outcomes: Work toward your squads’ activation, retention and conversion goals. Design experiments, read results with your PM and analyst, and let customer behaviour shape the next iteration.
  • Design AI people trust: Create experiences where AI completes real work for customers while keeping them informed and in control, especially when money is involved.
  • Be a seamless partner: Work side by side with product managers and engineers from discovery through delivery. Share work early, sweat the implementation details, and contribute to our design system so quality holds across iOS, Android and web.

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • 3+ years designing digital products, with a portfolio of shipped mobile and web work and the impact it had.
  • Strong interaction design skills and a solid grasp of information architecture, including simplifying complex workflows for non-technical users.
  • Rapid prototyping skills in Figma and AI-assisted prototyping or coding tools. Be ready to show something you prototyped quickly.
  • Experience designing consumer, SMB or self-serve products. Experience with growth goals such as activation, conversion or retention is an asset.
  • Comfort with research and data: running customer sessions, reading analytics and designing experiments.
  • Familiarity with native iOS and Android patterns and with working in a design system.
  • Experience with payments, fintech or financial products is an asset.
  • A maker at heart who would rather show an idea than describe it.
  • Obsessed with simplicity and willing to fight for it.
  • Curious about customers and how they actually work.
  • Collaborative and low ego, eager to learn and open to feedback.
  • Sweats the details while keeping the whole customer journey in mind.
  • Excited to help one-person businesses succeed, without adding complexity.

Where:

The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in Canada – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.


Benefits & Perks:

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Robust wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
  • 3 weeks of vacation to start, a paid volunteer day of your choosing, plus 2 floating holidays to celebrate anything of significance to you
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with 4% company match

Compensation: The target base compensation for this position is $80,000 to $95,000 CAD per year. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

jobs.title: Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) & Co-founder - AI for Small Law Firms
jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityAI is changing the economics of legal practice.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

AI is changing the economics of legal practice. Work that once took hours can increasingly be done in minutes, creating both enormous leverage for lawyers and new pressure to win and serve more clients efficiently.

Yet solo practitioners and small law firms still operate with many of the same constraints: missed calls, slow follow-up, intake handled between client matters, inconsistent marketing, and administrative work competing with billable time. Building larger intake, administrative, and marketing teams is expensive and increasingly unnecessary.

BloomLex is building a different model: a managed AI workforce that helps small law firms grow without growing their team.

The customer thesis has been validated through live pilots, and multiple deployments are moving into production evaluation. The next phase is proving in-production reliability, delivery economics, repeatability, and scalability. The companies that successfully deploy trusted AI workers into professional-service verticals over the next 18 months have an opportunity to define entirely new categories. We intend to be one of them.

The Venture

BloomLex is building an AI workforce for solo practitioners and small law firms, helping them win and serve more clients without adding headcount.

We call the broader shift the Rise of the Solo: AI gives an individual lawyer or small firm access to capabilities that historically required a much larger organization.

Unlike self-serve software, BloomLex is fully managed. We configure, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve the AI workforce for each firm. Our customers evaluate us on outcomes — calls answered, prospective clients captured, consultations booked, demand generated, follow-up completed, and time saved — not on how much software they configure themselves.

Our AI workforce starts with two teammates:

Ava — AI Front Desk. Ava answers calls 24/7, handles structured intake, screens and routes inquiries, books consultations, performs outbound callbacks and follow-up, and integrates those interactions into the firm's workflow.

Claire — AI Marketing Assistant. Claire helps firms generate and nurture demand through content, digital marketing, campaign management and optimization, lead nurturing, and ongoing marketing execution.

Together, Ava and Claire address both sides of growth: Claire helps create demand; Ava helps ensure that demand is captured and converted.

They are also the beginning, not the end, of the platform. Our roadmap expands the AI workforce across the operational side of the practice — including custom workflows and additional specialized AI roles — all delivered through the same managed model and coordinated around the lawyer.

The Partnership

The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, live pilots are running, and the technology and deployment infrastructure are being built for scale.

What remains is to complete the founding team with a commercial co-founder — someone who will own revenue and go-to-market with the same conviction, urgency, and sense of ownership as the CEO and CTO.

This is not a role where you inherit a sales team, a mature playbook, and a predictable funnel. You will help discover and build those things.

You will personally close early customers, determine which channels scale, refine the commercial model from real market evidence, and then build the organization capable of repeating it.

This is a co-founder and leadership role, not simply a sales hire. You will join the CEO and CTO as one of three co-founders, with founder-level equity, founder-level responsibility, and a meaningful voice in go-to-market, pricing, hiring, fundraising, product direction, and company strategy.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CRO, you will own the commercial journey from first conversation through acquisition, retention, and expansion.

  • Early Revenue — Personally convert pilots and prospects into paying customers and establish the first repeatable sales motion across solo practitioners and firms of up to five lawyers.

  • Go-to-Market — Refine and operationalize our ICP, positioning, messaging, and Rise of the Solo narrative, turning them into outreach, demos, pipeline, and closed revenue.

  • Pipeline & Channels — Determine which acquisition channels actually work — outbound, content, paid acquisition, referrals, partnerships, communities, events, and others — and concentrate resources behind the ones that can scale.

  • Partnerships & Distribution — Build relationships with legal business coaches, bar associations, legal communities, consultants, complementary technology providers, and other potential distribution partners.

  • Pricing & Commercial Economics — Own pricing, packaging, expansion strategy, customer acquisition economics, retention targets, and the path toward increasing revenue per firm as the AI workforce expands.

  • Customer Success & Retention — Stay close to early customers, understand why they buy and why they stay, and build the commercial processes that turn adoption into retention, expansion, referrals, and advocacy.

  • Customer Proof — Turn early wins into measurable case studies, testimonials, references, and commercial proof around the outcomes lawyers care about.

  • Fundraising — Help tell the growth story to investors through credible traction, metrics, unit economics, forecasts, and a clear path to scale.

  • Team — Once the motion is working, recruit and lead the sales, partnerships, and customer-success organization needed to scale it.

Co-Founder Profile

We're looking for a builder first and a sales executive second.

You are likely someone who has spent enough time inside an established company to know how a professional revenue organization works — but would rather build one than inherit one.

You should bring:

  • A strong record of full-cycle selling, ideally into the legal market or another fragmented SMB/professional-services vertical.

  • The confidence to personally prospect, run demos, negotiate, close, onboard, and expand early customers before hiring people to do it for you.

  • A strong understanding of how small-business buyers make decisions, what creates trust, and how to turn an early-stage product into a compelling commercial proposition.

  • Ideally, an existing network within legal technology, solo and small-firm legal communities, bar associations, legal services, or adjacent channels.

  • Strong commercial judgment — including the willingness to challenge assumptions about positioning, pricing, channels, or markets when the evidence says we should.

  • Entrepreneurial drive: you are ready to move from selling someone else's company to building one of your own.

  • Comfort with an early-stage compensation model weighted heavily toward ownership and revenue creation rather than a conventional executive salary.

  • The ability to operate as a principal, not an employee — making decisions with the long-term value of the company in mind and doing whatever work is necessary at this stage to move it forward.

Early-stage go-to-market leadership, experience selling AI or automation products, and experience selling into the legal profession are strongly preferred. Candidates should be able to operate effectively across North American time zones.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

The Associate Claims Examiner is an entry-level role dedicated to processing and managing low-complexity insurance claims for our policyholders. This is a highly influential role where you'll shape the future of data architecture at ENSEK. You'll lead our evolution towards a pragmatic data mesh model, enabling domain teams to take ownership of trustworthy, discoverable, and governed data products that power internal decision making, customer-facing solutions, and AI-driven innovation.

Working closely with Principal Engineers, Engineering Managers, Product leaders and Data Protection specialists, you'll define the architectural standards, platforms and practices that make data a first-class citizen in how ENSEK builds software.

  • Lead the introduction of a pragmatic data mesh approach, enabling teams to produce, govern and consume data products consistently across the organisation.

  • Drive key architectural decisions through technical leadership and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

  • Establish standards for event-driven data architectures, schema governance, data lifecycle management and data product ownership.

  • Shape ENSEK's self-service data platform by creating golden paths that simplify adoption across engineering teams.

The ideal candidate WILL HAVE: Bachelor's degree plus 3+ years of product, business analysis, or project-related experience in a high-volume environment, strong Agile methodology expertise, and hands-on experience implementing AI or emerging technology solutions.

The Product Owner owns an assigned healthcare technology product end to end, from vision and roadmap through delivery, release, and continuous improvement. This role brings hands-on experience delivering AI-enabled, HIPAA-compliant web applications to the hospital/provider revenue cycle space, where Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) experience is valued but not required.


The Product Owner partners with security, architecture, design, engineering, and business and client stakeholders to build new products from zero to one, enhance user workflows, and deliver solutions that increase efficiency and reduce cost. The ideal candidate combines analytical rigor, product insight, and an entrepreneurial spirit, and is accountable for the measurable business impact of the product.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:


Product Ownership and Strategy

  • Own the assigned product end to end, including vision, roadmap, prioritization, delivery, release management, and ongoing performance.
  • Take accountability for validating market and user opportunities and for the cross-functional success of the product, from engineering and design through launch and adoption.
  • Translate business and client needs into a clear product vision and ensure development teams understand and align to it.
  • Translate product vision into actionable implementation plans, and prioritize features and enhancements based on user needs, analytics, and business impact.

Agile Delivery and Backlog Management

  • Facilitate all Agile and sprint ceremonies with the development team, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

  • Work with project managers and technical leads to determine scope, priorities, and timelines for development cycles.
  • Inspire and motivate development teams to deliver innovative solutions with an appropriate sense of urgency.

Release Management and Change Governance

  • Own the release cycle for the assigned product, including planning, readiness, and successful delivery of each release.
  • Communicate planned and completed releases to the Enterprise Change Advisory Board (CAB) and other affected stakeholders, in line with enterprise change management practices.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with security, architecture, design, engineering, and QA teams to ensure solutions are secure, scalable, user-centered, and well-designed.
  • Collaborate with product owners and teams across the product organization to leverage existing solutions and shared platforms, and develop new capabilities only where necessary.

  • Support learning initiatives that build AI fluency and promote healthy, responsible adoption within the team.
  • Stay current on technology and industry trends, contribute to team knowledge sharing, and serve as a go-to resource for product leadership and delivery.

Security, Compliance, AI Governance, and Trust

  • Ensure products are designed and delivered in compliance with HIPAA and other applicable healthcare privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.
  • Take part in AI governance, helping define and uphold standards for responsible, transparent, and compliant use of AI in the product and across the organization.

Preferred:

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

Job Title: Senior Director - Payments Strategy

Job Location: Boston, MA

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Systems is seeking an accomplished and driven Senior Director of Strategy to drive the adoption and growth of our clinical trial payments solution, Veeva Payments, within the Veeva Clinical Operations suite.
This strategic leader will be responsible for defining, building, and driving the market adoption and growth of our industry-leading Payments solution. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of strategy, commercial execution, and knowledge of clinical trial budgeting, site contracting, and investigator payments within the Life Sciences industry. This role requires the ability to operate at an executive strategy level while simultaneously driving detailed, cross-functional execution to streamline how sponsors and CROs budget, contract, and pay clinical research sites.

What You'll Do

    • Drive Go-to-Market Strategy - Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to increase adoption and usage of Veeva Payments among Life Sciences companies (Sponsors, CROs, and emerging biotechs), aligning with Veeva’s broader Clinical Operations and Development Cloud vision
    • Engage with Customers - Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert to executive stakeholders, articulating the measurable value of a connected payments solution in improving site payment speed, budget visibility, financial accuracy, and site satisfaction
    • Support Sales Teams - Partner deeply with Veeva’s sales organization to define target accounts, educate customers on the advantages of a modern, cloud-native payments application that generates payable items directly from trial execution data, support strategic sales cycles, and ensure revenue goals are achieved
    • Industry Thought Leadership - Represent Veeva as the primary evangelist for clinical trial payments and site financial technology at key industry events, conferences, and executive customer meetings to drive awareness, define market opportunity, and establish credibility
    • Cross-Functional Collaboration - Work closely with Veeva’s Product Management, Marketing, and Services teams to refine core positioning and messaging, shape the future Payments roadmap based on market demand, and ensure seamless delivery and customer success
    • Market Insights & Feedback - Continuously gather detailed customer feedback on site payment and trial budgeting pain points, identify emerging trends in site financial management and investigator retention, and provide actionable insights to enhance the Payments product and overall business strategy

Requirements

    • 10+ years of progressive experience in strategic leadership, business development, or product/go-to-market strategy, specifically within a clinical software/SaaS/PaaS environment
    • Proven Operator: A track record as a successful leader who can seamlessly transition between high-level strategy and detailed execution/project management
    • Exceptional Communication: Strong presentation skills with the ability to articulate complex operational and technical concepts to diverse audiences (technical teams, clinical operations and finance leaders, and C-level executives)
    • Education: Bachelor’s degree required

Nice to Have

    • Payments Domain Expertise: Deep experience leading go-to-market strategy or implementation for clinical trial payment or site financial management solutions; understanding the nuances of fee schedules, clinical trial agreements, study budgets, and accounts payable integration is a core competency
    • Clinical Operations Expertise: Specific experience with the operational and financial workflows of clinical research sites, sponsors, and CROs
    • Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with GCP, ICH guidelines, and the compliance considerations of investigator payments, including fair market value and transparency reporting
    • Advanced Degree: MBA or advanced degree in a related field is a plus

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A personality assessment (unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously)
        3. A practical case exercise
        4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $150,000 - $300,000

Key Account Manager OEM

Här får du arbeta med stora industrikunder, utveckla redan etablerade affärer och samtidigt hitta nya möjligheter hos både befintliga och nya kunder.

Du erbjuds en roll där framgång märks. Genom aktivitet, uthållighet och förmågan att förstå kundens verksamhet får du möjlighet att påverka både försäljningen och hur OEM-affären utvecklas framåt.

Om tjänstenSom Key Account Manager ansvarar du för våra viktigaste OEM kunder. Det handlar om affärer med betydande volymer, långa säljcykler och stor utvecklingspotential. Kunderna är större industriföretag med flera beslutsfattare och kontaktytor. Du arbetar dig brett in i kundens organisation och bygger relationer inom bland annat inköp, R&D, konstruktion, produktledning och försäljning. En viktig del av rollen är att komma in tidigt i kundens utvecklingsprojekt, identifiera nya designmöjligheter och skapa förutsättningar för att DENSIQs lösningar blir en del av kundens produkter och plattformar.

Placeringen är flexibel och du kan utgå från Göteborg eller Stockholm. Om du bor i Västra Götaland kan du ha din bas på vårt huvudkontor i Västra Frölunda.

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

  • Utveckla strategiska OEM kunder genom tydliga kundplaner, aktiviteter och tillväxtinitiativ

  • Driva affären utifrån omsättning, marginal, pipeline och forecast

  • Arbeta aktivt med offerter, uppföljning, förhandlingar och försäljningsresultat

  • Leda kundspecifika projekt, tester och workshops

  • Identifiera och bearbeta nya kunder och affärsmöjligheter

  • Samla rätt interna kompetenser för att föra affären framåt

  • Samarbeta med kollegor och systerbolag även utanför Sverige

Vad har Daniel, Business Manager Leak sealing, att säga om bolaget?

"Det jag gillar med DENSIQ är att man får möjlighet att påverka på riktigt. Vi har otroligt mycket teknisk kompetens och ett starkt erbjudande, men också mycket kvar att utveckla i hur vi förstår våra kunder och skapar affärer tillsammans med dem.

DENSIQ har en stor potential, och det som motiverar mig är möjligheten att ta ansvar, driva idéer framåt och vara med och forma vår fortsatta utveckling. För mig är det just kombinationen av människor, teknik, kund och affär som gör DENSIQ till en väldigt spännande plats att arbeta på."

Din profilVi söker dig som har erfarenhet av kvalificerad försäljning inom teknisk industri, OEM eller tillverkande verksamhet. Du är van att driva din egen försäljning och trivs i affärer där det krävs både uthållighet och ett långsiktigt perspektiv för att nå resultat.

Du har ett starkt affärsdriv och är nyfiken på kundens verksamhet. Du tycker om att förstå kundens behov, identifiera nya möjligheter och bygga relationer på flera nivåer i organisationen. Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som involverar rätt kompetenser för att tillsammans skapa framdrift i större affärer.

  • God teknisk förståelse och förmåga att föra en trovärdig dialog med R&D och konstruktion samt omsätta tekniska behov till kommersiella lösningar

  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift

  • Erfarenhet från exempelvis komponenter, pumpar, ventiler, tätningar, packningar eller närliggande teknisk industri är meriterande

Vi värdesätter en kreativ och dynamisk arbetsmiljö där vi ger våra medarbetare stort ansvar och möjlighet att tillsammans utveckla bolaget. Du kommer verka i ett framgångsrikt företag med långsiktigt engagemang från vår ägare Latour Industries. Vi erbjuder utöver detta goda anställningsvillkor och förmåner.

jobs.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking a remote Sr IT Specialist to join our team!

Location: Texas, Colorado, Utah, Kansas, Nebraska

Work Schedule: This is a full‑time, non-exempt (hourly) position assigned to a First Shift schedule, with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. in your local time zone. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible.

Work Authorization: This position requires permanent authorization to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship (including H-1B, OPT/CPT, EAD, or other temporary work authorization) is not available.

Job Responsibilities

Technical Support & Incident Management

  • Manage IT support ticket queues, assign tickets, monitor service levels, and run turnaround time (TAT) reporting.
  • Resolve complex hardware, software, connectivity, and system issues, averaging 60 or more advanced troubleshooting tickets per week.
  • Serve as an escalation resource for field technicians and support teams.
  • Utilize remote support tools to troubleshoot issues, conduct user support sessions, and resolve incidents.

Field Services & System Installations

  • Install, configure, maintain, and document Labcorp-owned hardware and technology assets for IOPs, PSCs, internal and client locations.
  • Perform onsite system installations, troubleshooting activities, hardware replacements, and equipment upgrades.
  • Assist with Link Bridge and Link Autoprint installations and support activities.
  • Conduct site surveys and provide recommendations for hardware placement, equipment configuration, and technology deployments.
  • Follow RMA procedures for equipment replacement and return processing.

Acquisitions, Projects & Operational Support

  • Support ticket overflow during acquisitions, implementations, and large-scale projects.
  • Organize, coordinate, and execute divisional technology projects.
  • Assist with technology integration activities related to acquisitions and site transitions.
  • Identify recurring issues, recommend process improvements, and escalate division-wide concerns when appropriate.
  • Lead or support special projects as assigned, which will include travel.

Customer & Business Support

  • Partner with Sales, Phlebotomy, Operations, and client stakeholders to assess technology requirements and coordinate deployments.
  • Provide customer training and end-user support for hardware, software, and business systems.
  • Communicate project updates, new processes, and technical information to field service teams and stakeholders.

Compliance & Security

  • Maintain compliance with corporate IT policies, security standards, and asset management requirements.
  • Support hardware lifecycle initiatives, including replacement of aging or unsupported technology.
  • Document installations, service activities, asset information, mileage, time reporting, and project status updates.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma
  • 6 or more years of experience troubleshooting Windows-based hardware, software, peripheral devices, and connectivity issues.
  • 4 or more years of experience supporting network-connected devices, printers, workstations, and client-facing technology environments.
  • 3 or more years of experience utilizing remote support tools for troubleshooting, user support, and incident resolution.
  • 3 or more years of experience performing onsite hardware installations, equipment deployment, and technology refresh activities.
  • 2 or more years of experience managing or coordinating IT support ticket queues and service request workflows.
  • 2 or more years of experience documenting assets, service activities, and installation records within ticketing or asset management systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
  • 6 or more years of experience providing advanced field support, desktop support, or technical services.
  • 3 or more years of experience supporting healthcare, laboratory, diagnostic, or client-facing operational environments.
  • 2 or more years of experience supporting acquisitions, technology integrations, or enterprise deployment projects.
  • 2 or more years of experience supporting Link Bridge, Link Autoprint, or comparable laboratory connectivity solutions.
  • CompTIA A+, Network+, Microsoft, or other infrastructure support certifications.

Additional Job Standards

  • Ability to professionally communicate and articulate technical IT information to medical professionals and non-technical audiences.
  • Maintain a professional appearance and adhere to corporate dress codes while working on-site at the laboratory, internal facilities, and external client locations.
  • Ability to work effectively from a remote environment while maintaining collaborative communication with leadership and remote colleagues.
  • Access to a reliable personal vehicle for business travel.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel within an assigned territory.
  • Advanced troubleshooting expertise across hardware, software, networking, connectivity, and operational workflows.
  • Ability to mentor, guide, and provide technical assistance to field service technicians.
  • Strong customer service and professional communication skills.
  • Effective problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
  • Knowledge of IT security practices, asset protection, and technology governance processes.
  • Experience working collaboratively with Sales, Operations, Phlebotomy, and client stakeholders.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical users.
  • Commitment to process improvement, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction.

About the Role

The Sr IT Specialist serves as a senior technical resource responsible for supporting Labcorp's field-based technology environment. This role provides advanced troubleshooting, installation, deployment, and operational support for client-facing and internal systems while assisting with acquisitions, enterprise projects, and technology initiatives. The position acts as an escalation point for complex issues, supports business-critical operations, and helps ensure secure, reliable technology services across Labcorp's network of locations and client sites.

Application Window: 11/15/2026

Pay Range: $33.00 - $38.00 per hour

All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data.

Benefits: Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan.Employees regularly scheduled to work less than 20 hours, Casual, Intern, and Temporary employees are only eligible to participate in the 401(k) Plan.Employees who are regularly scheduled to work a 7 on/7 off schedule are eligible to receive all the foregoing benefits except PTO or FTO. Employer Account Executive - Remote

Job Description

The Account Executive serves as the primary relationship manager for multiple accounts in an assigned market segment. The role works directly with groups to optimize pharmacy spend through Prime's products and services, and drives the alignment of the assigned accounts and Prime's strategic goals and initiatives.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain key relationships with Plan's account and pharmacy teams, and with corresponding consultants/brokers; maintain an intimate understanding of the industry and assigned account trends, challenges, priorities, and adopted products and services to influence the development and prioritization of strategic plans

  • Ability to develop, evaluate and communicate selling strategies, presentations and proposals
  • Interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively facilitate meetings, resolve conflict, build consensus, establish rapport, collaborate, and influence effectively across departments, internally and externally, and at all levels within an organization
  • Able to balance and prioritize compliance, business and other competing goals and risks, while still driving programs and initiatives to completion

Job Description

Our team provides a wide range of civil and structural engineering services across markets sectors including electrical transmission and distribution (OH/UG power systems and substations).

We are looking for an enthusiastic individual to develop within and further the technical skills we bring to our new and existing client base. Qualified candidates will have a depth of experience in substation design as well as a familiarity with civil and structural design aspects for heavy industrial clients.

The responsibilities of this role also include, but may not be limited to, the following:

  • Leading / Supporting engineering and design for substations, switchyards and other electrical infrastructure projects (both green and brown field)
  • Perform engineering calculations and developing analytical models for both structural steel and concrete design
  • Working with Project Engineers and Project Managers on developing workload forecasts, design schedules and budgets for civil/structural work activities
  • Leads developing task and effort estimates for proposal support
  • Contributes to overall business development strategy around substation and high voltage electrical infrastructure

jobs.title: Senior Reporting QA & Data Validation Analyst (RCM)
jobs.excerpt: About The Auctus Group LLC Who we are: We’re big on people and culture at the Auctus Group.
jobs.description:
About The Auctus Group LLC

Who we are: We’re big on people and culture at the Auctus Group. Our most important role as a company is to provide an amazing working environment for our team. We’ve been work-from-home-warriors since before it was cool. We support (like encourage and fund) continuing education. We match charitable donations. Our whole goal is: work to live not live to work. Oh and we’re weirdos too…we do remote happy hours and have a book club and goofy stuff like that.

Who we’re looking for: Smart, talented, tech-savvy, experienced, go-getter types. You’ll do well if:

  • you like a fast-paced environment,
  • you thrive with change and development,
  • you like giving feedback,
  • you’re a team player,
  • you love learning/sleuthing,
  • you’re big on accountability.

About The Role

The Senior Reporting Quality Assurance & Data Validation Analyst is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of reports across healthcare practice management systems, electronic health records (EHRs), billing platforms, and internal reporting solutions.

This role works closely with the Reporting & Business Intelligence team, operations, and technical teams to validate reporting outputs, reconcile data across systems, investigate discrepancies, and strengthen reporting quality controls. Success requires strong SQL and Excel skills, sound analytical judgment, and the ability to trace reporting issues to their source and help drive them to resolution.

What You'll Do

  • Independently validate reports, dashboards, and datasets before they are shared with clients, leadership, or operational stakeholders.
  • Reconcile reported figures against source systems, including EHRs, practice management platforms, billing applications, internal databases, and automated extracts.
  • Perform record-level and aggregate-level checks to identify missing, duplicate, inaccurate, or inconsistent data.
  • Verify calculations, business rules, filters, date ranges, and metric definitions across financial, operational, productivity, and revenue cycle reports.
  • Investigate differences involving posting dates, transaction dates, adjustments, voids, refunds, and reporting cutoffs, distinguishing legitimate reporting differences from actual errors.
  • Trace discrepancies through data extraction, transformation, and reporting processes, working with analysts, developers, and data engineers to identify root causes and resolve issues.
  • Conduct regression testing when reporting logic, data pipelines, or source systems change.
  • Develop repeatable testing procedures, reconciliation templates, and validation checklists for recurring reports.
  • Create exception reports and identify opportunities to automate repetitive validation activities.
  • Document testing results, supporting evidence, business impact, recommended corrections, and resolutions to maintain clear records and support audit readiness.
  • Partner with operational stakeholders to clarify reporting requirements and expected results, and promptly escalate material inaccuracies.
  • Track recurring reporting defects and recommend improvements that strengthen data quality and reporting reliability.
  • Follow company policies for patient confidentiality, HIPAA compliance, and the secure handling of sensitive healthcare information.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting quality assurance, data validation, reconciliation, or a related analytical role.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, conditional formulas, and comparisons of large datasets.
  • Strong SQL skills for querying, comparing, aggregating, reconciling, and validating data.
  • Demonstrated experience investigating discrepancies across reports, databases, or business systems and identifying their underlying causes.
  • Ability to interpret complex business rules and translate them into practical validation scenarios.
  • Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with consistent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to independently investigate issues, follow through on findings, and manage multiple reporting validation assignments.
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills, including the ability to explain findings and business impact clearly.
  • Reliable computer access and a stable, high-speed internet connection suitable for remote work.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), medical billing, or healthcare reporting, with an understanding of accounts receivable, charges, payments, adjustments, denials, collections, and financial reconciliation.
  • Familiarity with EHR or practice management platforms such as ModMed, Tebra, Nextech, DrChrono, AdvancedMD, athenahealth, or OpenPM.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.
  • Familiarity with Python, Power Query, automated data validation tools, or data quality monitoring and exception reporting.
  • Experience validating ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, or database integrations.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA requirements and handling sensitive healthcare information.

Who We Are

At The Auctus Group, we help healthcare providers focus on patient care by supporting the revenue cycle operations behind their practices. We bring care, dependable service, and thoughtful problem-solving to our relationships with clients and teammates.

Our culture puts people first. We have long embraced remote work and make a deliberate effort to keep our team connected. We encourage continued learning, support community giving, and value a healthy balance between professional and personal life.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for curious, dependable people who take ownership of their work and care about its impact on clients and colleagues. You’ll be a strong fit if you:

  • Ask thoughtful questions and verify assumptions.
  • Enjoy investigating complex problems and following the evidence.
  • Take responsibility for issues and help bring them to resolution.
  • Communicate openly and welcome constructive feedback.
  • Collaborate well with others and adapt as systems and priorities evolve.
  • Look for practical ways to improve accuracy, consistency, and efficiency.

If you enjoy finding the explanation behind the numbers and helping others make decisions with confidence, we’d like to hear from you.

Position Title: MarTech & Marketing Automation Specialist (AI Solutions)

Location: Islamabad, Pakistan (Remote / کام گھر سے)

About Genifem

Genifem is an AI-powered MarTech and automation company helping businesses leverage artificial intelligence to enhance marketing, elevate customer experiences, and streamline everyday operations. We design and deploy conversational AI agents, marketing automation workflows, Copilot solutions, and customer engagement tools for growing organizations.

Role Overview

We are seeking an ambitious, proactive MarTech & Marketing Automation Specialist (AI Solutions) with 1–2 years of experience who can connect the dots between modern marketing tools, practical AI applications, client communication, and cross-functional coordination. This is a dynamic, hands-on, client-facing role where you will work directly with clients to understand their business challenges, demonstrate Genifem's AI tools, configure and test conversational agent workflows, set up marketing automation triggers, and coordinate with internal creative and technical team members to ensure smooth delivery. No software engineering or coding background is required, but you should be tech-savvy, naturally curious about emerging AI platforms, comfortable with no-code automation and CRM tools, and confident speaking directly with business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a dependable day-to-day point of contact for assigned client accounts.
  • Host client discovery calls, project check-ins, product walkthroughs, and progress updates.
  • Translate business goals, customer journeys, and operational workflows into clear internal task briefs.
  • Collect client feedback, coordinate revisions, track user adoption, and nurture long-term client relationships.
  • Conduct live walkthroughs and demos of Genifem's AI agents and automation solutions in clear, business-friendly terms.
  • Assist in mapping agent logic, prompt structures, knowledge bases, escalation rules, and everyday user scenarios.
  • Test and validate AI agents before and after deployment, reviewing conversation logs to improve response quality.
  • Research emerging generative AI tools, prompt techniques, and no-code platforms to expand Genifem's capabilities.
  • Help design and implement practical email/SMS sequences, CRM pipeline stages, and multi-channel campaign automations.
  • Support marketing and lead-generation initiatives for Genifem and its partner clients.
  • Monitor performance metrics and identify practical ways AI tools can enhance routine marketing workflows.
  • Keep up with modern MarTech, CRM, and digital customer engagement trends.
  • Guide clients and their teams through onboarding to ensure smooth adoption of their new AI and automation tools.
  • Create straightforward user guides, quick Loom video walkthroughs, or reference documentation as needed.
  • Identify usage friction early and provide proactive support to ensure client success.
  • Coordinate deliverables across internal content, design, technical, and marketing contributors.
  • Maintain organized project boards, action items, and timelines to ensure all milestones are met on schedule.
  • Review work quality before presenting deliverables to clients to ensure alignment with project goals.

Requirements & Skills

  • 1–2 years of professional experience in marketing automation, MarTech, CRM coordination, digital marketing, client success, or tech consulting.
  • Hands-on familiarity with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Perplexity, or similar productivity platforms).
  • Excellent written and spoken English with the poise to conduct professional virtual meetings with overseas or regional clients.
  • Demonstrated project coordination skills with strong organization, detail orientation, and task management.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to quickly master new web applications, software platforms, and digital workflows.
  • Nice-to-Have: Hands-on exposure to no-code automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make) or CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, GoHighLevel, ActiveCampaign).
  • Nice-to-Have: Foundational understanding of prompt engineering or conversational agent workflows.
  • Nice-to-Have: Experience supporting small-to-medium businesses (SMBs), e-commerce, hospitality, or service-based businesses.
  • Nice-to-Have: Basic conceptual understanding of APIs and webhooks (no coding required).

What We Offer

  • 100% remote work flexibility based in Pakistan.
  • Fast-track advancement into senior client management, product operations, or solutions consulting as Genifem expands its footprint.
  • Direct collaboration with leadership and hands-on experience deploying enterprise generative AI and automation solutions.

Work Details & Compliance

  • Work Arrangement: 100% Remote (work on your own laptop/computer)
  • Time Commitment: 40 hours per week, full-time commitment required
  • Engagement: Independent Contractor (Full-time commitment)
  • Taxes: As an independent contractor, you are responsible for reporting your income and paying applicable personal income taxes in Pakistan (FBR).
  • Intellectual Property: All project documentation, workflows, templates, marketing assets, and client deliverables created remain the exclusive property of Genifem.
  • Confidentiality: Client materials, proprietary agent workflows, and internal architectures are strictly confidential and subject to non-disclosure.
  • Work Eligibility: Candidates must have legal authorization to work and receive bank transfers in Pakistan.

Equal Opportunity

Genifem hires based purely on skill, communication ability, and potential. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds without discrimination.

About the job

is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

.
