Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Customer Success Manager on Twilio’s Twilio team.

About the job

At Twilio, we believe companies should be able to send their data wherever they want, whenever they want, with no fuss. We make this easy with a single platform that collects, stores, filters, transforms, and sends data to hundreds of business tools with the flip of a switch. More recently, we also developed the ability to let customers enrich their data in real time using computations they specify. Our goal is to make it easy to understand, extract value, and protect the integrity of data. We are creating a world where engineers spend their time working on their core product, letting us take care of the complexities of processing their customer data reliably at scale. We’re in the running to take over the entire customer data ecosystem, and we need the best people to take the market.

The Customer Success Management team at Twilio is the central touchpoint for our customers, orchestrating the post-sales customer lifecycle in partnership with professional services, sales and support. The team manages the customer relationship, coordinates internally within Twilio, drives product adoption and guides the customer to take full advantage of our ecosystem. Fundamentally, the CSM team ensures customers derive value from our platform, and ultimately renew and grow their relationships with us.

As a Customer Success Manager, Strategic accounts you will be at the forefront of driving customer satisfaction by developing tailored strategies that align with both customer goals and company objectives. Your work will directly impact customer retention and growth, as you will solve complex challenges, influence strategic decisions and advocate for customer needs across executive stakeholders. We are looking for CSMs who are passionate about first party data and how it can transform organizations. As a CSM, you will have the opportunity to help some of the world’s most influential companies solve their toughest data problems. Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure as Code

AI-Augmented Engineering & Operations

Required Qualifications

  • Solid hands-on experience with container ecosystems (Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, or ECS).
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or automation language (Python, Bash, or Go).
  • Experience with CI/CD automation and GitOps principles.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • Relevant AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or DevOps Engineer – Professional).
  • Experience building or maintaining an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) using tools like Backstage or similar self-service portals.

  • Experience setting up Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines or hosting machine learning models on AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock).

jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead LucentAI, an AI-native litigation operations venture in build at FutureSight.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead LucentAI, an AI-native litigation operations venture in build at FutureSight. This offers meaningful founder equity, not a salary.

LucentAI serves as an autopilot for medical-records and discovery operations in small-to-mid insurance-defence firms. Embedding in case-management systems, it retrieves and reviews records, flags key facts with confidence links, checks billing reasonableness, and chronologically triages discovery. This human-gated system excludes legal drafting, externalizing review capacity so firms can scale case volume without adding headcount.

Market validation through FutureSight’s discovery interviews confirmed strong demand:

  • Operations is the wedge; autopilot is the vision. All buyers wanted managed operations. LucentAI provides end-to-end automation, earning trust incrementally by handling routine work silently while keeping legal drafting human.

  • The pain is in the dollars, not the dashboards. One lead costs the middle phase at ~$1M/year in time and errors; a partner noted only ~$200K of a $1M medical bill was reasonable. With zero AI currently used, the ROI-driven payback case is immediate.

  • Capacity is the ceiling, and the record is the moat. Manual partner review caps case capacity and revenue. Defence records and billing patterns form a proprietary dataset that plaintiff-focused incumbents lack.

Market Context

We target underserved small-to-mid US insurance-defence firms.

The Phase-1 beachhead SAM is $150M–$600M across 1,500–3,000 firms; the full roadmap reaches a ≥$100M obtainable market (SOM ≈ $110M–$360M).

With 71% of legal AI funding flowing to plaintiff-focused companies, the defence market remains underserved, creating a need for technology purpose-built for litigation defence and risk management.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, size-tiered pricing model, and product positioning

  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with managing partners and claims/litigation-operations leads at small-to-mid insurance-defence firms, starting from the confirmed design partner, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go-to-market motion

  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 (records retrieval, key-fact flagging, billing-reasonableness analysis, and discovery triage) and iterate on user feedback; sequence carrier reserving and prediction as a later phase

  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B AI or B2B SaaS go-to-market, including consultative, relationship-driven sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

  • Deep domain expertise in insurance defence or claims operations, including pre-litigation records and discovery, legal billing review, and litigation case management.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Performance Media Buyer

Paid Social & Patient Acquisition | 83bar

**This is a remote, work-from-home position.

What We Do

83bar manages patient education, navigation, and acquisition campaigns for leading healthcare, pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, and wellness brands.

We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and results-driven Performance Media Buyer to support the execution, management, and optimization of paid digital campaigns across multiple platforms.

This is a hands-on media buying role focused on campaign builds, launches, daily performance management, budget pacing, and continuous optimization. The ideal candidate understands paid media platforms, can quickly identify performance trends, troubleshoot issues, and execute improvements that drive efficient patient acquisition and qualified lead generation.

What You'll Do

As a Performance Media Buyer, you will work closely with our digital strategists, media buyers, creative teams, and internal operations teams to execute paid media campaigns aligned with established campaign strategies, performance goals, and client requirements.

You will be responsible for building campaigns, managing day-to-day platform activity, monitoring performance, and proactively making optimizations to improve campaign efficiency and results.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable working directly inside advertising platforms, managing multiple campaigns simultaneously, and taking ownership of execution quality and performance.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Development & Execution

  • Build, configure, launch, and manage paid digital advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google Ads, Reddit, TikTok, and other assigned channels.
  • Execute campaign strategies developed by the digital strategy team, including campaign objectives, audience targeting, placements, budgets, and creative testing.
  • Configure campaign structures, ad sets, targeting, placements, bid strategies, naming conventions, and tracking parameters.
  • Upload and organize approved ad creative, headlines, primary text, descriptions, and destination URLs.
  • Perform pre-launch quality assurance (QA) to ensure campaigns are configured accurately and aligned with approved requirements.
  • Verify destination URLs, UTM parameters, tracking events, audience selections, and campaign settings before launch.
  • Maintain organized campaign structures and consistent platform naming and documentation standards.

Campaign Optimization & Performance Management

  • Monitor active campaigns daily to identify performance trends, delivery issues, inefficiencies, and optimization opportunities.
  • Optimize audiences, placements, bids, budgets, creatives, and campaign configurations to improve results.
  • Monitor key performance indicators, including CPM, CTR, CPC, CPL, Cost per Qualified Lead (CPSQL), conversion rates, and other assigned performance metrics.
  • Identify underperforming ads, audiences, or placements and implement appropriate adjustments.
  • Make informed budget adjustments within approved spending limits to improve performance and delivery.
  • Identify opportunities to scale high-performing campaigns while maintaining efficiency and lead quality.
  • Monitor campaign learning phases, delivery limitations, audience saturation, frequency, and creative fatigue.
  • Execute A/B tests across creative variations, audiences, placements, and campaign configurations.
  • Troubleshoot rejected ads, disapproved creative, limited delivery, tracking issues, and other platform-related challenges.

Budget Management & Campaign Pacing

  • Monitor daily and weekly campaign spending against approved budgets and performance targets.
  • Ensure campaigns remain within established spending limits and pacing expectations.
  • Identify campaigns that are overspending, underspending, or at risk of missing performance goals.
  • Proactively flag unusual spending patterns, delivery inconsistencies, or significant performance changes.
  • Make routine pacing adjustments within defined approval thresholds.
  • Communicate budget or campaign delivery concerns to the assigned strategist before they affect overall campaign performance.

Performance Monitoring & Reporting

  • Review campaign performance using advertising platforms and internal reporting tools.
  • Track key campaign metrics against established benchmarks and goals.
  • Identify performance changes and provide concise, actionable observations to the strategy team.
  • Monitor lead volume, qualified lead rates, and downstream performance indicators when available.
  • Assist with gathering campaign performance data for weekly and biweekly reporting.
  • Maintain accurate campaign change logs, testing results, and optimization notes.
  • Escalate tracking discrepancies, inconsistent conversion data, or unusual reporting changes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with digital strategists to execute approved media plans and optimization priorities.
  • Coordinate with creative teams to request new creative variations, replacements, or adjustments based on campaign performance.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to troubleshoot campaign-related issues affecting delivery, tracking, or conversion performance.
  • Communicate campaign changes, performance concerns, and optimization opportunities clearly and proactively.
  • Follow established campaign workflows, quality standards, and internal operating procedures.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

  • Ensure campaigns follow platform advertising policies and applicable healthcare and clinical trial advertising requirements.
  • Use approved messaging, imagery, landing pages, and targeting configurations.
  • Follow internal review and approval procedures before publishing new or materially revised advertising content.
  • Monitor platform policy changes and flag potential compliance concerns.
  • Maintain accurate campaign documentation and follow applicable privacy and data-handling requirements.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing paid digital advertising campaigns.
  • Strong proficiency in Meta Ads Manager, including campaign creation, targeting, budget management, creative testing, and performance optimization.
  • Experience managing campaigns in Google Ads and/or other paid advertising platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently build, launch, and optimize campaigns.
  • Strong understanding of paid media performance metrics, including CPM, CTR, CPC, CPL, conversion rates, and lead quality indicators.
  • Experience managing campaign budgets and monitoring daily and weekly pacing.
  • Ability to analyze campaign performance and translate data into practical optimization decisions.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly with campaign configuration, naming conventions, tracking parameters, and QA processes.
  • Experience troubleshooting campaign delivery issues, disapproved ads, tracking discrepancies, and performance declines.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable working independently while following established strategies, processes, and approval workflows.

Preferred Qualifications & Bonus Skills

  • Experience with healthcare, pharmaceutical, clinical trial recruitment, medical device, or other regulated-industry advertising.
  • Experience managing paid campaigns across Reddit Ads, TikTok Ads, (X) Twitter, NextDoor, Microsoft Ads, or programmatic platforms.
  • Experience with lead generation and conversion-focused advertising campaigns.
  • Familiarity with Meta Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), Google Tag Manager, GA4, UTMs, setup and conversion tracking.

  • Experience working with creative teams to execute structured A/B testing.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted campaign analysis, performance monitoring, and workflow automation.
  • Experience with bulk campaign builds, Meta Ads Manager bulk editing, Google Ads Editor, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with platform advertising policies and privacy requirements in healthcare marketing.

What Success Looks Like

  • Campaigns are built accurately, QA'd thoroughly, and launched on schedule.
  • Daily optimization is consistent, proactive, and supported by performance data.

  • Underperforming campaigns are identified and addressed quickly.

Job Description: Inpatient Coder (CCS)

Role Type: Contractor
Location: United States (Remote)

Job Summary

We are seeking experienced Inpatient Coders to support a project focused on improving clinical coding accuracy, medical documentation quality, and healthcare data integrity.

In this role, you will apply your medical coding expertise to review inpatient medical records, validate clinical documentation, assess AI-generated clinical content, and ensure coding accuracy in accordance with established industry standards. Your knowledge will help improve the reliability and quality of AI systems used in healthcare.

Scope of Work

  1. Review and analyze inpatient medical records to ensure accurate ICD-10 and applicable CPT/HCPCS coding in accordance with current guidelines and industry best practices.
  2. Evaluate clinical documentation for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and coding integrity.
  3. Review AI-generated clinical notes and summaries against source medical records and established documentation and coding standards.
  4. Validate and assign appropriate diagnostic and procedural codes using applicable ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, and CPT/HCPCS classification systems.
  5. Identify and resolve discrepancies in diagnosis and procedure coding to maintain accurate record abstraction and data capture.
  6. Enter and validate AI-generated patient information in computerized inpatient and outpatient medical record databases, following established workflows and quality standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Active certification in one or more of the following: Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC), Certified Outpatient Coder (COC), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), or another recognized AHIMA or AAPC coding certification.
  2. Hands-on experience with ICD-10 coding and medical record review.
  3. Access to current official ICD-10 and CPT coding references, along with Evaluation and Management (E/M) coding guidelines.
  4. Current employment or recent experience in medical coding, clinical documentation improvement (CDI), or a closely related healthcare documentation role.
  5. Availability to contribute at least 10 hours per week.
  6. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify coding discrepancies and documentation gaps.
  7. Ability to work independently, follow established coding guidelines, and maintain high standards of accuracy and quality.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a certified medical coding professional with practical experience reviewing inpatient medical records, applying coding guidelines, and validating clinical documentation. They demonstrate strong analytical skills, coding accuracy, and the ability to evaluate AI-generated healthcare content against real-world medical records and established coding standards.

Responsible for independently evaluating environmental risks associated with real estate collateral, determining appropriate levels of environmental due diligence, and ensuring the quality and integrity of the environmental review process. Provides clear, well-supported risk conclusions and mitigation recommendations to support credit decisions. Manages assignments with elevated complexity, including the most complex environmental matters, and serves as a technical resource to business units, credit teams, consultants, and less experienced teammates.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.

1. Independently determine appropriate scope and level of environmental due diligence based on property type, current and historical use, transaction structure, identified environmental conditions, and applicable Bank requirements.

2. Evaluate environmental risks associated with real estate collateral and determine whether those risks are acceptable within established risk parameters. Clearly communicate conclusions and provide practical risk mitigation recommendations to business units, credit teams, and other stakeholders in support of credit decisions.

3. Develop and oversee risk-based action plans when environmental concerns are identified, including additional investigation, regulatory evaluation, remediation, environmental insurance, engineering or institutional controls, ongoing monitoring, and estimates of potential costs to cure.

4. Order, review, and evaluate environmental assessments and related technical documentation for accuracy, completeness, regulatory relevance, compliance with applicable ASTM standards, and consistency with the approved scope of work.

5. Manage environmental assignments with elevated levels of risk, complexity, or sensitivity, including the most complex matters involving significant contamination, regulatory involvement, remediation obligations, redevelopment, multiple properties, or complex transaction structures.

6. Coordinate with environmental consultants, business units, legal counsel, credit teams, property owners, and other stakeholders to resolve due diligence deficiencies, clarify environmental findings, and determine whether completed work adequately addresses identified risks.

7. Evaluate the quality and performance of environmental consultants, provide feedback regarding the adequacy of completed work, and make recommendations concerning the addition, retention, restriction, or removal of firms from the Bank’s approved consultant program.

8. Provide technical consultation and training to business units, credit teams, and other teammates regarding environmental due diligence, environmental risk mitigation, regulatory requirements, and the application of Bank environmental risk policies and procedures.

9. Maintain advanced knowledge of environmental risk management practices, applicable federal and state environmental requirements, CERCLA liability and defenses, lender and secured-creditor protections, and current ASTM assessment and reporting standards.

10. Assist with the development, interpretation, implementation, and periodic revision of Bank environmental risk policies, procedures, guidance, tools, and quality-control practices.

11. Identify emerging environmental risks, regulatory developments, and industry trends that could affect real estate collateral, lending activities, or the Bank’s environmental risk management practices.

12. Mentor and provide technical guidance to less experienced teammates, support consistent application of environmental risk requirements, and assist with the review or escalation of complex assignments.

13. Maintain complete, accurate, and timely documentation of environmental reviews, risk conclusions, required actions, approvals, and final resolution in applicable Bank systems.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required Qualifications:

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

2. Five or more years of relevant environmental experience, including at least three years of experience reviewing, preparing, or managing environmental site assessments performed in accordance with applicable ASTM standards.

3. Demonstrated knowledge of environmental due diligence and environmental risk assessment, including the ability to evaluate environmental conditions affecting commercial real estate and determine appropriate investigation and risk mitigation strategies.

4. Working knowledge of CERCLA and other applicable environmental regulatory requirements, including liability considerations and protections applicable to real estate owners, purchasers, and secured lenders.

5. Demonstrated ability to independently analyze complex environmental information, exercise sound professional judgment, reach well-supported risk conclusions, and communicate recommendations in support of business and credit decisions.

6. Ability to critically review environmental reports, regulatory information, consultant findings, and other technical documentation and identify material environmental risks, data gaps, inconsistencies, and additional due diligence requirements.

7. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain complex environmental and regulatory matters to both technical and non-technical audiences.

8. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple assignments, including complex and time-sensitive matters, establish priorities, exercise independent judgment, and meet established deadlines.

9. Ability to effectively collaborate with environmental consultants, business units, credit teams, legal counsel, and other stakeholders to resolve environmental risk issues.

10. Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to effectively use technology and information systems to perform environmental review, documentation, research, and communication responsibilities.

Preferred Qualifications

1. Bachelor’s or graduate degree in environmental science, environmental engineering, geology, hydrogeology, chemistry, biology, or another field directly related to environmental risk assessment or environmental due diligence.

2. Relevant professional certification, licensure, or designation, such as Professional Engineer (PE), Professional Geologist (PG), Certified Hazardous Materials Manager (CHMM), or other environmental credential applicable to the responsibilities of the position.

3. Previous experience performing environmental risk management or environmental due diligence for a financial institution, commercial lender, or other organization engaged in real estate-secured lending.

4. Experience evaluating complex environmental conditions involving contaminated properties, regulatory programs, remediation, environmental liability, or environmental risk mitigation.

5. Experience providing technical guidance, training, mentoring, or quality review of environmental due diligence work.

Job Title: Senior Full Stack Software DeveloperJob Category: EngineeringTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: SecretEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking a Senior-level Full-Stack Software Developer to join the CNRFC N6 Enterprise Application Support team, supporting U.S. Navy Reserve business systems. The contract covers full lifecycle support, including web and mobile-responsive development, SharePoint, AI/ML, data warehousing, system administration, networking, and AWS cloud services. Key systems supported include the Navy Reserve Homeport, REAL, RFMT, and the Navy Reserve Data Warehouse, hosted in AWS and Azure environments. These platforms serve over 75,000 Navy Reserve personnel across multiple components. In this role, you will collaborate with managers, analysts, testers, and developers to design and deploy web-based business systems.

This is a remote opportunity, and it would be preferred if the candidate resided near the VA Beach/ Norfolk/Chesapeake areas but it is not required.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop end-to-end features by building responsive user interfaces in React and secure back-end services in ASP.NET
  • Design and develop database layers utilizing Entity Framework Core to interface efficiently with SQL Server
  • Build and deploy applications with automated CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps to
  • deliver code smoothly to staging and production environments
  • Optimize application performance across the entire stack, from front-end React components to back-end SQL query tuning
  • Actively participate in Agile ceremonies, including providing daily standup updates, estimating story points during sprint planning and demonstrating iteration accomplishments during sprint demo/retrospectives
  • Conduct constructive code reviews to maintain high standards of code quality, security and maintainability
  • Write automated tests using frameworks like xUnit/NUnit, Vitest or React Testing Library
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to debug complex issues and to address technical debt and production bottlenecks
  • Mentor junior team members while stepping up to lead feature initiatives independently

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree (B.S. or B.A.) in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Information Systems, Information Technology or Software Engineering; in lieu of the degree requirement, the applicant must possess one of the following certifications: Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP), GIAC Cloud Security Essentials (GCLD) or GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC)
  • 7+ years of experience developing with ASP.NET, React, Node.js, and relational databases.
  • Active SECRET security clearance.
  • Proficiency in C#, JavaScript, JSX/Angular Templates, and T SQL.
  • Hands-on experience with .NET (C#), ASP.NET, JavaScript, Node, React, and MS SQL Server.
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns.
  • Experience using project management and issue-tracking tools such as Azure DevOps, GitLab, or Jira.
  • Proficient with version control systems, preferably Git.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and successfully drive multiple projects.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to adapt quickly to complex environments; experience with AWS, Azure, or SaaS development is a plus.

Desired:


  • Experience with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Microsoft Copilot, MCP servers) and knowledge of AI/ML concepts including Generative AI, vector stores, LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG
  • Experience developing software within Agile frameworks such as Scrum and Kanban
  • Experience building and maintaining business systems for the Department of War or the Navy Reserve, including responsive web applications for desktop and mobile
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and managing production environments (Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Nexus, IIS, SQL Server, Windows Server)
    CompTIA Security+ and AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner certifications
-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$98,500-$206,800

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

Are you an experienced UiPath Developer ready to build smarter solutions that transform how work gets done?

At Naviant, our mission is to partner with organizations to reimagine how work gets done, combining deep industry expertise, intelligent technology, and a human-centered approach to deliver measurable outcomes. We serve as the Agentic Partner for the modern enterprise, leading deep business transformation by building autonomous, intelligent solutions that enable executive leaders to transform and optimize their entire operating model. Our vision is simple yet ambitious: Reimagine work through automation, AI, and data, freeing people to focus on what truly matters.

We’re looking for a UiPath Developerto design, develop, test, and deploy intelligent automation solutions using UiPath's traditional and emerging agentic capabilities. This hands-on role is ideal for a developer who combines strong UiPath Studio and Orchestrator expertise with experience in Document Understanding, APIs, and custom development, and familiarity with Maestro, IXP, and agentic orchestration and process design. You will work closely with project leads and customer stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable automation solutions, while contributing to Naviant's evolving agentic automation capabilities and growing toward greater project ownership.

Performance Objectives – What You Will Accomplish
First 30 Days: Getting Grounded

  • Learn Naviant's organizational structure, systems, processes, delivery methodologies, and customer environment, including Naviant’s automation, AI, and agentic solution offerings

  • Become familiar with Naviant's RPA and software development standards, including version control, logging, auditing, code reviews, security, testing, and maintainability

  • Begin contributing to active, billable automation projects, applying existing UiPath expertise across Studio, Orchestrator, Maestro, IXP, Document Understanding, and other relevant capabilities

  • Maintain technical and project documentation reflecting solution designs, implementation decisions, dependencies, and support considerations

  • Establish relationships and credibility with project leads, technical teammates, and customer stakeholders through clear communication, reliable execution, curiosity, and a willingness to learn

Within 60 Days: Taking Ownership

  • Independently develop and enhance UiPath automations that meet defined business and technical requirements, delivering scalable, maintainable, and well-tested solutions

  • Build and support integrations between UiPath solutions, APIs, and third-party systems using appropriate custom development tools and languages

  • Contribute to solution design discussions, identifying opportunities to incorporate agentic capabilities, Document Understanding, and intelligent orchestration to address customer needs

  • Take ownership of assigned technical workstreams, applying Naviant's development standards and proactively managing risks, dependencies, and delivery expectations

  • Review recent automation projects and solution designs with project teams and stakeholders to identify opportunities to improve, standardize, and reuse Naviant's automation assets and frameworks

At 90 Days and Beyond: Driving Impact

  • Consistently deliver high-quality automation solutions from requirements and solution design through development, testing, deployment, and stabilization

  • Own or substantially contribute to automation projects, applying sound technical judgment to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions that address complex customer requirements

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Naviant's automation assets, reusable frameworks, and development standards to strengthen delivery quality and consistency

  • Serve as a trusted technical resource to project leads and customer stakeholders, proactively identifying opportunities to improve solutions and delivery outcomes

  • Continue expanding technical and project leadership capabilities, taking on greater responsibility for solution design, customer engagement, and end-to-end project delivery

Competencies – Key Skills & Experience We're Looking For

UiPath Development, Automation & Agentic Orchestration
Hands-on expertise in UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, and Document Understanding, with the ability to design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain automation solutions. Familiar with Maestro, IXP, and agentic orchestration and process design, applying traditional and agentic approaches to deliver scalable customer solutions. UiPath certified or demonstrates equivalent competency.

Integration & Custom Development
Working knowledge of VB.NET, C#, and/or Python for custom automation logic. Experienced integrating automations with APIs and third-party systems and troubleshooting technical dependencies.

Software Development Practices
Experienced with version control, unit testing, code reviews, documentation, logging, and security practices. Applies development standards to deliver secure, maintainable, and scalable solutions.

Customer Collaboration & Communication
Strong communicator comfortable working directly with project leads and customer stakeholders. Translates business requirements into technical solutions and proactively communicates progress, risks, and dependencies.

Ownership & Growth
Demonstrates initiative, accountability, and experience owning or substantially contributing to an automation project end-to-end. Brings a continuous-improvement mindset and an interest in growing responsibility for solution design, customer engagement, project delivery, and technical leadership.

Perks and Benefits – How We Take Care of Our Team

At Naviant, we believe in taking care of our people, both professionally and personally. As a fully remotecompany, we offer an engaging and supportive culture that prioritizes work-life balance.

Our Benefits:

  • Comprehensive Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance

  • Employer Paid Disability & Life Coverage

  • 401k & Match Program

  • Generous Paid Time Off

  • Flex Spending Plans & Dependent Care

Other Valuable Perks:

  • Monthly Home Office Allowance

  • Volunteer Time Off

  • Charitable Giving Program

  • Lifestyle Spending Account

  • Employee Assistance Program, Parent Program, Wellness Initiatives, Virtual Gatherings, Employee Discount Program, Annual In-Person Celebration Week, and more!

Employees must reside in the U.S. and be authorized to work in the U.S.
Sponsorship is not provided.

jobs.excerpt: Looking to work with cutting-edge engineering software?
jobs.description:
Looking to work with cutting-edge engineering software? What if you could work with all of them?

WHAT YOU WILL DO

At Synera, we build an agentic automation platform for engineers that helps them create better products faster. Our software connects engineering tools, data, and people, enabling teams to automate complex workflows and focus on what really matters: solving hard engineering problems. We already have 80+ software integrations, ranging from the biggest players to the latest startups, and we're just getting started.

We're looking for an Integration Developer who truly understands engineering and who uses AI as a natural part of how they work, not an afterthought.

This role sits at the intersection of software development, partner collaboration, and engineering system implementation: you'll own the development of add-ins and integrations within our agentic platform, be the first dedicated technical member of our new Marketplace team, and work closely with Andrew, our VP of Software Partnerships, who leads the marketplace roadmap and relations with over 25+ different software partners. You'll work with a wide range of technologies – CAD tools, simulation solvers, PLM systems, and AI – and you'll have the autonomy to make technical decisions and own integration projects with 3rd parties from end to end.

👉 What a week at Synera could look like:

  • Monday: You join the weekly all-hands to align on company updates, followed by the developer meeting to share progress, questions, and technical insights.

  • Tuesday: After the morning stand-up, you dive into a partner call to help their developers plan their integration with Synera and ensure they build a solid foundation.

  • Wednesday (biweekly): You do backlog refinement and team retrospective to clarify tasks, estimate effort, and improve workflow. In the afternoon, you will work on AI skills to help you speed up the development of integrations by you and our partners.

  • Thursday (biweekly): Sprint review day - you demo the past two weeks' progress on the latest add-in to the internal team and get feedback on some improvements to make. Afterwards, sprint planning defines the next sprint's scope and clarifies any remaining questions.

  • Friday: Andrew invites you to join a customer call, for you to understand more deeply the customer’s PLM environment to help improve one of our existing integrations. In the afternoon, you use your unlimited Claude budget to experiment with anew AI workflow.

The rest of the week’s time is protected focus time: writing code, reviewing Bitbucket pull requests and pushing real value to production.

⚡ In 6 months:

  • You deliver customer-facing value regularly through integration projects.

⚡ In 12 months:

  • You have a growing ownership of complex integrations, especially in the PLM space, you mentor peers, and contribute to architecture and product decisions.

Here is our team at the summer event - join us at the next one! 👋

🌱 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned annual salary ranges are:

  • Experienced Level: 67,000 - 85,000 EUR

  • Advanced Level: 80,500 - 109,000 EUR

We determine the level we hire for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you’ll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine.

What we offer beyond salary:

  • With the high level of ownership, you make a real impact on our Synera software.

  • Flexible working: you decide when & where to work (as long as you have a residency in Germany).

  • Flexible public holidays: swap days off according to your values and beliefs!

  • Home office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Personal development budget of €2,000 to attend conferences and trainings or buy interesting books to improve in an area of your choice.

  • We don't count your vacation days, as we trust all our team members to decide what's best for them and the company.

  • Prefer two wheels over four? 🚲 We’ve got you covered with JobRad.

  • To support your personal and professional well-being, we offer company fitness with Wellpass and mental health platform nilo.

  • Regular team events, virtual coffee breaks, and spontaneous afterworks. We also get together as a whole company for 2-3 day off-sites twice a year! 🌈

Requirements

🚀 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You resonate with Synera's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.

  • You have a deep understanding of developing add-ins, plugins or integrations for complex software systems.

  • You’ve got the AI-native mindset and curiosity to constantly learn and develop your skills in this area.

  • You bring hands-on experience with PLM, SPDM, or MES platforms.

  • You bring strong proficiency in C# and C++, with solid algorithmic and logical thinking skills.

  • You're comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy – communicating directly with partners, making technical decisions, and owning projects from start to finish.

  • You are a strong communicator in English with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.

P.S. Synera is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work every day, and be prepared to share with us how your perspective will bring something unique and valuable to our Marketplace team.

jobs.excerpt: Movera are looking for a skilled and adaptable Full Stack Developer in our Microsoft- and Azure-centric environment to join our Technology Team on a 6 Month Fixed Term Contract.
jobs.description:
Movera are looking for a skilled and adaptable Full Stack Developer in our Microsoft- and Azure-centric environment to join our Technology Team on a 6 Month Fixed Term Contract.

This is a hands-on development role focused on modernising and integrating legacy systems with cloud-first, full-stack solutions. You will be responsible for delivering secure, high-performance applications and services, and supporting the full software development lifecycle—from analysis and design through implementation, testing, and deployment.

We expect a mix of technical expertiseand architecture-level thinking.

Important Requirement: This is a UK-based remote role. To be considered, you must physically reside in the United Kingdom and hold full, independent right to work in the UK. We are currently unable to offer visa sponsorship or consider candidates based outside the UK.

Who Are We:

Movera is a flourishing platform business that brings together ambitious home moving brands from across the sector. Built on the heritage and passion of experienced legal services businesses including ONP Solicitors and Cavendish Legal Group, brought together to transform the moving market for the better. Our vision is to create moving and remortgaging experiences to be celebrated – not tolerated.

Core Technical Expectations

Backend Development (C# / .NET)

  • Mastery of Core, including minimal APIs and middleware pipelines.

  • Proficient in designing and implementing RESTful APIs (using controllers or minimal APIs).

  • Comfortable with asynchronous programming, cancellation tokens, background services, and parallelism.

  • Experience with Dependency Injection, middleware, and custom service abstractions.

  • Skilled at structuring solutions using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) or at least modular, testable components.

  • Strong debugging and profiling skills.

Azure Cloud Proficiency

  • Solid experience deploying and managing:

    • Azure Function Apps (timer, HTTP, queue/storage/event triggers).

    • App Services and Web Apps.

    • API Management

    • Azure Front Door/CDN (optional but helpful).

  • Familiar with Storage Accounts, Blob/Table/Queue Storage, Key Vault, App Configuration.

  • Familiar with Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs (for scalable event-driven designs).

  • Can interpret and design architectures in Azure Architecture Center diagrams.

  • Recommend appropriate Azure services based on the problem (e.g., Durable Functions for orchestrations, Logic Apps vs Functions, etc.).

DevOps & CI/CD (Azure DevOps)

  • Writes and maintains multi-stage YAML pipelines (build, test, deploy).

  • Integrates tests (unit, integration, smoke) into CI/CD.

  • Understands ARM templates, Bicep, or Terraform for IaC (preferred but optional).

  • Ensures deployment slots, release approvals, and feature flags are well utilized.

Frontend

  • Strong with modern SPA frameworks like React, Angular, or Blazor.

  • Comfortable integrating with APIs, handling authentication, and state management.

  • Uses component-based architecture, lazy loading, and follows accessibility/responsiveness best practices.

Database (SQL Server/Azure SQL)

  • Skilled in:

    • Writing optimized T-SQL, views, indexes, and stored procedures.

    • Designing normalized and/or denormalized schemas depending on use case.

    • Managing migrations using EF Core (preferably fluent in IEntityTypeConfiguration).

    • Interpreting query execution plans for performance tuning.

Desirable Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  • Experience in modernising or migrating legacy systems.

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate or similar.

What We Offer

We aim to reward your hard work generously. You’ll be greeted in our offices with great coffee, fruit and biscuits to keep you going, alongside all the benefits listed below, plus much more.

  • 27 days holiday + your birthday off!

  • Health Cash Plan

  • Buy/Sell 5 days annual leave per annum

  • Build up more annual leave after 1 years service

  • Hybrid working

  • Free conveyancing legal fees

  • Moving home days off

  • Volunteering days

  • Retailer discounts and frequent socials

  • Refer a friend bonuses

Look forward to Monday mornings at Movera, we have the culture, technology and purpose to change the way you feel about your job and strive to create a positive and supportive work environment.

At Movera, we celebrate diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to succeed.

We welcome and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including those from underrepresented groups. As a Disability Confident Committed Employer, we go further for disabled candidates: under our guaranteed interview scheme, anyone who identifies as disabled and meets the essential criteria for the role is offered an interview. This positive action gives disabled candidates the chance to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities to us directly, rather than being screened out at the sift stage.

If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the recruitment process, please let us know and we will be happy to discuss how we can support you.

DBS and Financial Checks: We are committed to creating a safe, secure, and trustworthy workplace for everyone. As part of this commitment, all employment offers are subject to successful completion of DBS (Disclosure and Barring Service) checks and financial background checks. These checks help us maintain the highest standards of integrity and compliance while ensuring the well-being of our employees and clients. Rest assured, all checks will be carried out with care and in full accordance with relevant data protection laws.

Godot Game Developer

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

Job Description

We are seeking experienced Godot Game Developers to contribute to a project focused on creating engaging interactive experiences using the Godot game engine.

In this role, you will apply your game development expertise to real-world deliverables and help train and evaluate next-generation AI systems. You will work on gameplay systems, mechanics, and interactive features while providing technical feedback and documentation to improve AI-generated development solutions.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals with strong Godot development skills, practical game development experience, and excellent communication abilities.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Design and implement advanced gameplay systems, mechanics, and features using the Godot engine.
  2. Collaborate on scene creation, visual scripting, and asset integration to develop engaging and visually appealing experiences.
  3. Provide detailed documentation and regular written feedback on development processes and delivered components.
  4. Conduct comprehensive code reviews and provide technical guidance to improve code quality and maintainability.
  5. Identify, analyze, and resolve technical challenges while optimizing game performance and user experience.
  6. Participate in iterative development cycles and suggest improvements to gameplay, playability, and engagement.
  7. Adapt project assets and game logic to meet evolving project requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Demonstrated experience in game development across AAA, indie, solo, or serious hobby projects.
  2. A portfolio or verifiable published work through a personal website, itch.io, Steam, GitHub, game jam entries, or shipped game credits.
  3. Advanced proficiency in at least one major game engine, such as Godot, Unity, or Unreal Engine, including editor tools, scene management, and debugging utilities.
  4. Experience with engine scripting languages such as GDScript, C#, C++, or Blueprints, with the ability to interpret, troubleshoot, and improve gameplay logic.
  5. Proven ability to identify and resolve gameplay issues through iterative playtesting.
  6. Strong written communication skills, particularly in preparing clear task instructions and acceptance criteria.
  7. Experience in game QA, technical design, systems design, automated testing, or AI evaluation projects is an added advantage.

Portfolio Requirement

A portfolio is the most important part of your application and plays a major role in the selection process. Please include work that best demonstrates your game development skills, technical expertise, and practical experience.

Compensation Structure

  • Compensation is output-based, with payment provided per task that meets project specifications.
  • Task completion time may vary depending on the expert's experience and workflow.
  • Minimum submission requirements apply.
  • Experts are required to submit a minimum number of tasks per week.

Description

About Our Team

Our employees thrive in a culture that's fast-paced and ego-free, where innovation and collaboration are encouraged at every turn. We are an organization that provides federal agencies instant access to experienced and talented professionals who understand their unique challenges and know the most efficient ways to address them. We are continually investing in resources and talent, so we stay prepared with specialized teams in place who are experts in creating tailored technologies. Our solutions empower Federal organizations to grow, modernize, and succeed in a rapidly evolving landscape.

We value all voices and want to attract talent from all backgrounds. We're on the lookout for individuals who are passionate about technology and thrive in environments where problem-solving is approached with creativity and enthusiasm. If you're someone who enjoys continuously expanding your skill set while tackling real-world business problems, you'll feel right at home with us. Veterans and military spouses are especially encouraged to bring your unique and valuable experience to our team.

About the Role

Our team is seeking a Power Platform Tester to join our fast-growing IT-project based consulting business. We need a team member who is ready to plan, execute, and automate testing of Microsoft Power Platform solutions that support the missions of our federal customers. This is a specialized role for a tester who knows the Power Platform inside and out — from canvas and model-driven apps to Power Automate flows, Dataverse, custom connectors, and the APIs that tie them together.

The successful candidate will be a detail-oriented, inquisitive problem solver who can quickly understand business requirements and translate them into thorough, repeatable test coverage. In this fully remote role, you will validate workflows and functionality across Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Azure Government; build automated tests with Power Apps Test Studio, Power Apps Test Engine, and Playwright; and verify that every user persona sees and does exactly what their security role allows. Your work will give product owners clear, actionable reporting on quality and readiness for release.

You will work and collaborate on a team of project managers, business analysts, developers/engineers, and QA staff within an Agile environment. As a crucial member of our team, you will also be expected to interface with client representatives, including product owners, business owners, technical leads, and solution architects.

Responsibilities

•Validate requirements by testing workflows and functionality using Power Apps (canvas and model-driven), Power Automate, Azure Government, APIs, and Dataverse.

•Develop and execute test plans, test cases, scripts, and test results that provide actionable reporting to product owners and stakeholders.

•Execute testing activities for functionality, integrations, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT).

•Record, build, and run UI tests for canvas apps using Power Apps Test Studio and Power Fx expressions.

•Create and maintain automated test plans using Power Apps Test Engine (YAML/Power Fx test plans, connector mocking) with Playwright and the Power Platform CLI.

•Use Playwright and/or Selenium for deeper UI, browser-based, and model-driven app regression testing.

•Test custom connectors and validate Dataverse Web API endpoints using Postman or other REST clients.

•Use Power Platform Monitor to debug apps in real time and inspect network calls, formula errors, and data flow behavior.

•Test Power Automate cloud flows, including triggers, conditions, approvals, error handling, and connection behavior.

•Perform role-based persona testing to validate security roles, business units, team and field-level security, and access requirements.

•Validate functionality and data integrity during migrations from on-premises systems to cloud services.

•Document, track, prioritize, and drive resolution of defects in partnership with developers and product owners.

•Validate solution deployments across development, test, and production environments.

•Verify that applications meet Section 508 accessibility requirements.

•Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and sprint reviews.

•Develop and maintain test documentation throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC).

TAG:

TAG: INDMJC

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related technical field, or four (4) years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience in software quality assurance and testing
  • Minimum of three (3) years of on-the-job experience testing Microsoft Power Platform solutions, including Power Apps (canvas and model-driven), Power Automate, and Dataverse
  • Hands-on experience with Power Apps Test Studio and/or Power Apps Test Engine
  • Experience with Playwright or Selenium for browser-based test automation
  • Experience testing REST APIs, custom connectors, and Dataverse Web API endpoints using Postman or similar tools
  • Experience using Power Platform Monitor to troubleshoot app behavior, network calls, and formula errors
  • Experience with role-based persona testing and security access requirements
  • Experience developing and executing test plans for functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing
  • Experience documenting, tracking, and managing defects in tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
  • Familiarity with migration from on-premises to cloud services
  • Minimum two (2) years of experience working in an Agile framework
  • Ability to communicate complex concepts effectively to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Military experienced candidates are encouraged
  • Candidates will need to obtain Security Clearance of Public Trust once hired
  • Work is full-time 100% remote

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing in Microsoft Azure Government cloud environments
  • Proficiency with Power Fx and the Power Platform CLI (pac)
  • Experience writing Playwright tests in JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions)
  • Experience with Power Platform ALM, including managed solutions and environment strategy
  • Experience with Section 508 accessibility testing tools (e.g., ANDI, axe)
  • Microsoft certifications such as PL-200, PL-400, or PL-900; ISTQB certification
  • Experience with Federal government agencies

jobs.excerpt: worum gehts? Als Partner Manager Microsoft (w/m/d) agierst Du als Entrepreneur.
jobs.description:
worum gehts?

Als Partner Manager Microsoft (w/m/d) agierst Du als Entrepreneur. Du verantwortest die P&L unserer Microsoft-Partnerschaft als eigenständige Business Unit. Deine Mission: Die strategische Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Allianz, die Maximierung der Marktpräsenz durch gezielte Marketplace-Strategien und die Beschleunigung des Sales-Erfolgs durch effektives Co-Selling und Funding-Management.
Dein Einstieg bei uns ist für den 01.01.2027 geplant.

das wirst du tun

  • Relationship Management & Strategie: Du bist das Gesicht zum Partner. Du führst Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), treibst strategische Meilensteine (z.B. Azure Expert MSP) voran und entwickelst das „PCG + Microsoft“ Narrativ gemeinsam mit dem Management aktiv weiter.
  • Monetization & Marketplace: Du steuerst die Skalierung unseres Marketplace-Geschäfts. Als Funding-Driver stellst du sicher, dass jeder qualifizierte Enterprise-Deal (> 50k €) durch optimalen Einsatz von Mitteln (MDF, Cash-Back, POC-Funding) profitabel unterstützt wird.
  • Co-Sell Orchestration: Du bist der "Ressourcen-Guard" und priorisierst Marketing- und Event-Aktivitäten basierend auf striktem ROI. Zudem organisierst du Mapping-Sessions zwischen unseren internen Areas und dem Microsoft-Sales-Team.
  • Internal Enablement: Du agierst als Multiplikator und Botschafter. Durch Sales Masterclasses und regelmäßige Updates stellst du sicher, dass unser Vertriebsteam Partnerprogramme kennt und erfolgreich nutzt.
  • Governance: Du verantwortest das Monitoring und Management aller für den Partnerstatus kritischen Zertifizierungen (100% Compliance).

das bringst du mit

  • Strategischer Sales-Mindset: Tiefes Verständnis für Cloud-Ökosysteme und Erfahrung im Management von Hyperscaler-Partnerschaften mit Fokus Microsoft
  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du verantwortest eine P&L und denkst nicht in "Tickets", sondern in Partner Contribution (Revenue + Funding – Kosten).
  • Proven Track Record: Du bringst nachweisbare Erfolge in diesem Umfeld oder einem Ähnlichen Business mit und bringst Deine Lernkurve hands on ein.
  • Hands-on Deal-Acceleration: Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sales-Prozesse zu identifizieren, Funding-Hebel anzusetzen und diese proaktiv zum Abschluss zu bringen.
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Souveränes Auftreten auf C-Level und die Fähigkeit, intern als Enabler für die Sales-Organisation zu wirken.
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest datengetrieben, kennst deine KPIs (insb. Marketplace Adoption & Funding Penetration) und steuerst deine Aktivitäten nach messbarem Impact.
  • Persönlichkeit: Du zeichnest Dich durch hohe Integrität aus. Du lässt dich nicht aus dem Konzept bringen, besitzt Durchhaltevermögen und zeigst Mut bei notwendigen Veränderungen und Challenges.
  • Teamfähigkeit und Drive: Du überzeugst mit Ergebnisorientierung und der Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unserem diversen Team, bestehend aus Experten mit Leidenschaft

Was diese Rolle NICHT ist:

  • Keine administrative Ticket-Bearbeitung oder Portal-Verwaltung.
  • Kein "Secretariat" für manuelle Deal-Eingaben (wir setzen auf automatisierte Prozesse und CRM-Exzellenz).

das hast du davon

  • Flexibilität pur: Arbeite so, wie es zu deinem Leben passt – remote im Bundesgebiet, hybrid, oder in einem unserer Offices in Deutschland (Magstadt, Darmstadt, Berlin, München, Hamburg, Köln, Ulm, Heidelberg, Frankfurt).
  • Workation: Arbeiten & neue Orte entdecken? Nutze bis zu 30 Tage Workation im Jahr und verbinde Job & Abenteuer.
  • Auszeiten: Mit 30 Tagen Urlaub tankst du Energie, wann immer du sie brauchst.
  • Deine Hardware, deine Wahl: Mac, Windows oder Linux – du entscheidest, womit du am liebsten arbeitest.
  • Weiterkommen: Schulungen, Labs und Zertifizierungen bei AWS, Azure, Google & SAP – wir pushen dein Cloud-Know-how.
  • Feedback, das zählt: Regelmäßige Entwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche, damit du genau weißt, wo du stehst.
  • Mehr als Basics: wähle zwischen Spendit Card, oder Wellpass oder Deutschlandticket. On top Kita-Zuschuss und Bikeleasing als weitere Extras für dein Leben abseits des Laptops.
  • Teamspirit: Ob Teamevents (altern. Hackathons), Sommerfest oder Weihnachtsfeier – wir feiern Erfolge zusammen.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Database Observability, Grafana Cloud | UK | Remote
jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Spain and Germany.

About Grafana Cloud Observability

Grafana Cloud is our fully managed observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to use the best open source observability software, including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo, without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.

Within the Observability department, we build products that help customers understand and troubleshoot their applications and infrastructure. We work closely with product management, design and other engineering squads to provide seamless and highly curated experiences for our customers.

The squad: Database Observability

We build and evolve Grafana Cloud Database Observability. We want to help users understand the health and performance of their databases, identify slow queries and troubleshoot issues through clear, actionable insights.

As a frontend engineer on the squad, you’ll build experiences that make complex database telemetry easy to explore and understand. You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product management and design to take ideas from early exploration through to production and improve them based on customer feedback.

Our frontend stack is primarily TypeScript and React, interacting with backends written in Go. Your primary focus will be frontend engineering, with opportunities to work across the stack, contributing to APIs and backend functionality to deliver complete customer experiences. Frontend engineers at Grafana also have opportunities to contribute to open source communities.

The opportunity:

  • Own technical projects from problem framing through rollout, including getting user feedback and measuring whether what you shipped actually worked.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Product Design and backend engineers to build intuitive user experiences using clean, reusable components, contributing to supporting APIs and backend functionality where needed.
  • Mentor and collaborate with other engineers. Raise the engineering bar through code review, design feedback, pairing on hard problems, and writing that leaves the team better than you found it.
  • Participate in on-call for the software you help build, contributing to incident response and learning from incidents.
  • Provide technical support in customer escalations and help us identify areas of high friction to address.
  • Collaborate with other squads on shared dependencies, contribute to design proposals, and share the team’s work through demos and technical discussions.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

  • We highly value those who are intellectually curious, who default to transparency, possess a high bias towards action, and who are also kind and enjoy working as a team.
  • Strong frontend engineering experience, with experience across the stack. You have experience building and maintaining production web applications with React and TypeScript, and are comfortable contributing to backend services and APIs. You value maintainability, readability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Technical ownership. You have solid experience delivering complex projects, mentoring other engineers and helping teammates work more effectively. You communicate clearly in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.
  • You take responsibility for operating the software you have built. You have experience being on-call, supporting software in production, ensuring reliability and responding to incidents as needed.
  • You enjoy working on complex solutions, building production software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems with minimal supervision.
  • User focus and pragmatism. You break complex problems into short feedback loops: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate.
  • AI experience with a practical mindset. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully to improve productivity and quality, validate their output, and share useful practices with teammates.
  • You care about our community of users and contributors and are keen to be an active Grafana Community Contributor.

Bonus Points for

  • Open-source contribution or maintainership, and comfort engaging a community in the open.
  • An active interest in observability (metrics, logs and traces) and experience with tools like Grafana, Prometheus or other observability platforms.
  • Experience with databases, SQL or database performance monitoring.
  • Experience building backend services in Go.
  • Experience as an on-call user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo in a previous role (or on a homelab).
  • Experience in a fully remote, globally distributed team.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is £94,000 - £118,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.
