jobs.excerpt: The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD) About Sezzle:With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible.
jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a technically strong, hands-on Senior Database Reliability Engineer to help design, build, and scale the database platform used across Sezzle’s applications.

This is not a traditional DBA role. This role is for an engineer who can combine deep database knowledge with software engineering, infrastructure engineering, and platform thinking. You will help build the systems, libraries, automation, standards, and guardrails that make database usage across Sezzle reliable, secure, scalable, and easy for developers to adopt correctly.

As a Senior Database Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for improving how Sezzle applications connect to, migrate, operate, observe, and scale their databases. You will work across application teams, infrastructure, security, and engineering leadership to define patterns that improve database reliability by design — not just by operational response.

You should be comfortable owning problems end-to-end: understanding application behavior, reading code, reviewing database access patterns, building shared tooling, improving connection management, designing migration safety checks, analyzing production performance, and helping developers use databases in safer and more scalable ways.

You should consider yourself a DOer to be a good fit for this role. We are looking for someone who can ship production-quality engineering work, not just advise from the sidelines. With AI tooling and automation, you should be a force multiplier for database reliability, developer productivity, and operational excellence across Sezzle.

Compensation:

For this senior development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, build, and maintain shared database platform components used by Sezzle applications, such as database connection packages, database client libraries, migration tooling, safety checks, query standards, and developer-facing abstractions.
  • Establish reliable, scalable patterns for how Sezzle services connect to and interact with relational databases across production, staging, and development environments.
  • Partner with backend engineering teams to improve database usage in application code, including connection lifecycle, transaction handling, retries, timeouts, pooling, query patterns, and migration workflows.
  • Build automation and internal tooling that makes database operations safer, more repeatable, and less dependent on manual intervention.
  • Define and enforce engineering standards for database access, schema design, migrations, indexing, query performance, connection management, and operational readiness.
  • Architect and improve database infrastructure across AWS RDS/Aurora MySQL, PostgreSQL, RDS Proxy, read replicas, backups, failover, parameter groups, monitoring, and capacity planning.
  • Lead database reliability initiatives that reduce operational risk, improve performance, and help Sezzle scale safely.
  • Review application designs and database changes early in the development lifecycle to ensure reliability, scalability, maintainability, and security are built in from the start.
  • Build guardrails for database migrations, including automated checks, rollback expectations, schema review workflows, migration observability, and production safety controls.
  • Improve developer self-service for database provisioning, access, schema management, local development, testing, and observability.
  • Investigate production database issues by combining application telemetry, database metrics, logs, query plans, traces, and cloud infrastructure data.
  • Identify and fix systemic database problems, not just symptoms — including bad access patterns, unsafe migrations, inefficient queries, connection storms, lock contention, replication lag, and capacity bottlenecks.
  • Create and maintain high-signal dashboards, alerts, SLOs, SLIs, runbooks, and operational readiness checks for database-backed services.
  • Drive improvements in database backup validation, restore testing, disaster recovery, failover readiness, and business continuity.
  • Work with security and compliance teams to improve database access controls, auditability, encryption, secrets management, least privilege, and PCI/SOC 2 aligned controls.
  • Mentor engineers on database design, query performance, safe migrations, operational readiness, and production debugging.
  • Use automation and AI tooling where appropriate to improve migration review, query analysis, incident investigation, documentation, and developer productivity.

What We look for:

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering, infrastructure engineering, database engineering, SRE, or platform engineering experience.
  • Strong software engineering ability in at least one production programming language such as Go, Python, or TypeScript.
  • Proven ability to build production-quality internal tools, libraries, frameworks, services, or platform components used by other engineers.
  • Deep hands-on experience with relational databases, especially MySQL and/or PostgreSQL, in high-availability production environments.
  • Strong understanding of how application code interacts with databases, including connection pooling, transactions, isolation levels, retries, timeouts, deadlocks, locking, migrations, and query execution.
  • Experience designing or improving shared database access patterns, internal database packages, ORM wrappers, migration frameworks, or developer-facing database tooling.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS RDS/Aurora, including provisioning, upgrades, replicas, backups, failover, monitoring, parameter tuning, and production troubleshooting.
  • Experience with database connection management technologies such as RDS Proxy, PgBouncer, ProxySQL, or application-level pooling.
  • Strong ability to analyze database performance using query plans, indexes, slow query logs, wait events, locks, metrics, and application traces.
  • Experience designing safe database migration processes for production systems.
  • Strong understanding of observability for database-backed applications, including metrics, logs, traces, SLOs, alerting, and incident response.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD systems such as Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, Kubernetes, Helm, or similar tooling.
  • Ability to influence engineering teams through clear design reviews, documentation, technical standards, and practical implementation.
  • Ability to operate independently, identify high-impact problems, propose pragmatic solutions, and drive them to completion.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience building platform capabilities for a microservices environment.
  • Experience with Golang application development and database access patterns.
  • Experience creating database libraries, SDKs, service templates, migration frameworks, or paved-road developer tooling.
  • Experience improving database reliability across many services or teams, not just one application.
  • Experience with fintech, payments, banking, e-commerce, or other high-volume transactional systems.
  • Experience with compliance-sensitive environments such as PCI DSS, SOC 2, or SOX.
  • Experience with database access governance, audit logging, secrets management, encryption, IAM authentication, and least-privilege access models.
  • Experience with large-scale operational automation for provisioning, patching, failover testing, backup validation, access management, or schema review.
  • Experience with distributed systems patterns such as transactional outbox, event-driven architecture, idempotency, queues, eventual consistency, and data consistency tradeoffs.
  • Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, Performance Insights, OpenTelemetry, or New Relic.
  • Familiarity with Elasticsearch or other supporting data stores.
  • Familiarity with AI developer tooling such as Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor, and using it to be a more productive engineer.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.description:
Position Description

Valiant Solutions is seeking a Scrum Master to join our rapidly growing and innovative team!

The Scrum Master will join our agile software development practice supporting an environmentally focused Federal Government client. The agency's programs aim to promote environmental sustainability and protect the natural resources of our planet. As part of this contract, we will be supporting the agency's efforts to develop and maintain information systems that facilitate the tracking and reporting of environmental data. Our team will work closely with the agency to ensure that the information systems are secure, compliant with accessibility standards, and support the agency's business processes.

Scrum Master will work closely with other Team Valiant members, the Federal government agency and other stakeholders to support the development and maintenance of multiple information systems. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of agile principles and methodologies, with a focus on Scrum practices. The Scrum Master will facilitate agile ceremonies, work with stakeholders to prioritize and plan work, and remove impediments to progress.

Named one of the Washington Business Journal’sBest Places to Work every year since 2014, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

Location: Remote This position allows for 100% remote work. Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.

Eligibility Requirements: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States and able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

Required Education / Certifications: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)

Required Experience:

  • At least five years of experience as a Scrum Master, with a focus on supporting complex IT projects.
  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) required
  • Experience working in a government contracting environment.
  • Deep understanding of agile principles and methodologies, including Scrum, Kanban, and Lean.
  • Strong facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve impediments to progress.
  • Strong leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and empower the team to deliver high-quality work.
  • Experience working with agile project management tools, such as Jira
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, preferred, but not required

Responsibilities:

  • Facilitate agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and sprint retrospectives.
  • Work with the stakeholders to prioritize and plan work.
  • Remove impediments to progress, including managing dependencies and addressing conflicts.
  • Ensure the team is focused and productive, and that the work is aligned with the project goals and objectives.
  • Coach the Scrum team on Agile and Scrum principles, help them understand their roles and responsibilities, and guide them to self-organize and make decisions as a team.
  • Identify and remove roadblocks that hinder the team's progress. Work with the Product Owner to ensure that the Product Backlog is clear, prioritized, and understood by the team.
  • Monitor the team's progress and make sure that they are working towards the Sprint Goal.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, where the team is empowered to identify and implement process improvements.
  • Ensure that the team has a clear understanding of the work and that the requirements are well-defined and understood.
  • Provide status updates to stakeholders, including project progress and risks.
  • Help ensure that the team adheres to agile principles and practices, while also complying with the contract requirements.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement within the team. Encourage the team to reflect on their work and identify areas for improvement. Help the team implement changes and adjustments to their process.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, including the Product Owner, to ensure that the team is meeting the needs of the business. Communicate the team's progress and any issues or risks to stakeholders as needed.

Methodologies and Tools:

  • Agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban)
  • Project management tools (e.g. JIRA, Trello, Asana)
  • Code repository tools (e.g. GitHub, Bitbucket)
  • Continuous integration/continuous deployment methodology and tools (e.g. Jenkins)
  • Testing frameworks (e.g. Selenium, Appium, JUnit)
  • Communication and collaboration tools (e.g. Slack, Microsoft Teams, Zoom)
  • Cloud computing platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • DevOps practices (e.g. infrastructure as code, automation, monitoring)
  • Knowledge of programming languages and software development practices

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions delivers cybersecurity and IT services to federal civilian, defense, and national security customers nationwide. We support the full cyber lifecycle, from secure system design and accreditation through AI-enabled operations, threat emulation, and continuous improvement, across classified and unclassified environments. Our work is independently certified for quality and security, including CMMI, CMMC, and ISO certifications.

Valiant is a multi-year Washington Business Journal Best Places to Work winner, and our growth and cyber leadership have been recognized by Washington Technology, Northern Virginia Technology Council, and the Triangle Business Journal. We offer strong benefits, rewards for earning industry certifications, and room to grow your career as we grow. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, our distributed workforce supports customers from coast to coast. We go where the stakes are highest, and the margin for error is zero. If you want meaningful work alongside talented professionals, apply today.

Benefits Snapshot

Valiant takes care of the people who support our customers, with real choices in coverage and real investment in your career. Eligible full-time employees receive:

  • A choice of medical plans, from an affordable HSA option to a full-featured PPO, with generous company contributions
  • Dental and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Company-paid life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance
  • Optional supplemental life, accident, and critical illness coverage to round out your protection
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid time off that grows with your years of service, plus paid federal holidays
  • Paid certifications, professional development, and the Valiant University training portal
  • Flexible spending accounts and a wellness and fitness program
  • Referral bonuses when you help us bring great people to Valiant

Benefit eligibility and plan details are subject to the terms of each plan and may change from time to time.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $115,000 to $127,000. This range reflects Valiant Solutions' good-faith estimate of the base salary reasonably expected for this position upon hire, at the time of posting. The range has been established based on the scope of the role, market rates, and internal equity. Where a candidate falls within the posted range will depend on job-related factors, including relevant skills, experience, qualifications, achievements, education, geographic location, applicable security clearance requirements, additional corporate responsibilities, and other legitimate, non-discriminatory business considerations. The posted range does not guarantee an offer at any particular salary. In addition to base salary, this position includes the benefits described above.

Remote Work Policy (Remote and Hybrid Positions Only)

Remote work necessitates a high level of trust in our employees. To ensure that employee performance does not suffer in a remote work environment, all employees who telecommute are expected to have a quiet and distraction-free workspace with adequate internet, dedicate their full attention and availability to their job duties during working hours, and maintain a schedule during core business hours that aligns with those of their coworkers and Valiant's clients. In alignment with Valiant's inclusive and engaging environment, cameras are encouraged and can be required to be on during virtual video conferences. Additionally, in alignment with the Office of the Inspector General’s effort to eliminate conflicting employment, all Valiant employees are required to disclose any current or future outside employment engagements. During onboarding and throughout employment, employees must disclose any current activities or intent to engage in outside employment or other professional activities and obtain written approval. Employees may not solicit or conduct any outside business during core business hours for Valiant Solutions and our clients.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Valiant Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Valiant Solutions provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need an accommodation during the application or hiring process, please contact .

Physical Demands

Sitting or standing at a desk for prolonged periods and consistently operating a computer. Frequent communication and exchanging of accurate information via electronic communication, phones, and in person. Occasionally lift and/or move moderate amounts of weight, typically less than 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information

By submitting your resume for this position, you authorize Valiant Solutions to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates, and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education, and experience. jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

jobs.description:
Tech Lead - New Customers Team

Hybrid in London, UK

We’re looking for a Tech Lead

You'll lead the engineering behind how new businesses become iwoca customers – the application they fill in, the checks they go through, and the offer they get.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The New Customers team owns everything from a business's first application to a funded loan: the application flow, the logic that routes each application, the documents we ask customers for, and the models that set loan amounts and pricing. Its measure of success is the customer lifetime value it adds between sign-up and first loan.

The team sets its own goals and direction. It brings together engineers, data scientists, and product and strategy people. It partners closely with credit risk on the trade-offs behind every lending decision. Knowledge sharing is central to how the team works, supported by regular forums to share findings, and dedicated research and development time.

You'll lead two engineers and report to the head of engineering for iwoca's customer journey, from first application to repeat lending.

The role

As the Tech Lead, you'll spend most of your time building. The team is moving its offer logic out of a legacy monolith into a new service. It's the biggest change in a decade to the system behind iwoca's lending decisions. The next phase is yours to lead.

  • Autonomy and ownership. You'll shape what the team builds, decide how to build it, and own what goes live. You'll set its engineering roadmap, including what to pull out of the monolith, what to rewrite, and in what order.

  • Technical complexity. You'll design the team's part of the new service, which turns models and rules into a lending decision and optimises each offer across amount, duration, fee, and interest rate. You'll keep it reliable in production, easy to change as the models evolve, and able to show how it reached each decision.

  • Experimentation and learning. You'll build the systems that let data scientists test new models on live applications. Some experiments run for years, until each loan reaches the end of its term. You'll see the long-term results of the team's lending decisions.

  • Influence. You'll get colleagues across iwoca behind technical work that competes with new features for time.

  • Leadership and growth. You'll line-manage and coach the team's engineers, setting context and helping them own projects end to end. As the team grows, you'll decide the skills and make-up it needs, and hire the engineers to match.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Technical leadership. You've led a team of engineers for at least two years, including line management, while still remaining hands on.

  • Backend engineering. You have deep expertise in at least one object-oriented language. You've designed, built, and run customer-facing backend systems in production.

  • Commercial or product thinking. You take a business goal, get to the root of what's needed and why, and turn it into a technical plan. You can explain a trade-off in terms of what it means for customers and the business.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to deliver engineering work you couldn't have done alone. You help your team do the same. You judge where it's useful. You check its output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Lending or payments experience. You've worked in lending, payments, or another domain where engineering decisions carry financial risk.

  • Experimentation. You've built systems that run controlled experiments, especially long-running ones.

  • Legacy migration. You've moved business-critical logic out of a complex legacy monolith and kept everything that depends on it working.

  • Working with data scientists. You've worked with data scientists from prototype to production, and know their work well enough to challenge it.

  • Python stack. You've worked with Python, Django, and PostgreSQL.

  • Frontend. You've built frontend features as well as backend services.

The salary

We expect to pay from £100,000 to £130,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack (TAP)

Compensation Range: £100K - £130K

About Pilotbase:

Pilotbase is a connected system that brings together flight schools, pilots, and industry partners into a single, data-driven network. This next phase of growth is focused on expanding within our existing customer base, reaching pilots directly, and creating new revenue streams across the ecosystem.

Job Overview:

As the Senior Security Operations Engineer, you will own the hands-on security functions of the team implementing controls, closing findings, running detection and response, and producing the evidence our compliance programs depend on. The Security Manager sets the standards, you make them real, and show that they hold. You will work across endpoints, cloud, identity, applications and vendor security, ranging from alert triage through to control design by researching options and proposing designs or tooling.

Responsibilities:

The primary function is accountability for security outcomes in your domains being achieved and demonstrable. Where a control is claimed, you implement it, operate it, enforce its SLA, and evidence it. This role implements, operates, remediates and evidences. It also offers guidance and suggestions on proposing standards, policies, compliance frameworks and security tooling. As the team and the company scale, this role will grow to include additional related responsibilities.

Remediation and Closure

● Owns closure of security findings end to end: triage, prioritisation against the standard, driving the remediation cycle against existing findings with platform owners, and verifying closure. Closure, not detection, is the deliverable.

● Manages, reviews and drives outcomes against penetration tests, vulnerability and posture scans, audit gaps, access reviews, and CVEs across the estate.

● Security is an overlay onto other domains, so where security does not own the platform you own the finding and its closure while holding the platform owner (IT, DevOps, Engineering, etc) to executing the fix.

Functional Security

● Endpoint security direction and Tier 1 asset hardening.

● Vulnerability and application security scanning, and enforcement of its SLA.

● Cloud security posture management: stand up, then SLA enforcement.

● Data loss prevention: prevention and monitoring controls.

● Access control: least privilege, dual control, and other access validations.

● Network Security implementation at the cloud edge (alongside DevOps).

Detection and Response

● Operates managed detection and response end to end, including day to day interactions with the provider.

● First responder for security events, carrying triage through to closure.

● External phishing investigation and prevention.

● Selection, implementation, and operation of a SIEM (when approved).

Audit Evidence and Control Operation

● Produces and packages audit evidence for compliance frameworks (SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS v4, etc) where automated collection cannot reach it.

● Runs the recurring access review cycles; mitigates, remediates, or otherwise drives corrections.

● Builds the controls that close audit gaps, and returns the evidence that shows they operate.

Tooling, Design and Automation

● Researches, vets and recommends security tooling; owns day to day use once approved.●

● Drafts solution designs for new controls; implements on approval.

● Supports security architecture reviews for new services and integrations.

● Builds and maintains automation to remove recurring manual work from role scope.

Also Supports

● Technical contact for the QSA, ASV and external auditor, including the quarterly external scan cycle.

● Security questionnaires (CAIQ, HECVAT, etc) answered from the evidence library, and upkeep of that library.

● Review of vendor security assessments.

● Security awareness training, including Internal phishing simulation campaigns and content recommended for approval.

Qualifications:

REQUIRED:

Experience: 5+ years full time in an in-house security role, with hands-on ownership of controls in one or more of the domains above, and a track record of driving findings to verified closure.

Technical Skills:

○ Identity and access including least privilege, privileged access, conditional access, and running access reviews.

○ Detection and response using an EDR, a SIEM or a managed provider, from triage through containment.

Job Title:

Post Doctoral Scholar

Department:

FAES | Food, Agricultural and Biological Engineering

A Postdoctoral Researcher position is available immediately in the Department of Food, Agricultural and Biological Engineering within the College of Food, Agricultural, and Environmental Sciences (CFAES) at The Ohio State University (OSU). This position is supported through federal and state-funded research projects focused on advancing agricultural ecosystem science and evaluating the environmental benefits of conservation practices.


We seek a highly motivated individual to contribute to interdisciplinary research addressing agricultural ecosystem processes, environmental outcomes, and ecosystem services. Primary responsibilities include:


Research and Outreach Responsibilities

  • Develop, evaluate, and apply ecosystem and environmental models.
  • Assess environmental outcomes and ecosystem services with an emphasis on carbon sequestration, greenhouse gas emissions, and water quality.
  • Conduct data mining and analysis using machine learning and artificial intelligence approaches.
  • Integrate field, watershed, and regional-scale datasets to support ecosystem service assessments and decision-making.

The Postdoctoral Researcher will work closely with a collaborative, multi-institutional team of researchers from universities, government agencies, and research organizations. The position also includes opportunities to engage in Extension and stakeholder outreach activities in collaboration with OSU Extension faculty and partners.


Scholarly and Professional Development

In addition to leading data collection, analysis, and modeling efforts, the successful candidate will be expected to:

  • Publish research findings in peer-reviewed scientific journals.
  • Contribute to proposal development and grant-writing activities.
  • Develop Extension publications and outreach materials for diverse audiences.
  • Present research findings at national and international scientific conferences, stakeholder meetings, and professional workshops.
  • Mentor graduate and undergraduate students involved in project activities.

This is a term appointment with annual renewal contingent upon the availability of funding and satisfactory performance. This position has the potential to be approved as a remote position for candidates located anywhere within the United States. Remote work arrangements are subject to The Ohio State University's review and approval processes and are not guaranteed. Eligibility for remote work will depend on the candidate's state of residence and other university, legal, tax, and employment considerations. Occasional travel may be required for project meetings, field activities, stakeholder engagement, Extension programming, and scientific conferences.


The Postdoctoral researcher will work under the supervision of:

Dr. Asmita Murumkar

Assistant Professor and Ecosystems Services Field Specialist

OSU Extension, Agricultural and Natural Resources

Department of Food, Agricultural and Biological Engineering

The Ohio State University


Required Qualifications

  • Earned Ph.D. by the start date in Agricultural Engineering, Ecological Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Hydrology, Soil Science, Environmental Science, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience with ecosystem, hydrologic, biogeochemical, or watershed models and decision-support tools used for field and watershed assessments.
  • Knowledge of agricultural conservation practices and their environmental impacts.
  • Evidence of scholarly productivity, including peer-reviewed publications.
  • Experience contributing to research proposals and grant development.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with carbon accounting models and decision-support tools such as COMET-Farm and related ecosystem-service assessment tools.
  • Familiarity with machine learning, artificial intelligence, and large-scale environmental data analysis.
  • Experience integrating environmental monitoring data with modeling frameworks.
  • Experience working with interdisciplinary research teams and stakeholder-driven projects.

Desired Skills

  • Proficiency in programming and data analysis languages such as R, Python, MATLAB, or FORTRAN.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience mentoring students and junior researchers.
  • Experience communicating modeling and watershed assessment results to scientific, technical, and public audiences.

Conocé Darwoft

En Darwoft desarrollamos software que genera impacto real.

Somos una compañía tecnológica latinoamericana que trabaja junto a empresas de diferentes partes del mundo, creando soluciones digitales innovadoras, escalables y de alto valor.

Nuestra cultura combina excelencia técnica, colaboración, aprendizaje continuo y una fuerte orientación a las personas.

La Inteligencia Artificial forma parte de nuestra manera de trabajar, innovar y resolver problemas. Buscamos incorporar nuevas tecnologías para construir mejores productos y potenciar las capacidades de nuestros equipos.

Si te apasiona la tecnología, disfrutás resolver desafíos complejos y querés participar en proyectos donde tu trabajo tenga impacto, nos encantaría conocerte.

Sobre el rol

Estamos buscando un/a Data Engineer Semi-Senior con experiencia práctica en Neo4j, Cypher y modelado de datos en grafos para sumarse a un proyecto innovador de LegalTech enfocado en transformar la manera en que se organiza, conecta y consulta información legal, tributaria, contable y regulatoria.

Vas a participar en el desarrollo y evolución de un Knowledge Graph que permitirá relacionar grandes volúmenes de información, identificar conexiones semánticas y potenciar soluciones de búsqueda inteligente basadas en Inteligencia Artificial.

Esta posición combina Data Engineering, Graph Databases e Inteligencia Artificial, con un fuerte enfoque en la construcción de soluciones productivas, escalables y mantenibles.

Trabajarás junto a equipos de Data Science, Backend e IA para transformar modelos conceptuales, taxonomías y ontologías en estructuras de grafos eficientes que alimenten arquitecturas de recuperación de información como RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).

Buscamos una persona con una base sólida en ingeniería de datos, experiencia real trabajando con Neo4j y motivación por seguir desarrollándose en Knowledge Graphs, búsqueda semántica y GraphRAG.

¿Qué vas a hacer?

  • Modelado de grafos: Diseñar, implementar y mantener modelos de datos en Neo4j, representando entidades, relaciones, jerarquías y estructuras complejas de información.
  • Ingeniería de datos: Construir y optimizar pipelines ETL/ELT para ingesta, transformación, validación y actualización de datos estructurados y no estructurados.
  • Desarrollo con Cypher: Crear y optimizar consultas complejas para recuperación de información, navegación de relaciones y procesamiento de datos en grafos.
  • Implementación de Knowledge Graphs: Transformar taxonomías, ontologías y modelos conceptuales definidos por Data Science en estructuras productivas dentro de Neo4j.
  • Integración con IA y RAG: Participar en la integración de Neo4j con embeddings, búsqueda vectorial y arquitecturas de recuperación semántica.
  • Optimización de performance: Mejorar consultas, estrategias de indexación, consistencia de datos y escalabilidad de la base de grafos.
  • Integración con Backend: Desarrollar integraciones mediante Python o Node.js para conectar los datos del grafo con aplicaciones, APIs y servicios internos.
  • Calidad de datos: Implementar validaciones, controles automatizados y buenas prácticas para garantizar la integridad y confiabilidad de la información.
  • Trabajo interdisciplinario: Colaborar con especialistas en Data Science, Inteligencia Artificial y desarrollo de software para evolucionar la arquitectura de datos.

¿Qué buscamos?

  • Experiencia: Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia profesional en Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering o posiciones similares.
  • Neo4j: Experiencia práctica diseñando, implementando y manteniendo soluciones basadas en bases de datos de grafos.
  • Cypher: Buen dominio del lenguaje para desarrollar consultas complejas, recorrer relaciones y optimizar operaciones sobre grafos.
  • Modelado de datos: Conocimiento de modelos Property Graph, nodos, relaciones, labels, propiedades y buenas prácticas de diseño.
  • ETL/ELT: Experiencia desarrollando pipelines de ingesta, transformación e integración de datos.
  • Programación: Manejo de Python o Node.js para procesamiento de datos, automatización o integración con servicios.
  • Optimización: Conocimiento de índices, constraints, optimización de consultas y performance de bases de datos.
  • Arquitectura de datos: Capacidad para transformar requerimientos funcionales y técnicos en modelos de datos escalables y mantenibles.
  • Fundamentos de IA: Familiaridad con embeddings, búsqueda semántica, bases vectoriales o conceptos de RAG.
  • Autonomía y colaboración: Capacidad analítica, resolución de problemas, documentación técnica y buena comunicación con equipos interdisciplinarios.

Será un plus

  • Experiencia con Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG o arquitecturas de recuperación híbrida.
  • Conocimiento de Neo4j APOC, Graph Data Science (GDS) o Neo4j Vector Index.
  • Familiaridad con tecnologías semánticas como RDF, OWL, SKOS o SHACL.
  • Experiencia integrando Neo4j con LangChain, LlamaIndex u otros frameworks de IA.
  • Experiencia con Neo4j AuraDB, despliegues cloud o entornos contenerizados.
  • Conocimiento de NLP, extracción de entidades, procesamiento documental o enriquecimiento semántico.
  • Familiaridad con Kafka, RabbitMQ o herramientas de procesamiento distribuido.
  • Experiencia implementando pruebas automatizadas sobre grafos, validaciones de calidad de datos o herramientas de observabilidad.
  • Experiencia previa en proyectos de LegalTech, RegTech, compliance o plataformas de gestión de conocimiento.

¿Qué te ofrecemos en Darwoft?

  • Contrato full-time en relación de dependencia con pago en ARS.
  • Trabajo 100% remoto.
  • Salario competitivo.
  • Licencias legales y vacaciones.

jobs.excerpt: At Red Hat, we connect an innovative community of customers, partners, and contributors to deliver an open source stack of trusted, high-performing solutions.
jobs.description:
At Red Hat, we connect an innovative community of customers, partners, and contributors to deliver an open source stack of trusted, high-performing solutions. We offer cloud, Linux, middleware, storage, and virtualization technologies, together with award-winning global customer support, consulting, and implementation services. Red Hat is a rapidly growing company supporting more than 90% of Fortune 500 companies.


Job Summary:

The Red Hat Consulting team is looking for a Senior Container Infrastructure Consultant to join us. In this role, you will learn to design and guide implementations of Red Hat OpenShift infrastructure projects to include container and virtualization technologies. You won't be expected to know everything on day one, but your ability to learn new technology quickly will be essential. This is a remote based job that can be located anywhere in the U.S. within close proximity to an airport. Successful applicants must reside in a state where Red Hat is registered to do business.


What you will do:

  • Implement automated, containerized solutions with a focus on infrastructure concerns including networking, storage, virtualization, security, logging, monitoring, and high availability and system resilience
  • Learn new technologies quickly, including container orchestration, container registries, container build strategies, cloud storage, and software-defined networks
  • Travel frequently to work alongside leading financial services, retail, telecommunication, and institutional customers
  • After joining Red Hat, you will go through an intensive training program on Kubernetes, and OpenShift technologies and related DevOps and GitOps topics.

What you will bring:

  • Associates or Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or a technical discipline
  • Experience leading successful modern cloud platform enterprise-level projects
  • Bare-Metal Infrastructure: Deep Linux (RHEL) and automated hardware provisioning (BIOS/UEFI, RAID, BMC/Redfish, Kickstart/Cobbler).
  • Advanced Networking: L2/L3 concepts, DHCP/DNS, Load Balancing, CNI (OVN-K, Calico, SR-IOV), and network security/firewall policies.
  • Kubernetes/OpenShift: Cluster architecture, lifecycle management (IPI/UPI, Kubeadm), bare-metal deployment patterns (Metal3, Ironic), Day-2 operations, Operators, and GitOps.
  • Storage: Distributed/local storage, RAID/NVMe, performance tuning, and data management/DR (Velero, OADP, Ceph/ODF).
  • Automation & IaC: Strong proficiency in Ansible and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Helm). Scripting (Bash, Python, Go).
  • Security & Compliance: Linux/Kubernetes hardening (RBAC, SCC, network policies, TLS/PKI), and compliance standards (NIST, CIS).
  • Observability: Logging/monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and advanced platform/network troubleshooting (etcd, kernel, tcpdump).
  • Knowledge of common AddOns or third party tools. (Aria/vRealize Suite, SRM, Backup software, Performance tools)
  • Broad and deep technical experience with VMware:
    • VMWare ESXi software, including vCenter, VM lifecycle operations using VMware tools
    • Logging and Alerting functions for SRE operations available from VMware and how they integrate with non-VMware enterprise systems, such as Splunk
    • Expert level with VMware VM foundational technologies for networks ([S/DV]Switches/NSX)
    • Expert level with VMware VM foundational technologies for storage (Datastores, vSAN, vVols)
  • Additional technologies a plus: OpenStack, Red Hat Virtualization, Microsoft Hyper-V, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure
  • Experience across one or more vertical industry areas
  • Ability to lead design workshops, create clear documentation, and provide knowledge transfer for Day-0/1/2 planning.
  • Demonstrated track record of working in a strategic advisory role to senior IT and business executives
  • Applied knowledge and experience working in agile, scrum, and DevOps teams
  • Excellent written, verbal communication and presentation skills
  • Willingness to travel to customer locations about 20-30 weeks per year on average throughout North America

​Here's how your skill set will evolve and what you'll learn during your first year in the role:


At 2 months, be prepared to join a project team by acquiring the following:

  • Understanding of how to build production-ready container and virtualization platforms, integrated with existing enterprise systems
  • Knowledge of how to deploy source code into running, scalable containers and virtual machines in automated fashion at enterprise scale
  • Practical experience with our offerings

Within 6 months, be ready to implement a routine container platform project by attaining the following:

  • Successful, collaborative delivery of customer requirements using Red Hat OpenShift
  • Knowledge of how a customer use case can be developed into a project plan and how those requirements align with Red Hat’s technologies
  • Understanding of how Red Hat’s technologies can transform IT practices at large organizations

Within 12 months, begin to demonstrate technical leadership in container platforms by accomplishing the following:

  • Successfully implementing complex, large-scale container platform solutions in challenging customer environments
  • Helping other consultants implement large-scale IT solution paired with container technologies
  • Contributing lessons learned, best practices, and how-tos to our internal and external communities of practice
  • Applying new technologies, frameworks, or methodologies to container platforms
The salary range for this position is $118,600.00 - $195,680.00. Actual offer will be based on your qualifications.

Pay Transparency

Red Hat determines compensation based on several factors including but not limited to job location, experience, applicable skills and training, external market value, and internal pay equity. Annual salary is one component of Red Hat’s compensation package. This position may also be eligible for bonus, commission, and/or equity. jobs.description:
Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

You will join the team behind a leading network source-of-truth (NSoT) platform, used by thousands of organizations - from fast-growing tech companies to Fortune 500 enterprises - to model, document, and automate their network infrastructure.

CodiLime engineers work within the platform's Observability team, which builds the software responsible for network discovery and reconciliation (keeping the platform's documented network state in sync with what is actually discovered on the network), network observability and monitoring, as well as the agents and fleet management that collect data from customer networks. The team develops both closed-source and open-source components, used by the product's large community. Observability is a key part of network automation: it keeps the platform's view of the network accurate and up to date.

The platform is built AI-first, with its own Claude Code agent skills and MCP server, and that mindset carries over to how the team works: AI-assisted development is actively cultivated day to day to help the team move fast and consistently land high-quality results.

The scale is significant - some of the platform's largest customers manage hundreds of thousands of devices, each with multiple interfaces, across globally distributed environments.

As the observability offering keeps growing, the team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can strengthen coverage in US time zones.

Technology stack:

  • Programming languages: Go (primary language), Python (tests and tooling)

  • APIs: gRPC, Connect RPC, with Protobuf

  • Data & messaging: PostgreSQL (including migrations), Redis, RabbitMQ

  • Architecture: multi-tenant services, event-driven systems

  • Security: OAuth2 / OIDC

  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, metrics and instrumentation, Grafana, Prometheus

  • Network & device protocols: SNMP, gNMI, CLI-based collection, MQTT

  • Containerization & Orchestration: Docker (Docker Compose for local/test environments), Kubernetes

  • Cloud: AWS

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Ansible

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, MCP servers, Anthropic tooling

What else you should know:

  • Small, cross-functional team with strong ownership of code quality, security and tests

  • The team is distributed across Europe and the US, and we are looking for someone to strengthen coverage in US time zones (ideally Eastern Time), including customer support, production issues and on-call

  • AI tools are part of the daily workflow, including AI-assisted test writing and internal data/feed management tooling

  • This is a backend-focused role

  • Startup-like vibe: proactive, ownership-driven, fast-paced

We work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so it may happen that we’ll invite you to an interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.

Your role

As a part of the project team, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing and building Go services for network discovery and reconciliation, network observability and monitoring, and agents and fleet management

  • Designing multi-tenant ingestion pipelines for network device data, with clear delivery guarantees, idempotency and predictable behavior under load

  • Collecting device identity and state from network devices using protocols such as SNMP, gNMI and CLI

  • Building and evolving gRPC and Connect RPC APIs defined in Protobuf, and working with PostgreSQL, Redis and RabbitMQ

  • Instrumenting services with OpenTelemetry and keeping metrics clean and meaningful

  • Exploring and applying AI-assisted engineering practices - such as interactive, Claude Code-driven testing flows - to make development and testing faster and more reliable

  • Writing technical specifications with diagrams and contributing to architecture and design decisions

  • Supporting customers, production issues and on-call in US time zones

  • Writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code and participating in code reviews

Do we have a match?

As a Senior Software Engineer, you must meet the following criteria:

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience

  • Strong professional experience with Go

  • Experience with gRPC and/or Connect RPC APIs defined in Protobuf

  • Experience with PostgreSQL (including migrations), Redis and RabbitMQ

  • Experience with multi-tenant services and OAuth2 / OIDC

  • Deep knowledge of observability and instrumentation, including OpenTelemetry

  • Fluency and experience with Docker, Docker Compose

  • Experience with Kubernetes

  • Experience with event-driven systems, including at-least-once delivery and idempotent consumers

  • Solid understanding of networking: devices, configuration, protocols and layers

  • CI/CD experience (ideally GitHub Actions)

  • Hands-on, everyday use of AI coding tools (ideally Claude Code)

  • Availability to work in US time zones (ideally Eastern Time)

  • Good knowledge of English (minimum C1 level)

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the following nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with MQTT or other device/IoT protocols, or gNMI

  • Experience with Python, pytest, Django, FastAPI, REST

  • Experience with Swagger and/or Postman

  • Experience with Playwright or other E2E testing frameworks

  • Experience with Cloud computing (Ideally AWS, e.g. EC2, S3, EKS)

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

jobs.excerpt: Job Summary: At Modaxo, we're passionate about changing the face of people transportation.
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

At Modaxo, we're passionate about changing the face of people transportation. We believe that all transportation services should be safe, efficient, convenient, and equitable. Our products power mission-critical operations across a variety of industry sectors. We're making a strategic investment in AI to transform our solutions.

You will build the core services of a new enterprise AI platform - the APIs, orchestration, and data and integration on-ramps that our products build on. We ship working software on aggressive timelines; perfect is the enemy of shipped.
You'll report to the Head of AI Platform Engineering and join a small, senior founding team building the platform from the ground up.

The opportunity: build the services an entire product portfolio depends on, with a clean slate and real ownership.

Job Description:

Why this role is different

  • It's platform AND product. You build reusable platform capability while enabling product teams to ship features fast - balancing leverage with velocity.
  • It's domain-first, not tech-first. You'll learn our customers' operational domain; the best platform choices come from understanding how the work actually runs.
  • It's pragmatic build/buy. We win on integration and reliability using proven components - pragmatic decisions, not gold-plating.
  • It's a founding role - you help build the team. As an early hire you'll set the patterns, tests, and guardrails others build on, and help raise the bar as we hire.
  • It's production-first, not research-first. We ship on aggressive timelines and own what we ship.
  • It's value-based. You'll validate with product teams and customers and prioritize by value - building what moves outcomes, not what's novel.

What You'll Do

Core Platform Services

  • Design and build core backend services - APIs, orchestration, and access control - as reliable, well-tested production systems.
  • Shape API design and developer experience for internal and external consumers of the platform.
  • Contribute to the reference architecture and design records; keep boundaries clean so components stay swappable.

Multi-Tenant SaaS & Integration

  • Build for multiple customers on shared infrastructure: isolation, quotas, and usage metering done properly.
  • Build data and integration on-ramps - connector frameworks and governed data access that are idempotent and reliable at scale.

Ownership & Reliability

  • Own services end to end: design, implementation, tests, deployment, and on-call for what you ship.
  • Model failure modes explicitly - partial failure, retries, consistency, back-pressure - and design for them.

Delivering Value with Product & Customers

  • Work with product teams and customers to validate results and outcomes, prioritizing by value.
  • Take a value-based development approach: prove value with the smallest useful slice, then scale what works.
  • Instrument and measure impact; let evidence - not opinion - drive what ships.
  • Build automated QA - tests, quality gates, and regression checks - into the delivery pipeline.

Building the Team & Ways of Working

  • Help build the team: contribute to hiring, raise the bar in interviews, and mentor as we grow.
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession, and pragmatic shipping.
  • Partner with product teams across the portfolio who own their own roadmaps.

What You'll Bring

We look at demonstrated experience and scope, not years served - and we don't expect every candidate to tick every box.

  • Production distributed systems: You've built and operated production backend or distributed services that other teams depend on.
  • End-to-end ownership: You own correctness, tests, and operations for what you build.
  • Trade-off reasoning: You describe systems by the trade-offs you made, not just the technologies you used.
  • Clear communication: You explain your thinking clearly to engineers, product partners, and customers, and bring people along.
  • Value and pragmatism: You focus on outcomes and value and make pragmatic calls to ship.

Bonus Points

Any of these strengthen an application - none are required:

  • Multi-tenant SaaS: Backend services serving many customers with enforced isolation and metering.
  • Gateways & orchestration: API gateways or workflow orchestration at scale.
  • Integration frameworks: Connector or integration frameworks (API/EDI/CDC), not one-off scripts.
  • LLM-backed services: Backend work behind AI or LLM features in production.
  • Languages: Strength in C#/.NET or Python; Go a bonus.
  • Architecture experience: System/platform design and trade-off judgement - one-way vs two-way doors.
  • Enterprise scale: Experience building or operating enterprise-scale software and its reliability, security, and integration demands.
  • AI-assisted engineering: You use AI coding assistants productively and supervise their output with judgement.

New to some of this? If you bring the essentials above and are excited by the problem, we'd still like to hear from you.

Are you passionate about turning complex data into powerful business solutions? Do you enjoy designing innovative technology, solving big challenges and influencing how organisations use data and AI?

We're looking for an experienced Senior Data & AI Architect to help shape our data and AI landscape, building the platforms, capabilities and foundations that will support our future.

This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact, combining hands-on technical expertise with strategic thinking to influence how data and AI are used across our global organisation.

You'll be responsible for:

  • Shaping our data future: Designing and delivering enterprise-wide data architecture strategies that support our business ambitions.
  • Building smarter platforms: Architecting scalable, secure and high-performing data solutions across cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Bringing AI to life: Designing AI and machine learning solutions that tackle real business challenges and deliver measurable value.
  • Making data work harder: Improving existing infrastructure, optimising performance and identifying opportunities to increase efficiency.
  • Setting the standards: Establishing strong data governance, quality, security and compliance frameworks.
  • Connecting people and technology: Partnering with business leaders, engineers and data scientists to turn complex requirements into practical solutions.
  • Driving innovation: Exploring emerging technologies, challenging existing approaches and helping our teams stay ahead of the curve.
  • Sharing your expertise: Mentoring technical colleagues and helping build a culture of collaboration, learning and innovation.

​​​​​​What we’re looking for:

We're looking for someone who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to see the bigger picture. You'll be comfortable getting into the detail, but equally confident influencing stakeholders and shaping long-term technology decisions.

Ideally, you'll bring:

  • Significant experience in data architecture, data engineering or enterprise technology architecture, including leading large-scale initiatives.
  • Strong experience designing data platforms using AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
  • Expertise in data modelling, SQL, NoSQL and modern database technologies.
  • Experience with big data technologies, such as Apache Spark, Hadoop or distributed computing frameworks.
  • Programming knowledge in Python, Scala, Java or similar languages.
  • Experience architecting AI and machine learning solutions, including deploying models into production.
  • A solid understanding of data governance, security, quality and compliance.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical ideas clearly to a wide range of stakeholders.

Passion: Pride in our achievements engenders passion for our work and it translates into our ambition to make the world a safer place.

Brilliance: We strive to be the very best in everything we say and do. We exceed customers' expectations through innovation and pioneering science.

Respect: We respect gender, age, nationality, religion and individuality – our diversity is our strength.

We are committed to ensuring that every job applicant and employee is valued for their individual talents. We strictly prohibit discrimination on the basis of age, disability, race, colour, ethnic or national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership, pregnancy or parental status, religion, or belief. We proudly support an inclusive work environment where everyone can compete and succeed based on their merits.

Role Title: Computational Bioscience Expert (Python)

Pay: $60–$120/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

micro1 is seeking experienced Computational Bioscience Expert with strong, hands-on Python skills to contribute to projects focused on evaluating and improving advanced AI systems.

In this role, you will apply your scientific expertise to create, solve, and review challenging research problems within biology and related fields. You will use Python to analyze scientific data, develop reproducible solutions, validate computational results, and identify errors in technical reasoning or code.

Areas of Expertise

We are particularly interested in candidates with expertise in one or more of the following:

  1. Medicine and biomedical science
  2. Computational biology
  3. Neuroscience
  4. Molecular and cellular biology
  5. Biotechnology and bioinformatics
  6. Genetics and genomics
  7. Ecology and evolutionary biology
  8. Biostatistics or biological data science
  9. Etc.

Scope of Work

  1. Create and solve technically rigorous scientific problems within your area of expertise.
  2. Develop reproducible Python-based analyses, models, simulations, or data-processing workflows.
  3. Review scientific solutions and code for correctness, clarity, and completeness.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. PhD, MD, or master’s degree with substantial research experience in a relevant life sciences discipline.
  2. Strong scientific or applied research background demonstrated through publications, thesis work, computational projects, industry research, or equivalent accomplishments.
  3. Practical Python experience for scientific computing, data analysis, modeling, or simulation.
  4. Familiarity with tools such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, Matplotlib, scikit-learn, Jupyter, or relevant domain-specific libraries.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply..

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

Work Setup:Remote

Schedule:Must be flexible (esp. night shift)

Start Date: ASAP

As a Technical Support Engineer, you will be the key technical point of contact for customers and internal teams, providing expert support across enterprise applications, automation, APIs, and system monitoring. Your role combines customer-facing troubleshooting with deep technical problem-solving, ensuring system reliability, efficient workflows, and high-quality software

What does a day in the life of a Technical Support Engineer like?

Customer Support & Issue Resolution:

  • Provide advanced technical support for complex enterprise software issues, including automation, integrations, exports, and UI behavior.
  • Investigate and resolve customer-reported issues via tickets (SUP cases), Slack threads, and direct communications, documenting findings and resolutions.
  • Identify root causes of recurring issues and escalate critical problems to engineering with full reproduction steps, logs, and analysis.
  • Respond to escalations, including system errors, automation failures, or workflow interruptions, ensuring timely and accurate resolutions.

API & Integration Support:

  • Assist with integration of APIs such as client's API, guiding teams and customer through record creation, updates, and custom workflows.
  • Troubleshoot API errors using tools like Insomnia, Postman, or custom Python scripts.

Automation & Scripting:

  • Develop, maintain, and debug automation scripts in Python and Playwright for testing, exports, app installations, and workflow orchestration.
  • Automate repetitive tasks such as app exports, installations, and record updates to improve team efficiency.
  • Ensure automation scripts are robust, reusable, and aligned with system rules and constraints.

Quality Assurance & Testing:

  • Conduct comprehensive testing of platform features, including display blocks, dynamic/static picklists, export/import workflows, record selections, and custom aspect and etc.
  • Identify, document, and track bugs with clear steps, screenshots, logs, and environment details.
  • Perform retests to validate fixes and ensure functionality across multiple scenarios.
  • Collaborate with engineering to implement enhancements and prevent regression issues.

Monitoring & Analytics:

  • Use monitoring tools such as Datadog to analyze system logs, track recurring errors, and identify performance bottlenecks.
  • Detect patterns in system failures or automation issues and propose preventive solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineering on data-driven troubleshooting and debugging initiatives.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing:

  • Create clear, detailed technical documentation for workflows, API usage, automation scripts, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Maintain internal cheat sheets, guides, and best practices for the support team.
  • Share insights and lessons learned from ticket resolutions to improve team knowledge and operational efficiency.

Cross-functional Collaboration:

  • Coordinate with Products and Engineering to address technical issues, reproduce bugs,and validate fixes.
  • Provide support and guidance to other teams implementing integrations, automation, or advanced workflows.
  • Assist in evaluating new features and identifying potential support challenges before release.

Customer Communication & Escalations:

  • Provide clear, professional, and technical communication to customers regarding system issues, workarounds, and resolutions.
  • Track critical escalations and ensure engineering and leadership are updated on progress.
  • Maintain high customer satisfaction by balancing technical detail with actionable guidance.

What are the required qualifications for a Technical Support Engineer?

  • 3+ years of experience in SaaS software support and troubleshooting or solution architecture/implementation of SaaS software solutions.
  • Proficiency in SQL, GraphQL, APIs, JSON, and Excel/Google sheet functions
  • Familiarity with Snowflake and API tools like Postman or Insomnia
  • Familiarity with developer tools on the browser (e.g. console errors and network requests)
  • Familiarity with Python and Playwright for testing
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Datadog or similar to analyze system logs
  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science or computer engineering is plus
  • B2B SaaS startup experience is a strong plus
  • Motivated, high energy, self starter that works well independently and as part of a team of company leaders, engineers, customer support analysts, and account managers
  • Ability to learn technology quickly through instruction and hands-on self-training
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience working with account managers, external customers, technical/non-technical users, engineers, leadership, etc.)
  • Possesses strong analytical and problem solving skills with experience in investigating and resolving complex software issues.
  • Thrives in a dynamic, fast paced, customer facing environment.

  • Adherence to government-mandated benefits

  • Life Insurance
  • HMO on day 1
  • Paid time off, birthday leave
